sefc04e6fbb.en: What do peer reviewers actually look at — and how do they decide?
sefc04e6fbb.zh: 审稿人究竟在看什么——他们又是如何决定的？

s44385734a3.en: To find out, open-weight language models read every public ICLR review and split each one into pieces of reasoning. One piece — a unit — records four things: what the reviewer inspected, what they observed, the standard they judged it by, and what they concluded. This page counts 410,586 units from ICLR 2026 (98% of its reviews), read one review at a time, and 1,009,592 units from 2018–2026, read a second way that takes in each paper's whole discussion — rebuttal replies and the area chair included. Every number below is a count of units. The reading is a machine's, not a human's; the note below explains what that costs, and every plate links back to the original reviews.
s44385734a3.zh: 为了找到答案，开放权重语言模型读了每一篇公开的 ICLR 评审，并把每篇拆成若干推理片段。一个片段——一个单元——记录四件事：审稿人审视了什么，观察到了什么，依据哪条标准评判，以及得出了什么结论。本页统计了 ICLR 2026 的 410,586 个单元（覆盖其 98% 的评审），按一篇评审一次的方式读取；另有 2018–2026 年的 1,009,592 个单元，用第二种方式读取，一次读入每篇论文的整场讨论——包括 rebuttal 回复与领域主席。下文每个数字都是单元计数。这是机器的读取，不是人的；下面的须知说明这要付出什么代价，每张图版都链接回原始评审。

sbdd4b1ab6f.en: Open-weight language models read each review and split it into the separate judgments it makes. One unit records four things: the part of the paper inspected, what was observed there, the standard the reviewer judged it by, and the verdict reached. A typical review yields five or six. Every figure on this page is a count of units, so the labels are a machine's reading of the text — consistent across a million reviews, but not ground truth. The grain is a choice, too: these four parts, and the 12 × 12 taxonomy the plates sort them into, are one induced way of carving reasoning, held fixed throughout — internally consistent by the Method page's checks, but not a carving whose aptness any plate can test. A different scheme would draw a different map. Units link back to the review they came from; check them.
sbdd4b1ab6f.zh: 开放权重语言模型读取每篇评审，把它拆成其中各自独立的判断。一个单元记录四件事：论文中被审视的部分，在那里观察到的内容，审稿人评判所依的标准，以及得出的判定。一篇典型评审产出五到六个。本页每个数字都是单元计数，所以这些标签是机器对文本的读取——在一百万篇评审上保持一致，但并非真值。粒度也是一种选择：这四个部分，以及各图版据以归类的 12 × 12 分类体系，是归纳得到的一种切分推理的方式，全程保持固定——按方法页的检查，它内部一致，但其贴切性没有哪张图版能检验。换一套方案会画出另一张地图。单元链接回它们所来自的评审；请去核对。

s7c68c870f6.zh: 两次读取，并非单一语料库

s06704de391.en: The reviews were read twice, in two different ways, and the plates use whichever fits the question. ICLR 2026 was read one review at a time (410,586 units), so each unit can point at the line of the review it came from. 2018–2026 was read a second way — each paper's whole discussion in a single pass, including the replies written after the author's rebuttal and the area chair's meta-review (1,009,592 units) — which is what makes it possible to see when a judgment was made and whether it later changed. Neither is a subset of the other. Each plate's header names the years it uses; the Method page gives both pipelines in full. One more thing worth knowing before the sequence starts: the order of the plates is an editorial arrangement, made after the analyses existed, not the order in which the work was done — the Method page carries a plate-by-plate ledger of which questions were written down before the numbers existed, which plates are frankly exploratory, which we simply have no record for, and one claim that was published wrong and corrected in place. Finally, the stage-setting plates travel as overtures at the heads of the acts they serve: the calendar of one full review season opens Act V, one warning about review timing — reviews filed weeks early run harsher and longer than deadline-day ones, and no plate controls for filing time — opens Act VII as the Tide, and the venue's own census opens Act VIII.
s06704de391.zh: 这些评审被读了两遍，方式不同，各图版按问题选用其一。ICLR 2026 按一篇评审一次读取（410,586 个单元），所以每个单元都能指向它在评审中所出自的那一行。2018–2026 用第二种方式读取——每篇论文的整场讨论一次读入，包括作者 rebuttal 之后写下的回复以及领域主席的元评审（1,009,592 个单元）——正因如此，才能看到一条判断是何时做出的，以及之后是否改变。两者互不为子集。每张图版的页眉标明它所用的年份；方法页完整给出两条流水线。序列开始前还有一点值得知道：图版的顺序是编辑排布，在分析完成之后才定，并非工作进行的顺序——方法页载有一份逐图版台账，记录哪些问题在数字出现之前就已写下，哪些图版坦白说属于探索性质，哪些我们根本没有记录，以及一条曾发表有误、已就地更正的断言。最后，铺垫性的图版作为序曲置于它们所服务的各幕之首：一个完整评审季的日历开启第五幕；一条关于评审时机的警示——提前数周提交的评审比截止日当天的更严厉、更长，且没有哪张图版控制了提交时间——作为潮汐开启第七幕；会议自身的普查开启第八幕。

s89017978e7.zh: 对象 → 标准 → 判定

sca59b686a6.en: the question this project began with — recorded before any data existed — was: what do reviewers actually look at, how do they think, and how do they decide? This diagram is that question answered at its coarsest grain, and it is the closest thing the atlas has to a portrait of its subject: every act of judgment taken apart into what was inspected, the standard it passed through, and the verdict where it landed — all 410,586 units of ICLR 2026 at once. Every later plate is a slice of this picture. Each unit of reasoning was labelled three ways: the object it inspects (what part of the paper the reviewer was looking at — 12 of them), the standard it argues from (the rule the reviewer used to turn that observation into a judgment — 12 of them), and the verdict it reaches (negative, positive, mixed, conditional, or uncertain). One real unit, walked through its three labels: “A novel contribution supported by thorough empirical evaluation warrants high marks, even if some clarity issues exist” — its object is novelty (that is what was under inspection), its standard is merit recognition (the rule that strengths are credited to the score), and its verdict is positive. Every ribbon below is thousands of such triples stacked. Both label sets were induced from the reviews themselves, not chosen in advance. The couplings are the content: ribbon thickness is the strength of each bond — how many units tie an object to a standard, and a standard to a verdict — so a thick ribbon is a habit of the discipline and a thin one an exception. Hover a node to trace everything its units touch, upstream and down, and click one to read real units from it; hover any term for its definition, or see the full list.
sca59b686a6.zh: 这个项目起始于一个问题——在任何数据存在之前就已记录——审稿人究竟看什么，如何思考，又如何决定？这张图是该问题在最粗粒度上的回答，也是图谱中最接近其对象肖像的东西：每一次判断的行为都被拆开，分为被审视的东西、它所经过的标准，以及它落定的判定——ICLR 2026 全部 410,586 个单元同时呈现。之后的每张图版都是这幅图的一个切片。每个推理单元被打上三重标签：它审视的对象（审稿人在看论文的哪个部分——共 12 个），它据以论证的标准（审稿人把观察变为判断所用的规则——共 12 条），以及它得出的判定（否定、肯定、混合、有条件或存疑）。用一个真实单元走一遍这三重标签：“A novel contribution supported by thorough empirical evaluation warrants high marks, even if some clarity issues exist”——它的对象是新颖性（这是被审视的东西），它的标准是价值认可（优点计入评分的规则），它的判定是肯定。下方每条绸带都是成千上万个这样的三元组叠成的。两套标签都从评审本身归纳得出，并非事先选定。耦合才是内容：绸带粗细就是每条纽带的强度——多少单元把一个对象系到一条标准，又把一条标准系到一个判定——所以粗绸带是这个学科的习惯，细绸带是例外。悬停一个节点可以追踪其单元上下游触及的一切，点击一个节点可阅读来自它的真实单元；悬停任一术语可见其定义，或查看完整列表。

sf00e4aa404.zh: 实证范围流入设计论证标准

s27a0baec12.en: (4.8% of everything): the modal act of ICLR reviewing is asking why the experiments were set up as they were. Fourth, the bonds themselves run from tight to loose:
s27a0baec12.zh: （占全部的 4.8%）：ICLR 评审中最常见的动作，是追问实验为何如此设置。第四，纽带本身从紧到松不一：

s89219fede3.en: novelty is the most monogamous object
s89219fede3.zh: 新颖性是最专一的对象

s9a1ae8f8a0.en: — one standard (its own) carries 67% of its units and two cover 80% — while statistical rigor is the most promiscuous, spreading so widely that its top standard holds only 14% and eight are needed to cover 80%. The median object needs six. Judging what a paper is has one law; judging whether its numbers hold has many. Fifth, the strongest bonds that are not an object paired with its own namesake standard — the ones that carry information:
s9a1ae8f8a0.zh: ——一条标准（它自己的）承载其 67% 的单元，两条即覆盖 80%——而统计严谨性最为散漫，分布之广使其首位标准仅占 14%，要八条才能覆盖 80%。中位对象需要六条。评判一篇论文是什么只有一条法则；评判它的数字是否站得住则有许多条。第五，那些不是对象与其同名标准配对的最强纽带——真正携带信息的纽带：

s1392aeb246.en: half of all related-work criticism (50%, 3.3× its expected share) is argued under the novelty standard
s1392aeb246.zh: 全部相关工作批评的一半（50%，为预期份额的 3.3×）在新颖性标准下论证

sa55b59336b.en: , so the citation list is read chiefly as a claim about priority rather than a bibliography to complete;
sa55b59336b.zh: ，所以引文列表主要被读作一项关于优先权的主张，而非一份待补全的参考文献；

s82d33dde3c.en: missing citations are also read as a carelessness signal (presentation-as-trust at 2.4× base)
s82d33dde3c.zh: 缺失引文也被读作粗心的信号（表述即信任信号为基线的 2.4×）

s276565d53d.en: problem framing is the object where praise concentrates (merit recognition at 2.1× base)
s276565d53d.zh: 问题界定是称许最集中的对象（价值认可为基线的 2.1×）

sb8bbd6e451.en: — the motivation section is the field's default site of compliment.
sb8bbd6e451.zh: ——动机一节是这个领域默认的赞美之地。

s20e08591c0.en: one caution on the 71.8% level itself: the models that split reviews into units catch explicit criticism more reliably than brief praise — a passing "well written" often goes unrecorded — so the negative share is tilted upward, and it measures the reading as much as the reviewers (Appendix II reports the check). Comparisons stay safe, because every object and standard was read the same way. How each object × standard pairing resolves, cell by cell, is the map below.
s20e08591c0.zh: 关于 71.8% 这一水平本身的一点提醒：把评审拆成单元的模型，捕捉明确批评比捕捉简短称许更可靠——顺带一句的 "well written" 常常未被记录——所以否定份额被抬高了，它既在度量审稿人，也在度量读取本身（附录 II 报告了这项检查）。比较仍然安全，因为每个对象与标准都是以同一方式读取的。每个对象 × 标准配对逐格如何落定，见下方地图。

So a deep red cell means: when a reviewer examines this part of a paper under this rule, the judgment almost always ends in criticism; a pale cell means that pairing tends to end well for the author. Hover any cell for its exact share and unit count; one cell of the 144 (novelty × the reproducibility norm, 36 units) is too thin to read and is hatched grey rather than coloured.
s79482e5549.zh: 同样的 144 个对象 × 标准配对，排成网格：行是对象，列是标准，每格按该配对的单元中以否定判定收尾的占比着色。于是，深红格的意思是：审稿人用这条规则审视论文的这一部分时，判断几乎总以批评告终；浅色格则表示该配对对作者而言通常收尾良好。悬停任一格可见其确切占比与单元数；144 格中有一格（新颖性 × 可复现性规范，36 个单元）太薄，读不出结果，画成灰色斜纹而未着色。

s967ead1997.en: , where no other object exceeds 35%. That squares with Fig. 1a's fifth result: a citation list is read as a claim about priority, and there is no standard under which that claim is usually granted.
s967ead1997.zh: ，而其他对象没有一个超过 35%。这与图 1a 的第五条结果相符：引用列表被读作关于优先权的主张，而没有哪条标准通常会认可这一主张。

sab9741c8eb.en: the wall of red is also a reminder that the pipeline records explicit criticism more readily than passing praise — the level is tilted; the comparisons between cells are what to trust.
sab9741c8eb.zh: 这片红墙也提醒读者：流水线记录明确批评比记录顺带的称许更容易——水平仪有倾斜；可信的是格子之间的比较。

s97f0833ce5.en: Fig. 1c — The instrument, checked against the venue’s own gauges
s97f0833ce5.zh: 图 1c — 仪器，对照会议自身的量规校验

sca36275f0c.en: ICLR asks its reviewers for three sub-scores of their own. Where this atlas’s categories and those gauges should agree, they do —
sca36275f0c.zh: ICLR 要求审稿人另给三项子评分。本图谱的类别与那些量规应当一致之处，二者确实一致——

sfc44aeb97e.zh: 批评清晰度的评审在会议的表述量规上低 0.35 分，总评分相同

sd035fdd6cb.en: — and the one place they part is itself a finding.
sd035fdd6cb.zh: ——而二者分道的唯一一处，本身就是一项发现。

s212823ef1c.en: CELL = SUB-SCORE GAP, CRITICIZED VS NOT, AT FIXED OVERALL RATING · 1–4 SCALE · ICLR 2026
s212823ef1c.zh: 格 = 子评分差，受批评 vs 未受批评，总评分固定 · 1–4 分制 · ICLR 2026

s7902fe8ccc.en: every plate that follows leans on these twelve categories. Their induction is documented in the method pages; this figure is the check a reader can hold in one glance — the taxonomy against a rubric it never saw, collected by the venue itself.
s7902fe8ccc.zh: 此后每张图版都依赖这十二个类别。它们的归纳过程记录在方法页；这张图是读者一眼就能握住的校验——把分类体系对照一份它从未见过、由会议自己收集的评分表。

s81a8860c87.en: rows are the twelve objects of scrutiny; columns are ICLR’s own three sub-scores (soundness, presentation, contribution, each rated 1–4 by the same reviewer). A cell is the gap in mean sub-score between reviews that criticise that object and reviews that do not, measured inside each overall-rating level and then averaged — so a review’s general harshness is held fixed, and what remains is where the reviewer’s own gauges dip. If the twelve labels were arbitrary, no gauge would care which object was criticised: every cell would sit near zero. Rows are ordered by their deepest dip.
s81a8860c87.zh: 行是十二个审视对象；列是 ICLR 自己的三项子评分（严谨性 soundness、表述 presentation、贡献 contribution，由同一位审稿人各打 1–4 分）。一格是批评该对象的评审与未批评的评审之间子评分均值的差，在每个总评分档内测量后再取平均——于是评审的整体严厉程度被固定，剩下的就是审稿人自己的量规在哪里下沉。若这十二个标签是任意的，任何量规都不会在意批评的是哪个对象：每格都会接近零。行按最深的下沉排序。

sf9bb36597c.en: agreement where agreement is owed: clarity criticism dents presentation (−0.35, the sharpest cell of the map, four times any other), novelty criticism dents contribution (−0.12, that column’s deepest), and the evidence dockets — reproducibility, statistics, baselines — dent soundness most. Two smaller marks are worth the detour. Theory criticism dents presentation three times harder than soundness (−0.07 vs −0.02): “I could not follow the theory” is filed, by reviewer or by reading, as a writing complaint rather than a rigor complaint. And a clarity charge sits slightly higher on contribution (+0.04): at the same rating, a paper faulted for its prose keeps its ideas’ credit.
sf9bb36597c.zh: 该一致之处确实一致：清晰度批评压低表述（−0.35，全图最锐的一格，是其他任何格的四倍），新颖性批评压低贡献（−0.12，该列最深），而证据类案卷——可复现性、统计、基线——压低严谨性最多。两处较小的印记值得绕道一看。理论批评压低表述的力度是压低严谨性的三倍（−0.07 vs −0.02）：“I could not follow the theory” 无论出自审稿人还是出自机器读取，都被归档为写作方面的抱怨，而非严谨性方面的抱怨。清晰度指控在贡献上反而略高（+0.04）：同一评分下，因文字受责的论文仍保住其想法的功劳。

s4b22e39d3f.en: sub-scores exist only in recent forms, so this check runs on ICLR 2026 alone (74,380 reviews); it is association at fixed rating, not causation; and the gauge cannot split the reviewer from the instrument — “theory filed as writing” may be the reviewer’s habit, the model’s reading, or both. What it does establish is that the categories carry the venue’s own distinctions, not just the model’s.
s4b22e39d3f.zh: 子评分只存在于近年的评审表单中，所以这项校验仅在 ICLR 2026 上运行（74,380 篇评审）；它是固定评分下的关联，并非因果；而且量规无法把审稿人与仪器分开——“理论被归入写作” 可能是审稿人的习惯，可能是模型的读法，也可能两者皆有。它确立的是：这些类别承载了会议自身的区分，而不只是模型的区分。

s381e63b1d3.en: Plate I showed which objects reviewers inspect and which standards they argue from. Are the two coupled? For each object: how is its criticism argued?
s381e63b1d3.zh: 图版 I 展示了审稿人审视哪些对象、依据哪些标准论证。二者是否耦合？对每个对象：针对它的批评是如何论证的？

s8a002c6797.en: if any standard could be applied to any part of a paper, the standard label would carry no information — which would in turn empty out the later plates that compare reviewers by the rule they invoked. That consequence is a reason to check the coupling, not the reason this plate was built; it is one of the first things we drew. Every row is one object, divided by the standards used on it. A deep diagonal is the discipline judging each thing by its own rule; the off-diagonal cells are where one subject is judged by another subject's standard. One motive for showing nine years of movement this early, in Fig. 2b: if these couplings drifted freely year to year, the plates that pool nine years of data later would rest on sand — 2b is the stability check that licenses them.
s8a002c6797.zh: 如果任何标准都能用于论文的任何部分，标准标签就不携带信息——这又会掏空后面那些按所援引规则比较审稿人的图版。这一后果是检查耦合的一个理由，但这张图版并非因它而建；它是我们最早画出的图之一。每一行是一个对象，按用于它的标准切分。深色对角线是学界用每件事物自己的规则评判它；对角线之外的格子，是一个主题被另一个主题的标准评判。这么早就在图 2b 展示九年的移动，动机之一在于：若这些耦合逐年自由漂移，后面汇合九年数据的图版就建在沙上——2b 是准许它们这样做的稳定性检验。

scb7b04c856.en: Five of twelve objects answer chiefly to their own law; the rest are judged under borrowed ones — design justification above all.
scb7b04c856.zh: 十二个对象中有五个主要服从自己的法则；其余的在借来的法则下受审——首推设计论证。

s32a2583863.en: this grid is not a new dataset either — it is a third view of the same 144 object × standard pairings as Plate I: the sankey drew them as ribbons, the severity map coloured each by how it ends, and this one colours each by how common it is within its row. Frequency is exactly what this plate's question — are object and standard coupled? — needs: if any standard could be applied to any object indifferently, every row of this map would be the same stripe pattern — each column simply at that standard's corpus-wide share — and knowing the object would tell you nothing about the rule. Coupling is the departure from that: rows with individual profiles, each object concentrating its units on its own few standards. That departure is what the map shows everywhere — no two rows match. Each row is one object of scrutiny; cells are the share of that object's units argued under each standard, row-normalized, deeper brass for more. The one cell too thin to read (novelty × the reproducibility norm, 36 units) is hatched grey here as everywhere. If the object/standard distinction feels slippery here — what separates novelty the object from the novelty standard? — two real units about the same object show it. The object is what the reviewer was looking at; the standard is the rule the argument runs on. “Lack of sufficient differentiation from prior art undermines contribution” looks at novelty and argues from the novelty standard — the rule that being distinct from prior work is itself the requirement. “A novel contribution supported by thorough empirical evaluation warrants high marks, even if some clarity issues exist” looks at the same object but argues from merit recognition — the rule that strengths should be credited to the score. Same subject, two different laws; this plate counts how often each law is the one applied.
s32a2583863.zh: 这张网格同样算不上新数据集——它是与图版 I 相同的 144 个对象 × 标准配对的第三种视图：桑基图把它们画成流带，严厉度图按各自的结局着色，这一张则按每个配对在其所在行内有多常见着色。频率正是本图版的问题——对象与标准是否耦合？——所需要的：如果任何标准都能不加区分地用于任何对象，这张图的每一行都会是同一种条纹——每一列只是该标准在全语料中的占比——知道对象也就对规则一无所知。耦合就是对此的偏离：各行有各自的轮廓，每个对象把单元集中在自己的少数几条标准上。这种偏离在图上处处可见——没有两行相同。每一行是一个审视对象；格子是该对象的单元在各标准下论证的占比，按行归一化，占比越高，黄铜色越深。那一格太薄读不出的（新颖性 × 可复现性规范，36 个单元）在此处和别处一样画成灰色斜纹。如果对象/标准之分在这里显得滑溜——作为对象的新颖性与新颖性标准有何区别？——两条关于同一对象的真实单元可以说明。对象是审稿人在看的东西；标准是论证所依的规则。“Lack of sufficient differentiation from prior art undermines contribution” 看的是新颖性，依新颖性标准论证——即「与先前工作有别本身就是要求」这条规则。“A novel contribution supported by thorough empirical evaluation warrants high marks, even if some clarity issues exist” 看的是同一对象，却依价值认可论证——即「优点应计入评分」这条规则。同一主题，两条不同的法则；本图版统计的是每条法则被采用的频率。

sfe817d12a1.en: counting each row's most-used law: five objects are judged first by their own named standard — novelty (67%), clarity (48%), robustness (33%), compute cost (32%), reproducibility (31%) — while
sfe817d12a1.zh: 统计每一行最常用的法则：五个对象首先由与其同名的标准评判——新颖性（67%）、清晰度（48%）、鲁棒性（33%）、计算成本（32%）、可复现性（31%）——而

s86a3eb4c36.en: design justification is the most-used law for four others (empirical scope, method design, theory, statistical rigor)
s86a3eb4c36.zh: 设计论证是另外四个对象（实证范围、方法设计、理论、统计严谨性）最常用的法则

s790660311d.en: ; the citation list answers first to the novelty standard (50%), and problem framing to merit recognition (29%). Even the tightest coupling is far from total: novelty argues a third of its units under other laws, and
s790660311d.zh: ；引用列表首先服从新颖性标准（50%），问题界定首先服从价值认可（29%）。即便最紧的耦合也远非全部：新颖性有三分之一的单元在其他法则下论证，而

s6934ecc341.en: statistical rigor uses its nearest-named standard, identifiability, for just 9% of its units
s6934ecc341.zh: 统计严谨性对名称最接近的标准（可辨识性）的使用仅占其单元的 9%

s98680f90bd.en: — the standard label carries information the object's name does not.
s98680f90bd.zh: ——标准标签携带着对象名称所没有的信息。

sd92f03cb7f.en: treat diagonal brightness as bookkeeping, not certainty — several standards are name-twins of their objects (novelty and the novelty standard, robustness and the robustness norm), and for those cells a deep diagonal is partly analytic, since both labels can be responses to the same sentence; the evidence lives in the off-diagonal mass — statistical rigor judged by identifiability, empirical scope answering to the claim-evidence matching norm — and in how the whole grammar moved (Fig. 2b).
sd92f03cb7f.zh: 把对角线的亮度当作记账，不要当作确证——有几条标准与其对象同名（新颖性与新颖性标准，鲁棒性与鲁棒性规范），对这些格子而言，深色对角线有一部分是定义使然，因为两个标签可能是对同一句话的回应；证据在对角线之外的主体中——以可辨识性评判的统计严谨性、服从主张与证据范围匹配规范的实证范围——也在整个语法如何移动之中（图 2b）。

sf4769af31b.en: Fig. 2b — The grammar's nine years: where P(standard | object) itself moved
sf4769af31b.zh: 图 2b — 语法的九年：P(standard | object) 本身在哪里移动

s3c719e6216.en: The grammar is a habit, not a fashion:

sd883120e40.en: 138 of 144 cells stay inside the shuffle floor
sd883120e40.zh: 144 格中有 138 格落在置换底线之内

s705a975212.en: — and what little moved was mostly ground the novelty standard gave up.
s705a975212.zh: ——而那一点移动，多半是新颖性标准让出的地盘。

s6788773f8e.en: THE FIRST OF THREE NINE-YEAR VERDICTS — this map says the coupling grammar barely moved. Act VIII returns to the same question twice more: what reviewers attend to did move (Plate XXVI), and what the stated law of novelty says did not (Plate XXVII).
s6788773f8e.zh: 三项九年裁决中的第一项 — 这张图说：耦合语法几乎没动。第八幕还会两次回到同一问题：审稿人关注什么确实动了（图版 XXVI），而新颖性的成文法则所说的内容没有动（图版 XXVII）。

s8e5ff974c6.en: Fig. 2a is a still photograph — the coupling as it stands now. The plate's question has a natural second half: is that grammar a fixed habit of the discipline, or has it been drifting? This figure answers with the same matrix, except each cell now shows the change in P(standard | object) from the earliest era the corpus covers (2018–19, 32,257 units) to the current one (2025–26, 606,120 units).
s8e5ff974c6.zh: 图 2a 是一张静态照片——耦合当下的样子。本图版的问题有一个自然的后半：这套语法是学界固定的习惯，还是一直在漂移？这张图用同一个矩阵作答，只是每格现在显示的是 P(standard | object) 从语料覆盖的最早时代（2018–19，32,257 个单元）到当前时代（2025–26，606,120 个单元）的变化。

sd1993dba3e.en: if the grammar were fixed, the two eras would differ only by sampling noise — so the noise is measured rather than assumed: shuffle the era labels within each object and redraw the map, and in 95% of 50 relabelings even the single largest cell change stays within ±4.05 percentage points. Cells inside that floor are dimmed to near-invisibility; under the null, this entire map would fade to the unmarked page.
sd1993dba3e.zh: 若语法固定不变，两个时代只会因抽样噪声而不同——所以噪声是测出来的，而非假定的：在每个对象内部打乱时代标签并重画这张图，50 次重新标注中有 95% 的情况下，连最大的单格变化也落在 ±4.05 个百分点之内。落在这条底线之内的格子被压暗到近乎不可见；在零假设下，整张图会褪成一张空白的纸页。

s8768ff8378.en: brass = the standard gained jurisdiction over that object, violet = it lost it; deeper is a larger move; hover any cell for its early and current shares. (Those shares come from the nine-year labeling run, whose levels differ somewhat from Fig. 2a's 2026 corpus — this map's subject is the change within one consistent pipeline, not the levels.)
s8768ff8378.zh: 黄铜色 = 该标准对这一对象获得了管辖权，紫色 = 失去了管辖权；颜色越深，移动越大；悬停任一格可见其早期与当前占比。（这些占比来自九年标注运行，其水平与图 2a 的 2026 语料略有不同——这张图的主题是同一条流水线内部的变化，而非水平本身。）

sb85045a783.en: 138 of the 144 cells stay inside the shuffle floor: across nine years in which the corpus grew almost nineteen-fold, the grammar mostly did not move. Six cells did. Two are specialization —
sb85045a783.zh: 144 格中有 138 格落在置换底线之内：九年间语料增长近十九倍，语法大体没动。有六格动了。两格是专门化——

s13b0f08102.en: compute cost consolidated onto the cost-benefit standard (25.9% → 34.6%)
s13b0f08102.zh: 计算成本集中到成本收益标准（25.9% → 34.6%）

s37b3337675.zh: 可复现性集中到自己的规范（28.9% → 33.8%）

s91d3717d16.en: . Three sit in a single row:

s15f84761e9.en: problem framing's leading law, merit recognition, extended its lead (22.5% → 30.2%) while the novelty standard (21.7% → 15.4%) and presentation trust (11.4% → 7.2%) receded
s15f84761e9.zh: 问题界定的首要法则价值认可扩大了领先（22.5% → 30.2%），而新颖性标准（21.7% → 15.4%）与表述信任（11.4% → 7.2%）退却

sbc6ea7fd56.en: related work also slipped away from the novelty standard (34.7% → 28.6%)
sbc6ea7fd56.zh: 相关工作也从新颖性标准滑落（34.7% → 28.6%）

sc0c9761752.en: A share can move for boring reasons — reviews now arrive in structured Strengths/Weaknesses templates, and framing units are indeed praise more often than they were (30% → 39% positive), which by itself inflates merit recognition, the crediting rule. So each mover was re-checked within criticism and praise separately. Merit recognition's gain does shrink under that control but survives (+6.3pp among praise units alone); every other mover passes untouched — the novelty standard recedes among critical and praising units alike (−4.5pp and −5.4pp on problem framing, −4.3pp and −7.7pp on related work), and cost-benefit gains most inside critical units (+10.3pp), where a mere change of tone could not put it. Reading the units confirms that the rules themselves did not change meaning: a 2018 cost unit argues “fair comparison requires accounting for all computational resources consumed” and a 2025 one “overhead claims must be backed by runtime experiments” — the same law, reached for more often. What these checks cannot exclude is a quieter drift in phrasing that the labeling model reads as a different rule; every level here rests on one model's reading, applied uniformly to both eras.
sc0c9761752.zh: 份额的变动可能出于平淡的原因——评审如今按结构化的 Strengths/Weaknesses 模板写成，问题界定单元确实比过去更常表现为称许（肯定占比 30% → 39%），这本身就会抬高价值认可这条记功规则的份额。因此每个变动项都在批评与称许内部分别复核。价值认可的增幅在这一控制下有所收缩，但仍然成立（仅在称许单元中就有 +6.3pp）；其余每个变动项都原样通过——新颖性标准在批评与称许单元中同步退却（问题界定上 −4.5pp 与 −5.4pp，相关工作上 −4.3pp 与 −7.7pp），成本收益的最大增幅出现在批评单元内部（+10.3pp），单纯的语气变化不可能把它放到那里。通读这些单元可以确认，规则本身的含义没有变：一条 2018 年的成本单元主张 “fair comparison requires accounting for all computational resources consumed”，一条 2025 年的则称 “overhead claims must be backed by runtime experiments”——同一条法则，只是被援引得更频繁。这些检验无法排除的，是措辞上更隐蔽的漂移，标注模型会把它读成另一条规则；此处每一层都依赖同一个模型的读取，均匀施于两个时代。

se1c2473cd4.en: after the checks, the drift sorts into three grades of confidence. Firmest: the quiet specializations — cost and reproducibility questions each acquired their own law — and the novelty standard's retreat from the two objects next door to it, framing and citations, which holds among critical and praising units alike. To be read more gently: the swing toward merit recognition, the one mover that partly reflects the era's style of reviewing — praise now arriving in its own labelled section — and only partly a change in which rule judges framing. And the widest finding is the stillest one: 138 cells, nine years, a corpus grown nineteen-fold, and no movement that shuffling the era labels could not have drawn.
se1c2473cd4.zh: 经过这些检验，漂移按置信度分成三等。最稳固的一等：静默的专门化——成本与可复现性问题各自获得了自己的法则——以及新颖性标准从紧邻它的两个对象（问题界定与引用）上的退却，这在批评与称许单元中同样成立。须更审慎去读的一等：向价值认可的摆动，它是唯一部分反映了这个时代评审风格的变动项——称许如今写在自己的标注栏目里——只有一部分是评判问题界定的规则变了。范围最广的发现也最安静：138 个格子，九年，语料增长十九倍，没有一处变动是打乱时代标签后画不出来的。

saa11c267b7.en: the two plates before this recorded what a reviewer judged and which rule they judged by. Neither says anything about the shape of the argument — whether the reviewer asserted a norm, reported that a check could not be made, offered a competing explanation, or weighed the evidence the paper offered. Two criticisms can share an object and a standard and still be different acts. So this plate classifies the argument itself: not just which standard fires, but the shape the reviewer's reasoning takes. Six forms, assigned to all 1,009,592 units of the nine-year corpus, 2018–2026 (the second of the two readings described above: whole discussions, not single reviews) by a locally-trained classifier (no API, no keywords-only shortcut). The six are defined below the figure title, each with a real unit from the corpus. Where the six come from matters: they are induced from examples, not written in advance. A first pass noticed recurring argument language in real units — without X…, should…, could be an artifact…, compared to prior work…, beyond this setting… — and used those surface markers to draw a stratified sample. The analyst then hand-read 600 of its units and wrote the codebook against the text (eight codes, merged to six), overruling the markers freely: within marker-flagged units the hand code agreed with the marker’s suggestion only 61% of the time, and the corpus’s largest form — on-balance weighing — has no marker at all; it emerged from the unflagged residue. A classifier scales that reading to the full corpus. One defensible carving of the space, not the only one; the caption owns the method and its error.
saa11c267b7.zh: 前两张图版记录了审稿人评判的是什么，以及他们依据哪条规则评判。两者都没有说明论证的形状——审稿人是在主张一条规范、报告某项检查无法进行、提出一种竞争解释，还是在权衡论文所给的证据。两条批评可以共享同一审视对象与同一标准，却仍是不同的行为。所以这张图版给论证本身分类：不只看哪条标准被触发，还看审稿人推理所取的形状。六种形式，由一个本地训练的分类器（不调用 API，也不走仅靠关键词的捷径）赋予2018–2026 九年语料的全部 1,009,592 个单元（即上文所述两种读法中的第二种：完整讨论，而非单篇评审）。六种形式的定义列在图题之下，每种各附一条来自语料的真实单元。这六种从何而来很重要：它们从样例中归纳得到，并非事先写定。第一遍扫读注意到真实单元里反复出现的论证语言——without X…, should…, could be an artifact…, compared to prior work…, beyond this setting…——并用这些表层标记抽取分层样本。分析者随后手读其中 600 个单元，对照文本写出编码手册（八个编码，合并为六个），并随时推翻标记：在被标记命中的单元中，人工编码与标记的提示只有 61% 的时候一致；而语料中最大的形式——权衡——根本没有标记，它从未被命中的剩余部分中浮现。分类器把这一读法扩展到整个语料。这是对该空间的一种站得住的切分，不是唯一的一种；图注承担方法及其误差。

s1bcbcd6beb.en: Fig. 3 — The voice of each standard — six argument forms, all 1,009,592 units
s1bcbcd6beb.zh: 图 3 — 每条标准的声音 — 六种论证形式，全部 1,009,592 个单元

scdd4cd3dcb.en: Five of the six argument forms almost always criticize. When praise comes, nearly four times out of five (78.8%) it arrives as on-balance weighing.
scdd4cd3dcb.zh: 六种论证形式中有五种几乎总是在批评。称许出现时，五次中近四次（78.8%）以权衡的形式到来。

sb3899b89ac.en: NORM — the reviewer asserts a bar the paper must clear. “Clear problem framing is essential for evaluating contribution.”
sb3899b89ac.zh: 规范 — 审稿人主张一条论文必须达到的门槛。“Clear problem framing is essential for evaluating contribution.”

s10bdb13358.en: CAN’T-VERIFY — a check the reviewer needs cannot be made from what the paper provides. “Without variance metrics, limited performance improvements cannot be assessed for significance.”
s10bdb13358.zh: 无法核验 — 审稿人需要的某项检查，无法凭论文所给的内容完成。“Without variance metrics, limited performance improvements cannot be assessed for significance.”

sc5808bf543.en: PRECEDENT — prior work is held against the paper. “If the core contributions are already present in cited prior work, the novelty claim is weakened.”
sc5808bf543.zh: 判例 — 先前工作被拿来对照论文。“If the core contributions are already present in cited prior work, the novelty claim is weakened.”

s31e1c21582.en: SCOPE — the claim is asked how far it carries. “Strong assumptions limit the method’s generalizability to real-world data with feature correlations.”
s31e1c21582.zh: 范围 — 追问该主张能推及多远。“Strong assumptions limit the method’s generalizability to real-world data with feature correlations.”

s6a02b0c2be.en: RIVAL-CAUSE — another explanation could produce the same result. “Performance differences may reflect training budget artifacts rather than method ceilings.”
s6a02b0c2be.zh: 竞争解释 — 另一种解释也能产生同样的结果。“Performance differences may reflect training budget artifacts rather than method ceilings.”

sf2f3f3162e.en: ON-BALANCE — the evidence offered is weighed and found sufficient or wanting. “Improved clarity increases value, but broader experimental validation is needed to confirm generalizability.”
sf2f3f3162e.zh: 权衡 — 对所给证据加以权衡，判定其充分或不足。“Improved clarity increases value, but broader experimental validation is needed to confirm generalizability.”

s170b963f00.en: EACH BAR = THAT STANDARD’S UNITS, SPLIT BY ARGUMENT FORM
s170b963f00.zh: 每条横条 = 该标准的单元，按论证形式拆分

sf0086c2c22.en: each row is one reasoning standard; its bar splits that standard’s units by the argument form the classifier assigned, and the right column names the dominant form. The plate’s question — does each standard have a voice? — is answered by how far the rows depart from sameness: if the shape of an argument had nothing to do with the rule it runs on, every bar here would show the same six-way split, the corpus-wide mix (37% on-balance, 30% norm, 13% scope, 8% precedent, 6% rival-cause, 6% can’t-verify) — drawn as the dimmed first bar, so each row's departure from it is the finding.
sf0086c2c22.zh: 每一行是一条推理标准；其横条按分类器赋予的论证形式拆分该标准的单元，右栏标出占主导的形式。图版的问题——每条标准是否各有其声？——由各行偏离一致的程度来回答：如果论证的形状与它所依据的规则无关，这里每条横条都会呈现同样的六分格局，即全语料的混合比例（权衡 37%，规范 30%，范围 13%，判例 8%，竞争解释 6%，无法核验 6%）——画成淡显的第一条横条，各行对它的偏离即是发现。

se01eb2682a.en: the rows are nothing like the uniform mix.
se01eb2682a.zh: 各行与均匀混合相去甚远。

s2985e6c91e.zh: 可复现性有 69% 是纯粹的规范援引

s924a14ae43.en: statistical identifiability leads with the can’t-verify form at 43%
s924a14ae43.zh: 统计可辨识性以无法核验形式领先，占 43%

s7ea7323d85.en: — more than seven times that form’s corpus-wide share — the form that says a check the reviewer needs cannot be made, as in the 2019 unit “Without error bars, it is impossible to assess if differences are statistically significant”; and
s7ea7323d85.zh: ——是该形式全语料份额的七倍以上——这种形式说的是审稿人需要的某项检查无法进行，如 2019 年的这条单元 “Without error bars, it is impossible to assess if differences are statistically significant”；以及

s52512ad4fd.en: no standard cites precedent as often as the novelty standard
s52512ad4fd.zh: 没有哪条标准像新颖性标准那样频繁援引判例

s7d132f9326.en: (29% of its units — though even there, on-balance weighing leads the row). On-balance is also where the mercy lives:
s7d132f9326.zh: （占其单元的 29%——不过即便在那里，权衡仍领先该行）。权衡也是宽宥所在之处：

s1d7dfcc2c5.en: it is the only form in which praise occurs at scale
s1d7dfcc2c5.zh: 它是唯一有大规模称许出现的形式

s125db2db2a.en: (42% positive, and 78.8% of all praise in the corpus takes this one form; the other five forms run 88–97% negative).
s125db2db2a.zh: （肯定占 42%，语料中全部称许有 78.8% 采用这一种形式；其余五种形式的否定占比为 88–97%）。

sb0c651d34a.en: 600 units labeled by the analyst (an LLM reading each sentence), merged to six forms; the example quoted beside each form above is one of those 600 gold units, verbatim. A logistic classifier over local embeddings plus surface-marker features (5-fold CV accuracy 0.685, macro-F1 0.666; the weakest class is the precedent-citing form, at F1 0.53 — read its cells gently) then labels the full corpus. A cheaper second annotator agreed with the gold labels only 42% of the time and was excluded — the construct is genuinely interpretive, and these are one consistent reading at scale, not ground truth.
sb0c651d34a.zh: 由分析者（一个逐句阅读的 LLM）标注 600 个单元，合并为六种形式；上文每种形式旁所引的示例，都是这 600 条金标单元之一，原文照录。随后由一个基于本地嵌入加表层标记特征的逻辑回归分类器（5 折交叉验证准确率 0.685，macro-F1 0.666；最弱的类别是援引判例的形式，F1 为 0.53——读其格子时须留余地）为全部语料打标。另一个更廉价的第二标注者与金标只有 42% 的一致率，已被排除——这一构念确属解释性的，这些结果是同一种读法在规模上的一致应用，并非真值。

s58d8e42b46.en: the six-way split is one model's reading of a genuinely interpretive construct (macro-F1 0.666, weakest on precedent-citing) — trust the shape of each row against the corpus-mix bar above more than any single cell's exact share.
s58d8e42b46.zh: 六分格局是一个模型对一种确属解释性构念的读取（macro-F1 0.666，在援引判例上最弱）——与其相信任何单个格子的精确份额，不如相信各行相对上方全语料混合横条所呈现的形状。

s99990ec27c.en: what one reviewer sets down, alone · plates IV–VI
s99990ec27c.zh: 一位审稿人独自写下的内容 · 图版 IV–VI

sf575b4f366.en: The next two plates ask one question through three windows — when a review is read in the order it was written, does position carry information? — and a reader meeting the three analyses in a row may fairly ask what separates them. The answer is the window. Below is the same review three times: each stack is one review's units in written order, coloured by the section of the review form they sit in — strengths, weaknesses, questions, the same colours the plates ahead use for positive, negative, and hedged verdicts. The bright part is what that plate reads; the fine print beneath names the chance level its ×-numbers are measured against. Click a panel to jump to its plate. And one adjustment of expectations, made honestly up front: these three windows mostly find weak or negative results. The strongest order in a review turns out to belong to the review form, not the reviewer; the grammar hunt comes back nearly empty; what survives — who gets the first word of the criticism — is real but modest. The plates keep these results because the absences are informative: knowing that judgment has almost no syntax is worth as much as a syntax would have been.
sf575b4f366.zh: 接下来的两张图版透过三扇窗问同一个问题——按写作顺序读一篇评审时，位置是否携带信息？——连续遇到这三项分析的读者有理由问，它们之间有何区别。答案是窗。下面是同一篇评审出现三次：每一叠是一篇评审的单元按写作顺序排列，按它们所处的评审表单栏目着色——Strengths、Weaknesses、Questions，与后面图版用于肯定、否定与有所保留的判定的颜色相同。亮起的部分就是那张图版所读取的；其下的小字标明其 × 倍数所对照的机会水平。点击某一面板可跳到对应图版。还有一项对期望的调整，先坦白说在前面：这三扇窗找到的大多是微弱或否定的结果。评审中最强的顺序原来属于评审表单，而非审稿人；语法搜寻几乎空手而归；留存下来的——谁在批评中拿到第一句话——真实但有限。图版保留这些结果，因为缺席本身有信息量：知道评判几乎没有句法，与找到一种句法同样有价值。

s9f7971c7ad.en: The search for a syntax finds almost none
s9f7971c7ad.zh: 寻找句法，几乎一无所获

s65d4edaceb.en: Plate III sorted every unit into six argument forms. Do the forms care what comes next? For every review, count which form follows which between consecutive units, and compare against a null that preserves the review's own composition — so a common form cannot masquerade as an attractive one.
s65d4edaceb.zh: 图版 III 把每个单元归入六种论证形式。这些形式在意接下来是什么吗？对每篇评审，统计相邻单元之间哪种形式跟在哪种之后，再与一个保留该评审自身构成的零模型比较——这样常见的形式就无法伪装成有吸引力的形式。

s68a2d55943.en: Fig. 4a — The transition table, as departure from each review's own mix
s68a2d55943.zh: 图 4a — 转移表，以相对各评审自身混合比例的偏离表示

s8ed1a4e106.en: The grammar hunt comes back nearly empty: no transition beats chance by more than 18% — and the little structure that remains looks like the review template, not a way of thinking.
s8ed1a4e106.zh: 语法搜寻几乎空手而归：没有一种转移超出机会水平 18% 以上——剩下的少许结构看起来像评审模板，而非一种思维方式。

s21f71f7f7a.en: WHO SPEAKS FIRST, WHO LAST — the flanking OPENS / CLOSES columns ask of the six argument forms what the next plate’s prologue will ask of the twelve subjects: who gets the first word of a review, and who the last.
s21f71f7f7a.zh: 谁先开口，谁最后 — 两侧的 开场 / 收尾 栏对六种论证形式提出的问题，正是下一张图版的序章将对十二个审视对象提出的：谁拿到评审的第一句话，谁拿到最后一句。

s056e5c13db.en: CELL = LIFT VS. EACH REVIEW’S OWN SHUFFLED MIX · 1.00 = ORDER CARRIES NO INFORMATION
s056e5c13db.zh: 格子 = 相对各评审自身打乱后混合比例的提升 · 1.00 = 顺序不携带信息

s4784815f6c.en: each cell is a lift: how often one argument form actually follows another, divided by how often it would if each review's own units were shuffled — so 1.00 means order carries no information, and if the forms did not care what comes next, the entire table would sit at 1.00. Sienna marks a following that happens more than the review's own mix predicts, verdigris less; the flanking columns give each form's share of opening and closing positions.
s4784815f6c.zh: 每个格子是一个提升值：一种论证形式实际跟在另一种之后的频率，除以把各评审自身单元打乱后它本应出现的频率——因此 1.00 表示顺序不携带信息；如果各形式不在意接下来是什么，整张表都会停在 1.00。赭色标出比该评审自身混合比例所预测的更常出现的接续，铜绿色标出更少的；两侧的栏给出各形式在开场与收尾位置上的份额。

sb7a872e590.en: the finding is an absence. No cell leaves the 0.80–1.18 band: once a review's own mix of forms is fixed, knowing the current form changes the odds of the next one by at most ±20% — argument order is nearly memoryless. If reviewer reasoning had a real syntax, the way sentences do, cells here would run to several times chance; nothing comes close. What little structure survives:
sb7a872e590.zh: 发现是一处缺席。没有一个格子离开 0.80–1.18 区间：一旦固定了某篇评审自身的形式混合比例，知道当前形式对下一形式几率的改变至多 ±20%——论证顺序近乎无记忆。如果审稿人的推理像句子那样有真正的句法，这里的格子会达到机会水平的数倍；没有一个接近。仅存的少许结构：

s6b4951d49b.en: a form is most attracted to itself (rival-cause follows rival-cause at 1.18, scope follows scope at 1.18)
s6b4951d49b.zh: 一种形式最吸引它自己（竞争解释接竞争解释为 1.18，范围接范围为 1.18）

s52364ae968.en: every other form mildly resists being followed by on-balance (0.80–0.95)
s52364ae968.zh: 其余每种形式都轻微抵制被权衡接续（0.80–0.95）

s98c40c017c.en: on-balance opens 38.5% of reviews against its 30.5% share of all units
s98c40c017c.zh: 权衡在 38.5% 的评审中开场，而它在全部单元中的份额为 30.5%

sc547855a9d.en: — eight points above chance — while closing shares sit near every form's baseline (largest deviation: norm, +1.7pp).
sc547855a9d.zh: ——高出机会水平八个百分点——而收尾份额都贴近各形式的基线（最大偏离：规范，+1.7pp）。

s7bf284124e.en: read even that residue with suspicion: reviews are written into a template — a summary up front, strengths and weaknesses in blocks — and the template alone would produce exactly these traces. The on-balance-first opening matches the summary-section convention, and same-form runs match section blocks. So the honest reading is not "reasoning has a grammar" but the reverse: we went looking for one, found almost nothing, and what remains is plausibly the architecture of the review form rather than of thought. Forms from the Plate III classifier (CV accuracy 0.685); transitions pool 183,717 reviews, 829,684 units.
s7bf284124e.zh: 即便这点残余也要带着怀疑去读：评审是填进模板写成的——开头一段总结，Strengths 与 Weaknesses 各成一块——单凭模板就会产生恰好这样的痕迹。以权衡开场对应总结栏的惯例，同形式连串对应栏目分块。所以诚实的读法与“推理有一套语法”相反：我们去找过，几乎一无所获，剩下的多半是评审表单的架构，而非思维的架构。形式来自图版 III 的分类器（交叉验证准确率 0.685）；转移统计汇集 183,717 篇评审、829,684 个单元。

s3345a74d75.en: Corpus: ICLR 2026 · prologue: all 410,586 units in written order · itinerary: 192,085 units anchored to their exact line
s3345a74d75.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 · 序章：全部 410,586 个单元按写作顺序 · 行程：192,085 个锚定到确切行的单元

sbc224a95cd.en: Criticism is written in an order

s68fe8a746d.en: this plate reads the review as a document written in order — in two passes. The prologue takes the widest possible window, the whole review first unit to last; one source of regularity there is known before looking — the ICLR review form itself is ordered, strengths before weaknesses, questions at the end — so much of what the prologue finds is the form’s script, not the reviewer’s, and its captions separate the two where the data allows. The itinerary then strips that scaffolding away: in the 2026 reading every unit records the line of the review it came from, so the [weaknesses] section can be isolated and read on its own — a window inside which the form dictates no order at all. Whatever regularity survives there is the community’s own habit, not the template’s. One honest limit before reading: this is the order of the written document, not necessarily the order of thinking — a review is composed, and a reviewer may reorder, template, or polish before submitting. What the plate can claim is that the writing has strong conventions. (Plate IV asked the same kind of question of the argument forms and found almost none; here the subject matter is what carries the order.) The quantities, in plain terms. Prologue: for each of the twelve objects, an opening lift and a closing lift — how often that object is a review’s first (or last) unit, divided by how often it appears anywhere, so a frequently-raised object cannot look like a favourite opening move just by being common — and the verdict arc: each review with three or more units cut into fifths by position, each fifth’s units sorted by verdict — negative, positive, or hedged, the pooled name used here for conditional, uncertain, and mixed judgments. Itinerary: the bill of faults — a fault is a unit whose cited line falls inside the review’s [weaknesses] section, and for each subject the chart shows where its faults sit within that section, plus how often the subject is written first against random ordering (asked, beside each row, is the share of the subject’s units raised in the [questions] section instead) — and the traveling companions: across consecutive units, which subjects follow one another, and which mostly just share a review.
s68fe8a746d.zh: 本图版把评审当作一份按顺序写成的文档来读——分两遍。序幕取最宽的窗口，从第一个单元到最后一个单元读完整篇评审；那里有一个规律来源在看数据之前就已知——ICLR 评审表本身有序，先 strengths 后 weaknesses，questions 在末尾——所以序幕所见多半是评审表的脚本，而非审稿人的脚本，其图注在数据允许处把两者分开。行程随后拆掉这层脚手架：在 2026 年的读取中，每个单元都记录了它来自评审的哪一行，因此 [weaknesses] 部分可以单独隔出来读——在这个窗口内，评审表不规定任何顺序。那里留存下来的任何规律，都是社区自己的习惯，而非模板的。阅读前先说一条限制：这是书面文档的顺序，未必是思考的顺序——评审是写成的，审稿人提交前可能重排、套模板或润色。本图版能断言的是，写作有很强的惯例。（图版 IV 对论证形式问过同类问题，几乎一无所获；这里承载顺序的是论题本身。）各量的直白说明。序幕：对十二个对象中的每一个，给出开篇提升度与收尾提升度——该对象作为评审第一个（或最后一个）单元的频率，除以它在任意位置出现的频率，这样一个常被提起的对象不会仅因常见就显得像惯用开篇——以及判定弧线：每篇含三个或以上单元的评审按位置切成五等分，每一等分的单元按判定归类——否定、肯定或有保留，后者是此处对有条件、存疑与混合判断的合并称呼。行程：过失清单——过失指所引行落在评审 [weaknesses] 部分内的单元，图表对每个主题显示其过失在该部分内的位置，以及该主题相对随机排序被先写的频率（每行旁的提问，是该主题的单元转而在 [questions] 部分提出的占比）——以及旅伴：在相邻单元之间，哪些主题彼此接续，哪些大多只是共处一篇评审。

s1047888591.en: Prologue · The Script — the whole review, where the form writes first
s1047888591.zh: 序幕 · 脚本 — 整篇评审，评审表先落笔之处

s325c42309e.en: Fig. 5a — Opening move vs closing move, by object (lift vs base rate)
s325c42309e.zh: 图 5a — 开篇 vs 收尾，按对象（提升度 vs 基准率）

s65161b1aa6.en: Reviews open on what the paper is — framing at 1.86× its base rate, novelty 1.57× — and close on clarity (1.81×), related work, and reproducibility.
s65161b1aa6.zh: 评审以论文是什么开篇——问题界定为基准率的 1.86×，新颖性 1.57×——以清晰度（1.81×）、相关工作和可复现性收尾。

s91add2a493.en: SAME QUESTION AS FIG. 5a's FLANKING COLUMNS — first and last word, now for subjects rather than argument forms, as a ×chance ratio. the itinerary below re-cuts the opening end inside the weaknesses list alone, where the form imposes no order.
s91add2a493.zh: 与图 5a 两侧列相同的问题 — 首尾之言，此处针对主题而非论证形式，以“×随机”倍率表示。下方的行程仅在 weaknesses 清单内重新切分开篇一端，评审表在那里不规定顺序。

s86f89c45e6.en: OPENS — how often this subject is a review's first unit, divided by its share of all units; right of the rule = a favourite opening move
s86f89c45e6.zh: 开篇 — 该主题作为评审第一个单元的频率，除以它在全部单元中的占比；竖线右侧 = 惯用开篇

s1a8031f6df.en: CLOSES — the same ratio for the last unit; the vertical rule is ×1, where position tells you nothing
s1a8031f6df.zh: 收尾 — 最后一个单元的同一比值；竖线为 ×1，位置在此不提供任何信息

sc0caeda9e0.en: Fig. 5b — The arc of a review
sc0caeda9e0.zh: 图 5b — 一篇评审的弧线

sd72ee2b011.en: Warm open, hard middle (82% negative at its peak), softened close — an arc the review form itself writes: strengths first, weaknesses in the middle, questions at the end.
sd72ee2b011.zh: 温和开篇，严厉中段（峰值处 82% 为否定），软化收尾——这条弧线由评审表自身写就：strengths 在前，weaknesses 居中，questions 在末。

sb7490b2c82.en: one row per object of scrutiny, sorted by opening lift; the horizontal axis is the lift defined in the lede, drawn on a log scale so ×2 sits as far right of the ×1 rule as ×0.5 sits left of it. The legend above the chart names the two marks; hover a row for exact values.
sb7490b2c82.zh: 每个审视对象一行，按开篇提升度排序；横轴是导语中定义的提升度，取对数刻度，使 ×2 在 ×1 竖线右侧的距离等于 ×0.5 在其左侧的距离。图表上方的图例标出两种标记；悬停某行可见精确数值。

sc2ccecfc59.en: problem framing opens a review 1.86× more often than its overall share predicts
sc2ccecfc59.zh: 问题界定作为评审开篇的频率，是其总体占比所预测的 1.86×

s425003e40d.en: (5.5% of first units against 3.0% of all units), with novelty (1.57×) and method design (1.37×) behind it; the closing end belongs to clarity (1.81×), related work (1.66×) and reproducibility (1.41×). No subject claims both ends, and statistical rigour — a plausible guess for a closing subject — closes exactly at its base rate (1.00×) while avoiding the opening (0.63×).
s425003e40d.zh: （占首单元的 5.5%，对比占全部单元的 3.0%），新颖性（1.57×）与方法设计（1.37×）紧随其后；收尾一端属于清晰度（1.81×）、相关工作（1.66×）和可复现性（1.41×）。没有主题同时占据两端，统计严谨性——一个看似合理的收尾候选——恰在其基准率处收尾（1.00×），却避开开篇（0.63×）。

s87f214d1c4.en: How much of this is the form?
s87f214d1c4.zh: 其中有多少是评审表的作用？

s2554d16994.en: The whole-review cut mixes the strengths section into the opening, and that matters most for the top row: when problem framing opens a review, 49% of the time it opens as praise — "the paper tackles an important problem" is the classic first strength. Recomputed over negative units only, asking which subject the criticism starts with, problem framing's lift drops to 1.34× while novelty's sharpens to 1.65× (89% of novelty's openings are objections). The closing side barely moves under the same check — clarity 1.81 → 1.77, related work 1.66 → 1.65, reproducibility 1.41 → 1.40 — so closing on clarity is a habit of the criticism itself, the "minor points" tail; and those closing clarity units are asserted, not asked (78% negative, 8% hedged). The opening result is also confirmed below: Fig. 5c makes the same cut independently, never leaving the weaknesses section, and finds novelty leading off the listed faults at 1.62× against the 1.65× here — two cuts, one habit.
s2554d16994.zh: 全评审切分把 strengths 部分混进了开篇，这对首行影响最大：问题界定开篇时，49% 的情况是以称许开篇——"the paper tackles an important problem" 是经典的第一条优点。仅对否定单元重算，问批评从哪个主题开始，问题界定的提升度降到 1.34×，新颖性则升至 1.65×（新颖性开篇中 89% 是异议）。同一检验下收尾一侧几乎不动——清晰度 1.81 → 1.77，相关工作 1.66 → 1.65，可复现性 1.41 → 1.40——所以以清晰度收尾是批评本身的习惯，即 "minor points" 的尾巴；这些收尾的清晰度单元是断言而非提问（78% 否定，8% 有保留）。开篇结果也在下文得到确认：图 5c 独立做了同一切分，从未离开 weaknesses 部分，发现新颖性以 1.62× 领衔所列过失，对比此处的 1.65×——两种切分，一个习惯。

s1edce36925.en: the horizontal axis is position within the review in fifths; each curve is the share of that fifth's units carrying one verdict — negative, positive, or hedged (the dashed line; conditional, uncertain, or mixed, as defined in the lede) — pooled over the reviews with three or more units, so the three curves sum to 100% in every fifth. If position carried no information, all three curves would run flat at their overall share; every bend is the finding.
s1edce36925.zh: 横轴是评审内的位置，按五等分；每条曲线是该等分中带某一判定的单元占比——否定、肯定或有保留（虚线；即导语所定义的有条件、存疑或混合）——在含三个或以上单元的 篇评审上合并计算，因此三条曲线在每一等分中之和为 100%。若位置不携带信息，三条曲线都会平铺在各自的总体占比上；每一处弯折就是发现。

s96c75da832.en: the negative share runs 70% in the opening fifth, peaks at 82% in the middle, and falls to 60% at the close. Praise does something different from a mirror image: 26% of opening-fifth units are positive, collapsing to 6% by the third fifth and 5% in the fourth, then only half-returning (13%) at the close.
s96c75da832.zh: 否定占比在开篇等分为 70%，中段峰值 82%，收尾降到 60%。称许的走势并非镜像：开篇等分 26% 的单元为肯定，到第三等分跌至 6%，第四等分 5%，收尾只回升一半（13%）。

s3bd1f0f2e9.en: What actually grows toward the end is the hedged share — monotonically, 3% → 27%
s3bd1f0f2e9.zh: 真正随末尾增长的是有保留的占比——单调上升，3% → 27%

s5630231dd8.en: Most of it, and that is the honest reading: ICLR's template asks for strengths before weaknesses and questions at the end. The warm opening is the strengths section passing by; the hard middle is the weaknesses section (93.4% of weaknesses-section units are negative — Fig. 5c documents this); and the close softens less because warmth returns than because assertion gives way to questions — it is the hedged curve, not the positive one, that claims the final fifth. The arc is better read as the form's script, executed in near-unison across the corpus, than as a rhetorical choice each reviewer makes.
s5630231dd8.zh: 大部分都是，这也是坦率的读法：ICLR 的模板要求先 strengths 后 weaknesses，questions 在末尾。温和的开篇是 strengths 部分经过；严厉的中段是 weaknesses 部分（weaknesses 部分 93.4% 的单元为否定——图 5c 记录了这一点）；收尾的软化，主要因为断言让位于提问，而非温情回归——占据最后一个等分的是有保留曲线，而非肯定曲线。这条弧线更宜读作评审表的脚本在整个语料中近乎齐声执行，而非每位审稿人各自做出的修辞选择。

s8daac280aa.en: this describes where in a document a kind of judgment tends to be written down; it is not evidence about the order in which the reviewer thought, or decided.
s8daac280aa.zh: 这描述的是某类判断倾向于写在文档的哪个位置；它不构成关于审稿人思考或决定顺序的证据。

s9dc30c2aa0.en: The Itinerary — inside the weaknesses list, where the form imposes no order
s9dc30c2aa0.zh: 行程 — weaknesses 清单内部，评审表不规定顺序之处

s0c122eb011.en: Fig. 5c — The bill of faults: what a reviewer lists first
s0c122eb011.zh: 图 5c — 过失清单：审稿人最先列出什么

sd27f8d66ee.en: What a paper is — novelty, framing — gets objected to first (novelty leads the bill at 1.6× chance); how it is measured — statistics, reproducibility — comes last (0.7×).
sd27f8d66ee.zh: 论文是什么——新颖性、问题界定——最先被质疑（新颖性以随机的 1.6× 领衔清单）；它如何被度量——统计、可复现性——排在最后（0.7×）。

sf30787c1ea.en: SAME RATIO, NARROWER WINDOW — the dot column is the same “written first, ×chance” ratio as the prologue's OPENS (Fig. 5a above) — computed here inside the weaknesses list only, so the review form's section order cannot produce it.
sf30787c1ea.zh: 同一比值，更窄窗口 — 圆点列是与序幕的“开篇”（上方图 5a）相同的 “先写，×随机” 比值——此处仅在 weaknesses 清单内计算，因此评审表的分区顺序无法产生它。

se0a598899c.en: Fig. 5d — Traveling companions: which subjects share a review
se0a598899c.zh: 图 5d — 旅伴：哪些主题共处一篇评审

sd9f480096d.en: Mostly company, not sequence: theory fills the reviews it enters, while novelty is said once —
sd9f480096d.zh: 多为结伴，少有接续：理论一进入评审便铺满全篇，新颖性只说一次——

s16a2b48f3a.en: 97% of reviews that raise it never return to it
s16a2b48f3a.zh: 提出它的评审中 97% 不再回到它

s2ad7189ca5.en:
SOURCE itinerary-data.json → mention.novelty.once_share
DERIVATION share of reviews mentioning novelty that mention it exactly once = 0.9655 ≈ 97%
VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25
s2ad7189ca5.zh:
来源 itinerary-data.json → mention.novelty.once_share
推导 提到新颖性的评审中恰好只提一次的占比 = 0.9655 ≈ 97%
已核验 已对照上线的 JSON 核对，2026-08-25

sde3654fca5.en: “Written first, ×chance” — the dot column: one quantity, three states
sde3654fca5.zh: “先写，×随机” — 圆点列：一个量，三种状态

s08a1992f46.en: OPENS — dot right of the ×1 line: written first more often than random ordering (≥1.15×; the lede defines the ratio)
s08a1992f46.zh: 开篇 — 圆点在 ×1 线右侧：比随机排序更常被先写（≥1.15×；比值定义见导语）

s5566817bd3.en: DEFERS — dot left of the line: less often (≤0.85×)
s5566817bd3.zh: 后置 — 圆点在线左侧：更少被先写（≤0.85×）

sf19674a8ff.zh: 中性 — 靠近该线（±15% 以内）

s9cb95af022.en: “Asked” — the bar column: a separate measure, which section
s9cb95af022.zh: “提问” — 条形列：另一个度量，落在哪个部分

s2dce02fa98.en: ASKED — bar length: the share of the subject’s units raised in the [questions] section instead of the weaknesses list
s2dce02fa98.zh: 提问 — 条长：该主题的单元中在 [questions] 部分而非 weaknesses 清单中提出的占比

s573734a0cf.en: “Fault” throughout = a unit whose cited evidence line falls inside the review’s [weaknesses] section — defined by place, not tone (93.4% of them are negative, most of the rest conditional).
s573734a0cf.zh: 全文的“过失” = 所引证据行落在评审 [weaknesses] 部分内的单元——按位置而非语气定义（其中 93.4% 为否定，其余大多为有条件）。

seb2de706b6.en: NODE — one subject; circle size = its share of the corpus’s units
seb2de706b6.zh: 节点 — 一个主题；圆的大小 = 它在语料全部单元中的占比

s59245e15e0.en: HALO — dwell: how often a unit is followed by another about the same subject, versus corpus-wide chance; drawn only above ×1.12, thicker = stronger (theory ×1.9 wears the thickest; novelty, below chance, has none)
s59245e15e0.zh: 光环 — 驻留：一个单元之后紧接同一主题另一单元的频率，相对全语料随机水平；仅在 ×1.12 以上绘出，越粗 = 越强（理论 ×1.9 最粗；新颖性低于随机，没有光环）

s444fc1b2d5.en: CHORD — two subjects that follow one another above chance (lift ≥ 1.1 in either direction, ≥ 1,600 successions); thicker = more successions, denser = further above chance
s444fc1b2d5.zh: 弦 — 彼此接续高于随机的两个主题（任一方向提升度 ≥ 1.1，接续 ≥ 1,600 次）；越粗 = 接续越多，越浓 = 越高于随机

s46e791e05b.en: SPARK — animation tracing the chords, faster = stronger pull; hover any node to isolate its connections
s46e791e05b.zh: 火花 — 沿弦运行的动画，越快 = 牵引越强；悬停任一节点可单独显示其连接

s14600348e9.en: each row is one object of scrutiny; the ribbon is where its criticisms sit inside the weaknesses section (left edge = the section's first line, right edge = its last); the ribbon's height at any point is the share of that subject's faults falling at that depth of the section, each row scaled to its own peak — so compare shapes and positions, not absolute heights across rows. The brass tick marks the median position. Everything is computed over the 30,869 reviews with two or more line-anchored faults. One shape is shared by every row and means nothing: the spike at the left edge. A list's first item sits at its start, so each review deposits exactly one fault at position zero — with ~3.9 faults per review, a quarter of all faults (25.0%) are some review's opener. The signal is not the spike but who claims that opening slot beyond their share — the dot column — and the shape after it. If the order of writing carried no information, every ribbon would center on the same spot and every lead-off lift would sit at 1.0; neither happens. Lead-off lift compares how often an object is the first fault listed against its overall share of faults:
s14600348e9.zh: 每行是一个审视对象；色带表示其批评在 weaknesses 部分内的位置（左缘 = 该部分第一行，右缘 = 最后一行）；色带在任一点的高度是该主题的过失落在该部分该深度的占比，每行按自身峰值缩放——所以请比较形状与位置，勿跨行比较绝对高度。黄铜色刻度标出中位位置。一切都在含两条或以上有行锚定过失的 30,869 篇评审上计算。有一种形状每行共有且没有意义：左缘的尖峰。清单的第一项位于起点，所以每篇评审都在位置零恰好留下一条过失——每篇评审 ~3.9 条过失，全部过失的四分之一（25.0%）是某篇评审的开篇。信号在于谁超出自身占比占据了那个开篇位——圆点列——以及尖峰之后的形状，而非尖峰本身。若书写顺序不携带信息，每条色带都会居中于同一点，每个领衔提升度都会落在 1.0；两者均未发生。领衔提升度比较一个对象作为所列第一条过失的频率与其在全部过失中的总体占比：

s0af3dfbfba.en: novelty objections open the bill 1.6× more often than their base rate and sit earliest in the section
s0af3dfbfba.zh: 新颖性异议开启清单的频率是其基准率的 1.6×，且在该部分中位置最早

s1d35f597b6.en: , with problem framing (1.4×) and method design (1.2×) behind them, while statistics, robustness, and reproducibility are filed toward the end (0.7×). The chip's second number, asked, is a different axis — not where in the weaknesses list, but whether the subject lands there at all — and the two ends line up: novelty, written first, is also the least often softened into a question (9%, the lowest of the twelve), while robustness, written last, is the most often asked rather than asserted (29%). Between the extremes the trend is loose, but the ends are clean: what is written first is asserted; what is deferred is questioned. One candidate reading of that split: questions go where an answer could change something — a missing detail, an absent error bar — while novelty, which no rebuttal can repair, is asserted outright. Read descriptively: the order of the bill mirrors how the community's writing habits arrange criticism — identity-level objections first, measurement-level objections later — not a ranking of importance by any one reviewer. And one rival explanation for the order itself cannot be excluded: reviewers may simply write objections in the order the paper presents its material — novelty and framing live in a paper's opening pages, statistics and reproducibility in its experiments — so the bill may mirror the paper's own table of contents as much as any habit of judgment. One tempting explanation can be checked and set aside: the ICLR 2026 Reviewer Guide contains no novelty-first checklist — its step-by-step opens with clarity, technical correctness, and reproducibility, the very objections reviewers file last — so the observed order is a habit of the community's prose, not an echo of the instructions.
s1d35f597b6.zh: ，问题界定（1.4×）与方法设计（1.2×）紧随其后，而统计、鲁棒性和可复现性被归到末尾（0.7×）。标牌上的第二个数字提问是另一条轴——它衡量该主题是否根本落在 weaknesses 清单里，与清单内的位置无关——两端对得上：最先被写的新颖性，也最少被软化为问题（9%，十二项中最低），而最后被写的鲁棒性，最常以提问而非断言的方式出现（29%）。两极之间趋势松散，但两端干净：先写的被断言；后置的被提问。对这一分野的一种候选解读：问题落在答案能改变些什么的地方——缺失的细节、缺席的误差棒——而没有任何 rebuttal 能修复的新颖性，则被直接断言。请作描述性解读：清单的顺序映照的是社区写作习惯如何安排批评——身份层面的异议在前，度量层面的异议在后——并非任何一位审稿人的重要性排序。而对顺序本身的一种竞争解释无法排除：审稿人可能只是按论文呈现材料的顺序写异议——新颖性与问题界定在论文的开头几页，统计与可复现性在实验部分——所以清单映照的既可能是评判习惯，也同样可能是论文自身的目录。有一种诱人的解释可以核查后放下：ICLR 2026 Reviewer Guide 中没有新颖性优先的清单——其分步指引以清晰度、技术正确性和可复现性开头，恰是审稿人最后提交的那些异议——所以观察到的顺序是社区文风的习惯，而非指南的回声。

s55b1f51788.en: the twelve objects sit on a ring, sized by how much of the corpus they occupy; a halo marks dwell — how often a unit is followed by another about the same subject, against corpus-wide chance (theory 1.9×; novelty 0.72×, the only subject below chance). Chords join subjects that follow one another across 336,206 consecutive-unit pairs more often than independence predicts (lift ≥ 1.1 in either direction, at least 1,600 successions joined):
s55b1f51788.zh: 十二个对象排成一环，大小按其在语料中所占份额；光环标出驻留——一个单元之后紧接同一主题另一单元的频率，相对全语料随机水平（理论 1.9×；新颖性 0.72×，唯一低于随机的主题）。弦连接那些在 336,206 对相邻单元中彼此接续频率高于独立性预测的主题（任一方向提升度 ≥ 1.1，且至少 1,600 次接续）：

scd7da724a3.zh: 清晰度与相关工作同行（1.9×）

s2b3f35563f.en: , compute cost with robustness (1.3×), statistics with reproducibility (1.25×). Hover a node to isolate its connections. One apparent paradox is worth disarming:
s2b3f35563f.zh: ，计算成本与鲁棒性同行（1.3×），统计与可复现性同行（1.25×）。悬停节点可单独显示其连接。有一个表面上的悖论值得拆解：

s6041bb33a0.en: the biggest node, empirical scope, has no chord at all
s6041bb33a0.zh: 最大的节点实证范围没有任何弦

s34c3c359c1.en: — not because it travels alone but because it travels with everyone. At 21.8% of all units it follows and precedes every subject at almost exactly that subject's base rate (its strongest pairing reaches just 1.03× chance), and a companion to all is a companion to none in particular.
s34c3c359c1.zh: ——原因在于它与所有主题同行，而非独行。它占全部单元的 21.8%，跟在每个主题之后、走在每个主题之前的频率几乎恰等于该主题的基准率（其最强配对仅达随机的 1.03×），与所有人为伴，便与谁都不算特别为伴。

sba86f455b5.en: What this order is — and is not
sba86f455b5.zh: 这个顺序是什么——又不是什么

s310fa965a2.en: the baseline here is corpus-wide chance, not the stricter within-review shuffle of Fig. 5a, and the difference matters: re-run under Fig. 5a's null, the halos flatten to 0.94–1.29 — subject adjacency is as weak as form adjacency — and even novelty's repulsion inverts (1.20); the small panel beneath the ring draws that collapse, subject by subject. So the ring is mostly a map of company, not sequence: theory reads dense because theory-heavy reviews contain many theory units, and the strongest chords are subjects that share reviews. The fact that survives either reading lives at the review level: 41% of reviews that raise theory raise it again, while 96.5% of reviews that raise novelty say it exactly once — the highest one-mention rate of the twelve. Three candidate readings, offered as hypotheses. Theory's fullness is consistent with proof-checking being sequential work: a derivation read step by step can raise an objection at every step, so one theory reading yields several units where a novelty comparison yields one. At the other pole, the identity subjects — novelty, framing, related work — are said once in over 92% of the reviews that raise them, as if a verdict needs stating, not developing. And the strongest adjacency that survives the stricter null belongs to baselines-and-ablations (1.29): missing-baseline requests read like enumeration, one item after the next. All three readings are hypotheses against the weaker null; under Fig. 5a's stricter shuffle only the baselines adjacency survives, so the ring should be read as a map of company, not of sequence.
s310fa965a2.zh: 这里的基线是全语料的随机水平，而非图 5a 那种更严格的评审内打乱，差别要紧：在图 5a 的零假设下重跑，光环压平到 0.94–1.29 — 主题相邻与形式相邻一样微弱 — 连新颖性的排斥也反转了（1.20）；环下方的小面板逐主题画出了这一坍缩。所以这个环主要是一张共现的地图，而非序列的地图：理论显得密集，是因为理论为主的评审含有许多理论单元，而最强的弦是共处同一条评审的主题。两种读法下都成立的事实在评审层面：提出理论的评审中 41% 会再提一次，而提出新颖性的评审中 96.5% 只说一次 — 十二个对象中最高的单次提及率。三种候选读法，作为假设提出。理论的饱满与证明核对是逐步的工作相符：一条推导一步步读下去，每一步都可能引出异议，于是一次理论阅读产出多个单元，而一次新颖性比较只产出一个。另一极是身份类主题 — 新颖性、问题界定、相关工作 — 在提出它们的评审中超过 92% 只说一次，仿佛裁决只需陈述，无需展开。而在更严格的零假设下仍存活的最强相邻属于基线与消融（1.29）：缺失基线的请求读起来像清单，一项接一项。三种读法都是相对较弱零假设而言的假设；在图 5a 更严格的打乱下，只有基线的相邻存活，所以这个环应读作共现的地图，而非序列的地图。

sd79c6015ac.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 · 74,380 条有评分的评审

s1378ddb3cd.en: The score counts the verdicts — it barely reads the topics
s1378ddb3cd.zh: 评分数的是判定 — 几乎不读主题

sc3ca602b69.en: every 2026 review was cut down to its first k units, and a logistic classifier was trained on that stub alone — the objects those units inspect and whether each came out negative or positive — to guess whether the reviewer's rating was 6 or higher. Sweeping k from one unit to fifteen, and scoring each fit by three-fold cross-validation, shows how much of a review you have to read before your guess stops improving. Because half of all reviews run to five units or fewer, the same sweep is run again on the 2,649 reviews that run to ten units or more, where "does the rest add anything?" is a real question rather than an artefact of reviews running out.
sc3ca602b69.zh: 把每条 2026 年的评审截到前 k 个单元，仅凭这段开头 — 这些单元审视的对象，以及每条的判定是否定还是肯定 — 训练一个逻辑回归分类器，猜测审稿人的评分是否达到 6 或更高。把 k 从一个单元扫到十五个，每次拟合用三折交叉验证打分，就能看出要读多少评审，猜测才不再改进。因为一半的评审只有五个单元或更少，同一扫描又在长达十个单元或以上的 2,649 条评审上重跑一遍，在那里“其余部分还有增益吗？”是一个真问题，而非评审写完了所致的伪象。

s826a72eff0.en: that the opening beats a coin flip is not a finding — 72% of units are negative and the score tracks negativity, and the target is the same writer's own rating, so panel ① below is the expected part, drawn for scale. The findings are the other three panels: where the climb stops, what it is made of — and what one negative weighs.
s826a72eff0.zh: 开头能胜过掷硬币，这不算发现 — 72% 的单元是否定的，评分随否定程度走，而目标又是同一位执笔者自己的评分，所以下方面板 ① 是预料之中的部分，画出来只为给出尺度。发现在另外三个面板：攀升在哪里停下，它由什么构成 — 以及一条否定有多重。

s1dd09de16b.en: Fig. 6a — Verdict readability against units read
s1dd09de16b.zh: 图 6a — 裁决可读性随已读单元数

s80dbd0a56e.zh: 评分是一份加权的计数：

sff0f31b26d.en: a novelty negative counts ×2.4 the average, a robustness negative ×0.4
sff0f31b26d.zh: 一条新颖性否定计为平均值的 ×2.4，一条鲁棒性否定为 ×0.4

s96678bcc79.en: — the same price order Plate XIV’s tariff will find — yet the count alone does almost all the ranking, and nothing after the ninth unit changes it.
s96678bcc79.zh: — 与图版 XIV 的量刑表将要发现的价目顺序相同 — 然而单凭计数就完成了几乎全部排序，第九个单元之后再无改变。

sfbc67e5da0.en: NOT A FOURTH WINDOW — Plates IV–V described where things are written; this plate weighs how much the opening alone already tells you about the score. The first slot's privileged status there becomes a number here.
sfbc67e5da0.zh: 不是第四个窗口 — 图版 IV–V 描述了东西写在哪里；本图版衡量的是只看开头已经能告诉你多少关于评分的信息。第一槽位在那里的特权地位，在这里变成一个数字。

sed28d5d9fa.en: the four panels share one currency: AUC, the chance the classifier ranks a randomly picked 6-or-above review over a randomly picked lower one — 0.5 is a coin flip, and height or length above the coin-flip mark is the signal. ① is the cumulative climb: the horizontal axis is how many units the classifier was allowed to read, the filled area its lead over chance, the dashed line what the whole review achieves. ② is the same sweep differentiated, on the long reviews only: each bar is the AUC gained by reading one more unit — the first unit's +0.23 is off the scale and stated in the corner; bars turn pale where the gain dies. ③ decomposes the whole review's AUC — verdicts alone, then topics added, then a third bar that abandons the unit features entirely and reads every word (TF-IDF over the full text). ④ asks what one negative unit weighs: a logistic fit on whole-review per-topic negative counts, each bar the pull of one negative of that topic on the score, expressed as a multiple of the average negative's pull — the dashed line is ×1, an average negative.
sed28d5d9fa.zh: 四个面板共用一种货币：AUC，即分类器把随机抽取的一条 6 分或以上的评审排在随机抽取的一条更低评审之前的概率 — 0.5 是掷硬币，高出或长出掷硬币线的部分就是信号。① 是累积攀升：横轴是允许分类器读取的单元数，填色面积是它对随机水平的领先，虚线是整条评审能达到的水平。② 是同一扫描的差分，仅限长评审：每根柱是多读一个单元所增加的 AUC — 第一个单元的 +0.23 超出刻度，标注在角上；增益消失处柱子转淡。③ 分解整条评审的 AUC — 仅判定，再加入主题，第三根柱则完全放弃单元特征，读取每一个词（全文 TF-IDF）。④ 问一条否定单元有多重：对整条评审的各主题否定计数做逻辑回归拟合，每根柱是该主题一条否定对评分的拉力，以平均否定拉力的倍数表示 — 虚线是 ×1，即一条平均否定。

s8233143132.en: the findings are ③ and ④, read together. The verdicts buy +0.260 of the +0.279 climb and the topics +0.019 (in the long subset, −0.006 — nothing but noise). Yet the tally is genuinely weighted: one novelty negative counts as 2.4 average negatives — six robustness negatives — and the ordering of these weights reproduces the within-paper tariff of Plate XIV almost exactly (Spearman ρ = 0.90): two designs, one price list. (In the model's own units, a novelty negative is −1.04 log-odds toward a sub-6 rating; the method page carries the details.) Both facts hold at once because so little of the between-review variance rides on composition — weighting the tally beats the plain count by just +0.009 AUC. Topic-blind for ranking, priced for each unit. The words themselves reach 0.822 (TF-IDF, so a floor, not a ceiling, on what the text carries) — more than the coarse profile (+0.043) — and even so, a wide residual stays outside every reading here; Plate XXV will show how much of it is the reviewer, not the review. ② the ninth unit still pays a sliver; from the tenth, nothing — even with fifteen units on the page, the tail is redundant with the head (the few-thousandths jitter is cross-validation noise). ① is the expected part, drawn for scale:
s8233143132.zh: 发现在 ③ 和 ④，须合起来读。+0.279 的攀升中，判定买下 +0.260，主题买下 +0.019（在长评审子集里是 −0.006 — 纯属噪声）。然而这份计数确实是加权的：一条新颖性否定相当于 2.4 条平均否定 — 相当于六条鲁棒性否定 — 且这些权重的排序几乎精确复现了图版 XIV 的论文内量刑表（Spearman ρ = 0.90）：两种设计，一张价目表。（按模型自身的单位，一条新颖性否定是朝低于 6 分方向的 −1.04 对数优势；细节见方法页。）两个事实同时成立，因为评审间方差极少依赖构成 — 加权计数只比朴素计数多出 +0.009 AUC。就排序而言不看主题，就每条单元而言各有标价。词本身达到 0.822（TF-IDF，所以这是文本所载信息的下限而非上限）— 高于粗粒度的画像（+0.043）— 即便如此，一大块残差仍在此处的每一种读法之外；图版 XXV 将展示其中有多少属于审稿人而非评审。② 第九个单元仍带来一丝增益；从第十个起，再无 — 即使页面上有十五个单元，尾部相对头部也是冗余的（几千分之一的抖动是交叉验证噪声）。① 是预料之中的部分，画出来只为给出尺度：

s97c00e7402.en: one unit reaches 0.69, two thirds of the way to the 0.78 ceiling
s97c00e7402.zh: 一个单元就达到 0.69，走完了到 0.78 上限的三分之二路程

sd2c6301acd.en: ; the pooled flattening at six is partly arithmetic — a median review is over by five — which is exactly why ② is computed on the long reviews alone.
sd2c6301acd.zh: ；合并样本在六处的走平部分是算术使然 — 中位数评审到五就结束了 — 这正是 ② 只在长评审上计算的原因。

s1be824a3cc.en: What it shows, and what it does not
s1be824a3cc.zh: 它显示了什么，没显示什么

s77cf965460.en: the target is the same reviewer's own rating, so this is the internal consistency of a document with its own summary number, not a prediction of anything external — and it is a statement about the text, not about when the reviewer decided: later units largely restate the first, which is exactly what you would write if the conclusion came first. Provenance: ③'s words bar and all of ④ were added as follow-up analyses during review — declared exploratory, committed to publication whichever way they came out. ④'s weights are descriptive regression coefficients on correlated counts, not causal prices; their agreement with the tariff's independent design is what earns them the reading. ⚖ reviews are not interchangeable draws — early-filed ones run harsher and longer, uncontrolled throughout — the tide · overture to act VII
s77cf965460.zh: 目标是同一位审稿人自己的评分，所以这是一份文档与其自身总结分数之间的内部一致性，而非对任何外部事物的预测 — 它是关于文本的陈述，不是关于审稿人何时下定论的陈述：后面的单元大体在复述第一条，这正是结论先行时你会写出的样子。溯源：③ 的词柱与 ④ 全部是评审期间追加的后续分析 — 事先声明为探索性，无论结果如何都承诺发表。④ 的权重是对相关计数的描述性回归系数，不是因果价格；它们与量刑表独立设计的一致，才使这一读法成立。⚖ 评审不是可互换的抽样 — 早提交的更严厉也更长，全程未加控制 — 潮汐 · 第七幕序曲

s5d8ba4bceb.en: what a criticism actually says — and asks for · plates VII–XIII
s5d8ba4bceb.zh: 一条批评到底说了什么 — 又要求什么 · 图版 VII–XIII

s9f5cd3244b.en: Corpus: 698,507 negative units across all twelve objects, 2018–2026 · ground → law → remedy, decomposed at the unit level
s9f5cd3244b.zh: 语料：2018–2026 年全部十二个审视对象的 698,507 条否定单元 · 依据 → 法则 → 修复，在单元层面分解

s3d8a5a2f4f.zh: 一条指控到底说了什么

s4a060b22ae.en: Act II watched one reviewer write — the order, the arc, the early verdict. This act stops watching the writer and cross-examines the writing. Tell a first-year researcher their paper "lacks novelty" — or rigor, or clarity — and they learn nothing. This plate takes such a sentence apart. Because each unit stores the reviewer's observation and their reasoning separately, every negative unit can be split into three: the ground — what the reviewer actually saw in the paper; the rule — the general principle they applied to it, quoted in their own words; and the remedy — what they asked the author to do, if anything. (The courtroom words are used consistently from here on: a negative unit is a denial or a charge, and the principle behind it is a rule or a law.) One more borrowed word: a docket is all the criticism aimed at one of the twelve objects of scrutiny from Plate I, so "the novelty docket" means every criticism of novelty. Pick one below and it opens as ground → rule → remedy. A single criticism can invoke several rules at once, and nothing here forces it into one.
s4a060b22ae.zh: 第二幕看一位审稿人写作 — 顺序、弧线、早判。本幕不再看写作的人，转而盘问写下的文字。告诉一位一年级研究者，他的论文“缺乏新颖性”— 或严谨性，或清晰度 — 他什么也学不到。本图版把这样一句话拆开。因为每条单元分开存储审稿人的观察与推理，每条否定单元都可以一分为三：依据 — 审稿人在论文里实际看到了什么；规则 — 他们据以评判的一般原则，以他们自己的话引出；以及修复 — 他们要求作者做什么，如果有的话。（从此处起法庭用语保持一致：一条否定单元是一条否决或一条指控，其背后的原则是一条规则或一条法则。）再借一个词：一份案卷是针对图版 I 十二个审视对象之一的全部批评，所以“新颖性案卷”指对新颖性的每一条批评。在下方选一份，它就展开为依据 → 规则 → 修复。一条批评可以同时援引多条规则，这里不强迫它归入一条。

s94af55a17a.en: GROUND → LAW → REMEDY · RIBBON WIDTH = SHARE OF THE DOCKET’S DENIALS · RIBBONS DO NOT CONSERVE
s94af55a17a.zh: 依据 → 法则 → 修复 · 带宽 = 占该案卷否决的份额 · 各带不守恒

s9c9b0ba746.en: pick a docket above. Left: the grounds — what the reviewer actually observed (named per docket; shares estimated on 40,000-unit samples where a docket exceeds that). Middle: the laws — the definitions the denials invoke, counted only when the reviewer states the rule in words (26–40% of denials do; the rest leave it implicit; a stated denial can invoke several). A law tagged VISITING lives in another docket — the evidence rule visits every court, novelty's own rule sits in six others, and clarity's in three: the jurisprudence of imports is general. Each law card carries its own remedy mix as a thin bar; ribbons on the right carry the same mix outward to the remedy cards, colored by remedy — they represent only the denials whose law was stated, and like the left ribbons they do not conserve. The right column totals everything, and Fig. 7c compares the totals across all twelve dockets. Provenance, stated plainly: cluster structure is data-driven (local embeddings, k-means); merges and names are readings of exemplars — novelty's by the analyst, the eleven extensions drafted by machine readers from the exemplars and reviewed by the analyst; raw clusters ship with the dataset, and the sentence-mining pattern is a prior about normative phrasing, so all stated-law shares are floors. An independent three-reader audit of the borders is recorded in Method §10.
s9c9b0ba746.zh: 在上方选一份案卷。左：依据 — 审稿人实际观察到了什么（按案卷分别命名；案卷超出 40,000 条单元时，份额在这一规模的样本上估计）。中：法则 — 否决所援引的定义，只在审稿人明言规则时计入（26–40% 的否决如此；其余留作隐含；一条明言的否决可援引多条）。标为外来的法则属于另一份案卷 — 证据规则造访每一个法庭，新颖性自己的规则出现在另外六份案卷中，清晰度的出现在三份中：引入的判例法是普遍现象。每张法则卡以细条带出自己的修复构成；右侧的带把同一构成向外送到修复卡，按修复着色 — 它们只代表明言了法则的否决，且与左侧的带一样不守恒。右列汇总一切，图 7c 跨全部十二份案卷比较这些汇总。溯源，直白说明：聚类结构由数据驱动（本地嵌入、k-means）；合并与命名是对范例的解读 — 新颖性的由分析者完成，其余十一个扩展由机器读者据范例起草、经分析者审阅；原始聚类随数据集一并发布，句子挖掘模式是关于规范性措辞的先验，所以所有明言法则的份额都是下限。对边界的一次独立三读者审计记录于方法 §10。

s6ecf09c0f7.en: Fig. 7b — The rulebook: novelty's unwritten rules, in reviewers' own words
s6ecf09c0f7.zh: 图 7b — 规则手册：新颖性的不成文规则，以审稿人自己的话写成

se1fad433a6.en: Six operative definitions of novelty, mined verbatim from 12,789 normative sentences — each clause quotable, dated, and linked to the paper it was written about.
se1fad433a6.zh: 新颖性的六条有效定义，从 12,789 句规范性句子中逐字挖出 — 每条条款可引用、有日期、并链接到它所评的论文。

s8a518ffdeb.en: Each clause is the sentence closest to its law's center — an actual reviewer's sentence, not a paraphrase written by us (the wording is still the model's tidied version of that sentence; the link leads to the original on OpenReview). Together they are the operative definition of novelty at this venue: distinctness that the author must articulate; more than an increment, more than an assembly, more than a transfer; and, sometimes, explicitly indexed to the venue's rank. One clause is deliberately kept though it is not a law of novelty at all:
s8a518ffdeb.zh: 每条条款都是离其法则中心最近的那句话 — 真实审稿人的句子，而非我们写的转述（措辞仍是模型对该句的整理版；链接指向 OpenReview 上的原文）。合起来，它们就是新颖性在本会议的有效定义：作者必须阐明的独特性；不止于增量，不止于拼装，不止于迁移；有时还明确对标会议的档次。有一条条款被有意保留，尽管它根本不是新颖性的法则：

s7809b9c660.en: the imported evidence rule, under which the objection is to the support for the novelty claim rather than to the novelty itself
s7809b9c660.zh: 引入的证据规则，据此异议针对的是新颖性主张的支撑，而非新颖性本身

sf096d23215.en: — a jurisdiction switch worth seeing. The rulebook shown is novelty's — the pilot docket, read deepest; the other eleven carry their laws in Fig. 7a, and Plate VIII opens one clause — the combination rule — all the way down.
sf096d23215.zh: — 一次值得一看的管辖权切换。所示规则手册是新颖性的 — 试点案卷，读得最深；其余十一份的法则载于图 7a，图版 VIII 则把一条条款 — 组合规则 — 一路打开到底。

sa0f0f81c96.en: an audit stands behind the borders: three independent machine readers, given raw denials and no taxonomy, re-derived these families — and surfaced two finer clauses the clustering had folded away (the false-priority accusation; the contribution that cannot be located at all), recorded in Method §10.
sa0f0f81c96.zh: 边界背后有一次审计：三个独立的机器读者，只给原始否决、不给分类体系，重新推导出了这些族 — 并浮现出两条被聚类折叠掉的更细条款（虚假优先权的指控；完全找不到的贡献），记录于方法 §10。

sf943d161ca.zh: 图 7c — 每种指控向你要什么

s3eb597bb01.en: Every docket has a remedy signature: clarity wants writing (90%), baselines want experiments (80%), reproducibility wants disclosure (76%) — and novelty, alone, wants nothing at all 39% of the time.
s3eb597bb01.zh: 每份案卷都有一种修复签名：清晰度要写作（90%），基线要实验（80%），可复现性要披露（76%）— 唯有新颖性，39% 的时候什么都不要。

s7400c1b5b1.zh: 柱 = 占该对象否决的份额，按所求修复分

s43a3b42239.en: for every object of scrutiny, its denials split by what the reviewer asked for: articulate (writing and positioning), substantiate (new experiments and analyses), redesign (change the method itself), disclose (details, code, data), or nothing. The signatures are almost caricatures of each docket —
s43a3b42239.zh: 对每个审视对象，其否决按审稿人所求划分：阐明（写作与定位）、实证（新的实验与分析）、改方法（改动方法本身）、披露（细节、代码、数据），或无。这些签名几乎是各案卷的漫画像 —

sba548f712d.zh: 清晰度的修复 90% 是写作，基线的 80% 是实验，可复现性的 76% 是披露

One artifact was checked and ruled out: novelty complaints are not terser than others (slightly longer, in fact), and the gap persists inside every quartile of unit length (novelty offers a fix for 60–61% of its denials in each quartile, against 76–94% for the other objects). “Redesign”

s5d6bb0c54b.zh: 在各处都罕见（只有理论有一些，占 7%）

s1fa12bea3b.en: , which is itself worth knowing: reviewers ask authors to argue, prove, and disclose far more often than to change the method.
s1fa12bea3b.zh: ，这本身就值得知道：审稿人要求作者论证、证明、披露的频率，远高于要求改动方法。

sa7d258be8c.en: remedy shares for the eleven extended objects are estimated on 40,000-fix samples per object where fixes exceed that, and each docket's fixes are read through eight clusters — so an exact 0% means rarer than the clustering resolves, a floor rather than a measured absence.
sa7d258be8c.zh: 十一个扩展对象的修复份额按每对象 40,000 条修复的样本估计（修复数超出该规模时），每份案卷的修复经八个聚类读取 — 所以恰好 0% 意味着比聚类所能分辨的更罕见，是下限而非测得的缺席。

sd5fb6c9d98.en: If a charge were a syllogism, this observation would summon that rule, and that rule would fix the ask. Inside the novelty docket the current runs — but barely:
sd5fb6c9d98.zh: 若一条指控是一个三段论，这个观察就会唤出那条规则，那条规则就会定下要求。在新颖性案卷内部，电流确在流动 — 却十分微弱：

s7534d5f755.en: NOT A CONTRADICTION OF FIG. 4a — THAT WAS THE ORDER OF WRITING; THIS IS THE LOGIC INSIDE ONE CHARGE. AND ONE NUMBER RETURNS BY ANOTHER ROAD: 39.4% OF THESE 30,447 DENIALS ASK NOTHING — FIG. 7c FOUND 39% ON A DIFFERENT PIPELINE.
s7534d5f755.zh: 这与图 4a 并不矛盾 — 那里是书写的顺序；这里是一条指控内部的逻辑。另有一个数字从另一条路回来了：这 30,447 条否定中 39.4% 未提任何要求 — 图 7c 在另一条流水线上得到 39%。
