s4d14a3888a.en: every negative novelty unit in the nine-year corpus, cut into its three stages — what was seen (ground), the rule invoked (warrant), what was asked (demand) — each stage clustered on its own, then the flow between them counted. Each ribbon is real traffic — its width, the share of denials taking that path; its colour, that path’s traffic as a multiple of chance (warm above, cool below; hover any ribbon for the exact figures; the dashed bar is the empty ask). If the syllogism were a real circuit, a few ribbons would run hot and the rest would vanish — Plate XIII’s coupled rule-pairs reach 3.6×. Instead nearly every ribbon is pale: each observation fans out over all the rules at close to their base rates, and each rule fans out over the asks the same way. In the corpus’s own words, the stages sound like this — a ground: “Method resembles a combination of existing approaches”; a warrant: “Combining existing techniques without a conceptual leap is not a strong contribution”; and after that warrant, the modal ask is nothing at all.
s4d14a3888a.zh: 九年语料中的每一条新颖性否定单元，切成三个阶段 — 所见（依据）、所援引的规则（理据）、所求（要求） — 每个阶段各自聚类，再统计阶段之间的流量。每条带都是真实流量 — 宽度是走该路径的否定所占份额；颜色是该路径流量相对随机的倍数（暖色高于，冷色低于；悬停任一条带可见精确数字；虚线条是空要求）。若三段论是一条真实电路，少数几条带会发热，其余会消失 — 图版 XIII 中耦合的规则对可达 3.6×。实际上几乎每条带都是浅色：每个观察以接近基础率的比例散向所有规则，每条规则同样散向各种要求。用语料自己的话说，这几个阶段听起来是这样 — 一条依据：“Method resembles a combination of existing approaches”；一条理据：“Combining existing techniques without a conceptual leap is not a strong contribution”；而在这条理据之后，最常见的要求是一无所求。

s2edb5aedeb.en: the coupling is real — χ² rules out independence at this n — and everywhere faint: Cramér’s V ≈ 0.12–0.14 at both stages, both grains.
s2edb5aedeb.zh: 耦合是真实的 — χ² 在这个 n 下排除了独立性 — 却处处微弱：两个阶段、两种粒度下，Cramér’s V 均 ≈ 0.12–0.14。

s72abd08c22.en: Even the natural pair, “an assembly of known parts” → “combination is not a contribution”, runs at just 1.22× chance

s730a6d6262.en: . The channels that do carry current tell one story:
s730a6d6262.zh: 。真正有电流通过的通道讲的是同一个故事：

sf4a850bf34.en: confusion invites the imported rigor attack (“cannot tell what is new” → rigor doubts, 1.88×)
sf4a850bf34.zh: 含混招来外来的严谨性攻击（“看不出何为新” → 严谨性质疑，1.88×）

see47ed35c3.en: the combination rule flows to an empty ask — 49% of its uses request nothing, 1.24× the docket’s own high base
see47ed35c3.zh: 组合规则流向空要求 — 其 49% 的使用未提任何要求，是该案卷本已很高的基础率的 1.24×

s01d9ec025a.en: — while rigor-doubt reasoning almost always asks for something (25% empty). The novelty syllogism is less a chain of reasoning than a bin of interchangeable parts: any observation licenses nearly any rule, and the rule barely narrows the ask.
s01d9ec025a.zh: — 而严谨性质疑式的推理几乎总会提出要求（25% 为空）。新颖性三段论算不上一条推理链，更像一箱可互换的零件：任一观察几乎可以引出任一规则，规则又几乎不收窄要求。

s1905d433ad.en: the observation, reasoning and suggested-fix fields of all 30,447 negative novelty units (2018–2026, forum track) embedded separately (bge-small) and k-means clustered — 10 grounds, 10 warrants, 8 demands, seed 46 — then merged to the five/four/three named stages shown, by reading exemplars; raw clusters and matrices ship in the dataset. The χ² and V above are quoted at the raw grain, before any merge, against the product of marginals — the marginal-preserving shuffle null. The ask stage counts “nothing asked” as an outcome, so its V includes the decision to demand at all.
s1905d433ad.zh: 全部 30,447 条新颖性否定单元（2018–2026，forum 轨道）的观察、推理、改进建议三个字段分别嵌入（bge-small）并做 k-means 聚类 — 10 个依据、10 个理据、8 个要求，随机种子 46 — 再通过阅读样例合并为图中所示的五/四/三个命名阶段；原始聚类与矩阵随数据集发布。上文的 χ² 与 V 取自合并前的原始粒度，对照边际乘积 — 即保持边际的置乱零模型。要求阶段将“未提要求”计为一种结果，因此其 V 也包含了是否提出要求这一决定。

sa1ba829450.en: faintness is the finding — this figure must not be quoted as “criticism has a logic-grammar after all.” A 1.9× channel over a 1.00 floor is a lean, not a law. And the stages are the model’s distillation of the reviewer’s words, read one unit at a time: a distiller that phrases rules generically could smooth real structure away, so these lifts are floors, not ceilings — what survives distillation is faint; what the reviewer privately walked through is beyond this instrument.
sa1ba829450.zh: 微弱本身就是发现 — 不可把这张图引作“批评终究有一套逻辑语法。”在 1.00 的底线之上 1.9× 的通道，是倾向，算不上法则。而且这些阶段是模型对审稿人文字的蒸馏，逐单元读取：把规则表述得笼统的蒸馏器可能抹平真实结构，所以这些提升度只是下限，算不得上限 — 蒸馏后留存的是微弱的；审稿人私下走过的推理，超出这件仪器的范围。

sc614c28388.zh: 图版 VIII · 组合条款

s2a12daad00.en: Corpus: ICLR 2018–2026 · 4,316 combination-rule sentences from 4,262 units
s2a12daad00.zh: 语料：ICLR 2018–2026 · 来自 4,262 个单元的 4,316 条组合规则语句

s0706382ff3.en: Plate VII found the combination rule — assembling known components is not novel unless the integration itself is. This plate opens the clause: what, concretely, is the unless? And what is being called a combination in the first place? Sub-clustering the rule’s own sentences answers the first; the units’ observations answer the second.
s0706382ff3.zh: 图版 VII 找到了组合规则 — 组装已知组件不算新颖，除非整合本身新颖。本图版打开这条条款：那个除非，具体是什么？以及，被称作组合的究竟是什么？对规则自身语句做子聚类回答前者；单元的观察回答后者。

sca78ec742d.en: The judgment that needs no referent

sab526b01cc.en: Plate VIII opened one clause of the novelty rule from the inside — what redeems “mere combination.” This plate opens a different clause the same way: every novelty objection implies a comparison — this work against the prior it allegedly repeats. We went looking for the canon: the named prior works that kill novelty. The search came back nearly empty, and the emptiness describes the standard itself. A judgment that cites nothing is not automatically careless — novelty can be judged from the reviewer’s internal map of the field, which is much of what expertise is — but a judgment made that way cannot be checked from the text, and its burden of proof moves to the author. What follows measures that mode of judgment: how common it is, and which way it has moved as the venue grew.
sab526b01cc.zh: 图版 VIII 从内部打开了新颖性规则的一条条款 — 什么能救赎“只是组合”。本图版以同样方式打开另一条条款：每条新颖性异议都隐含一次比较 — 这项工作，对照它据称重复的先前工作。我们去找那部正典：那些扼杀新颖性的、被点名的先前工作。搜索几乎空手而归，而这份空缺本身描述了标准。不引任何文献的评判不必然草率 — 新颖性可以凭审稿人心中的领域地图来判断，专业能力多半正是这个 — 但这样做出的评判无法从文本核对，举证责任转到了作者身上。下文度量这种评判模式：它有多常见，以及随着会议扩张它向哪边移动。

sa5c6a6d919.en: an earlier version ran the same regex on the distilled units instead and found 5 / 29 / 66. The naming level is instrument-sensitive — the tight unit reading is a floor, and the ±2-sentence window leans high because it can absorb a neighbouring criticism’s citation — but the two facts this plate rests on hold under both: roughly two thirds of novelty objections carry no referent at all (66 tight, 63 generous), and the naming rate halves from 2018 to 2026 under either reading (8.4%→3.5% tight; 20%→11% generous). Nor is there a canon among the named: under a deliberately generous key (surname + year, which merges distinct papers), the most-cited key reaches 21 of the 23,251 papers these objections were filed against. The accusation of un-novelty is structurally unnamed: the burden of locating the colliding prior work is left with the accused. The regex misses prose references ("the BERT paper"), so all lit shares are undercounts.
sa5c6a6d919.zh: 早先的版本把同一正则跑在蒸馏单元上，得到 5 / 29 / 66。点名水平对仪器敏感 — 紧凑的单元读法是下限，±2 句窗口偏高，因为它可能吸入相邻批评的引用 — 但本图版依赖的两个事实在两种读法下都成立：约三分之二的新颖性异议全无所指（紧凑 66，宽松 63），点名率从 2018 到 2026 在两种读法下都减半（紧凑 8.4%→3.5%；宽松 20%→11%）。被点名者之中也不存在正典：即便用刻意宽松的键（姓氏 + 年份，会把不同论文合并），被引最多的键也只覆盖了这些异议所针对的 23,251 篇论文中的 21 篇。不新颖的指控在结构上是无名的：定位那篇冲突的先前工作的责任，留给了被告。正则漏掉散文式引用（"the BERT paper"），因此所有亮标记份额都是低估。

s0b9ca802f4.en: Corpus: ICLR 2026 · 293,671 negative units, embedded locally · nearest twin always from a different paper
s0b9ca802f4.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 · 293,671 条否定单元，本地嵌入 · 最近孪生始终来自另一篇论文

s1d8db5d7f9.en: Take any criticism and search every other paper’s reviews for the most similar one — its nearest twin. Some criticisms have no close twin: they could only have been written about this paper. Others recur almost word for word across many papers — the field’s standard formulas. Finding formulas is not an accusation: a shared formula is how a discipline applies the same standard to everyone ("release the code" has to read the same everywhere to be a standard at all). The question is which criticisms are formulas and which are written for the paper at hand — and Fig. 10b’s answer is that the two kinds carry very different weight. After three plates of nine-year corpora, the window narrows again: the embedding search reads ICLR 2026 alone — 293,671 negative units.
s1d8db5d7f9.zh: 取任一条批评，在所有其他论文的评审中搜索与之最相似的一条 — 它的最近孪生。有些批评没有近似的孪生：它们只可能是为这篇论文写的。另一些则在许多论文中几乎逐字重现 — 这个领域的标准套语。找到套语并非指控：共享的套语正是一门学科对所有人施加同一标准的方式（"release the code" 在哪里都得读起来一样，才称得上标准）。问题在于哪些批评是套语、哪些是为手头这篇论文写的 — 图 10b 的回答是，两类批评的分量大不相同。经过三张九年语料的图版，窗口再次收窄：嵌入搜索只读 ICLR 2026 — 293,671 条否定单元。

sd0d7ddd59a.en: one line per object of scrutiny, strung between two poles. The left pole is how formulaic its criticisms are — the share whose nearest twin clears 0.90. The right pole is what raising the objection costs in score — how much lower a reviewer rates a paper when they raise it, compared with the other reviewers of the same paper — the tariff, a quantity Plate XIV will define and defend four plates ahead; its values are borrowed early so the two can be read together. If formulaic and expensive went together, the lines would run level; instead nearly every line crosses, and the crossing is the finding. The inversion holds at every cutoff tried (0.85, 0.90 and 0.95 all put the same four objects at the bespoke end; clarity tops the formula end at 0.85, reproducibility at the other two — and at 0.95 related work edges past clarity; 0.90 shown): the objections that cost points are
sd0d7ddd59a.zh: 每个审视对象一条线，牵在两极之间。左极是其批评的套语化程度——最近孪生句相似度超过 0.90 的占比。右极是提出该异议在评分上的代价——审稿人提出它时，给分比同一篇论文的其他审稿人低多少——即量刑表，图版 XIV 将在四张图版之后定义并论证这个量；这里提前借用其数值，以便两者并读。若套语化与高代价同行，线会平行；实际上几乎每条线都交叉，交叉本身就是发现。这一反转在所尝试的每个阈值下都成立（0.85、0.90 和 0.95 都把同样四个对象放在定制端；套语端在 0.85 时清晰度居首，另两个阈值下可复现性居首——在 0.95 时相关工作略超清晰度；图中所示为 0.90）：耗费分数的异议是

s15bbd7c082.en: Corpus: ICLR 2018–2026 · 120,540 of 191,946 reviews state a rule in words
s15bbd7c082.zh: 语料：ICLR 2018–2026 · 191,946 篇评审中有 120,540 篇明文陈述了规则

s0c11775006.en: Plate VII collected the rules reviewers state in their own words — proofs must be rigorous, notation must be defined, novelty requires differentiation from prior art. A single review usually states several. This plate asks: which rules tend to appear in the same review together — and what that pattern says about the person writing. The logic is simple: if each rule appeared only because of the paper’s own faults, any two rules would share a review at plain chance rate, so every departure from chance points at something else. Departures are measured with the ×chance lift used throughout the atlas — 2× means a reviewer who states one rule states the other twice as often as chance — across all 191,946 initial reviews. Two kinds of departure appear. Rules about rigour and presentation cluster in the same review, for two reasons at once: a paper that earns one such complaint tends to earn the others, and a careful reader is careful about everything (the two are told apart by checking the other reviewer of the same paper — the caption walks through it). The novelty complaint does the opposite: a reviewer who has written “not novel” once does not write it again under another heading, while the other reviewer of the same paper is just as likely to write their own. The clustering is partly the paper’s doing; the once-only habit belongs to the reviewer alone. In the figures below the rules are called laws and a review’s set of them its charge sheet — the atlas’s courtroom image, and nothing more.
s0c11775006.zh: 图版 VII 收集了审稿人用自己的话陈述的规则——证明必须严谨、符号必须有定义、新颖性要求与先前工作有所区分。一篇评审通常陈述好几条。本图版问：哪些规则倾向于在同一篇评审中一起出现——以及这一模式透露了写评审的人什么。逻辑很简单：若每条规则只因论文自身的缺陷而出现，任意两条规则会以纯随机的比率共处一篇评审，因此每一处偏离随机都指向别的东西。偏离用图谱通篇采用的 ×随机 提升值度量——2× 表示陈述了一条规则的审稿人陈述另一条的频率是随机基准的两倍——覆盖全部 191,946 篇初审评审。出现两类偏离。关于严谨性与表述的规则聚集在同一篇评审中，两个原因同时起作用：招致其中一条抱怨的论文往往也招致其他几条，而细心的读者对一切都细心（区分二者的办法是查看同一篇论文的另一位审稿人——图注会逐步说明）。新颖性抱怨恰相反：写过一次 “not novel” 的审稿人不会在另一个标题下再写一次，而同一篇论文的另一位审稿人写下自己那条的可能性丝毫不减。聚集部分是论文所致；只写一次的习惯只属于审稿人。下文各图中，规则称为法则，一篇评审的规则集合称为其控罪单——这是图谱的法庭意象，仅此而已。

s7be814af94.en: NEVER ON THE SAME SHEET — THE BOTTOM EIGHT

s9be88bff22.en: in 13a, rows and columns are the 61 stated rules, grouped by docket; a brass cell means the two rules land on the same review more often than chance, a violet cell less often, and the barely-tinted cells lack the 60 joint filings needed to be read (same-docket pairs are excluded throughout — two rules about the same object co-occur trivially). Two textures carry the finding. The base tone is warm — the median cross-docket pair sits at ×1.19 and 82% of readable cells exceed ×1, because a longer, more thorough review files more of everything — so the deepest brass (the clarity–theory–statistics neighbourhood, up to ×3.6) and every violet cell are departures read against that tide. The violet cells concentrate where one novelty-flavored clause meets another: filing one pushes the other off the sheet, in the teeth of the verbosity that lifts every other pair. 13b names the extremes — on the matrix they are the white-ringed cells; 3.6× means a reviewer who states one of the pair states the other 3.6 times as often as independent filing would produce (universe: all 191,946 initial official reviews). The faint band behind each pair of dots is a 95% interval from resampling whole papers — every attracted pair’s interval stays above ×1.25 and every repelled pair’s below ×0.91, so the extremes are not sampling luck. Because each docket’s sentences were sampled independently, absolute co-filing rates are thinned, but the ratio between them stays accurate, so only ratios are shown. The attracted pairs are almost all form-and-rigor pairs —
s9be88bff22.zh: 13a 中，行与列是 61 条明述规则，按案卷分组；黄铜色格表示两条规则出现在同一篇评审中的频率高于随机，紫色格表示低于随机，几乎无色的格则达不到可供解读所需的 60 次共同提出（全程排除同案卷配对 — 关于同一对象的两条规则共现是平凡的）。两种纹理承载了这一发现。底色偏暖 — 跨案卷配对的中位数为 ×1.19，82% 的可读格超过 ×1，因为更长、更周全的评审什么都提得更多 — 所以最深的黄铜色（清晰度–理论–统计一带，最高 ×3.6）和每一个紫色格，都是逆着这股潮水读出的偏离。紫色格集中在一条带新颖性色彩的条款遇上另一条之处：提出其一便把另一条挤出纸面，顶着那股抬高所有其他配对的冗长之势。13b 点名了极端值 — 在矩阵上它们是白圈标出的格；3.6× 意为陈述了配对中一条的审稿人陈述另一条的频率，是独立提出时的 3.6 倍（总体：全部 191,946 条首轮正式评审）。每对圆点背后的淡色带是以整篇论文为单位重抽样得到的 95% 区间 — 每个相吸配对的区间都在 ×1.25 之上，每个相斥配对的区间都在 ×0.91 之下，所以极端值并非抽样运气。由于各案卷的句子是独立抽样的，绝对的共同提出率被稀释，但它们之间的比值仍然准确，因此只显示比值。相吸配对几乎都是形式与严谨类配对 —

sbadbf686e3.en: a within-review lift cannot by itself say whether the pull follows a careful reviewer or a paper that invites both complaints, so every displayed pair was re-measured across two different reviewers of the same paper (the grey column; test declared before results). The attractions are a mixture: the median attracted pair keeps ×1.44 across reviewers — the paper’s contribution — against ×1.87 within one review, and the excess is the reviewer. (The two reviewers of one paper also share a year; re-basing chance within each year moves the cross-reviewer medians by 0.01, so the shared year contributes essentially nothing.) The repulsions are not a mixture: across reviewers the median is ×0.97, no suppression at all, against ×0.75 within one review — filing one novelty clause suppresses the next only inside the same review. The one-stamp habit is the reviewer’s, not the paper’s. (Cross-docket pairs cannot share a unit, so double-labelled sentences contribute nothing to either list.) One residual the control cannot remove: units are the model’s distillation, read one review at a time, so a machine reader’s internal consistency could contribute to the within-review excess on the attraction side. On the repulsion side that bias runs the other way — an extractor’s consistency can only create positive correlation — so the one-per-review suppression is, if anything, understated.
sbadbf686e3.zh: 评审内的提升倍数本身说不清这种牵引是来自一位仔细的审稿人，还是来自一篇同时招致两种抱怨的论文，所以每个显示的配对都在同一篇论文的两位不同审稿人之间重新测量了一次（灰色列；检验在看到结果前已声明）。相吸是混合的：相吸配对的中位数跨审稿人时保持 ×1.44 — 这是论文的贡献 — 而在同一篇评审内为 ×1.87，超出的部分来自审稿人。（同一篇论文的两位审稿人也共处同一年份；在每个年份内重新计算随机基线，跨审稿人中位数只移动 0.01，所以共同年份几乎没有贡献。）相斥则不是混合的：跨审稿人时中位数为 ×0.97，完全没有抑制，而在同一篇评审内为 ×0.75 — 提出一条新颖性条款只在同一篇评审内部抑制下一条。只盖一个章的习惯属于审稿人，不属于论文。（跨案卷配对不可能共享同一单元，所以双重标注的句子对两份名单都没有贡献。）有一项残余是这个对照无法消除的：单元是模型的提炼，逐篇评审读出，所以机读器的内部一致性可能对相吸一侧的评审内超出量有所贡献。在相斥一侧，这种偏差方向相反 — 抽取器的一致性只能制造正相关 — 所以每篇评审只提一次的抑制，若有偏差，也只会被低估。

s31f129a00e.en: What a fault costs, and whose law decides
s31f129a00e.zh: 一处缺陷的代价，由谁的法则裁定

s8861d2159d.en: A review ends in one number. This plate asks three questions that number hides. First, what does each objection cost — how much lower does a reviewer score a paper when they raise it? Comparing reviews of different papers would answer nothing: weak papers attract both criticism and low scores. So the cost is measured between reviewers of the same paper, also holding fixed how much criticism each review contains overall — what survives is the price of that particular objection, the plate’s tariff. Second, is a fault’s price tied to whether it can be repaired — do the costly objections arrive with a prescribed fix, or without one? Third, when two reviewers examine the same object of the same paper, does their agreement depend on the reasoning standard each brought to it — the laws of Plate VII? And fourth, one level finer and nine years wide: when a criticism states its rule in words, does the stated rule set the price — or does the same rule cost differently depending on where it is aimed?
s8861d2159d.zh: 一篇评审终于一个数字。本图版问三个被这个数字遮住的问题。第一，每种异议的代价是多少 — 审稿人提出它时，给论文的评分会低多少？比较不同论文的评审答不了这个问题：弱的论文既招批评也招低分。所以代价在同一篇论文的审稿人之间测量，同时固定每篇评审所含批评的总量 — 剩下的就是那条特定异议的代价，即本图版的量刑表。第二，一处缺陷的代价是否与它能否修复有关 — 昂贵的异议是带着指定修复来的，还是不带？第三，两位审稿人审视同一篇论文的同一对象时，他们是否一致，取决于各自带来的推理标准 — 图版 VII 的法则 — 吗？还有第四，再细一层、横跨九年：当一条批评用文字陈述了它的规则，是明述的规则定下代价 — 还是同一条规则因所指向之处不同而代价不同？

s89adc6cdae.en: . Robustness and compute-cost objections carry a positive sign: they are the objections of reviewers who found nothing worse to say. Read these as associations, not effects. Nobody assigned the objections at random: a reviewer who is already unconvinced is the one who raises novelty, so the number measures which objection travels with a low score, not what raising it would do. ⚖ reviews are not interchangeable draws — early-filed ones run harsher and longer, uncontrolled throughout — the tide · overture to act VII

sf68b5f08b4.en: across all nine years, take every pair of reviewers who examined the same object of the same paper in their initial reviews; a reviewer's stance on the object is whether the majority of their units on it were negative, and their standard is the reasoning law they used most.

sd73807efdd.en: — read their exact sizes loosely. Splits are rare in absolute terms because criticism dominates the corpus — most pairs condemn together — which is why the sienna addition, not the whole crack, is the quantity to read. And stance and standard are extracted from the same few units, so consistency of a reviewer's writing can contribute to the gap. The choice of standard is not prior to the judgment — it is part of it: which law a reviewer reaches for already carries most of the verdict they are about to give.
sd73807efdd.zh: — 它们的确切数值宜粗读。分歧在绝对数上稀少，因为批评主导了语料 — 多数配对一同定罪 — 所以该读的量是赭色的新增部分，而非整道裂缝。此外，立场与标准是从同样的少数单元中抽取的，所以审稿人写作的一致性可能对这一差距有所贡献。标准的选择并不先于判断 — 它是判断的一部分：审稿人伸手去拿哪条法则，已经承载了他们即将给出的裁决的大半。

scf92347d15.en: THE FIVE FIGURES, READ TOGETHER — hold the paper fixed and most objections cost nothing (14a); the one objection that does cost is the one that rarely arrives with a repair (14b); two reviewers of the same object disagree half again as often when they argue from different standards (14c); and the stated rule prices by where it is aimed, not by what it says (14d, 14e). Together they say one thing: what a review writes as its reasons looks less like the input that produced the verdict than like a part of the verdict itself. The repairable criticism is homework that leaves the score alone; the unrepairable charge, and even the choice of standard, travel with the judgment. Association throughout, never causation — but the same picture, three ways.
scf92347d15.zh: 五张图合读 — 固定论文，多数异议没有代价（14a）；唯一有代价的异议，正是很少带修复而来的那条（14b）；同一对象的两位审稿人依不同标准论证时，分歧多出一半（14c）；明述的规则按所指向之处定价，而非按其内容（14d、14e）。它们合起来说一件事：一篇评审写下的理由，与其说像产生裁决的输入，更像裁决本身的一部分。可修复的批评是不动评分的家庭作业；不可修复的指控，乃至标准的选择，都随判断而行。全程是关联，从不是因果 — 但同一幅图景，三种画法。

s05f65b725b.en: The Law’s Price — the same rule, priced docket by docket over nine years
s05f65b725b.zh: 法则的代价 — 同一条规则，九年间逐案卷定价

sbbd5452982.en: a natural model of refereeing goes: the reviewer finds a rule violated — "claims must match their validation", "the contribution is too incremental" — and the penalty follows from the rule that was broken. If that model were right, the same rule should cost about the same wherever it is applied — a prediction that can be read straight off the chart below. (Stated plainly for provenance: the measurement is descriptive and was not designed as a test of this model; the model is offered as the reader’s yardstick, added at review.)
sbbd5452982.zh: 一种自然的审稿模型是这样的：审稿人发现一条规则被违反 — "claims must match their validation"、"the contribution is too incremental" — 处罚随被违反的规则而定。若该模型成立，同一条规则无论用在哪里，代价都应大致相同 — 这个预测可以直接从下图读出。（为溯源起见直言：这项测量是描述性的，并非为检验此模型而设计；该模型是审校时补加的、供读者使用的标尺。）

sde45364bbb.en: a minority of criticisms state their reasoning rule in words — rare enough that all nine years, 2018–2026, are pooled, where the figures above read 2026 alone. For each stated rule, in each docket where it appears (a docket is one object’s file: the clarity docket holds criticism of the writing, the novelty docket of originality), the measure is how much lower the rule’s invoker rated the paper than the same paper’s other reviewers — in standard deviations (σ) of that year’s rating scale, because ICLR changed scales four times over these years. The test needs two things held fixed: the paper — handled by comparing each invoker to the same paper’s other reviewers — and the rule itself, which is why the test case is the evidence rule: it is the only rule that appears in all twelve dockets, the only one that lets the docket change while the rule stays put.
sde45364bbb.zh: 只有少数批评用文字陈述了其推理规则 — 少到需要把 2018–2026 全部九年合并，而上面几张图只读 2026 年。对每条明述规则，在它出现的每个案卷中（一个案卷是一个对象的卷宗：清晰度案卷收纳对写作的批评，新颖性案卷收纳对原创性的批评），度量的是援引该规则的审稿人给论文的评分比同一篇论文的其他审稿人低多少 — 以当年评分量表的标准差（σ）计，因为 ICLR 在这些年里改了四次量表。这项检验需要固定两样东西：论文 — 通过把每位援引者与同一篇论文的其他审稿人比较来处理 — 以及规则本身，这就是为什么检验案例是证据规则：它是唯一出现在全部十二个案卷中的规则，唯一能让案卷变而规则不变的规则。

s4877c60410.en: the prediction does not hold. With the volume of criticism held fixed, the same rule keeps a −0.30σ deficit in the framing docket and none at all in clarity (14d), and the expensive docket’s bill is run up by its own rules, not by imported ones (14e). The reason written down does not set the score — what was doubted does. Association, not causation, as everywhere in this act — but it is the tariff’s lesson (Fig. 14a), one level finer: the stated reason reads less like the cause of the judgment than like an explanation attached to it.
s4877c60410.zh: 这一预测不成立。在批评数量固定的情况下，同一条规则在问题界定案卷中保持 −0.30σ 的分差，在清晰度案卷中则毫无分差（14d）；而昂贵案卷的账单由它自己的规则累出，并非由外来的规则（14e）。写下的理由并不决定评分——被质疑的对象才决定。与本幕各处一样，这是关联而非因果——但它是量刑表的教训（图 14a）再细一层：写明的理由读来更像附在判断之上的解释，而不太像判断的原因。

s2a3ddb9bfa.en: Fig. 14d — One law, twelve courtrooms: the evidence rule’s tariff by docket
s2a3ddb9bfa.zh: 图 14d — 一条法则，十二间法庭：证据规则在各案卷中的量刑表

s4ccbf44e84.en: Aimed at what the paper claims to be (framing), the same rule keeps a −0.30σ deficit even with the review’s criticism volume held fixed; aimed at how it is written (clarity), it costs nothing.
s4ccbf44e84.zh: 对准论文自称是什么（问题界定）时，即便固定评审的批评数量，同一条规则仍保持 −0.30σ 的分差；对准论文写得如何（清晰度）时，它的代价为零。

s804f2a49f7.en: THE RULE IS IDENTICAL IN EVERY ROW — ONLY THE DOCKET CHANGES. AXIS: THE INVOKING REVIEWER’S RATING MINUS CO-REVIEWERS’ MEAN FOR THE SAME PAPER, IN σ — ONE STANDARD DEVIATION OF THAT YEAR’S RATING SCALE · 0 = NO GAP
s804f2a49f7.zh: 每一行的规则相同 — 只有案卷不同。坐标轴：援引该规则的审稿人评分减去同一论文其他审稿人的均值，单位 σ — 即当年评分尺度的一个标准差 · 0 = 无差距

s0abbf7601f.en: Fig. 14e — Inside the novelty docket: the price of each of its rules
s0abbf7601f.zh: 图 14e — 新颖性案卷之内：其每条规则的代价

s639282ec0b.en: Novelty’s own rules — about combining or extending existing work — cost the most (−0.44 to −0.46σ, volume-adjusted); the borrowed evidence rule costs well under half that (−0.19).
s639282ec0b.zh: 新颖性自己的规则——关于组合或扩展已有工作——代价最高（−0.44 至 −0.46σ，已按数量调整）；借来的证据规则的代价远不及其一半（−0.19）。

s43c6e7166a.en: SAME AXIS, NOVELTY DOCKET ONLY — BRASS = NOVELTY’S OWN CLAUSES · RED = THE BORROWED EVIDENCE RULE, PRICED DOCKET-BY-DOCKET AT LEFT
s43c6e7166a.zh: 同一坐标轴，仅新颖性案卷 — 黄铜色 = 新颖性自己的条款 · 红色 = 借来的证据规则，左图已逐案卷标价

sfcc1b4a888.en: the two ends of the left panel:

s9137fcef8c.en: the identical rule keeps a −0.30σ deficit in the framing docket and one indistinguishable from zero in clarity
s9137fcef8c.zh: 同一条规则在问题界定案卷中保持 −0.30σ 的分差，在清晰度案卷中则与零无法区分

s7d0dcc0ea4.en: — both marked on the chart; the framing−clarity gap is −0.29σ (95% CI −0.38 to −0.20, resampling whole papers). In the right panel,
s7d0dcc0ea4.zh: ——两者都标在图上；问题界定−清晰度之差为 −0.29σ（95% CI −0.38 至 −0.20，按整篇论文重采样）。右图中，

sccd8ee5e93.en: novelty’s own rules (brass) sit at −0.44σ and beyond, the borrowed evidence rule (red) at −0.19
sccd8ee5e93.zh: 新颖性自己的规则（黄铜色）位于 −0.44σ 及更低，借来的证据规则（红色）位于 −0.19

s13f05fa21c.en: each filled point is the mean within-paper score deficit of reviews invoking that rule — how much lower the invoker rated the paper than its other reviewers did — with the review’s criticism volume regressed out (each negative unit −0.37σ, each unit +0.27σ), so "reviews invoking this rule here are simply harsher overall" cannot explain what remains; hollow circles are the gap before that adjustment. The adjustment was declared during review as a robustness check, committed to publication either way: it shrinks every deficit but preserves the order. Whiskers ±1 standard error; everything in standard deviations of the year’s own rating scale so four scoring regimes can share one axis. The dashed line is what the naive model predicts: if the rule alone set the score, every dot would sit on it — the spread of the dots is the finding.
s13f05fa21c.zh: 每个实心点是援引该规则的评审在论文内的平均分差——援引者给论文的评分比其他审稿人低多少——并已回归掉该评审的批评数量（每个否定单元 −0.37σ，每个单元 +0.27σ），因此“此处援引该规则的评审只是整体更严苛”无法解释剩下的部分；空心圆是调整前的差距。该调整在审阅阶段即已声明为鲁棒性检验，无论结果如何都承诺公布：它缩小了每一处分差，但保持了顺序。须线为 ±1 标准误；一切以当年评分尺度的标准差计，使四种评分制度可共用一条坐标轴。虚线是朴素模型的预测：若仅由规则决定评分，每个点都会落在线上——点的散布就是发现。

sf3ffc755c7.en: the price order tracks what the docket concerns: the evidence rule is expensive where the paper’s identity and credibility are at issue — framing, reproducibility, related work, novelty — and cheapest in clarity, where only the writing is. The rule is the same everywhere; what it costs depends on where it is applied. And inside the novelty docket, the expensive rules are novelty’s own — the increment and combination rules, more than twice the price of the borrowed one. Same association-not-causation reading as the tariff plate: the rule a reviewer reaches for is part of the verdict, not prior to it.
sf3ffc755c7.zh: 代价的排序跟随案卷所关涉之事：凡论文的身份与可信度成为争点之处——问题界定、可复现性、相关工作、新颖性——证据规则代价高昂；而在只涉及写作的清晰度案卷中最便宜。规则处处相同；代价取决于它用在何处。在新颖性案卷之内，昂贵的规则是新颖性自己的——增量规则与组合规则，代价是借来那条的两倍以上。与量刑表图版相同的关联而非因果读法：审稿人伸手取用的规则是裁决的一部分，并非先于裁决。

seac2bf8055.en: Corpus: ICLR 2026 · decisions joined at display time
seac2bf8055.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 · 录用决定在展示时才连接

sfb1e33bb3e.en: the decisions were deliberately kept out of the reading pipeline, so the units and the outcomes are independent records. Joining them is the first look at decisions — accept or reject, rather than the scores the tariff plates used — and at whether the criticism has anything to do with them.
sfb1e33bb3e.zh: 录用决定被刻意隔离在读取流水线之外，因此逻辑单元与结果是两份独立记录。将二者连接，是首次审视录用决定——接收或拒稿，而非量刑表图版所用的评分——并审视批评是否与之相关。

sa7fd2d3022.en: of the 19,474 reviewed ICLR 2026 papers, the 13,704 that carry a decision and were not withdrawn are split twelve times over — once per object of scrutiny — into those that drew at least one negative unit on that object and those that drew none, and the acceptance rate of each side is compared. Nothing is held fixed, so this is a comparison between different papers, not within one. The closing figure counts the same join sideways — not which object drew criticism but on how many.
sa7fd2d3022.zh: 在 19,474 篇有评审的 ICLR 2026 论文中，13,704 篇带有录用决定且未撤稿的论文被切分十二次——每个审视对象一次——分成在该对象上至少引来一个否定单元的，与一个都没有的，再比较两侧的接收率。没有任何变量被固定，所以这是不同论文之间的比较，而非同一篇之内。收尾的图将同一连接横向计数——不看哪个对象引来批评，只看有多少个。

s494406b43c.en: Fig. 15a — Acceptance rate with (●) vs without (○) negative units, per object
s494406b43c.zh: 图 15a — 各审视对象上，有（●）与无（○）否定单元的论文接收率

s16e18f7214.zh: 新颖性批评与拒稿同行——

s43a4731f7d.zh: ；计算成本与鲁棒性批评则不与任何结果同行。

s00efaf038a.en: SAME QUESTION AS THE TARIFF, A DIFFERENT COIN — the tariff (Plate XIV) priced an objection in rating points with the paper held fixed; here the outcome is the paper's decision, with nothing held fixed. And unlike Fig. 5a's dumbbells, the vertical rule is not ×1 chance — it is the venue-wide acceptance rate. One more thing these venue-wide gaps hide: Plate XXVIII will split this same indicator by research territory, where the signatures differ far more than they do here.
s00efaf038a.zh: 与量刑表同一问题，换一种货币 — 量刑表（图版 XIV）在固定论文的前提下，以评分分值为一条异议标价；这里的结果是论文的录用决定，不固定任何变量。与图 5a 的哑铃图不同，竖线代表会场整体的接收率，而非 ×1 的机会水平。这些全会场的差距还藏着一件事：图版 XXVIII 会把同一指标按研究疆域拆开，那里的指纹差异远大于此处。

sa21d26804b.en: EACH ROW SPLITS THE 13,704 DECIDED PAPERS BY ONE OBJECT: ● = ACCEPTANCE RATE OF PAPERS DRAWING ≥1 NEGATIVE UNIT ON IT · ○ = OF PAPERS DRAWING NONE. IF DECISIONS HAD NOTHING TO DO WITH THE CRITICISM, ● AND ○ WOULD COINCIDE ON EVERY ROW
sa21d26804b.zh: 每一行按一个审视对象切分 13,704 篇已决论文：● = 在该对象上引来 ≥1 个否定单元的论文接收率 · ○ = 一个都没引来的论文接收率。若录用决定与批评无关，每一行的 ● 与 ○ 都会重合

s8f91efc656.zh: 新颖性的差距最宽，而计算成本与鲁棒性——灰色，区间跨越零——毫无差距

s5094749be2.en: one row per object; the filled dot is the acceptance rate of the papers that drew at least one negative unit on that object, the hollow dot the acceptance rate of those that drew none, and the bar between them is the gap; the thin bar under each filled dot is its 95% interval.
s5094749be2.zh: 每个审视对象一行；实心点是在该对象上至少引来一个否定单元的论文的接收率，空心点是一个都没引来的论文的接收率，两点之间的横条是差距；每个实心点下方的细条是其 95% 区间。

s51fd77053b.en: novelty shows the largest gap, −10.6 points (95% CI −12.1 to −9.0, resampling whole papers), with
s51fd77053b.zh: 新颖性的差距最大，−10.6 个百分点（95% CI −12.1 至 −9.0，按整篇论文重采样），

se7150f6ac0.en: statistical rigour (−9.5) and baseline complaints (−9.3) behind it
se7150f6ac0.zh: 统计严谨性（−9.5）与基线批评（−9.3）紧随其后

s8d7609f24e.en: ; compute cost (CI −1.7 to +1.4) and robustness (−0.9 to +2.4) show no gap at all — papers criticised on those grounds are accepted at the same rate as papers that are not.
s8d7609f24e.zh: ；计算成本（CI −1.7 至 +1.4）与鲁棒性（−0.9 至 +2.4）毫无差距——在这些方面受到批评的论文，与未受批评的论文以相同比率被接收。

s64c088e188.en: association only, and the direction is not established: reviewers raise novelty on papers they are already unconvinced by, so this measures which criticism keeps company with rejection, not which criticism causes it. One thing it is not, though: an artefact of the pipeline. The decisions were never shown to the models that read the reviews, and are joined to the units only here. ⚖ reviews are not interchangeable draws — early-filed ones run harsher and longer, uncontrolled throughout — the tide · overture to act VII
s64c088e188.zh: 仅为关联，方向未定：审稿人会对本已不信服的论文提出新颖性问题，所以这里测的是哪种批评与拒稿相伴，而非哪种批评导致拒稿。但有一点它不是：流水线的人为产物。录用决定从未展示给读取评审的模型，只在此处才与逻辑单元连接。⚖ 评审并非可互换的抽样 — 早提交的评审更严苛也更长，全程未加控制 — 潮汐 · 第七幕序曲

s6625e9772e.en: THE SAME JOIN, COUNTED SIDEWAYS — BREADTH OF CRITICISM VS ACCEPTANCE — IS EXPECTED BY CONSTRUCTION, SO ITS FIGURE HANGS IN THE NULL CABINET ↓
s6625e9772e.zh: 同一连接横向计数 — 批评广度对接收率 — 按构造即在预期之中，故其图挂在零假设陈列柜 ↓

s030cfcafa1.zh: 图 15b — 可读的裁决：录用决定有多少写在批评之中

s3bd68abbfd.zh: 图谱首页的问题，按字面来问：仅凭批评能否读出接收还是拒稿？

s721507f741.zh: 柱 = 区分接收与拒稿的交叉验证 AUC · 0.50 = 不可读 · 1.00 = 完全确定

sd98d686bef.en: every decided, non-withdrawn paper of 2018–2026 (39,484; 2019 carries no decision records in this corpus), each reduced to what its reviewers criticised before any rebuttal: the tally model sees only fourteen numbers — how many negative units each of the twelve objects of scrutiny drew, plus the paper’s total praise and hedged counts — and a logistic regression guesses the decision under five-fold cross-validation. If decisions were unreadable from criticism, every bar would sit at 0.50; the review-count-only bar (0.51) is that floor made visible — volume alone carries nothing. The scores bar is a reference, not a rival: it answers “how far is anything text-side from what the panel’s own numbers already say.”
sd98d686bef.zh: 2018–2026 年每一篇已决且未撤稿的论文（39,484 篇；本语料中 2019 年无录用决定记录），各自压缩为审稿人在任何 rebuttal 之前批评了什么：计数模型只看到十四个数——十二个审视对象各引来多少否定单元，加上该论文的称许总数与留有余地的单元计数——再由逻辑回归在五折交叉验证下猜测录用决定。若录用决定无法从批评读出，每根柱都会停在 0.50；仅用评审数量的那根柱（0.51）就是这条底线的显形——单凭数量什么都带不出来。评分柱是参照，而非对手：它回答的是“文本一侧的任何东西，距评审组自己的数字已经说出的内容还有多远。”

s96e35bb712.en: association, not mechanism: reviewers may criticise novelty because they are rejecting, and an AUC cannot tell the direction. Per-year AUCs are computed within their own year, so the moving score-ruler does not contaminate them — but the pooled scores-reference does pool four scoring forms. And the fall is not unique to criticism: the scores’ own legibility slips too, though later and less (0.96 through 2023, then 0.94, 0.94, 0.89) — part of what fell is the decision’s readability from anything. Within that, the tally-vs-text contrast is the criticism-specific part, and the nine-year fall of the tally bar is a fact about legibility, not about rigor — it says the decision increasingly turns on something other than the topic-mix of criticism: the words, the rebuttal, or what no text records.
s96e35bb712.zh: 关联，而非机制：审稿人可能因为正在拒稿才批评新颖性，AUC 无法分辨方向。逐年 AUC 在各自年份内计算，所以移动的评分标尺不会污染它们——但合并的评分参照确实合并了四种评分形式。下降也不只发生在批评上：评分自身的可读性也在下滑，只是更晚、更少（到 2023 年为 0.96，之后 0.94、0.94、0.89）——下降的一部分是录用决定从任何东西读出的可读性。在此之中，计数对文本的反差是批评特有的部分，而计数柱九年的下降是关于可读性的事实，与严谨性无关——它说明录用决定越来越取决于批评主题组合之外的东西：文字、rebuttal，或任何文本都未记录的东西。

s4c391f7a13.en: Before asking whether judgment moves when people meet, watch the calendar the meetings happen on. Every public act of the ICLR 2026 cycle, on its real calendar day: 19,814 submissions crest at the deadline, 75,859 reviews land in a two-day burst, 180,146 discussion comments answer them, 5,216 papers withdraw — most in the week after the reviews arrive — and on a single day in January, 14,175 decisions fall at once. This overture replays a single season; the plates that follow read nine years of such seasons.

s41ef8fcf70.en: every official review roots a thread; its shape is decided by the turns beneath it — a stump received no reply at all, a monologue was answered by the authors with the reviewer never speaking again, a return saw the reviewer come back once, a volley twice or more; the rare aside (replies from neither authors nor reviewer, 0.05–2% of a year) is the hairline at the top of the strip. Roles for 2018–21 are recovered from signature formats, so the earliest years are the least certain. The strip stacks each year’s threads to 100%. The brass layers — return and volley, the threads the reviewer came back to — rise from the baseline, so their share reads directly as a height; the dark stumps hang from the top, so silence reads as a thickness pressing down; monologue fills the middle. The numbers along the top are the came-back share, year by year.
s41ef8fcf70.zh: 每篇官方评审生出一条线程；线程的形状由其下的轮次决定 — 树桩没有收到任何回复，独白是作者回答了而审稿人再未开口，重返是审稿人回来了一次，往复是两次或更多；罕见的旁白（回复既不来自作者也不来自审稿人，占一年的 0.05–2%）是条带顶端的细线。2018–21 年的角色由签名格式恢复，所以最早几年最不确定。条带把每年的线程堆叠到 100%。黄铜色层 — 重返与往复，即审稿人回来过的线程 — 从基线升起，其份额可直接读作高度；深色的树桩从顶端垂下，沉默便读作向下压的厚度；独白填在中间。顶部一行数字是逐年的重返率。

s21494639ce.en: the reviewer came back to 43.8% of threads in 2025 — the high-water mark — and to 17.7% in 2026, while stumps grew from 9% in 2021 to 26%: one review thread in four now ends in silence before it begins. One care for the year-to-year line: each year’s discussion rules differ — response windows, mandatory acknowledgements — so the levels track the venue’s process as well as its people. In 2026, threads where the reviewer returned were accepted at 50–51% against 39% for monologues and 1.2% for stumps — read the direction both ways, since authors triage which battles to fight and which papers to quietly abandon.
s21494639ce.zh: 2025 年审稿人重返了 43.8% 的线程 — 这是最高水位 — 2026 年为 17.7%，而树桩从 2021 年的 9% 增至 26%：如今每四条评审线程就有一条在开始之前便归于沉默。对逐年曲线有一点要留意：每年的讨论规则不同 — 回应窗口、强制确认回复 — 所以这些水平既反映会议的流程，也反映其中的人。2026 年，审稿人重返过的线程接收率为 50–51%，独白为 39%，树桩为 1.2% — 方向要两头读，因为作者会分拣哪些仗要打、哪些论文悄悄放弃。

s5d44012c6f.en: The next three plates watch a single event — after the author’s rebuttal, did the reviewer’s written judgment soften? — and differ only in what they divide it by. The Rebuttal counts per unit written after the response: of what got written again, what moved. The Moves counts per author–reviewer exchange, joined to what the author did: which moves travel with movement. The Fate of an Objection counts per objection originally raised — the only denominator that can see the objections never spoken of again, and they turn out to be the large majority. Same event, three denominators; the denominator decides what each number can mean.
s5d44012c6f.zh: 接下来三张图版观察同一件事 — 作者 rebuttal 之后，审稿人写下的判断是否软化了？ — 区别只在用什么去除它。“Rebuttal”按回应之后写下的单元计数：在再次被写下的内容中，有多少动了。“招式”按作者–审稿人交流计数，并连接到作者做了什么：哪些招式与变动同行。“一条异议的命运”按最初提出的异议计数 — 这是唯一能看见那些再未被提及的异议的分母，而它们恰是绝大多数。同一件事，三个分母；分母决定每个数字能意味着什么。

s7afca83edd.en: 130,650 units sit after the author response (2018–2026) — written by the reviewers who spoke again at all; most never do (Plate XVI). When a written judgment moves, it moves toward reinforcement 2.4 times more often than concession — and every kind of response, fresh experiments included, reinforces at least twice as often as it softens. Two limits, stated up front: this plate reads what reviewers wrote, so a score quietly raised without a word is invisible — the corpus keeps no rating history — and every recorded fate is a model's reading of the text.

s57c8042b6b.en: — yet even for them reinforcement beats concession, and unanimous panels barely stir at all (9,329 split panels; a reviewer's units are matched to their rating through their anonymous OpenReview identity, which succeeds for 95% of reviews). Two cares close the plate: every fate here is the model’s reading of prose — a courteous "I thank the authors and maintain my score" reads as reinforcement — and a rating changed without accompanying text never enters these counts; the corpus stores no rating history, so the score’s own needle is beyond this plate’s reach.
s57c8042b6b.zh: — 但即便对他们，加强也多于让步，而意见一致的评审组几乎纹丝不动（9,329 个分歧评审组；审稿人的单元通过其匿名 OpenReview 身份与其评分匹配，95% 的评审匹配成功）。两点留意收束本图版：这里的每一条命运都是模型对文字的读取 — 一句客气的 "I thank the authors and maintain my score" 读作加强 — 而未附文字的评分改动永远不进入这些计数；语料不保存评分历史，所以评分自身的指针超出本图版所及。

s9ba1458ae3.en: Corpus: ICLR 2018–2026 · 67,290 author–reviewer exchanges with observable outcomes

s6138b81db8.en: — no single move tracks softening as strongly as sheer volume of engagement.
s6138b81db8.zh: — 没有哪一种招式与软化的关联强过投入的纯粹体量。

s6646f1a8d0.en: Fig. 18b — The seven moves, effort held fixed
s6646f1a8d0.zh: 图 18b — 七种招式，固定努力

sde6d2c3006.en: One move survives the length control: the contest
sde6d2c3006.zh: 只有一种招式经受住了长度控制：争辩

s159944bfa5.en: . “We respectfully disagree” keeps a +1.4 to +2.8pp softening premium in every reply-length stratum; every other move’s premium touches or crosses zero.
s159944bfa5.zh: 。“We respectfully disagree” 在每个回复长度层中都保持 +1.4 到 +2.8pp 的软化溢价；其他每种招式的溢价都触及或穿过零。

s5da15c9a52.en: right panel: the dashed line is the null — a move that changed nothing puts every mark on it. Six of the seven bands touch or cross that line; only the contest’s clears it.
s5da15c9a52.zh: 右图：虚线是零假设 — 一种什么也没改变的招式会把每个标记都放在这条线上。七条带中有六条触及或穿过这条线；只有争辩的那条越过了它。

sf743ff3bd0.en: left, the share of exchanges in which the reviewer recorded a weakened or reversed judgment, by decile of the author’s total reply length (median words on the axis) — an association, not a payoff: longer replies also happen where there is more to fix, and where the reviewer was engaged enough to answer at all. Right, each move’s four filled dots are its softening premium computed inside reply-length quartiles, so a move common in long replies cannot borrow the effort effect; the hollow dot is the raw gap before that control, and the band spans the four strata.
sf743ff3bd0.zh: 左图，审稿人记录了减弱或反转判断的交流所占份额，按作者回复总长度的十分位划分（轴上为中位词数） — 这是关联，并非回报：更长的回复也出现在有更多东西要修的地方，以及审稿人投入到足以作答的地方。右图，每种招式的四个实心点是在回复长度四分位之内计算的软化溢价，所以常见于长回复的招式无法借用努力效应；空心点是控制之前的原始差距，色带跨越四个层。

s46a532f744.en: only the contest — detected in 5% of exchanges, though the seven detectors differ in breadth, so prevalences compare only loosely — stays positive in every stratum: +1.6 to +2.8pp in the three quartiles with enough contests to read, and +1.4pp in the shortest-reply quartile, drawn faint because it holds only 265 contests, under the 300-exchange floor the other strata clear. The rest flatten once effort is held fixed: the concession and the ritual thanks swing between −1.4 and +1.4pp with no consistent sign, and the promissory note keeps a faint non-negative residue (0 to +1.6pp).
s46a532f744.zh: 只有争辩 — 在 5% 的交流中被检出，不过七个检测器的宽窄不同，所以流行率只能粗略比较 — 在每个层中都保持为正：在争辩数量足以解读的三个四分位中为 +1.6 到 +2.8pp，在回复最短的四分位中为 +1.4pp，画得很淡，因为它只含 265 次争辩，低于其他层都达到的 300 次交流下限。其余招式一旦固定努力便趋平：让步与例行致谢在 −1.4 到 +1.4pp 之间摆动，没有一致的符号，承诺保留一点微弱的非负残余（0 到 +1.6pp）。

s32b538f30b.en: The delivered experiment — the move authors invest most in — is the flattest of all
s32b538f30b.zh: 补做的实验 — 作者投入最多的招式 — 是最平的一种

sa15ad81964.en: : within ±0.7pp of the line, negative in three of four strata, and the most negative average premium of the seven — though the ritual thanks and the plain revision also average fractionally below the line. An object-level check finds the same flatness at the point of impact: among exchanges charged on a given object, delivering experiments shifts softening on that object by less than half a point in either direction across all eight most-charged objects, with no consistent sign (novelty 1.1% with vs 1.3% without; empirical scope 1.7% vs 1.2%). Read the contest with care: authors choose to contest when they hold a strong hand, so this is the association of a chosen move, not the payoff of a tactic anyone could copy. And the outcome measure is conservative — it counts only judgment changes the reviewer put in writing; a reviewer quietly raising a score without re-engaging the argument is invisible here (Plate XVII reads the same limit from the other side). An embedding clustering of 722,406 reply sentences — a 26,428-exchange subsample of this universe, capped at 30 sentences per exchange (method § 10) — separates topics more than tactics and finds the same null.
sa15ad81964.zh: ：在线的 ±0.7pp 之内，四个层中有三个为负，且是七种中平均溢价最负的一种 — 不过例行致谢与单纯的修订稿的平均值也略低于线。对象层面的检查在受力点上发现同样的平坦：在就某一对象被指控的交流中，补做实验使该对象上的软化在八个最常被指控的对象上朝任一方向的移动都不到半个百分点，且符号不一致（新颖性：有则 1.1%，无则 1.3%；实证范围：1.7% 对 1.2%）。读争辩时要小心：作者手握强牌时才选择争辩，所以这里是一种被选中的招式的关联，并非任何人都能照抄的战术的回报。而且结果度量是保守的 — 它只计入审稿人写成文字的判断变化；审稿人不再回到论证而悄悄提高评分，在此不可见（图版 XVII 从另一侧读到同一限制）。对 722,406 条回复句子的嵌入聚类 — 本总体的一个 26,428 次交流的子样本，每次交流最多 30 句（方法 § 10） — 区分主题多于区分战术，并得出同样的零结果。

s766f19123a.en: Follow every objection — a reviewer's initial negative unit on one object — through the discussion phase: did the same reviewer return to that object after the authors responded, and if so, did the judgment soften or harden? The dominant fate, for every kind of objection, is silence.
s766f19123a.zh: 跟随每一条异议 — 审稿人在某一对象上的初始否定单元 — 走过讨论阶段：作者回应之后，同一位审稿人是否回到了那个对象，若回到了，判断是软化还是趋严？对每一种异议，占主导的命运都是沉默。

s8d60e53368.zh: 。被提起的 8% 中，多数原样不动 — 而判断真的变动时，趋严的频率是软化的 2.5×。

s2dceb227e9.zh: 顶部的条带就是全部故事：全部 551,595 条异议中，92.1% 占据近乎空白的左段 — 同一位审稿人再未提起它们 — 6.5% 被重提但未变动，1.0% 趋严与 0.4% 软化挤在右缘。

s248e2f8d3d.en: Asked or asserted, an objection meets the same fate — revisited at 5.1% vs 5.2%, a null result reported as one. The only thing that moves the needle is raising it in both fields (7.4%): intensity, not grammar.
s248e2f8d3d.zh: 提问还是直陈，异议的命运相同——重提率 5.1% 对 5.2%，一个零结果，如实报告。唯一能撼动指针的是在两个字段中都提出（7.4%）：起作用的是强度，而非语法。

s0ffaa9a9d5.en: “ASKED” IS PLATE V's MEASURE — the share of a subject's objections phrased as questions, introduced beside the bill of faults; here the question mark is followed to its outcome.

s8941870eee.en: each row is one fate — revisited, softened, hardened — and each dot is the share of objections that met it: brass for objections written as questions (in the review's [questions] field), grey for objections asserted (in [weaknesses]), violet for objections the reviewer wrote in both fields. Every row runs on its own 0→max scale. If the question mark changed an objection's fate, the brass and grey dots would sit apart.
s8941870eee.zh: 每一行是一种命运 — 重提、软化、趋硬 — 每个点是遭遇该命运的异议份额：黄铜色为写成问句的异议（位于评审的 [questions] 字段），灰色为直陈的异议（位于 [weaknesses]），紫色为审稿人在两个字段中都写下的异议。每行各用自己的 0→max 刻度。若问号改变了异议的命运，黄铜色点与灰色点会彼此分开。

s7d0dd21ee0.en: they coincide on all three rows: revisited 5.1% against 5.2%, softened 0.2% against 0.3%, hardened 0.6% in both — the interrogative is a register of politeness, not a different epistemic act. Only the violet dot steps away:
s7d0dd21ee0.zh: 三行上它们都重合：重提 5.1% 对 5.2%，软化 0.2% 对 0.3%，趋硬两者皆为 0.6%——疑问句是一种礼貌语体，并非另一种认识行为。只有紫色点走开了：

sea786172b3.en: an objection raised in both fields is revisited at 7.4% and hardens at 1.1%
sea786172b3.zh: 在两个字段中都提出的异议，重提率 7.4%，趋硬率 1.1%

sb3528d5093.zh: ——撼动指针的是强度，而非语法。

s1130309106.en: objections differ sharply in form — robustness concerns are posed as questions 29% of the time, novelty verdicts only 9% — so if form mattered, the question mark would be doing invisible work all over this atlas.
s1130309106.zh: 异议的形式差异悬殊——鲁棒性方面的顾虑有 29% 以问句提出，新颖性判定只有 9%——所以若形式有影响，问号就会在整部图谱中暗中发挥作用。

s7a0de94799.en: 109,062 reviewer-object objections from 2026 were anchored to the review's form fields; 5,000 anchored in neither field (summaries, strengths, limitations sections) are set aside, leaving 104,062 classified — 13,568 asked, 85,343 asserted, 5,151 in both — each joined to its post-response fate.
s7a0de94799.zh: 2026 年的 109,062 条审稿人—对象异议被锚定到评审表的字段；5,000 条两个字段都锚不到的（摘要、strengths、局限部分）被搁置，余下 104,062 条完成分类——13,568 条提问，85,343 条直陈，5,151 条两者皆有——每条都连接到其回应后的命运。

sbf206ef333.en: Reviewers of the same paper, read as a panel — four questions in one plate. Where do co-reviewers take opposite stances (Fig 20a)? How does the meta-reviewer’s tone differ from the panel they summarize (the three numbers beside it)? When the final decision disagrees with the panel’s lean, which way does it err (Fig 20b)? And how much of the ground does a panel actually walk (Fig 20c)?
sbf206ef333.zh: 把同一篇论文的审稿人当作一个评审组来读——一张图版，四个问题。同稿审稿人在哪些地方立场相反（图 20a）？元评审者的语气与其所总结的评审组有何不同（图旁的三个数字）？最终决定与评审组的倾向相左时，它偏向哪一边（图 20b）？一个评审组实际走过多少地面（图 20c）？

s6d1121e042.en: Fig. 20a — Contested ground: share of papers where reviewers took opposite stances
s6d1121e042.zh: 图 20a — 争议地带：审稿人立场相反的论文份额

s2c1cadb079.en: Panels split most over whether the question matters at all.
s2c1cadb079.zh: 评审组分歧最大的地方，是这个问题究竟是否重要。

s082ca97c7a.en: each row is one object of scrutiny; the bar is the share of its papers on which two official reviewers landed on opposite valences (a paper counts only when at least two reviewers touched the object; bars drawn relative to the 38.6% maximum).
s082ca97c7a.zh: 每一行是一个审视对象；柱是其论文中两位正式审稿人落在相反判向上的份额（仅当至少两位审稿人触及该对象时论文才计入；柱长相对 38.6% 的最大值绘制）。

s088ad4f4db.en: reviewers split most on problem framing (38.6%) — whether the question matters — and least on robustness (16.3%), where the evidence speaks
s088ad4f4db.zh: 审稿人在问题界定上分歧最大（38.6%）— 问题是否重要 — 在鲁棒性上最小（16.3%），那里由证据说话

s4f03630fcf.en: the three numbers beside the figure are a separate reading with no figure of their own: across nine years of units, meta-reviewers run 13.7pp less negative and 10.5pp more positive than the panels they summarize — the judge is kinder than the prosecution. Part of that gap is genre: a meta-review summarizes and justifies a decision rather than inspecting a paper, so its milder mix is not by itself proof of a milder mind.
s4f03630fcf.zh: 图旁的三个数字是一项独立读数，没有自己的图：在九年的单元上，元评审者比其所总结的评审组少 13.7pp 的否定、多 10.5pp 的肯定——法官比控方更宽厚。这一差距部分源于体裁：元评审总结并论证一项决定，而非审视一篇论文，所以它较温和的构成本身并不能证明心思更温和。

s760b5e55ba.en: Fig. 20b — The bench: when the decision disagrees with the panel's lean
s760b5e55ba.zh: 图 20b — 法官席：当决定与评审组的倾向相左

sf1d427c4c3.en: When the decision departs from its panel, it departs toward mercy:
sf1d427c4c3.zh: 当决定偏离评审组时，它偏向宽宥：

s243c051c12.en: 919 papers lifted from below the line against 338 dropped from above it — 2.7×
s243c051c12.zh: 919 篇论文从线下被拉起，对 338 篇从线上被落下 — 2.7×

SOURCE overrule-data.json → n_overruled_accepted, n_overruled_rejected
DERIVATION 919 papers accepted despite a below-line panel mean ÷ 338 rejected despite an above-line mean = 2.72, rounds to 2.7×
VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25

来源 overrule-data.json → n_overruled_accepted, n_overruled_rejected
推导 919 篇评审组均分低于线却被接收 ÷ 338 篇均分高于线却被拒稿 = 2.72，四舍五入为 2.7×
核验 已对照发布的 JSON 核对，2026-08-25

s65e250d41d.zh: 被推翻者 — 公开范例

s9bd3ba2c67.en: for each of the 13,700 decided 2026 papers with three or more rated reviews, the panel's lean is its mean rating, and the accept line is the mean-rating cut that reproduces the venue's actual acceptance rate (5.0 in 2026). A paper counts as overruled when its decision lands on the far side of that line by at least half a point — rejected despite a mean of 5.5 or more, accepted despite a mean of 4.5 or less.
s9bd3ba2c67.zh: 对 2026 年 13,700 篇有三条或以上评分评审的已决论文，每篇的评审组倾向是其平均评分，接收线是能复现会场实际接收率的平均分切点（2026 年为 5.0）。当一篇论文的决定落在该线另一侧至少半分——均分 5.5 或以上却被拒稿，均分 4.5 或以下却被接收——它就计为被推翻。

sb8184b0d82.en: the curve is how often the decision agrees with the panel's lean, plotted against distance from the accept line, so agreement near zero is the interesting part; the figures beside it count the overruled cases in each direction, and the mirrored wings beneath draw those two counts against the shared accept line — a bench that erred with no direction would draw two equal wings.
sb8184b0d82.zh: 曲线是决定与评审组倾向一致的频率，按到接收线的距离绘制，所以接近零处的一致率才是看点；曲线旁的数字统计两个方向上被推翻的案例，下方的镜像双翼把这两个计数画在共同的接收线两侧——一个出错不分方向的法官席会画出两片相等的翼。

s302c0bf52c.en: 919 papers were lifted from below the line and 338 dropped from above it
s302c0bf52c.zh: 919 篇论文从线下被拉起，338 篇从线上被落下

s87a6a5e2cb.en: — when the decision departs from its panel, it does so toward acceptance about 2.7 times as often. The half-point margin is a choice, so the ratio was recomputed at margins of 0.25, 0.75 and a full point: it runs 2.4×, 3.9× and 3.9× — the direction survives any reasonable margin.
s87a6a5e2cb.zh: ——当决定偏离评审组时，偏向接收的频率约为另一方向的 2.7 倍。半分的幅度是一种选择，所以比值在 0.25、0.75 和整一分的幅度下重新计算：得到 2.4×、3.9× 和 3.9×——任何合理的幅度下方向都不变。

s2fe31bdc95.en: the accept line is inferred from the outcomes, not published by the venue, so a paper counted as overruled may simply have been decided on information the mean does not carry — a chair's reading of the discussion, a policy on scope, a reviewer discounted.
s2fe31bdc95.zh: 接收线是从结果推断的，并非会场公布的，所以一篇计为被推翻的论文，可能只是依据均分未承载的信息做出了决定——主席对讨论的解读、关于范围的政策、某位审稿人被打了折扣。

s27a98224f0.en: Fig. 20c — The search party: what a panel covers, duplicates, and never sees
s27a98224f0.zh: 图 20c — 搜索队：评审组覆盖了什么，重复了什么，从未看见什么

sc90fcca71b.en: The panel duplicates some searches and leaves a third of the ground unwalked.
sc90fcca71b.zh: 评审组重复了一些搜索，却留下三分之一的地面无人踏足。

sc164350786.en: treat the panel as a search party over the twelve objects of scrutiny. For each object, the bar splits the 18,074 rated 2026 panels of three or four by how many of their reviewers examined it at all — from the void of no one to the bright band of three or more. The party is uncoordinated: the average panel covers 7.95 of the twelve objects, agrees on examining only 0.83 of them, and leaves 4.05 entirely unvisited. Duplication and blindness sit side by side —
sc164350786.zh: 把评审组当作一支在十二个审视对象上搜索的队伍。对每个对象，柱把 2026 年 18,074 个三人或四人的有评分评审组按有多少位审稿人审视过它来切分——从无人的空白到三人或以上的亮带。这支队伍没有协调：平均每个评审组覆盖十二个对象中的 7.95 个，只有 0.83 个是一致都审视的，4.05 个完全无人造访。重复与盲区并肩而立——

s9e7d9a953b.en: over half of panels put three or more reviewers on empirical scope while two-thirds leave reproducibility unexamined
s9e7d9a953b.zh: 过半评审组有三位或以上审稿人审视实证范围，而三分之二的评审组对可复现性无人审视

sbf36960520.en: , and the objections that decide papers are among the least searched:
sbf36960520.zh: ，而决定论文去留的异议位于最少被搜索之列：

seff89196ae.en: novelty, the costliest charge on the tariff (Plate XIV), goes unexamined by every reviewer in 56% of panels
seff89196ae.zh: 新颖性，量刑表上代价最高的指控（图版 XIV），在 56% 的评审组中无一位审稿人审视

sa7992b1b3e.en: . Coverage here means one unit of any valence — a low bar, deliberately.
sa7992b1b3e.zh: 。此处的覆盖指任一判向的一个单元——门槛很低，有意为之。

sce497c72a6.en: Corpus: 17,848 ICLR 2026 panels (21a) · fourteen deliberations scored in full (21b) · 49,441 panels 2018–2026 (21c–d)
sce497c72a6.zh: 语料：17,848 个 ICLR 2026 评审组（21a） · 十四场完整记谱的合议（21b） · 2018–2026 年 49,441 个评审组（21c–d）

s9143c227c8.en: First, how the 17,848 panels of ICLR 2026 usually end — then fourteen real deliberations, written out like music. Each reviewer is a staff and each unit a note, placed in the order it was reasoned; the dashed barline is where the authors respond, and what follows it carries the fate of each judgment — hardened, softened, or reversed. Faint verticals bind reviewers who touched the same object: ink where they agree, sienna where the same object drew opposite verdicts. Hover any note to read the unit.
s9143c227c8.zh: 先看 ICLR 2026 的 17,848 个评审组通常如何收场——再看十四场真实的合议，像乐谱一样写出。每位审稿人是一行五线谱，每个单元是一个音符，按推理顺序排列；虚线小节线是作者回应之处，其后的部分承载每条判断的命运——趋硬、软化或反转。淡淡的竖线把触及同一对象的审稿人连在一起：一致处为墨色，同一对象引来相反判定处为赭色。悬停任一音符可读该单元。

s5e80c9f70d.zh: 图 21a — 合议通常如何进行

s38f6389a23.en: Six panels in seven — 85.7% — never visibly move at all.
s38f6389a23.zh: 每七个评审组有六个——85.7%——从未有可见的移动。

s6537e7ba5d.en: one bar per ending — silence, procedural, softening, entrenchment, contested — its length the share of panels showing it.
s6537e7ba5d.zh: 每种结局一根柱 — 沉默、程序性、软化、固守、争议 — 长度是呈现该结局的评审组份额。

s712cacd838.en: all 17,848 rated 2026 panels with two or more reviewers whose units could be matched to their rating, classified by the field in which the model records whether a reviewer's judgment strengthened, weakened, or reversed after the authors replied. The five endings overlap (a split panel can also soften) and the levels are machine-read, so treat them as a census of what is visible in writing: movement of any kind is rare —
s712cacd838.zh: 2026 年全部 17,848 个有评分、有两位或以上审稿人且其单元能与评分匹配的评审组，按模型记录审稿人判断在作者回复后是加强、减弱还是反转的那个字段分类。五种结局有重叠（分歧的评审组也可能软化），且各水平由机器读取，所以请把它们当作对书面可见之物的一次普查：任何形式的移动都罕见——

sfcd728b1ea.en: 85.7% of panels never show a judgment change
sfcd728b1ea.zh: 85.7% 的评审组从未显示判断改变

sba8c89abf7.en:
SOURCE deliberation-data.json → population.no_movement, population.n_panels
DERIVATION 15,289 panels with no recorded strengthen/weaken/reverse ÷ 17,848 rated panels × 100 = 85.66%, rounds to 85.7%
VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25
sba8c89abf7.zh:
来源 deliberation-data.json → population.no_movement, population.n_panels
推导 15,289 个无加强/减弱/反转记录的评审组 ÷ 17,848 个有评分评审组 × 100 = 85.66%，四舍五入为 85.7%
核验 已对照发布的 JSON 核对，2026-08-25

s5ef02475ef.en: — and when judgments do move after the response,
s5ef02475ef.zh: ——而当判断在回应后确实移动时，

s0f924f7290.en: strengthening outnumbers softening and reversal combined, 3,543 units to 1,336
s0f924f7290.zh: 加强的数量超过软化与反转之和，3,543 个单元对 1,336 个

sa9179f4f03.en: Fig. 21b — The case files: fourteen deliberations, scored in full
sa9179f4f03.zh: 图 21b — 案件卷宗：十四场合议，完整记谱

s4dd54685ba.en: Everything else in this atlas averages thousands of panels; this figure does the opposite. Below are individual papers — fourteen real 2026 discussions, hand-picked as extreme, legible specimens of the five endings above (not a random sample; the pull-quotes on each card are the panel's final ratings). Open a case to read its full score.
s4dd54685ba.zh: 本图谱中其余一切都在成千个评审组上取平均；这张图反其道而行。下面是单篇论文——十四场真实的 2026 年讨论，手工挑选为上述五种结局的极端且可读的标本（并非随机样本；每张卡片上的引文是评审组的最终评分）。打开一个案例即可阅读其完整乐谱。

s7eecba4490.en: negative unit positive conditional uncertain ▲ hardened after response ▼ softened ↺ reversed
s7eecba4490.zh: 否定单元 肯定 有条件 存疑 ▲ 回应后趋硬 ▼ 软化 ↺ 反转

s7763b568cd.en: rows are the paper's reviewers, ordered by rating (badge at left); notes are their logic units in reasoning order, colored by verdict; the brass barline marks the author response, and the notes after it are the same reviewer returning — the triangle above a note records whether that judgment hardened or softened, the rare ↺ a reversal. The vertical threads are the panel's harmony and dissonance: the same object of scrutiny judged alike (ink) or oppositely (sienna) by different reviewers. Fourteen scenarios were chosen to span the repertoire — softenings, entrenchments, reversals, ten-point splits, unanimity — and every one links to its public page on OpenReview.
s7763b568cd.zh: 各行是该论文的审稿人，按评分排序（左侧为徽标）；音符是他们的逻辑单元，按推理顺序排列，按判定着色；黄铜色小节线标出作者回应，其后的音符是同一位审稿人的再次发言——音符上方的三角记录该判断趋硬还是软化，罕见的 ↺ 表示反转。竖向的线是评审组的和声与不协和：同一审视对象被不同审稿人判得一致（墨色）或相反（赭色）。十四个场景的挑选覆盖了全部曲目——软化、固守、反转、十分之差的分歧、一致——每一个都链接到其在 OpenReview 上的公开页面。

s01eca7c51c.en: Fig. 21c — The repertoire: the five endings and their verdicts
s01eca7c51c.zh: 图 21c — 曲目：五种结局及其裁决

s62ae217ed6.en: The quiet endings accept least — silence 27%, entrenchment 54% (association, not cause)
s62ae217ed6.zh: 安静的结局接收最少 — 沉默 27%，固守 54%（关联，非因果）

s46ee37cc57.en: — and co-reviewers barely inspect the same things strangers would.
s46ee37cc57.zh: ——而同稿审稿人审视的相同之处，几乎不比陌生人多。

s240e71b1f5.en: HOW A DISCUSSION ENDS × HOW OFTEN THE PAPER IS ACCEPTED · 2026
s240e71b1f5.zh: 讨论如何收场 × 论文接收频率 · 2026

se4af46e0cb.en: DO CO-REVIEWERS EVEN INSPECT THE SAME THINGS?
se4af46e0cb.zh: 同稿审稿人审视的究竟是同样的东西吗？

sd11151a9d2.en: each row is one ending of a panel's discussion phase (silence: no post-response units; procedural: units but no recorded movement); the bubble sits at the share of that ending's decided 2026 panels that were accepted, its area is the ending's share of 2026 panels, and the dashed rule is the venue's own 2026 rate (39%) — bubbles slide out from that rule, so a fate that made no difference would never leave it. In four panels out of five, no judgment moves at all; the nine-year composition, year by year, is Fig. 21d below. The acceptance rates are association only: entrenchment accepts most because reinforcement includes reviewers reinforcing praise, and unanimity of silence often means unanimity about rejection. (right)
sd11151a9d2.zh: 每一行是评审组讨论阶段的一种结局（沉默：没有回应后的单元；程序性：有单元但无记录在案的移动）；气泡落在该结局的 2026 年已决评审组中被接收的份额上，面积是该结局在 2026 年评审组中的份额，虚线是会场自身的 2026 年接收率（39%）——气泡从这条线滑出，所以一种不产生差别的命运永远不会离开它。每五个评审组中有四个没有任何判断移动；逐年的九年构成见下方图 21d。接收率仅为关联：固守的接收率最高，因为强化也包括审稿人强化称许；而一致的沉默常意味着一致拒稿。（右）

s525013800f.en: The two curves compare the overlap of inspected objects for reviewers of the same paper against reviewers of different papers: 0.27 versus 0.21
s525013800f.zh: 两条曲线比较同一篇论文的审稿人与不同论文的审稿人在所审视对象上的重叠度：0.27 对 0.21

s87794b128c.en: — reviewers of one paper attend to only marginally more of the same things than strangers do. So the disagreement measured elsewhere in this atlas begins before any verdict is reached, at the choice of what to look at. And the dissonant objects — where co-reviewers reached opposite verdicts — are revisited after the response slightly less often than the agreed ones: the chords do not resolve.
s87794b128c.zh: ——同一篇论文的审稿人关注的相同之处，只比陌生人略多一点。所以本图谱在别处测得的分歧，早在任何判定得出之前、在选择看什么时就已开始。而不协和的对象——同稿审稿人得出相反判定之处——在回应后被重提的频率还略低于一致的对象：和弦没有解决。

s429e1a057a.en: Fig. 21d — The great quieting: 49,441 panels, year by year
s429e1a057a.zh: 图 21d — 大寂静：49,441 个评审组，逐年

s8773d5dbc5.en: Conversation bulges in 2022 and is squeezed shut by 2026 — silence falls 51% → 20%, then climbs all the way back to 52%.
s8773d5dbc5.zh: 对话在 2022 年鼓起，到 2026 年被挤压闭合——沉默从 51% 降到 20%，随后一路回升到 52%。

sb201e1fb0d.en: the shape is the finding: the inked strata rising from the floor are the panels whose discussion phase did anything at all — judgments moving (verdigris, violet, sienna) under talk that moved nothing (dim grey) — and the unmarked page above them is silence. The strata swell toward 2022, the most conversational year the venue has had (judgments moved in 29% of panels), then are squeezed to 13% by 2026, as submissions grew past nineteen thousand; the figures on the boundary are silence's share,
sb201e1fb0d.zh: 形状本身就是发现：从底部升起的着墨地层是讨论阶段有过任何动作的评审组——移动了的判断（铜绿色、紫色、赭色）压在什么都没改变的谈话（暗灰色）之下——其上未着墨的页面是沉默。地层向 2022 年隆起，那是会场有过的最多对话的一年（29% 的评审组有判断移动），随后到 2026 年被挤压到 13%，此时投稿数已超过一万九千；边界上的数字是沉默的份额，

s417b4a3586.en: each year's column stacks to 100% of that year's panels; same categories as 21c, computed per year over all 49,441 panels, 2018–2026. On first view the strata rise out of a flat 2018 and settle into the bulge.
s417b4a3586.zh: 每年的柱堆叠至该年评审组的 100%；类别与 21c 相同，在 2018–2026 年全部 49,441 个评审组上逐年计算。首次进入视野时，地层从平坦的 2018 年升起，落定成隆起。

sc37cb4849c.en: descriptively only: the format, the volume, and the culture all changed together, and this figure cannot separate them.
sc37cb4849c.zh: 仅作描述：形式、规模与文化一同改变，这张图无法把它们分开。

s498e034949.zh: 主席的法庭 — 它权衡什么，借用谁的话 · 图版 XXII–XXIII

s1d95cf2d88.zh: 语料：56,736 个元评审者单元（90% 来自 2024–26） · 6,547 个 2026 年边缘评审组 · 关联，非因果

sff369905c6.en: Above every panel sits an area chair who writes a meta-review — and those were read the same way:
sff369905c6.zh: 每个评审组之上坐着一位撰写元评审的领域主席——这些元评审也以同样的方式读取：

sbf53488175.en: 56,736 meta-reviewer units, nine tenths of them from 2024–26, joined at the margin to 6,547 borderline 2026 panels
sbf53488175.zh: 56,736 个元评审者单元，十分之九来自 2024–26，在边缘处连接到 6,547 个 2026 年边缘评审组

VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25
s6957bd94ab.zh:

sd1492846f4.en: . The higher court has its own grammar: it does not re-litigate the evidence, it weighs the verdicts. And at the margin, where panels sit just below the accept line, its choices reveal which objections it declines to forgive.
sd1492846f4.zh: 。上级法庭有自己的语法：它不重审证据，它权衡裁决。而在边缘处，评审组刚好位于接收线之下，它的选择揭示了它拒绝宽恕哪些异议。

sf27878fa6c.en: Fig. 22a — Two grammars: what the panel inspects, what the chair weighs
sf27878fa6c.zh: 图 22a — 两种语法：评审组审视什么，主席权衡什么

s0f17592eb9.en: The chair does not re-litigate evidence — it weighs verdicts: statistics, positioning, novelty.
s0f17592eb9.zh: 主席不重审证据——它权衡裁决：统计、定位、新颖性。

sa5f1abe4f2.en: Fig. 22b — What the bench forgives at the margin
sa5f1abe4f2.zh: 图 22b — 法官席在边缘处宽恕什么

s5d807b35aa.en: At the margin, only a clarity charge reliably blocks the pardon.
s5d807b35aa.zh: 在边缘处，只有清晰度指控能可靠地挡住赦免。

s89a70b37fc.en: each line is one object of scrutiny; its left end is the object's share of all 952,856 official-reviewer units, its right end its share of the 56,736 meta-reviewer units (nine-tenths of them from 2024–26). The chair's attention is not the panel's:
s89a70b37fc.zh: 每条线是一个审视对象；左端是该对象在全部 952,856 个官方审稿人单元中的占比，右端是它在 56,736 个元评审单元中的占比（其中十分之九来自 2024–26）。领域主席的注意力与评审组的并不相同：

s812d8a9c8c.en: statistics and metrics grow from 10% of reviewer attention to 26% of the chair's, related work from 5% to 16%, novelty doubles
s812d8a9c8c.zh: 统计与指标从占审稿人注意力的 10% 升至占主席注意力的 26%，相关工作从 5% 升至 16%，新颖性翻倍

s37af4f12d1.en: — the objects a chair can rule on from the reviews alone — while
s37af4f12d1.zh: ——这些是主席仅凭评审意见即可裁断的对象——而

sd85c2905ec.en: empirical scope, theory, and method design, the objects that demand re-reading the paper, fall to less than half their reviewer share
sd85c2905ec.zh: 实证范围、理论与方法设计，这些需要重读论文的对象，跌至其审稿人占比的一半以下

s2b9b932486.en: . Meta-review units are also positive 30% of the time against the reviewers' 19%: the higher court speaks in verdict-language, not evidence-language.
s2b9b932486.zh: 。元评审单元为肯定的比例也达 30%，审稿人为 19%：上级法庭讲的是裁决的语言，不讲证据的语言。

s7952a3de02.en: among the 6,547 borderline 2026 panels (mean rating 3.5–5.0, decided), each point compares how often lifted papers carried at least one negative unit on the object against rejected papers at the same mean rating (matched inside 0.25-point bins; whiskers are a 95% interval from resampling whole papers). Left of zero, the charge travels with rejection. The tilts are small and only
s7952a3de02.zh: 在 2026 年 6,547 个边缘评审组中（平均评分 3.5–5.0，已有决定），每个点比较的是：被抬升的论文在该对象上至少带有一个否定单元的频率，对照相同平均评分的被拒论文（在 0.25 分的分箱内匹配；须线为整篇论文重抽样得到的 95% 区间）。零点左侧，该指控与拒稿同行。倾斜都很小，且只有

s7e753ba00b.en: clarity's interval clears zero — a paper the panel found hard to read is 4.4 points less likely to be lifted
s7e753ba00b.zh: 清晰度的区间越过了零——评审组觉得难读的论文，被抬升的可能性低 4.4 个百分点

sb35737caac.en: — but the ordering echoes the tariff of Plate XIV:
sb35737caac.zh: ——但其排序呼应图版 XIV 的量刑表：

sf754b8fb05.en: identity charges (framing, novelty) lean against the lift
sf754b8fb05.zh: 身份类指控（问题界定、新颖性）不利于抬升

s72b7165555.en: robustness and related-work charges are the ones the bench most readily overlooks
s72b7165555.zh: 鲁棒性与相关工作的指控，是法官席最容易放过的

sbfd2a424b5.en: . Clarity is the exception worth naming: it costs a reviewer nothing in score, yet at the bench it blocks the pardon.
sbfd2a424b5.zh: 。清晰度是值得点名的例外：它在审稿人那里不扣分，到了法官席却挡住赦免。

s90723a7dbc.en: Fig. 22c — The redemption: what the chair praises when it lifts a paper
s90723a7dbc.zh: 图 22c — 救赎：主席抬升一篇论文时称许什么

sb565c159f6.en: 75% of a lifted paper's meta-review is praise — of its numbers and its positioning; on rejected borderline papers, praise falls to 8%.
sb565c159f6.zh: 被抬升论文的元评审有 75% 是称许——称许其数字与定位；在被拒的边缘论文上，称许降至 8%。

sf06f12cdf4.en: Fig. 22c — Share of all meta-review units on those same borderline papers that praise each object, for lifted papers against rejected ones. On a lifted paper roughly three-quarters of the meta-review is praise, and its favorite subjects are the numbers and the positioning — "the improvements are significant, the comparisons honest" — while on a rejected borderline paper praise of any kind nearly vanishes. Read as the language of justification, not independent evidence: the meta-review is written by the person who has already decided.
sf06f12cdf4.zh: 图 22c — 同一批边缘论文的全部元评审单元中称许各对象的占比，被抬升论文对照被拒论文。被抬升的论文，其元评审约四分之三是称许，最爱的话题是数字与定位——"the improvements are significant, the comparisons honest"——而在被拒的边缘论文上，任何形式的称许几乎消失。请把它读作辩护的语言，而非独立证据：元评审出自已经做出决定的人之手。

s6c82364b93.zh: 图版 XXIII · 借来的裁决

s21bed8250a.en: Corpus: ICLR 2018–2026 · 8,439 papers · every meta-review unit matched to the reviewer unit it most resembles
s21bed8250a.zh: 语料：ICLR 2018–2026 · 8,439 篇论文 · 每个元评审单元匹配到与之最相似的审稿人单元

s40b0e6dd74.en: Match every meta-review unit to its nearest reviewer unit on the same paper — nearest in wording, not in time — across the 8,439 papers of 2018–2026 with a meta-review of three or more units and at least two official reviews. Three tiers fall out: near-copies, echoes, and the area chair’s own words — and the borrowing has a direction.
s40b0e6dd74.zh: 把每个元评审单元匹配到同一篇论文上与之最近的审稿人单元——措辞上最近，而非时间上——覆盖 2018–2026 年间元评审含三个或更多单元且至少有两篇官方评审的 8,439 篇论文。落出三个层级：近似复制、回声，以及领域主席自己的话——而且借用有方向。

sdcb91bdcf9.en: Fig. 23a — What the meta-review is made of
sdcb91bdcf9.zh: 图 23a — 元评审由什么构成

sbd2e458917.en: 73% of meta-review reasoning is the area chair's own words; 0.5% is near-copy
sbd2e458917.zh: 元评审推理的 73% 是领域主席自己的话；0.5% 是近似复制

sbbc26275cf.en:
SOURCE acecho-data.json → tiers.own, tiers.copy
DERIVATION own = 0.7306 → 73%; copy = 0.0047 → 0.5%, share of meta-review units by cosine-similarity tier to their nearest reviewer unit
VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25
sbbc26275cf.zh:
来源 acecho-data.json → tiers.own, tiers.copy
推导 own = 0.7306 → 73%；copy = 0.0047 → 0.5%，按元评审单元与其最近审稿人单元的余弦相似度层级计算的占比
核验 2026-08-25 对照已发布 JSON 核对

s37bf6a70d8.en: . But criticism is borrowed more than praise — at every cutoff.
s37bf6a70d8.zh: 。但批评比称许被借用得更多——在每个阈值下都如此。

sa6a9da09a7.en: PLATE XXII COMPARED WHAT THE CHAIR WEIGHS — this plate asks where the chair's words come from: matched to the panel's, tier by tier.
sa6a9da09a7.zh: 图版 XXII 比较了主席权衡什么 — 本图版问主席的话从何而来：与评审组的话逐层匹配。

sdf6454b4b3.en: Fig. 23b — When the AC borrows, from whom
sdf6454b4b3.zh: 图 23b — AC 借用时，借自谁

s1470aba578.en: Echoes concentrate on one reviewer (60% from a single voice), and in rejections they lean to the harsher side of the panel, 60/40.
s1470aba578.zh: 回声集中于一位审稿人（60% 来自同一个声音），在拒稿中偏向评审组里更严厉的一侧，60/40。

s15050a7834.en: the bars of 23a left-align the borrowed mass, so the borrowed edges compare directly:
s15050a7834.zh: 23a 的条形把借用部分左对齐，所以借用的边缘可直接比较：

sd2c6c4e447.zh: 批评的边缘比称许的多伸出 6.6 个百分点

s4936cfb179.en: , and the gap survives any cutoff (+7.0 / +6.6 / +3.3 at ≥ 0.70 / 0.75 / 0.80 — thresholds are conventions, so the comparison was recomputed at all three). In 23b the dashed line is blind borrowing: rejections escape it to the harsh side, 60/40; accepts do not (51/49, interval crossing even).
s4936cfb179.zh: ，而且这一差距在任何阈值下都成立（≥ 0.70 / 0.75 / 0.80 时分别为 +7.0 / +6.6 / +3.3——阈值是约定，所以比较在三个阈值下都重算了）。23b 中的虚线是盲目借用：拒稿偏离它、偏向严厉一侧，60/40；接收则没有（51/49，区间跨过对半线）。

sa5d661b4d4.en: tiers by cosine similarity — a 0-to-1 score for how alike two pieces of text are once embedded — between the meta unit’s reasoning and its nearest reviewer unit: near-copy ≥ 0.90, echo 0.75–0.90, below that the AC’s own words. The decision is written, not compiled —
sa5d661b4d4.zh: 层级按余弦相似度划分——一个 0 到 1 的分数，衡量两段文本嵌入后有多相像——比较元评审单元的推理与其最近的审稿人单元：近似复制 ≥ 0.90，回声 0.75–0.90，再往下是 AC 自己的话。决定是写出来的，而非拼凑出来的——

s0fcfcfd363.en: 73% of meta-review reasoning is the chair’s own words, 0.5% near-copy
s0fcfcfd363.zh: 元评审推理的 73% 是主席自己的话，0.5% 是近似复制

sa3a3242b82.en: — but what is borrowed tilts: negative meta units echo reviewers at 28.8% against 22.4% for positive ones, and on papers with three or more echoed units, 60% of echoes come from a single reviewer.
sa3a3242b82.zh: ——但确实被借用的部分有所倾斜：否定的元评审单元有 28.8% 是对审稿人的回声，肯定的为 22.4%；在有三个或更多回声单元的论文上，60% 的回声来自同一位审稿人。

s53ed6fb571.en: among panels where every reviewer’s rating is known and the panel is not unanimous,
s53ed6fb571.zh: 在每位审稿人评分均已知且评审组意见不一致的评审组中，

s270c84681d.en: the most-echoed reviewer is the panel’s uniquely lowest rater in 16% of cases against 13% for the uniquely highest
s270c84681d.zh: 被回声最多的审稿人是评审组内唯一最低评分者的情况占 16%，是唯一最高评分者的占 13%

s1afba9c5a0.en: — a lean, not a rule; in half of panels the echoed reviewer’s rating ties an extreme, the coarse scale allowing no verdict. Nearest-neighbor attribution measures textual proximity, not causal influence: an AC and a reviewer may both echo the paper itself.
s1afba9c5a0.zh: ——是倾向，不是规则；在半数评审组中，被回声的审稿人评分与某个极值打平，粗粒度的量表给不出判定。最近邻归属度量的是文本邻近，而非因果影响：AC 与审稿人可能都在回应论文本身。

s6ec7d49516.en: 8,439 papers of 2018–2026 with ≥ 3 meta-review units and ≥ 2 official reviews; 31,598 meta units matched; the who/side analyses use the 3,334 panels with full, non-unanimous rating panels; the side test keeps the 2,220 decided rejections and 752 accepts where the echo-weighted rating differs from the panel mean at all.
s6ec7d49516.zh: 2018–2026 年间元评审单元 ≥ 3 且官方评审 ≥ 2 的 8,439 篇论文；匹配了 31,598 个元评审单元；借自谁/偏向哪侧的分析使用评分齐全且不一致的 3,334 个评审组；偏向检验保留回声加权评分与评审组均值存在差异的 2,220 个已决定拒稿与 752 个接收。

s18105aafd0.en: can a rating be trusted as a measurement · plates XXIV–XXV
s18105aafd0.zh: 评分能否被当作一次测量来信任 · 图版 XXIV–XXV

se0e2eb871e.en: Corpus: ICLR 2026 & 2025 · every official review, binned by days before the filing peak
se0e2eb871e.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 & 2025 · 每篇官方评审，按提交高峰前的天数分箱

s9f9d90192f.en: The early review is a different document
s9f9d90192f.zh: 早交的评审是另一份文档

s6c2aea147f.en: Reviews filed weeks early run harsher and longer than deadline-day reviews — in both years.
s6c2aea147f.zh: 提前数周提交的评审比截止日当天的评审更严厉、更长——两年皆然。

sa41fc6672e.en: this act asks whether a rating can be trusted as a measurement, and before its plates listen to what a score sounds like, one property of reviews as documents is worth having in hand: they are not interchangeable draws. When a review was written already goes with how harsh and how long it is, and no plate in this atlas controls for filing time — so this stands as a caveat over the whole atlas, backward as well as forward. It is filed in this act because filing time is a fact about the calendar rather than about the text — a confounder of the measurement, not part of what reviews say. The plates where a score first entered the story (VI, XIV, XV) each carry a pointer back to this one, and the reader’s note names it before Act I.
sa41fc6672e.zh: 本幕问评分能否被当作一次测量来信任；在本幕的图版去听一个分数听起来像什么之前，评审作为文档的一个性质值得先握在手里：它们不是可互换的抽样。一篇评审何时写成，已经与它多严厉、多长相伴，而本图谱中没有任何图版控制了提交时间——所以这是一条悬在整个图谱之上的注意事项，向后也向前。它归在本幕，因为提交时间是关于日历的事实，而非关于文本——它是测量的混杂因素，不属于评审所说的内容。分数首次进入故事的那些图版（VI、XIV、XV）各带一个指回本图版的指针，读者须知也在第一幕之前点了它的名。

s89d4cd25c0.en: every official review of ICLR 2026 and 2025 was placed in a bin by how many days before that year's filing peak — the de-facto deadline — it was first posted, and each bin's mean rating, median length and mean number of units were computed.
s89d4cd25c0.zh: ICLR 2026 与 2025 的每篇官方评审，按其首次发布距当年提交高峰（事实上的截止日）多少天分箱，并计算每箱的平均评分、长度中位数与平均单元数。

s82ec98dba4.en: the horizontal axis runs from two weeks early, on the left, to after the deadline, on the right. Left: mean rating, shown as the deviation from the same year's deadline-day mean so the two scale regimes never share an axis; whiskers are bootstrap 95% intervals. Right: median length in words. The gradient is monotone and replicates in both years:
s82ec98dba4.zh: 横轴从左侧的提前两周延伸到右侧的截止日之后。左图：平均评分，显示为相对同年截止日当天均值的偏差，使两种量表体系永不共用一根轴；须线为自助法 95% 区间。右图：长度中位数（词数）。梯度单调，且在两年中都复现：

s7ed8614c19.en: reviews filed two or more weeks early run about half a point (2026: −0.48; 2025: −0.34) harsher and some fifty words longer than deadline-day reviews
s7ed8614c19.zh: 提前两周或更早提交的评审，比截止日当天的评审严厉约半分（2026：−0.48；2025：−0.34），长约五十个词

scd9f1dbb3a.en: , and carry more units of logic (5.68 vs 5.40). Read without a causal story — early filing is not randomly assigned: reviewers who finish early may simply be those with the most to say, and a paper that invites a swift, thorough rejection gets one. What this establishes, robustly, is only a correlation: when a review was filed goes together with how harsh and how long it is. ⚖ the scale itself changed four times over these years — method § 10 · the moving ruler
scd9f1dbb3a.zh: ，并且带有更多逻辑单元（5.68 vs 5.40）。读时不要套因果故事——提前提交不是随机分配的：早完成的审稿人也许恰是最有话可说的人，而一篇招来迅速、彻底拒绝的论文也就得到了这样一篇评审。这里稳健确立的只是一种相关：评审何时提交，与它多严厉、多长相伴。⚖ 这些年间量表本身改了四次 — 方法 § 10 · 移动的标尺

sc342f8549a.en: Corpus: ICLR 2026 · official ratings joined at display time
sc342f8549a.zh: 语料：ICLR 2026 · 官方评分在显示时才拼接

s21458632f7.zh: 每个分数听起来像什么

s4df41703c0.en: a question the researcher set down before any number existed: why is a low score low, and why is a high score high? Ratings and units were extracted independently, so joining them can answer it. Some of what follows is near-tautological (a low score has more negative units); the caption marks which findings are not.
s4df41703c0.zh: 研究者在任何数字存在之前就写下的一个问题：低分为什么低，高分为什么高？评分与单元是独立提取的，所以把二者拼接起来可以回答它。下文有些内容近乎同义反复（低分有更多否定单元）；图注标出了哪些发现不是。

s939e84994e.en: join every 2026 review's official rating — never shown to the extraction pipeline — to its logic units: what a 2 argues about, what an 8 still checks, and where on the ladder the reviewer's own confidence lives.
s939e84994e.zh: 把 2026 年每篇评审的官方评分——从未展示给提取流水线——与其逻辑单元拼接：一个 2 分在争论什么，一个 8 分仍在检查什么，以及审稿人自己的置信度落在阶梯的哪一级。

s09d7585c3d.en: Fig. 24a — The ladder: verdict mix per rating (ICLR 2026, whose ratings run 0–10 in steps of two)
s09d7585c3d.zh: 图 24a — 阶梯：各评分的判定构成（ICLR 2026，评分从 0 到 10、每两分一级）

s10c2f42575.en: Even a perfect 10 is one-third objection (35% negative units); a 0 is 91% condemnation.
s10c2f42575.zh: 即便满分 10 也有三分之一是异议（35% 为否定单元）；0 分则 91% 是谴责。

s88d4785848.en: The mix, not just the amount, is the score.
s88d4785848.zh: 分数在于构成，不只在于数量。

s5bb74f5a0b.en: PLATE VI’S JOIN, READ BACKWARD — the Early Verdict asked how well the verdict mix predicts the score; this ladder reads the same join the other way: what each score is made of.
s5bb74f5a0b.zh: 图版 VI 的拼接，反向读 — 早判问的是判定构成预测分数的准确程度；本阶梯把同一拼接反过来读：每个分数由什么构成。

s44b02da818.en: Fig. 24b — What a 2 argues vs what an 8 argues (share of units per standard)
s44b02da818.zh: 图 24b — 2 分在争论什么 vs 8 分在争论什么（各标准的单元占比）

s8f0beef60e.en: The standards swap with the verdict:

s97b84d9866.en: novelty and fair comparison belong to the 2 (18% vs 12%, 10% vs 6% of units), merit recognition to the 8 (7% → 29%)
s97b84d9866.zh: 新颖性与公平比较属于 2 分（单元占比 18% vs 12%、10% vs 6%），价值认可属于 8 分（7% → 29%）

s46bd1b5c47.en: rating 2rating 8
s46bd1b5c47.zh: 评分 2评分 8

sdbe3e2b1ea.en: Fig. 24c — The relocation of scrutiny: share of reviews that inspect each object, per rating
sdbe3e2b1ea.zh: 图 24c — 审视的转移：审视各对象的评审占比，按评分

s5e4e1543df.en: novelty falls 20% → 9% and baselines 42% → 29% up the ladder
s5e4e1543df.zh: 沿阶梯向上，新颖性从 20% → 9%，基线从 42% → 29%

sb0efe6872e.en: theory, method design and compute rise
sb0efe6872e.zh: 理论、方法设计与计算成本上升

saf77a7fa59.en: Fig. 24d — Same paper, split verdict: share of papers where each side condemns the object
saf77a7fa59.zh: 图 24d — 同一论文，分歧裁决：各方谴责该对象的论文占比

sb30d9e6c7c.en: On the same paper, both sides inspect theory and method at identical rates and split only on the verdict —
sb30d9e6c7c.zh: 在同一篇论文上，双方以相同的比例审视理论与方法，只在判定上分歧——

sd711c0a24a.en: novelty is the weapon only the low side draws: 21% vs 4%.
sd711c0a24a.zh: 新颖性是只有低分一方才拔出的武器：21% vs 4%。

s7df1c9d155.en: PLATE XXI ASKED THIS OF EVERY PANEL — contested ground counted opposite stances across all papers; here only the pairs already split on the score, asking what each side condemns.
