s3ad349adbe.en: 93% of multi-review papers disagree, half by four points or more — yet at a fixed exact mean, unanimous and divided panels are decided alike (92% vs 92% at mean 6.0; 12% vs 13% at mean 4.0).
s3ad349adbe.zh: 93% 的多评审论文存在分歧，半数相差四分或更多——但在固定的精确均值下，一致与分歧的评审组得到同样的决定（均值 6.0 时 92% vs 92%；均值 4.0 时 12% vs 13%）。

s1d4e67b246.en: each row is one rating; the bar is the verdict mix of its units; the thin brass underbar is the relative number of reviews at that rating; the right column reads n reviews · units per review · mean reviewer confidence (1–5). Ratings are joined at display time only; extraction never saw them. Five findings that are not the tautology (low score = more negative): (1) Scrutiny relocates rather than shrinks — novelty largely disappears from an 8's review (a novelty unit appears in 20% of 2-reviews but only 9% of 8-reviews) and baselines (42% → 29%), but inspects theory, method design, and compute more than a 2 does. (2) A 2's praise leans consolation — both courts of praise lead with empirical scope, but a 2's rare positive units tilt toward the packaging (clarity takes 13% of them against an 8's 8%, framing 8% against 6% — "well written, nice motivation") while an 8's run deeper into theory (16% vs 13%). (3) There are many ways to fail — within-rating diversity of what reviews discuss falls monotonically as the rating rises, so that reviews rating a paper 0 are the most varied in subject and those rating it 10 the most alike: unhappiness is diverse, excellence has one shape. (4) In split verdicts on the very same paper, both reviewers inspect theory and method at identical rates and merely disagree on the verdict — but novelty is a weapon only the low scorer draws (condemned by 21% of 2-givers vs 4% of their 8-giving co-reviewers, across the 1,789 papers rated both 2 and 8). Quieter still: the reviewer's own confidence follows a U (4.2 at 0 · 3.4 at 6 · 3.9 at 10), and mid-scale criticism is the most actionable (78% of a 2–4's units carry a fix vs 56% at 10). (5) The decision is a mean, not a variance — 93% of multi-review papers carry disagreement (half of them by 4 points or more), and disagreement peaks for mid-scoring papers; yet holding the exact mean fixed, a unanimous panel and a divided one are accepted at the same rate — 92.1% vs 91.8% at mean 6.0, and 12% vs 13% at mean 4.0, where the threshold actually bites. A naive banded version of this analysis suggests "consensus is fate" — that is a mean-composition confound, and the panel averages it away.
s1d4e67b246.zh: 每行是一个评分；条形是其单元的判定构成；下方细黄铜条是该评分下评审数量的相对值；右栏读作：n 篇评审 · 每篇评审的单元数 · 审稿人平均置信度（1–5）。评分仅在显示时拼接；提取从未见过它们。五条不属于同义反复（低分 = 更多否定）的发现：（1）审视在转移，而非收缩——新颖性在 8 分评审中几近消失（新颖性单元出现在 20% 的 2 分评审中，8 分评审中只有 9%），基线亦然（42% → 29%），但它对理论、方法设计与计算成本的审视多于 2 分。（2）2 分的称许偏向安慰——两个称许法庭都以实证范围开头，但 2 分罕见的肯定单元偏向包装（清晰度占其 13%，8 分为 8%；问题界定则是 8% 对 6%——"well written, nice motivation"），而 8 分的称许更深入理论（16% vs 13%）。（3）失败的方式很多——评审所讨论主题的评分内多样性随评分上升单调下降，于是给 0 分的评审主题最杂，给 10 分的最相似：不满是多样的，卓越只有一种形状。（4）在同一篇论文的分歧裁决中，两位审稿人以相同比例审视理论与方法，仅在判定上不同——但新颖性是只有低分者才拔出的武器（在同时被评 2 和 8 的 1,789 篇论文中，21% 的给 2 分者谴责它，其给 8 分的共同审稿人中只有 4%）。更安静的一条：审稿人自己的置信度呈 U 形（0 分时 4.2 · 6 分时 3.4 · 10 分时 3.9），中段的批评最可执行（2–4 分的单元中 78% 附有修复，10 分时为 56%）。（5）决定是均值，不是方差——93% 的多评审论文存在分歧（其中半数相差 4 分或更多），分歧在中等分数的论文上达到峰值；但固定精确均值后，一致的评审组与分歧的评审组以相同比例被接收——均值 6.0 时 92.1% vs 91.8%，均值 4.0 时 12% vs 13%，那正是门槛真正起作用之处。此分析的一个粗糙分段版本会暗示"共识即命运"——那是均值构成的混杂，评审组把它平均掉了。

s636e0b43d0.en: type any panel's scores and they land on the upper rule; a pair of dividers measures the spread (max − min), then transfers that measurement onto the lower axis, where every real ICLR 2026 panel with three or more rated reviews is stacked by its spread. Bar heights are √-scaled so the rare wide splits stay visible; the green fraction of each bar, and the percentage above it, is the share of those panels accepted. One quiet regularity worth knowing: a wide split is not a death sentence — panels split by eight points were accepted 47% of the time (a thin bin — 168 panels), while perfect unanimity was accepted 30% of the time (1,319 panels), because unanimity is most often unanimity about rejection. The spread of scores has also not collapsed over the decade — the entropy of each year's score distribution — a 0-to-1 measure of how evenly the scores spread across the available levels, where 1 would mean every level used equally — normalized to that year's own scale so that changes of scoring form do not masquerade as changes of behavior, holds between 0.74 and 0.82 in every year but one (2020's four-point form reads 0.92) — so "everyone scores a six now" is not what the record shows. ⚖ the scale itself changed four times over these years — method § 10 · the moving ruler
s636e0b43d0.zh: 输入任一评审组的评分，它们会落在上方标尺上；一副两脚规量出分差（最大 − 最小），再把这一量度转移到下方坐标轴，那里堆放着 ICLR 2026 每一个有三篇或以上评分评审的真实评审组，按分差排列。柱高按 √ 缩放，使罕见的大分歧仍可见；每根柱的绿色部分及其上方的百分比，是这些评审组中被接收的份额。一条值得知道的安静规律：分歧大不是死刑判决 — 分差八分的评审组有 47% 被接收（一个薄分箱 — 168 个评审组），而完全一致的评审组只有 30% 被接收（1,319 个评审组），因为一致多半是一致拒稿。评分的分差在这十年间也没有塌缩 — 每年评分分布的熵 — 一个 0 到 1 的量度，衡量评分在可用等级上分布得多均匀，1 表示每个等级使用得同样多 — 按当年自身尺度归一化，使评分表的变更不会伪装成行为的变更，除一年外每年都保持在 0.74 到 0.82 之间（2020 年的四档表为 0.92）— 所以“现在人人都打六分”并非记录所示。⚖ 这些年里评分尺度本身变过四次 — 方法 § 10 · 移动的标尺

s9fb555f519.en: a deliberately simple model, stated in full. Each paper's underlying value is estimated from its observed panel mean by the variance decomposition of Fig. 25a (shrunk toward the venue mean in proportion to the reliability of a panel its size); a fresh panel of the same size then re-reads it, and the venue's own empirical acceptance curve — the observed P(accept | panel mean) — makes a fresh margin call. The line is the probability, over 4,000 such redraws, that the decision comes out differently, by observed panel mean. In the band where most decided papers live the redraw is close to a coin toss (
s9fb555f519.zh: 一个有意从简的模型，全文陈述如下。每篇论文的潜在价值由其观测到的评审组均值经图 25a 的方差分解估得（按同等规模评审组的信度比例向会议均值收缩）；再由一个同等规模的新评审组重读它，会议自身的经验接收曲线 — 观测到的 P(accept | panel mean) — 重新做一次临界裁定。曲线是在 4,000 次这样的重抽中，按观测评审组均值计，决定变得不同的概率。在多数已决论文所处的区间，重抽接近掷硬币（

se2b3d39a8d.en: ), falling toward certainty only at the extremes. Under this model 37% of all 14,175 decided 2026 papers — and 58% of the accepted ones — would receive the other decision from a fresh draw; on 2025's finer scale the accepted-paper figure is 45%. The NeurIPS experiments, which ran real second committees, found roughly half of accepted papers un-reproduced. This model lands in the same range, which is reassuring but is not a validation: one is a real second committee, the other a simulation built from this atlas's own variance estimate. This measures the system's precision under its constraints, not any panel's diligence; and because the margin call is itself part of the redraw, it counts the decision layer's own latitude alongside the panel draw.
se2b3d39a8d.zh: ），只在两端才趋于确定。在此模型下，全部 14,175 篇已决的 2026 年论文中有 37% — 接收论文中有 58% — 会在重抽一次后得到相反的决定；在 2025 年更细的尺度上，接收论文的这一数字为 45%。NeurIPS 的实验真的组建了第二委员会，发现约一半接收论文未被复现。本模型落在同一区间，令人安心，但不是验证：一个是真实的第二委员会，另一个是用本图谱自己的方差估计搭建的模拟。它度量的是系统在其约束下的精度，而非任何评审组的勤勉；而且由于临界裁定本身也是重抽的一部分，它把决定层自身的余地与评审组抽取一并计入。

s3aba6412f9.en: — scrutiny has drifted from what is this idea? toward what does the evidence cost, and does it cover the claim? Negativity in the nine-year corpus holds near 77% all nine years (the 2026 corpus reads 71.8% — a different memo style, the same story). The share of units the labeller places in the same category on a held-out check is the same in the early years as in the late ones (0.81), so the drift is a change in what reviewers wrote, not a change in how well the labels fit older text. The moves are small in points but far outside noise — a reviewer-clustered bootstrap (2,721 reviewers in 2018 against 73,427 in 2026) puts each of the four named moves at eight to sixteen times its standard error; in relative terms
s3aba6412f9.zh: — 审视已从这个想法是什么？漂向证据花了什么代价，它是否覆盖了主张？九年语料中的否定率九年都维持在 77% 左右（2026 语料为 71.8% — 备忘风格不同，故事相同）。标注器在留出检验中把单元归入同一类别的占比，早年与晚年相同（0.81），所以这一漂移是审稿人所写内容的变化，而非标签对旧文本贴合度的变化。这些移动以百分点计很小，却远在噪声之外 — 按审稿人聚类的自助法（2018 年 2,721 位审稿人对 2026 年 73,427 位）把四个点名的移动各置于其标准误的八到十六倍；以相对值计

s728357c192.en: The Drift plate showed enforcement changing — which objections are raised, how often, at what price. This plate asks about the statute itself. It was run expecting to find a change: nine years spanning the arrival of large language models seemed likely to have rewritten what counts as a new contribution. The result is negative, and is reported as a negative result. The test: fit the code of novelty on 2026 sentences alone, then hold every earlier year against it. If the law had been rewritten, 2018 should sit measurably farther from the 2026 code than 2026 does from itself.
s728357c192.zh: 漂移图版展示了执法在变 — 提出哪些异议、多频繁、代价几何。本图版问的是法条本身。运行它时预期会找到变化：横跨大语言模型到来的九年，看起来很可能已经改写了什么算作新贡献。结果为负，并作为负结果报告。检验方法：只用 2026 年语句拟合新颖性法典，再把每个更早年份对照它。若法则被改写过，2018 年到 2026 法典的距离应当可测地大于 2026 年到它自身的距离。

sf5a9237220.en: — and sentences cluster within reviews, so even that overstates the certainty), so the null is a claim about size, not undetectability — a drift of a few percent in the rule’s phrasing, beside the double-digit relative swings in its enforcement one plate back. The lower strip draws exactly this — each year’s deviation in SE units against a ±2SE corridor — and the bars beneath place the phrasing drift beside Plate XXVI’s four enforcement movers (different rulers, shown for scale, not as a test). An embedding distance can also only see changes large enough to shift the phrasing, and the six clauses are coarse. Right, each year’s sentences assigned to the 2026 clauses: all six clauses are present in every year of the record — the differentiation clause holds 36–50%, the combination clause 29–35%, the transfer clause 5–7%. One slow tilt is real: the differentiation clause’s share slips from 50% in 2018 to 38% in 2026, with the combination clause absorbing most of it — a drift in which clause reviewers reach for, not in what any clause says, so it belongs with Plate XXVI’s enforcement story rather than against this plate’s null. Two owned limits: sentence embeddings could miss a subtle semantic shift that preserves register; and the transfer clause rides on the code’s one genuinely mixed cluster (most of its sentences describe applying a known technique in a new setting, though some read equally well as ordinary differentiation claims), so its band is the least certain of the six. What changed across nine years is the docket’s traffic and its price (Plates XXVI, XIV) — not its text: the fashions of scrutiny moved; the stated standard of newness did not.
sf5a9237220.zh: — 而且句子在评审内部成簇，所以连这个数字也高估了确定性），因此这里的零假设是关于幅度的断言，而非关于不可探测 — 规则措辞上几个百分点的漂移，与前一张图版中其执行力度两位数的相对摆动并列。下方的条带画的正是这一点 — 每一年以 SE 为单位的偏离，对照 ±2SE 的走廊 — 其下的柱把措辞漂移与图版 XXVI 的四个执行变动项并排（尺子不同，只为标示尺度，不作检验）。嵌入距离也只能看到大到足以改变措辞的变化，而六条条款是粗粒度的。右图，每一年的句子归入 2026 年的条款：全部六条条款在记录的每一年都存在 — 区分条款占 36–50%，组合条款占 29–35%，迁移条款占 5–7%。有一处缓慢的倾斜是真实的：区分条款的份额从 2018 年的 50% 滑到 2026 年的 38%，其中大部分被组合条款吸收 — 这是审稿人伸手取用哪条条款的漂移，而非任何条款所言的漂移，所以它属于图版 XXVI 的执行故事，而不是对本图版零假设的反证。两处自认的局限：句子嵌入可能漏掉保留语体的细微语义变化；迁移条款依托于该编码中唯一真正混合的聚类（其多数句子描述把已知技术应用于新场景，但有些读起来同样像普通的区分主张），所以它的色带是六条中最不确定的。九年间变化的是这份案卷的流量与代价（图版 XXVI、XIV）— 而非它的文本：审视的风尚移动了；明述的新颖性标准没有。

s9140f0708f.en: every island is one primary area, placed by multidimensional scaling — a method that puts similarly-treated items near each other on a map — of its criticism fingerprint — fields that are criticized in the same way drift together, and the theory-judged fields form their own archipelago in the east while the applied coasts lie west. Island size is the number of 2026 papers; the shape of the coastline is the fingerprint itself: each of the twelve objects of scrutiny is a fixed compass direction (the rose gives the bearings), and a cape grows toward every object the field is charged with more often than the venue baseline, a bay where it is charged less. So

sf6ed5601c9.en: since 2023, some unknown share of reviews has been written with a language model's help. No review discloses this, and per-review detectors are unreliable — they flag non-native English as machine text and are trivially evaded — so this plate never asks which review. It asks what a corpus-level instrument can honestly measure: whether the record as a whole moved toward the documented signature of machine-assisted prose. One published estimate already exists for one year — about 10.6% of ICLR 2024 review sentences were substantially LLM-modified (Liang et al., ICML 2024). This plate extends the question across all nine years with a simpler, fully reproducible instrument.
sf6ed5601c9.zh: 自 2023 年起，有一部分比例未知的评审是在语言模型的帮助下写成的。没有一篇评审披露这一点，而逐篇评审的检测器不可靠 — 它们把非母语英语标为机器文本，又极易被规避 — 所以本图版从不问哪一篇评审。它问的是一件语料层面的仪器能诚实测量什么：记录整体是否朝着有文献记载的机器辅助文风指纹移动。已有一项针对单一年份的公开估计 — ICLR 2024 约 10.6% 的评审句子被 LLM 实质修改过（Liang et al., ICML 2024）。本图版用一件更简单、完全可复现的仪器，把这个问题延展到全部九年。

s22c3ab817d.en: a thirteen-word signature list was frozen before any counting, taken verbatim from the two studies that quantified LLM-preferred vocabulary (Liang et al., ICML 2024; Kobak et al., Science Advances 2025): commendable, meticulous, meticulously, intricate, pivotal, versatile, delve, delves, delving, underscores, underscoring, showcases, showcasing. For every year, the share of reviews containing at least one of these words; the expectation from the 2018–2022 trend alone; and the excess above it. Alongside: how alike co-reviews of the same paper have become, and how the marked minority behaves. The full plan, hypotheses and decision rules were written down before computation (method § 12).
s22c3ab817d.zh: 一份十三词的指纹词表在任何计数之前即已冻结，逐字取自量化 LLM 偏好词汇的两项研究（Liang et al., ICML 2024；Kobak et al., Science Advances 2025）：commendable, meticulous, meticulously, intricate, pivotal, versatile, delve, delves, delving, underscores, underscoring, showcases, showcasing。对每一年：含这些词中至少一个的评审份额；仅由 2018–2022 年趋势得出的预期；以及高于预期的超出量。与之并列：同一篇论文的同稿评审变得多么相像，以及被标记的少数如何表现。完整的计划、假设与决策规则在计算之前已写下（方法 § 12）。

s4e599d0dcf.en: nothing here attributes any trend to AI, and the watermark is ink, not a census. The list is a lower-bound tracer with a shelf life: newer models prefer different words, ICLR 2026 required reviewers to disclose LLM use, and a reviewer can delete the tells in one editing pass — so the 2026 fade is ambiguous three ways (different models, the new rule, or cleaner laundering). A fourth explanation was checked and excluded:
s4e599d0dcf.zh: 这里没有任何东西把任何趋势归因于 AI，而且水印是墨迹，不是普查。这份词表是一个有保质期的下限示踪剂：更新的模型偏好不同的词，ICLR 2026 要求审稿人披露 LLM 使用，而审稿人一次编辑就能删掉这些破绽 — 所以 2026 年的淡去有三种歧义（不同的模型、新规则，或更干净的洗稿）。第四种解释经检查已被排除：

sfbdeb1cf3b.en: — is flat. So the convergence is real in the words and unproven in the targets: what co-reviewers say grows alike; what they choose to charge does not measurably follow. That divide has an honest reading the plate cannot prove: expert annotation finds full machine authorship leaving a content fingerprint — AI reviewers’ criticisms overlap with each other seven times more than humans’ (21% vs 3%; Kim et al., arXiv:2605.20668, the “hivemind effect” of Baumann et al., arXiv:2605.03202) — while prose-level assistance would converge the wording and leave the choices alone, which is the pattern this record shows. One neighbouring study reads a shift in ICLR review-text diagnostics at the 2022–23 transition (arXiv:2607.10511); this plate’s own placebo puts the vocabulary’s arrival one cycle later — different instruments, both correlational, both cited rather than reconciled. And one prediction from the LLM-review literature fails here, and is reported as failing: benchmark studies find machine-written reviews lexically flatter (arXiv:2605.25415), but each review’s own lexical diversity sits at a nine-year high in 2026 — type-token ratio 0.638 over a review’s first 200 words, against 0.578–0.598 in every earlier year. The record converges between reviews while growing more varied within them; whatever is homogenizing the juries is not flattening the prose.
sfbdeb1cf3b.zh: — 是平的。所以趋同在用词上真实存在，在指控目标上未获证明：同稿审稿人说的话越来越像；他们选择指控什么则没有可测量的跟随。这一分野有一种本图版无法证明的坦率解读：专家标注发现，完全由机器撰写会留下内容指纹 — AI 审稿人的批评彼此重叠的程度是人类的七倍（21% 对 3%；Kim et al., arXiv:2605.20668，以及 Baumann et al., arXiv:2605.03202 的 “hivemind effect”）— 而文句层面的辅助只会让措辞趋同、不动选择，这正是本记录呈现的模式。一项相邻研究在 2022–23 年的过渡处读到 ICLR 评审文本诊断量的变化（arXiv:2607.10511）；本图版自己的安慰剂检验则把这套词汇的到来定在晚一个周期 — 仪器不同，都是相关性结论，此处只并列引用，不做调和。LLM 评审文献的一项预测在这里失效，并如实报告为失效：基准研究发现机器撰写的评审在词汇上更平（arXiv:2605.25415），但每篇评审自身的词汇多样性在 2026 年处于九年最高 — 评审前 200 词的类符/形符比为 0.638，此前各年为 0.578–0.598。这份记录在评审之间趋同，在评审之内却更为多样；无论是什么在让陪审团同质化，它都没有把文句压平。

scce20df40a.zh: 图 29d — 结构静止不动：三件仪器，无收窄

sb9d732ed96.en: The mix of criticism spreads slightly, a reviewer’s own apparent spread turns out to be mostly its null, and the distilled reasoning’s co-review gap holds still — nine years, no structural narrowing.

s8b1350cb94.en: THE CORRECTION’S OTHER HALF — Fig. 29c found the prose converging; these three instruments ask whether the substance followed. It did not: the convergence, so far, lives in the words.
s8b1350cb94.zh: 更正的另一半 — 图 29c 发现文句在趋同；这三件仪器追问实质是否跟随。没有：到目前为止，趋同只存在于用词之中。

s5bec17521f.en: ENTROPY = EVENNESS OF THE MIX, 1.00 = ALL TWELVE EQUAL · MIDDLE, BRASS DASH = N-MATCHED NULL (SAME UNIT COUNTS, OBJECTS DRAWN FROM THE YEAR’S MIX) · GAP = CO-REVIEW MINUS CROSS-PAPER REASONING SIMILARITY · A STRUCTURAL NARROWING WOULD BEND ANY OF THESE DOWN AFTER 2023 — NONE DOES

s05e45de106.en: So this panel affirms nothing about widening — and since its null draws from the year’s mix, it is best read as the left panel’s check at the person grain, not a third independent instrument. What it still rules out is the claim that matters: after 2023 the observed-minus-null excess shows no downward bend. Right: the sub-unit grain — each unit’s distilled reasoning, in embedding space: the gap between co-review pairs of one paper and random cross-paper pairs holds at ≈0.012 in every year, and the year’s overall dispersion is unchanged (0.231 → 0.229). Three owned limits: twelve categories are coarse, so a convergence inside one category is invisible here; the embeddings read the atlas’s distilled reasoning, whose uniform extractor voice is shared by all years — it can mask a converging style, though converging content should still register; and a corpus-level mix says nothing about any single paper. The null pattern is the point: had the machine era narrowed what review looks at, some line here would bend down after 2023.
s05e45de106.zh: 因此这一面板对拓宽不作任何肯定 — 而且它的零模型取自当年构成，最好把它读作左图在个人粒度上的复核，而非第三件独立仪器。它仍然排除的是那条要紧的断言：2023 年后，观测减零模型的余量没有向下弯折。右图：亚单元粒度 — 每个单元的提炼推理，置于嵌入空间：同一论文的同稿评审配对与随机跨论文配对之间的差距每年都保持在 ≈0.012，当年的整体离散度不变（0.231 → 0.229）。三条自认的局限：十二个类别很粗，所以一个类别内部的趋同在这里看不见；嵌入读取的是图谱的提炼推理，其统一的抽取器语气为所有年份共有 — 它可能掩盖风格的趋同，但内容的趋同仍应显现；而语料层面的构成对任何单篇论文都不置一词。零模式正是要点：若机器时代收窄了评审所审视的范围，这里总会有某条线在 2023 年后向下弯折。

sb784788b71.en: Fig. 29e — The company the watermark keeps

s97f7c7d9e0.en: The marked review is longer, cites less, and hands its paper a slightly higher score than its own co-reviews (firm in 2024–25, marginal in 2026) — and its distinctness is dissolving year by year.
s97f7c7d9e0.zh: 带标记的评审更长、引用更少，给论文的评分略高于同稿评审（2024–25 年确定，2026 年边缘）— 而它的独特性正逐年消散。

s7dcbb04287.en: THE AI-LOTTERY DESIGN, WITH A TRANSPARENT INSTRUMENT — Latona et al. found detector-flagged ICLR 2024 reviews scoring higher within the same paper. The paired comparison here replicates that direction for 2024–2026 with the frozen public word list in place of a proprietary detector.
s7dcbb04287.zh: AI 彩票研究的设计，换上透明的仪器 — Latona et al. 发现被检测器标出的 ICLR 2024 评审在同一论文内评分更高。这里的配对比较用冻结的公开词表取代专有检测器，在 2024–2026 年复现了同一方向。

sc3d190be90.zh: 同一论文内，带标记评审的平均评分减去未标记评审的平均评分

s261724d8c4.en: a paper’s longest review (hatched) scores lower than its peers by 0.17–0.35 points
s261724d8c4.zh: 一篇论文最长的评审（阴影线）比其同侪评分低 0.17–0.35 分

s6b282d3312.en: , and marked reviews are the long ones (+58 to +123 words), so length alone predicts the opposite sign. Split by the co-reviews’ own verdict — under a permutation control, because conditioning on the comparison group manufactures a weak-paper gradient out of mean reversion alone — the premium survives in every quality band (+0.07 to +0.28 points over the permuted baseline), running mildly larger for weakly-rated papers in 2024–25, the direction the newest leniency study predicts (Sharma et al., arXiv:2601.20920). Bottom block, with reviews compared only against same-length peers: the marked review cites scholarship less (“et al.” −6.3 points in 2024) and replies less in the rebuttal (−0.08 exchanges) — the profile the ICML study found for machine-modified text — but
s6b282d3312.zh: ，而带标记的评审正是长的那些（多 +58 到 +123 词），所以单凭长度预测的是相反的符号。按同稿评审自身的裁决分层 — 并加置换对照，因为以比较组为条件，仅凭均值回归就会造出一个弱论文梯度 — 溢价在每个质量档都保留下来（比置换基线高 +0.07 到 +0.28 分），2024–25 年对低评分论文略大，正是最新宽松性研究预测的方向（Sharma et al., arXiv:2601.20920）。下块，评审只与同等长度的同侪比较：带标记的评审引用文献更少（“et al.” 2024 年 −6.3 个百分点），在 rebuttal 中回复也更少（−0.08 次交流）— 这正是 ICML 研究在机器修改文本中发现的特征 — 但

sf76aca7536.en: both gaps thin each year and the rebuttal gap is gone by 2026 (−0.0009)
sf76aca7536.zh: 两个差距逐年变薄，rebuttal 差距到 2026 年已消失（−0.0009）

s5c439b4659.en: . The null shape matters as much as the effects: as the watermark fades, the population it marks stops being distinctive — consistent with the residue of Fig. 29b belonging increasingly to ordinary, engaged reviewers who have simply absorbed the vocabulary. Confidence runs mildly higher for marked reviews (+0.03, length-adjusted) in all three years — the one place this record disagrees with the ICML study’s low-confidence profile, and it is reported as the disagreement it is.
s5c439b4659.zh: 。零形态与效应同等重要：随着水印淡去，它标出的人群不再独特 — 这与图 29b 的残余越来越多地属于普通、投入、只是吸收了这套词汇的审稿人相一致。带标记评审的置信度在三年里都略高（+0.03，已按长度调整）— 这是本记录与 ICML 研究的低置信度特征唯一相左之处，并如实报告为分歧。

s56a56be048.en: the raw reasoning, held against its originals · plate XXX
s56a56be048.zh: 原始推理，与原文对照 · 图版 XXX

s15eafe4986.en: not at random. For each of the twelve objects of scrutiny, up to twenty reviews were taken that contain at least one unit confidently assigned to that object (label similarity 0.75 or better), deduplicated across objects — 232 reviews in all. The sample therefore covers the taxonomy evenly rather than reflecting how often each object occurs, and it is here to be checked against the originals, not to be counted. Each review is shown as its structured logic flow. Filter by object, standard, or verdict; non-matching units dim. Every title links to the paper's OpenReview page, and each review ID opens the exact review — so you can hold the atlas's reading against the original.
s15eafe4986.zh: 并非随机。对十二个审视对象中的每一个，最多取二十篇评审，要求至少含一个被有把握地归入该对象的单元（标签相似度 0.75 或更高），跨对象去重 — 共 232 篇评审。因此样本均匀覆盖分类体系，而不反映各对象出现的频率；它放在这里是供与原文核对的，不是供计数的。每篇评审以其结构化逻辑流呈现。可按对象、标准或判定筛选；不匹配的单元变暗。每个标题链接到论文的 OpenReview 页面，每个评审 ID 打开对应的那篇评审 — 你可以把图谱的解读与原文对照。

scc0bb78ca1.en: HOW TO READ A SPECIMEN — the italic line is the atlas’s summary of the review; each bordered block below it is one logic unit, the atlas’s structured reading of the reviewer’s prose — not the reviewer’s own words. The four chips name the object of scrutiny, the standard invoked, the verdict, and its provenance (reviewer_explicit = stated outright); the flow then runs inspected → observed → reasoned → judged. Hover any chip for its meaning, and hold the whole reading against the original via REVIEW … OPENREVIEW ↗.
scc0bb78ca1.zh: 怎么读一件标本 — 斜体行是图谱对该评审的摘要；其下每个带边框的块是一个逻辑单元，即图谱对审稿人文句的结构化解读 — 不是审稿人的原话。四枚小标签分别标出审视对象、所援引的标准、判定及其溯源（reviewer_explicit = 明白说出）；随后的流程为审视 → 观察 → 推理 → 判断。悬停任一小标签可见其含义；经由 REVIEW … OPENREVIEW ↗ 可将整段解读与原文对照。

s9f59298f77.en: No syntax, but a rate card

s778db81a6f.en: Three times this atlas searched criticism for a grammar of sequence and logic; three times it found nearly none. What it found instead does not move, and it charges. This page adds nothing new — it only sets the answer in one place, each number quoted from the plate where its caveats live.
s778db81a6f.zh: 本图谱三次在批评中寻找顺序与逻辑的语法；三次几乎一无所获。它找到的东西不会动，却会索价。本页不添加任何新内容 — 只把答案集中在一处，每个数字都引自其告诫所在的图版。

s35b108abe1.en: no argument form’s transition to the next beats chance by more — what little remains is the review form’s template, not a way of thinking. PLATE IV →
s35b108abe1.zh: 没有哪种论证形式到下一种的转换比这更超出随机 — 残余的那一点是评审表的模板，而非一种思考方式。图版 IV →

s929dcd50ec.en: the arc of a review — warm open, hard middle, hedged close — is the form’s script executed in near-unison, and subject “company” collapses to near-chance under the stricter within-review null. PLATE V →
s929dcd50ec.zh: 一篇评审的弧线 — 温和开篇、严厉中段、有保留的收尾 — 是评审表的剧本被近乎齐声地执行，而主题间的 “结伴” 在更严格的评审内零模型下坍缩到接近随机。图版 V →

sfbe28eca53.en: at most, inside the novelty charge itself: the strongest channel from observation to rule; the syllogism’s stages are nearly interchangeable parts. FIG. 7d →
sfbe28eca53.zh: 至多如此，且只在新颖性指控自身内部：从观察到规则的最强通道；三段论的各阶段几乎是可互换的零件。图 7d →

s6d08d09433.en: The structure that stands still — and charges
s6d08d09433.zh: 静止不动的结构 — 且会索价

s025aca1ce2.en: object–standard couplings sit inside the shuffle floor across nine years: what is inspected is lawfully tied to how it is argued, and the tie does not move. PLATE II →
s025aca1ce2.zh: 对象–标准耦合九年间都落在置换底线之内：所审视之物与论证方式依法则相系，这一联系不曾移动。图版 II →

sa4ec08f5cf.en: one novelty negative counts more than double the average unit in the tally that reconstructs the score. PLATE VI →
sa4ec08f5cf.zh: 在重构评分的计数中，一条新颖性否定的权重超过平均单元的两倍。图版 VI →

s20007ec346.en: the within-paper price of a novelty objection — the same paper, the reviewer who files that charge, that much lower. PLATE XIV →
s20007ec346.zh: 一条新颖性异议的论文内代价 — 同一篇论文，提出这条指控的审稿人，评分低这么多。图版 XIV →

s794ba2e3f1.en: novelty clauses repel each other only within one reviewer (×0.97 across reviewers of the same paper): the one-stamp habit is the writer’s, not the paper’s. PLATE XIII →
s794ba2e3f1.zh: 新颖性条款只在同一审稿人内部相互排斥（同一论文的不同审稿人之间为 ×0.97）：只盖一次章的习惯属于写作者，不属于论文。图版 XIII →

s789c340b18.en: of novelty denials ask for nothing at all — every other charge offers a road back 82–92% of the time. PLATE VII →
s789c340b18.zh: 的新颖性否决不提任何要求 — 其他每种指控在 82–92% 的时候都留一条回头路。图版 VII →

sc17e014de6.en: the acceptance gap of papers carrying a novelty charge — the price list runs all the way to the verdict. PLATE XV →
sc17e014de6.zh: 带新颖性指控的论文的接收率差距 — 价目表一路延伸到裁决。图版 XV →

s8d4f76869f.en: A reviewer’s criticism follows almost no sequence and works only the faintest syllogism. Yet what it inspects is lawfully coupled to how it argues, and what it names has a stable price. Criticism at ICLR is not a grammar. It is a tariff.
s8d4f76869f.zh: 审稿人的批评几乎不遵循任何顺序，只运转着最微弱的三段论。然而它审视什么与它如何论证依法则相耦合，它点名的东西有稳定的价格。ICLR 的批评不是一种语法。它是一张量刑表。

sc487bb0d8a.en: Every figure above carries its own caveats where it is drawn · associations, not causes · one venue, one field, nine years · one chosen grain of reading
sc487bb0d8a.zh: 上文每张图的告诫都写在它绘出之处 · 是关联，不是因果 · 一个会议、一个领域、九年 · 一种选定的阅读粒度

s374d847a63.en: The taxonomy was induced from the data, then named by hand. These are the working definitions behind every label on this page — also available anywhere by hovering the term itself.
s374d847a63.zh: 分类体系从数据中归纳得到，再由人工命名。以下是本页每个标签背后的工作定义 — 在任何位置悬停术语本身也可查看。

se2e411922c.zh: 附录 II · 溯源与方法

sa182b170dd.zh: 完整交叉表 — 审视对象 × 推理标准

s7a48023547.en: Fig. A1 — The changing words of criticism, 2018–20 vs 2024–26

s6f16110693.en: The vocabulary of criticism moved — partly with the review form itself.
s6f16110693.zh: 批评的词汇移动了 — 部分随评审表本身而动。

s78e55723ef.en: Centroid drift of criticism language is 7–14× the typical year-to-year wobble in categories that are otherwise stable (novelty, empirical scope, clarity) — but read it gently: part of the shift is the review form itself (structured "weakness" fields arrived mid-decade), and the units are one pipeline's paraphrase. The direction that survives the caveat: early-era criticism speaks in verdicts (fails, weak, insufficient), late-era criticism in assessments (limited, concerns, quality, generalizability).
s78e55723ef.zh: 在其他方面稳定的类别（新颖性、实证范围、清晰度）中，批评语言的质心漂移是典型逐年抖动的 7–14 倍 — 但要审慎地读：变化的一部分来自评审表本身（结构化的 "weakness" 字段在十年中期出现），且这些单元是一条流水线的转述。经过告诫仍成立的方向：早期批评以判定说话（fails, weak, insufficient），晚期批评以评估说话（limited, concerns, quality, generalizability）。

s570cf64971.zh: 附录 III · 零假设陈列柜

se2156e0867.en: The results that did not survive — kept on purpose
se2156e0867.zh: 未能存活的结果 — 有意保留

s392a2cecc7.en: not every analysis in a project this size finds something, and a few found things that a harder look deflated — to near-definitional truths, to artifacts of the review form, or to leans too weak to carry a plate. Deleting them would quietly bias the atlas toward its successes; parading them in the main flow would spend the reader’s trust on weak material. So they live here, each with the claim it once made, the test that deflated it, and where the survivors of that analysis now stand. A null told well is a finding; these are the ones that could not be told well — published anyway.
s392a2cecc7.zh: 这般规模的项目里，并非每项分析都有所得，还有几项所得经更严的审视而被戳破——缩为近乎定义式的真理、评审表格式的产物，或弱到撑不起一张图版的倾向。删掉它们会悄悄让图谱偏向自己的成功；把它们摆进主线，则会把读者的信任耗在薄弱材料上。于是它们住在这里，每条都附上它曾提出的断言、戳破它的检验，以及该分析的幸存部分如今所在。讲述得当的零结果也是一项发现；这里是讲不好的那些——照样发表。

sb8ed89a981.en: The archetype mirage, drawn: real roses against forged ones
sb8ed89a981.zh: 原型幻象，绘出来看：真玫瑰图对伪造的玫瑰图

s6ede6be81b.en: The forgery blooms: five specialists at ×2.0–3.0 emerge from pure multinomial noise, and
s6ede6be81b.zh: 伪造品也开花：五个 ×2.0–3.0 的专才从纯多项分布噪声中浮现，而且

s971925051f.en: the clustering explains barely more of the real reviewers (35.8%) than of the noise (31.0%)
s971925051f.zh: 聚类对真实审稿人的解释量（35.8%）仅略高于对噪声的解释量（31.0%）

sf1aa092a84.en:
SOURCE mirage-data.json → ev_real, ev_null
DERIVATION share of between-profile variance the 5-cluster k-means partition explains: 0.3578 (35.8%) for the 98,513 real reviewer profiles, 0.3102 (31.0%) for the synthetic multinomial-noise profiles
VERIFIED checked against shipped JSON, 2026-08-25
sf1aa092a84.zh:
来源 mirage-data.json → ev_real, ev_null
推导 5 簇 k-means 划分所解释的画像间方差份额：98,513 个真实审稿人画像为 0.3578（35.8%），合成的多项分布噪声画像为 0.3102（31.0%）
核验 已对照发布的 JSON 核对，2026-08-25

s66ad5e3249.en: each rose has twelve petals, one per reasoning standard; a petal’s length is how far that cluster leans on the standard relative to the whole field (√-compressed), and the dashed ring is ×1 — the rose an interchangeable field would draw.
s66ad5e3249.zh: 每朵玫瑰有十二片花瓣，每片对应一条推理标准；花瓣长度是该簇相对整个场域对这条标准的倚重程度（经 √ 压缩），虚线圆环是 ×1——一个成员可互换的场域会画出的玫瑰。

sa02af23af0.en: Top row: the five clusters k-means (k = 5, seed 7) finds among 98,513 real reviewer-paper profiles
sa02af23af0.zh: 上排：k-means（k = 5，随机种子 7）在 98,513 个真实的审稿人–论文画像中找到的五个簇

sadae25fa9b.en: Bottom row: the five clusters the same pipeline finds in synthetic profiles drawn from one shared field mix
sadae25fa9b.zh: 下排：同一条流水线在合成画像中找到的五个簇，这些画像从一个共享的场域混合比例中抽取

sad3292d42c.en: at each reviewer’s own unit volume — profiles that by construction contain no reviewer types at all. Under each rose: its leading standard, that petal’s ratio, and the cluster’s share of profiles; hover any petal for its standard and exact ratio.
sad3292d42c.zh: ，抽样量取每位审稿人自己的单元数——按构造，这些画像不含任何审稿人类型。每朵玫瑰下方：其领衔标准、该花瓣的比值，以及该簇占画像的份额；悬停任一花瓣可见其标准与精确比值。

s6dd64852f4.en: the two rows are nearly the same picture — a median profile holds six units, and at that grain k-means carves sampling noise into confident-looking specialists. This is the test that deleted a plate.
s6dd64852f4.zh: 两排几乎是同一幅画——中位数画像只有六个单元，在这种粒度上，k-means 把抽样噪声切分成看似笃定的专才。正是这项检验删掉了一张图版。

s80159c3ec7.en: the mirage is quantified, not total: the real rows sit 1.15× above the multinomial variance floor at the median standard (1.58× at the most dispersed), and the clustering explains 4.8pp more of the real profiles than of the forged ones, a gap that widens with profile length — a faint true signature, far below what the roses’ confidence suggests. Recomputable by scripts/build_mirage_data.py (null seed 46). The cabinet’s entries follow.
s80159c3ec7.zh: 幻象已被量化，并非全然虚假：真实的一排在中位标准上为多项分布方差底线的 1.15×（最分散的标准为 1.58×），聚类对真实画像的解释比对伪造画像多 4.8pp，该差距随画像长度而扩大——一道微弱但真实的印记，远低于玫瑰的信心所暗示的程度。可用 scripts/build_mirage_data.py 重算（零假设随机种子 46）。陈列柜条目如下。

s4390b044bc.en: Fig. A2 — Acceptance rate by breadth of criticism · kept under glass
s4390b044bc.zh: 图 A2 — 接收率按批评广度 · 置于玻璃罩下

sbd66c2423f.en: Each additional object criticised comes with about five points less acceptance.
sbd66c2423f.zh: 每多一个被批评的对象，接收率约少五个点。

s2b460e3d47.en: RELOCATED FROM THE CONSEQUENCE PLATE — expected by construction, so it lives here rather than spending main-flow attention; the measurement is real and unchanged. No new measurement: take Fig. 15a's twelve with/without splits, sum them per paper into "on how many objects did this paper draw criticism" — how broadly a paper was criticised rather than how harshly — and read the same 13,704 decisions against that count. One number per paper instead of twelve.
s2b460e3d47.zh: 自后果图版移来 — 按构造即在预期之中，故置于此处，不占用主线的注意力；度量本身真实且未变。没有新的度量：取图 15a 的十二组有/无拆分，按论文加总为“这篇论文在多少个对象上招致批评”——论文被批评得有多广，而非多重——再把同样的 13,704 项录用决定对照这个计数来读。每篇论文一个数，而非十二个。

s35bd5731b5.en: the horizontal axis is the number of distinct objects criticised, the vertical axis the acceptance rate of the papers at that breadth, and dot size is how many papers stand there.
s35bd5731b5.zh: 横轴是被批评的不同对象数，纵轴是该广度下论文的接收率，圆点大小是落在该处的论文数。

s6aaf9dfde7.en: acceptance falls steeply and then almost linearly —
s6aaf9dfde7.zh: 接收率先陡降，随后近乎线性下滑 —

s3358666d71.en: 69% at two objects, 57% at three, then roughly five points for each additional object, down to 27% at nine or more
s3358666d71.zh: 两个对象时 69%，三个时 57%，之后每多一个对象约降五个点，到九个或更多时降至 27%

s2ffcf692d6.en: . Few papers escape with fewer than four;
s2ffcf692d6.zh: 。少有论文能以不足四个脱身；

sf41c3d427b.en: the most common paper is criticised on seven of the twelve — the brass bar
sf41c3d427b.zh: 最常见的论文在十二个对象中的七个上受到批评 — 黄铜色柱

s55cdf95e12.en: . And no decided paper escaped criticism everywhere: breadth zero does not occur, and the two papers criticised on a single object are omitted as too few to chart.
s55cdf95e12.zh: 。而且没有一篇已决论文能处处免于批评：广度为零的情况不存在，仅在一个对象上受批评的两篇论文因数量太少未绘入图中。

sc8f0960663.en: association only, and here the two quantities are entangled by construction — a weaker paper gives reviewers more to criticise, so breadth of criticism is partly a measurement of the paper rather than a treatment applied to it.
sc8f0960663.zh: 仅为关联，且这里两个量按构造就纠缠在一起——更弱的论文给审稿人更多可批评之处，所以批评广度部分是对论文本身的度量，而非施加于它的处理。

s0b8bce71dd.en: The archetype mirage — “five kinds of reviewer”

sc0d943fbb2.en: A rose-diagram plate once claimed five reviewer archetypes — Architect, Stress-Tester, Advocate, Gatekeeper, Auditor — from k-means over 98,513 per-reviewer standard profiles, each rose a specialization of ×2.4–3.1 the field. The deflating test is drawn above, at full strength, because it is the cabinet’s centerpiece; the plate was removed on 2026-08-21. What survives is a faint true signature — per-standard variance 1.15× the multinomial floor at the median (1.58× at most), a 4.8pp real-over-noise gap in explained variance that widens with profile length — real, small, and honestly below plate grade. The one live descendant, needing no clustering, is the drift of reasoning-standard shares, now in the Drift plate.
sc0d943fbb2.zh: 一张玫瑰图图版曾宣称存在五种审稿人原型——建筑师、压力测试者、辩护人、守门人、审计员——来自对 98,513 个按审稿人计的标准画像做 k-means，每朵玫瑰都是相对场域 ×2.4–3.1 的专门化。戳破它的检验以完整篇幅绘于上方，因为它是本陈列柜的中心展品；该图版已于 2026-08-21 撤下。幸存下来的是一道微弱但真实的印记——每条标准的方差在中位数上为多项分布底线的 1.15×（最高 1.58×），解释方差上真实高于噪声 4.8pp 的差距，且随画像长度扩大——真实、微小，老实说不够图版级别。唯一存活的后裔无需聚类：推理标准份额的漂移，现在漂移图版中。

s40bc0bbaa1.en: The gauntlet’s slope — breadth of criticism vs acceptance
s40bc0bbaa1.zh: 夹道的斜率 — 批评广度对接收率

sd5981ab836.en: Acceptance falls ~5 points per additional object criticised, almost linearly (69% at two objects to 27% at nine or more). Expected by construction — a weaker paper gives reviewers more to criticise, so breadth partly measures the paper. Its figure hangs above in this cabinet (relocated from the Consequence plate, 2026-08-25) for its residual facts: the near-linearity itself, that no decided paper escaped criticism everywhere, and that the modal paper is criticised on seven of twelve objects.
sd5981ab836.zh: 每多一个被批评的对象，接收率约降 5 个点，近乎线性（从两个对象时的 69% 到九个或更多时的 27%）。按构造即在预期之中——更弱的论文给审稿人更多可批评之处，所以广度部分度量的是论文本身。其图挂在本陈列柜上方（2026-08-25 自后果图版移来），为的是它残留的事实：近线性本身、没有一篇已决论文处处免于批评，以及众数论文在十二个对象中的七个上受到批评。

s9a1ae33aca.en: Whose rating the chair echoes — a lean, not a rule
s9a1ae33aca.zh: 主席呼应的是谁的评分 — 一种倾向，而非规则

s6035f5cf69.en: In the Borrowed Verdict, the panel’s uniquely-lowest rater is echoed most in 16% of panels against 13% for the uniquely-highest — and in half of panels the echoed rating ties an extreme under the coarse scale, so no verdict is possible at all. The direction claim that plate makes stands on its 60/40 rejection tilt instead; this per-reviewer lean alone would not have carried it.
s6035f5cf69.zh: 在借来的裁决中，评审组里唯一给分最低者被呼应最多的情形占 16% 的评审组，唯一给分最高者则为 13%——而在半数评审组中，被呼应的评分在粗粒度量表下与某个极值打平，根本无从判定。该图版关于方向的断言改而立足于其 60/40 的偏向拒稿；单靠这一按审稿人计的倾向撑不起它。

sf5d73aa4ed.en: Plate IV’s finding in full: once a review’s own mix is fixed, no argument form predicts the next beyond ±20% — judgment, as written, has almost no grammar. Kept in the main flow because the absence is informative; indexed here because it is the project’s cleanest true null. Addressee: work that assumes review-internal argument structure.
sf5d73aa4ed.zh: 图版 IV 的完整发现：一旦固定一篇评审自身的混合比例，没有哪种论证形式能在 ±20% 之外预测下一种——写下来的评判几乎没有语法。留在主线，因为这一缺席本身有信息量；在此索引，因为它是本项目最干净的真零结果。致：假定评审内部存在论证结构的研究。

s971bfa315a.en: Asked versus asserted — the interrogative null
s971bfa315a.zh: 提问对断言 — 疑问句的零结果

s33c26001ea.en: Whether an objection is phrased as a question or an assertion makes no detectable difference to its fate after the rebuttal (the Fate of an Objection’s second figure). Reported in place as a null; indexed here.
s33c26001ea.zh: 一条异议措辞为提问还是断言，对其 rebuttal 后的命运没有可检测的差别（一条异议的命运的第二幅图）。原地报告为零结果；在此索引。

se70a1458a2.zh: 辩护人的软化 — 近乎定义式

sd422cd9172.en: An early “advocate reviewers soften more” reading collapsed on inspection: the defining standard of the advocate profile is the praise standard, so the claim was close to circular and was never published as a finding.
sd422cd9172.zh: 早期一种“辩护人型审稿人更常软化”的解读经检视即告崩塌：辩护人画像的定义性标准就是称许标准，所以该断言近乎循环论证，从未作为发现发表。

sdf6782042f.en: the common thread: three deflators account for every entry — the review form’s own structure, volume-plus-noise nulls, and definitional circularity. They are the same three checks every surviving plate had to pass; this cabinet is what passing looks like from the other side.
sdf6782042f.zh: 共同的线索：三种戳破手段解释了每一条——评审表自身的结构、体量加噪声的零模型、定义上的循环。它们正是每张幸存图版都必须通过的三项检查；这个陈列柜就是通过检查从另一面看的样子。

sbed137a4d7.en: Most readers arrived holding one line from a review — "limited novelty," "insufficient baselines." By now that line has a docket. Pick it here and the page returns to the plate that takes it apart: what reviewers had actually observed when they wrote it, the law they were applying, and the remedy they most often prescribe. The three links under the grid go to what reviewers ask for, what each criticism costs in score, and what happened to authors who answered.
sbed137a4d7.zh: 多数读者来到这里时手里都握着评审里的一句话——“limited novelty”“insufficient baselines”。到现在，那句话已有了一份案卷。在这里选中它，页面就回到拆解它的那张图版：审稿人写下它时实际观察到了什么、他们援引的法则，以及他们最常开出的修复。网格下方的三个链接分别通往审稿人要什么、每种批评在评分上的代价，以及回应了的作者遭遇了什么。

s763c74d16f.zh: 这页上的每一个印记都是一条真实的审稿人推理单元——与各图版一直在读的是同样的单元，重新聚成一幅印样 · 九年 ICLR

sc1738e0739.en:
What this is not
Not a direct analysis of raw reviews. Each unit is a two-stage LLM reading (DeepSeek memo → Qwen normalization); the support_status tag records whether a unit is grounded in the reviewer's explicit words or inferred by the memo. The ${pct(valTot.negative / TOTAL)} negative share reflects the memos' bias toward articulating the logic of criticism — it is not the sentiment ratio of human reviews.
Known limits
Reasoning-side clustering had 61.5% noise, so the standard taxonomy is a skeleton induced from ~40% of the sample; assignment confidence is reported per unit. The structuring model's phrasing conventions may influence embeddings. 1,479 reviews (1.9%) failed extraction and are excluded; topic correlation of that missingness is unverified. Constellation names are automatic; they describe, not define, their regions.
Leakage control
Outcome metadata (decisions, scores) was never shown to the extraction pipeline; decisions are joined only at display time.
Instrument checks
How far the machine reading can be trusted — the memo-inferred share per category and year, and the construct-validity check against ICLR sub-scores — is documented on the Method page (§10).
sc1738e0739.zh:
这不是什么
不是对原始评审的直接分析。每条单元都是两阶段的 LLM 读取（DeepSeek 备忘 → Qwen 归一化）；support_status 标签记录该单元是基于审稿人的明确文字，还是由备忘推断。${pct(valTot.negative / TOTAL)} 的否定占比反映的是备忘偏向于阐明批评的逻辑 — 它并非人类评审的情感比例。
已知局限
推理侧聚类有 61.5% 的噪声，所以标准分类体系是从约 40% 的样本归纳出的骨架；分配置信度逐单元报告。结构化模型的措辞习惯可能影响嵌入。1,479 篇评审（1.9%）抽取失败而被排除；这一缺失与主题的相关性未经核验。星座名称是自动生成的；它们描述而非定义各自的区域。
泄漏控制
结果元数据（录用决定、评分）从未展示给抽取流水线；录用决定仅在显示时关联。
仪器校验
机器读取可信到什么程度 — 逐类别、逐年的备忘推断占比，以及对照 ICLR 子评分的构念效度检验 — 记录在方法页（§10）。
