sf54810405f.zh: ${pid || ""}${ptitle || ""}${meter}${scope ? scope.textContent.replace("Corpus: ", "") : ""}实时

seed963bb27.en: What this atlas cuts — the eight acts and the coda, each at its own depth
seed963bb27.zh: 本图谱所切开的 — 八幕与尾声，各在其深度

sb117fcf12a.zh: 领域主席 · 元评审 · 录用决定：

sd24b6a43c7.en: One field of one unit — the atlas's smallest countable thing. Act I asks whether such a thing survives being counted at all.
sd24b6a43c7.zh: 一个单元的一个字段——图谱里最小的可计数之物。第一幕问：这样的东西经得起计数吗。

s65e056c302.en: The whole column, in the order it was written: what one reviewer, working alone, sets down — and whether that order carries information.
s65e056c302.zh: 整栏，按写下的顺序：一位审稿人独自落笔写下的内容——以及这个顺序是否承载信息。

s6bfc27ed17.en: The judged stratum of one charge: what it asserts, which standard it invokes, and what it asks for in return.
s6bfc27ed17.zh: 一项指控的判断层：它主张什么、援引哪条标准、又要求什么。

s3796f8778c.en: The same charge, joined to the number beside it. Not what it says — what it costs the paper.
s3796f8778c.zh: 同一项指控，接上旁边的数字。不问它说了什么——只问它让论文付出了什么代价。

s04c09e592b.en: The scale alone. The instrument turns on its own output and asks whether that number can be trusted as a measurement.
s04c09e592b.zh: 只看评分标尺。仪器转向自身的输出，问这个数字能否当作一次测量来信任。

s9cb1a61ece.en: The slab above: the chair's decision — what it weighs, and whose words it is written in.
s9cb1a61ece.zh: 上方的石板：主席的决定——它权衡什么，又是用谁的话写成。

s6831ff7af2.en: Both columns at once — the review and the reply. Does judgment move when people meet?
s6831ff7af2.zh: 两栏同时——评审与回应。人们相遇时，评判会移动吗？

s2849d5d317.en: The prose the whole atlas was read out of, held against its original.
s2849d5d317.zh: 整部图谱据以读出的文字，对照其原文。

sceaa0cc84a.en: Nine of these, one per year. Is any of what you have just read particular to now — or to one field?
sceaa0cc84a.zh: 九份这样的记录，每年一份。你刚读到的一切，有哪些只属于当下——或只属于某一领域？

s7dfd6c210d.en: — every band, every stratum length and every valence is this review's own record;
s7dfd6c210d.zh: — 每条色带、每一层的长度与每个判向都是这篇评审自身的记录；

se5f0d84a2a.en: each stratum is as long as the text actually written at that layer. The scale is drawn empty: the unit record carries no rating.
se5f0d84a2a.zh: 每一层的长度即该层实际写下的文字长度。评分标尺画成空白：单元记录不含评分。

s53022b1c2f.en: Hover a part to read what the atlas stored there.
s53022b1c2f.zh: 悬停某一部分，读取图谱在那里存下的内容。

s3cbca7ec68.zh: 词汇表 · 溯源 · 零假设陈列柜

s4fbb6f0894.en:
Atlas of Judgment
The Chart
s4fbb6f0894.zh:
评判图谱
总图

s3d9f7f8129.en: of everything reviewers write is criticism · plate i
s3d9f7f8129.zh: 的审稿人所写内容是批评 · 图版 i

s2bb3168a97.en: How a million reviews became countable: every act of judgment split into what was inspected, the rule it invoked, and the verdict it reached — and the couplings that make criticism a grammar rather than a mood.
s2bb3168a97.zh: 一百万篇评审如何变得可计数：每一次评判拆成所审视的对象、所援引的规则与所达成的判定——以及让批评成为一种语法而非一种情绪的耦合。

s347813364d.en: the first unit already carries two thirds of the verdict's signal · plate vi
s347813364d.zh: 首个单元已承载裁决信号的三分之二 · 图版 vi

s736c83feb8.en: One reviewer, alone at the page: the order criticism is written in, the forms it chains through, and how early the written verdict is already decided.
s736c83feb8.zh: 一位审稿人，独对页面：批评写下的顺序，它串联经过的形式，以及书面裁决多早就已定下。

sc392e12cbc.en: of criticisms are formulas with a near-verbatim twin · plate x
sc392e12cbc.zh: 的批评是有近乎逐字孪生的套语 · 图版 x

scb5723ee86.en: The anatomy of a charge: what a criticism actually says, the clauses it invokes, the repair it prescribes — and which laws are filed together when a paper stands trial.
scb5723ee86.zh: 一项指控的解剖：一条批评实际说了什么，援引哪些条款，指定何种修复——以及论文受审时哪些法则被一并立案。

scef338df46.en: points — the price of a novelty objection, paper held fixed · plate xiv
scef338df46.zh: 分 — 一条新颖性异议的代价，论文固定不变 · 图版 xiv

sb25e5f3a14.en: The price list: what each objection costs in score with the paper held fixed, and which criticism keeps company with rejection — the atlas's closest look at consequence.
sb25e5f3a14.zh: 价目表：论文固定不变时，每条异议在评分上的代价，以及哪种批评与拒稿相伴——图谱对后果最贴近的一次审视。

sfc62444b49.en: of objections are never mentioned again · plate xix
sfc62444b49.zh: 的异议再未被提及 · 图版 xix

s9d1dc44696.en: Judgment meets resistance: rebuttals, authors' moves, panels in deliberation — six plates on whether anything said after the review actually moves the judgment.
s9d1dc44696.zh: 评判遭遇抵抗：rebuttal、作者的招式、合议中的评审组——六张图版，看评审之后说的任何话是否真能撼动评判。

s000459e238.en: the bench overrules toward mercy · plate xx
s000459e238.zh: 法官席朝宽宥方向推翻 · 图版 xx

sa2621d14b9.en: The area chair's bench: a different grammar of attention, what the bench forgives that reviewers would not, and whose words the meta-review actually carries.
sa2621d14b9.zh: 领域主席的法官席：另一套注意力的语法，法官席宽恕而审稿人不肯宽恕的东西，以及元评审实际承载的是谁的话。

sb64f0e2f83.en: the 2026 intraclass correlation — the ruler on trial · plate xxv
sb64f0e2f83.zh: 2026 年的组内相关系数 — 受审的量尺 · 图版 xxv

sb50543d5b2.en: The ruler itself on trial: what the 1–10 scale is made of, and how much of a rating is the paper against how much is the reviewer you happened to draw.
sb50543d5b2.zh: 量尺本身受审：1–10 评分尺由什么构成，一个评分里有多少是论文，多少是你碰巧抽到的审稿人。

s6564a41863.en: clarity's nine-year retreat from reviewer attention · plate xxvi
s6564a41863.zh: 清晰度在审稿人注意力中的九年退却 · 图版 xxvi

sdcf3fba980.en: Nine years and twelve territories: how attention drifted, what the unamended law of novelty held still, and how differently the same venue judges its different fields.
sdcf3fba980.zh: 九年与十二块疆域：注意力如何漂移，未修订的新颖性法则守住了什么不变，以及同一会议评判其不同领域的方式有多大差别。

sf394fefe15.en: real reviews, readable in full · plate xxx
sf394fefe15.zh: 篇真实评审，可完整阅读 · 图版 xxx

s7342851484.en: The evidence, unprocessed: real reviews with their reasoning laid bare, every specimen linked back to its source on OpenReview.
s7342851484.zh: 未经加工的证据：真实评审，推理摊开可见，每件标本都链接回 OpenReview 上的来源。

s55bb554694.en: Breadth and representativeness of empirical evaluation: dataset scale, benchmark coverage, generalization to other models/settings, robustness scope, attack/threat coverage.
s55bb554694.zh: 实证评估的广度与代表性：数据集规模、基准覆盖、向其他模型/设置的泛化、鲁棒性范围、攻击/威胁覆盖。

sd2f3981915.en: Choice, fairness, and completeness of baseline comparisons and ablation studies.
sd2f3981915.zh: 基线比较与消融研究的选择、公平性与完整性。

s8aeb2688e4.en: Theoretical assumptions, formal guarantees, proofs, and the loss/objective's formal properties.
s8aeb2688e4.zh: 理论假设、形式保证、证明，以及损失/目标函数的形式性质。

sb4c2f93308.en: Justification of design choices: architecture, reward/objective design, training procedure, mechanism claims.
sb4c2f93308.zh: 设计选择的论证：架构、奖励/目标设计、训练流程、机制主张。

sdd831e8ca9.en: Training/inference computational cost, latency, scalability analysis.
sdd831e8ca9.zh: 训练/推理的计算成本、延迟、可扩展性分析。

sa2f774e829.en: Writing quality, figures, notation, exposition and structure.
sa2f774e829.zh: 写作质量、图表、符号、阐述与结构。

se4a587a14a.en: Novelty of the contribution and its articulation relative to existing methods.
se4a587a14a.zh: 贡献相对既有方法的新颖性及其阐明。

s9dc8a50c12.en: Coverage and accuracy of citations and positioning within prior literature.
s9dc8a50c12.zh: 引用的覆盖面与准确性，以及在既有文献中的定位。

s90bf80a127.en: Statistical reporting, significance, choice and validity of evaluation metrics including LLM-as-judge setups.
s90bf80a127.zh: 统计报告、显著性、评估指标的选择与效度，包括 LLM-as-judge 设置。

see3b4bad15.en: Hyperparameter sensitivity, noise robustness, failure-mode analysis.
see3b4bad15.zh: 超参数敏感性、噪声鲁棒性、失败模式分析。

s7fec5df810.en: Code availability and sufficiency of detail for independent replication.
s7fec5df810.zh: 代码可得性，以及供独立复现的细节是否充分。

s6463d045bc.en: Framing, motivation, and significance of the problem being addressed.
s6463d045bc.zh: 所研究问题的界定、动机与重要性。

sb5874bfa34.zh: 混杂因素 / 替代解释

sa5e32f2060.en: Contribution must show conceptual/epistemic difference from prior art, not mere recombination.
sa5e32f2060.zh: 贡献必须展现与既有工作在概念/认识层面的差别；单纯重组不算。

s28fc14fc1f.en: Generality of claims must be matched by breadth of empirical demonstration.
s28fc14fc1f.zh: 主张的普遍性必须有相称广度的实证展示来匹配。

s64ef6bb26e.en: Baselines must be comparable in tuning, compute, and recency for the comparison to be meaningful.
s64ef6bb26e.zh: 基线在调参、算力与时新性上必须可比，比较才有意义。

s1785c5f5e8.en: Without variance/significance reporting, signal cannot be distinguished from noise.
s1785c5f5e8.zh: 不报告方差/显著性，就无法把信号与噪声区分开。

s855cc408d2.en: Results could be explained by leakage, memorization, weak protocols, or other artifacts.
s855cc408d2.zh: 结果可能由泄漏、记忆、薄弱的协议或其他伪影解释。

scb078a335c.en: Design choices need mechanistic grounding or comparison against plausible alternatives.
scb078a335c.zh: 设计选择需要机制层面的依据，或与合理替代方案的比较。

s9ce76f5390.en: A practical method should be stable across hyperparameters and settings.
s9ce76f5390.zh: 实用的方法应在各种超参数与设置下保持稳定。

s56dcff4a85.en: Gains must be weighed against computational/engineering cost for practical utility.
s56dcff4a85.zh: 增益必须与计算/工程成本相权衡，方能论及实用价值。

s6e43bc47b6.en: Metrics must actually measure what they claim to measure.
s6e43bc47b6.zh: 指标必须确实测量其宣称测量的东西。

s92f6cc6009.en: Enough detail must be disclosed for independent re-implementation and verification.
s92f6cc6009.zh: 必须披露足够的细节，供独立重新实现与核验。

sc3b3f864a7.en: Polish signals care; presentation flaws undermine trust in the work's rigor.
sc3b3f864a7.zh: 打磨体现用心；表述缺陷削弱对工作严谨性的信任。

saaa5f5877e.en: Positive appraisal: breadth/soundness of evidence or contribution acknowledged as convincing.
saaa5f5877e.zh: 正面评价：证据或贡献的广度/可靠性被认可为令人信服。

sba84ffd566.en: Extend the evidence — more datasets, domains, models, scale
sba84ffd566.zh: 扩展证据 — 更多数据集、领域、模型、规模

sec1fb85ee1.en: Fix the surface — typos, notation, figures
sec1fb85ee1.zh: 修表面 — 错别字、符号、图表

s6af2ec6740.en: Measure the true cost — runtime, memory, GPU-hours
s6af2ec6740.zh: 测真实成本 — 运行时间、内存、GPU 小时

s686153513a.en: Strengthen the theory — proofs, bounds, guarantees
s686153513a.zh: 加强理论 — 证明、界、保证

s9e0d6e77fe.zh: 论证假设并限定主张范围

s08af6629a1.en: Release & document — code, data, repro details
s08af6629a1.zh: 发布并记录 — 代码、数据、复现细节

s6d36e71a6b.en: Validate against humans & the real world
s6d36e71a6b.zh: 对照人类与真实世界验证

sc13dce95a6.en: Show it on real visual data
sc13dce95a6.zh: 在真实视觉数据上展示

sbb577c2e94.zh: 在攻击与分布偏移下做压力测试

sdd3dfdbc80.en: Claims of robustness, generalizability, and practical stability require validation across varied data distributions, scales, architectures, attack intensities, and non-ideal conditions, with unexpected results explained rather than assumed.
sdd3dfdbc80.zh: 鲁棒性、泛化性与实际稳定性的主张，须在不同数据分布、规模、架构、攻击强度与非理想条件下验证；意外结果须加以解释，不得径行假定。

sf09c912cca.en: Claims of applicability, structural properties, or theoretical validity require corresponding empirical evidence or verification.
sf09c912cca.zh: 适用性、结构性质或理论有效性的主张，须有相应的实证证据或验证。

s7f80fb3a14.en: A paper must clearly articulate and distinguish its contribution from prior work; combining existing techniques without a distinct new insight does not constitute sufficient novelty.
s7f80fb3a14.zh: 论文必须清楚阐明并区分其贡献与既有工作；组合现有技术而无独特的新见解，不构成足够的新颖性。

s083f94181a.en: Claims of real-world or practical applicability require validation on real-world or realistic data, not only synthetic or idealized settings.
s083f94181a.zh: 现实世界或实际适用性的主张，须在真实或贴近真实的数据上验证，不能只在合成或理想化设置中验证。

sefaac4d074.en: Design choices and newly proposed methods must be theoretically or empirically justified, demonstrating a distinct advantage over existing approaches.
sefaac4d074.zh: 设计选择与新提出的方法必须有理论或实证论证，并展现相对既有方法的明确优势。

sa346b88e5b.en: Fair comparison requires testing against strong, relevant, and consistently applied baselines.
sa346b88e5b.zh: 公平比较要求对照强的、相关的、一致施用的基线进行测试。

s7800e5e396.en: Reproducibility requires precise, transparent, and clearly described methodology and data-processing details.
s7800e5e396.zh: 可复现性要求方法与数据处理细节精确、透明、描述清楚。

sb2f9dee616.en: New tasks, added complexity, and specific design choices must be theoretically or empirically justified and shown to offer feasible, distinct advantage over simpler alternatives.
sb2f9dee616.zh: 新任务、增加的复杂度与具体设计选择必须有理论或实证论证，并证明相对更简单的替代方案有可行且明确的优势。

s4eb5f7cef3.en: Claims of generality, learned mechanisms, or design robustness must be verified across varied conditions, hyperparameters, and operational paradigms rather than a single setting.
s4eb5f7cef3.zh: 普遍性、习得机制或设计鲁棒性的主张，必须在多种条件、超参数与运行范式下验证，而非单一设置。

s5c4246a607.en: The paper must clearly distinguish its specific contribution from closely related prior work; combining existing techniques without significant new insight or adaptation is not a substantial contribution.
s5c4246a607.zh: 论文必须清楚区分其具体贡献与密切相关的既有工作；组合现有技术而无显著的新见解或改造，不算实质贡献。

s763c0720b1.en: Theoretical and interpretability claims require corresponding experimental validation.
s763c0720b1.zh: 理论与可解释性主张需要相应的实验验证。

saaa355088e.en: The method's mechanism and motivation must be explained with enough technical clarity to be understood and validated.
saaa355088e.zh: 方法的机制与动机必须以足够的技术清晰度解释，使人能理解并验证。

s3f3e18f2a8.en: Fair comparison requires accurately reproduced, relevant, and consistently applied strong baselines.
s3f3e18f2a8.zh: 公平比较要求准确复现、相关且一致施用的强基线。

s2453af7dce.en: Reproducibility requires sufficiently detailed methods, rationale, and implementation specifics.
s2453af7dce.zh: 可复现性要求足够详细的方法、理由与实现细节。

s607de977fd.en: Theoretical, scalability, and robustness claims require corresponding empirical validation or grounding in practice.
s607de977fd.zh: 理论、可扩展性与鲁棒性主张需要相应的实证验证或实践依据。

s7044f03c3c.en: Theoretical assumptions must be justified, and unnecessary or unused assumptions that complicate or over-constrain the theory must be removed or defended.
s7044f03c3c.zh: 理论假设必须有论证；使理论复杂化或过度约束的不必要或未用到的假设，必须移除或加以辩护。

s588dc819ef.en: A theoretical contribution must be new and clearly positioned against prior work; incremental derivations or trivial extensions do not constitute significant contribution.
s588dc819ef.zh: 理论贡献必须是新的，并相对既有工作清楚定位；增量推导或平凡扩展不构成显著贡献。

s1e15ada6f9.en: Clarity of technical exposition is required for a result to be verified and reproduced.
s1e15ada6f9.zh: 技术阐述的清晰是结果得以核验与复现的前提。

s6d82de5eec.en: Mathematical correctness, valid derivations, and logical consistency are required for a proof to be accepted.
s6d82de5eec.zh: 证明要被接受，须有数学正确性、有效的推导与逻辑一致性。

s21999a238f.en: Theory-motivated design choices require theoretical or empirical justification.
s21999a238f.zh: 理论驱动的设计选择需要理论或实证论证。

s1dd848ca76.en: Small or marginal improvements, and claims of superiority or practical relevance, are not meaningful without statistical proof of significance.
s1dd848ca76.zh: 微小或边际的改进，以及优越性或实际相关性的主张，没有统计显著性证明就没有意义。

sda21d53a22.en: Empirical and computational-tractability claims require corresponding supporting evidence and empirical validation.
sda21d53a22.zh: 实证主张与计算可行性主张需要相应的支持证据与实证验证。

s32914f5aae.en: Robust and generalizable conclusions require comprehensive, quantitative validation across parameter settings, architectures, and diverse datasets.
s32914f5aae.zh: 鲁棒且可泛化的结论，需要跨参数设置、架构与多样数据集的全面定量验证。

s71143cf8bd.en: Fair, credible comparison requires strong, consistent, and adequate baselines.
s71143cf8bd.zh: 公平可信的比较需要强的、一致的、充分的基线。

s0782e65e5c.en: Chosen metrics must be justified and shown to have predictive validity for the evaluation to be trusted.
s0782e65e5c.zh: 所选指标必须有论证并显示预测效度，评估才可信。

s5d1d4c5fad.en: Terminological precision and operational clarity are required for the work to be technically clear.
s5d1d4c5fad.zh: 术语精确与操作清晰是工作在技术上清楚的前提。

se371d8a49c.en: Reproducibility requires transparent reporting of parameters and clear, complete methodological detail.
se371d8a49c.zh: 可复现性要求透明报告参数，并给出清楚完整的方法细节。

s6d2a03666a.en: Claims of scalability or feasibility must be demonstrated with empirical evidence at the scales the method is meant for, not asserted from small settings.
s6d2a03666a.zh: 可扩展性或可行性的主张，必须在方法所针对的规模上用实证证据展示，不能从小规模设置断言。

s48d78c52e2.en: Claims of efficiency or optimization, and any deviation from standard efficient practice, require quantitative empirical validation rather than conceptual argument alone.
s48d78c52e2.zh: 效率或优化的主张，以及任何偏离标准高效实践之处，需要定量实证验证，仅凭概念论证不够。

seffcac9d5d.en: Added complexity, computational cost, and deployment trade-offs must be justified by commensurate performance gains.
seffcac9d5d.zh: 增加的复杂度、计算成本与部署权衡，必须由相称的性能增益来论证。

s64316e434a.en: Practical utility must be established through efficiency comparisons against baselines under equal computational budgets.
s64316e434a.zh: 实用价值必须通过等计算预算下与基线的效率比较来确立。

s44708b43a0.en: Claims must be backed by empirical or theoretical evidence, stated with qualifiers proportionate to that evidence.
s44708b43a0.zh: 主张必须有实证或理论证据支撑，措辞的限定须与证据相称。

s28bfb63bca.en: Reproducibility requires precise, explicit reporting of algorithmic and computational implementation details.
s28bfb63bca.zh: 可复现性要求精确、明确地报告算法与计算实现细节。

sf229771100.en: Presentation must be clear enough that readers can verify, interpret, and trust the reported results.
sf229771100.zh: 表述必须足够清楚，使读者能核验、解读并信任所报告的结果。

s628997fe24.en: A paper must clearly and precisely articulate its purpose, logic, and specific contribution so it can be evaluated by its intended audience.
s628997fe24.zh: 论文必须清楚、精确地阐明其目的、逻辑与具体贡献，使目标读者能够评估。

s4e8b46ba10.en: Empirical claims must be supported by evidence — including consistency and robustness checks and explicit, plausible assumptions — sufficient to actually verify them.
s4e8b46ba10.zh: 实证主张必须有证据支持——包括一致性与鲁棒性检验，以及明确、合理的假设——足以实际核验。

s317f56d435.en: Consistent notation and precise terminology are required for mathematical correctness and clarity.
s317f56d435.zh: 一致的符号与精确的术语是数学正确性与清晰度的前提。

s7032fb6e36.en: Figures and visualizations must accurately reflect the methodology and be clearly, legibly labeled so they convey their intended information.
s7032fb6e36.zh: 图与可视化必须准确反映方法，并清楚、可读地标注，以传达其应传达的信息。

s3b8e1b3101.en: Unnecessary complexity or abstraction hinders understanding of the contribution and can itself introduce technical error.
s3b8e1b3101.zh: 不必要的复杂度或抽象妨碍对贡献的理解，本身也可能引入技术错误。

s78004355d4.en: Valid claims of effectiveness or superiority require fair comparison against strong, relevant, and current state-of-the-art baselines.
s78004355d4.zh: 有效性或优越性的主张要成立，需要与强的、相关的、当前最先进的基线公平比较。

sdeb8d961c1.en: Ablation studies that isolate each component's individual contribution are necessary to validate and understand the method.
sdeb8d961c1.zh: 必须以消融实验分离出每个组件的独立贡献，才能验证并理解该方法。

s08856f0518.en: Empirical assertions and claims require corresponding experimental evidence to be valid.
s08856f0518.zh: 实证性的论断与主张须有对应的实验证据才成立。

s6bd49f3b48.en: A contribution must be shown to be non-trivial and understood on its own terms, not merely a marginal or trivial combination of existing methods.
s6bd49f3b48.zh: 贡献须证明其非平凡，并能就其本身得到理解；现有方法的边际或平凡组合不算。

sb7135b7bc0.en: Reproducibility and validity require precise, complete descriptions of experimental conditions.
sb7135b7bc0.zh: 可复现性与有效性要求对实验条件做精确、完整的描述。

s2af1892e59.en: Claims of robustness or generalizability require empirical validation across parameter variations, ranges, and tuning conditions, not assertion or reliance on unavailable ground truth.
s2af1892e59.zh: 鲁棒性或泛化性主张须在不同参数取值、范围与调参条件下做实证验证；仅凭断言或依赖无法获得的真值不算。

s6e1f22edb5.en: Design choices, parameter choices, and method structure must be transparently explained and empirically justified.
s6e1f22edb5.zh: 设计选择、参数选择与方法结构必须公开说明，并有实证依据。

s64d83a7623.en: Comparisons against baselines require comparable, transparent tuning effort to establish genuine superiority.
s64d83a7623.zh: 与基线的比较须投入相当且透明的调参努力，才能确立真实的优势。

s0dad8664db.en: Empirical and theoretical claims require numerical or empirical substantiation to be credible.
s0dad8664db.zh: 实证与理论主张须有数值或实证支撑才可信。

s8bb32c9041.en: Reproducibility requires precise, justified specification of hyperparameters and experimental parameters.
s8bb32c9041.zh: 可复现性要求精确、有依据地给出超参数与实验参数。

sf39dcfcddb.en: Assessing robustness requires understanding and analyzing the method's failure modes and cases.
sf39dcfcddb.zh: 评估鲁棒性要求理解并分析该方法的失效模式与失效案例。

s9d97052359.en: Novelty requires clear differentiation from established techniques, not merely applying known methods to a new problem.
s9d97052359.zh: 新颖性要求与既有技术有明确区分；把已知方法套用到新问题上不算。

s274e392075.en: Design and methodological choices, especially those departing from established baselines or claiming generality, require explicit justification grounded in evidence rather than assertion.
s274e392075.zh: 设计与方法上的选择，尤其是偏离既有基线或声称具有一般性的选择，须有基于证据的明确论证，不能仅凭断言。

se30a959044.en: A paper must clearly articulate its motivation and distinguish its aims and capabilities from prior art to justify its existence.
se30a959044.zh: 论文必须清楚阐明动机，并将其目标与能力同先前工作区分开，以证明自身存在的理由。

se30b0d439d.en: Claims, whether theoretical or empirical, require corresponding evidence to be credible.
se30b0d439d.zh: 无论理论主张还是实证主张，都须有对应证据才可信。

s4335a66f65.en: A contribution must be distinctive and demonstrate practical or theoretical significance beyond incremental extension to be worthwhile.
s4335a66f65.zh: 贡献须有独特性，并展示超出增量式扩展的实践或理论意义，才有价值。

s160973a57e.en: A method's formalism, problem statement, and implementation must align logically to provide a rigorous, self-consistent justification for the approach.
s160973a57e.zh: 方法的形式化、问题陈述与实现必须在逻辑上对齐，才能为该方法提供严谨、自洽的论证。

s7efce5e33c.en: Accurate terminology and conceptual clarity are required to position the work correctly relative to established literature.
s7efce5e33c.zh: 术语准确、概念清晰，才能相对既有文献正确定位这项工作。

s720f2f3d2f.en: A paper must comprehensively and accurately situate itself within existing literature, citing and acknowledging relevant prior work to properly position its contribution.
s720f2f3d2f.zh: 论文必须全面、准确地置于既有文献之中，引用并承认相关先前工作，以正确定位其贡献。

sc29e08690f.en: Novelty and contribution require explicit, substantive differentiation from closely related prior art, not superficial or incremental changes.
sc29e08690f.zh: 新颖性与贡献要求同密切相关的先前工作有明确、实质的区分；表面或增量式的改动不算。

s8df4f1bb9a.en: Citations must be accurate to maintain scholarly rigor and proper attribution.
s8df4f1bb9a.zh: 引用必须准确，以维持学术严谨与正当的归属。

s73960026bf.en: Citations and references must adhere to required formatting standards.
s73960026bf.zh: 引用与参考文献必须遵守规定的格式标准。

sa2c8df553e.en: Claims require supporting evidence and accurate citation to be credible.
sa2c8df553e.zh: 主张须有支持证据与准确引用才可信。

s0ddbf7c7ef.en: Reproducibility requires complete, clear, and accessible implementation details sufficient for independent replication.
s0ddbf7c7ef.zh: 可复现性要求实现细节完整、清晰、可获取，足以支持独立复现。

sb170d9d4bd.en: Claims of robustness, generality, or practical utility require rigorous empirical validation, including controlled experiments, statistical significance, and evaluation across multiple settings, not assertion.
sb170d9d4bd.zh: 鲁棒性、一般性或实用性主张须有严格的实证验证，包括受控实验、统计显著性与多种设定下的评估；仅凭断言不算。

s5198fde7a6.en: Reproducibility requires that source code be made accessible.
s5198fde7a6.zh: 可复现性要求公开源代码。

s684c478362.en: Claims of importance or effectiveness require empirical verification to be credible.
s684c478362.zh: 重要性或有效性主张须经实证核验才可信。

s3d090fd4d0.en: Practical applicability requires that necessary inputs, data, and resources actually be available in realistic deployment or replication contexts.
s3d090fd4d0.zh: 实际适用性要求所需的输入、数据与资源在真实的部署或复现场景中确实可得。

sbfd4b9fc16.en: Reproducibility and ethical acceptance require clear, transparent documentation of data provenance.
sbfd4b9fc16.zh: 可复现性与伦理上的可接受性要求对数据来源有清晰、透明的记录。

s1d76b2d4d1.en: novelty means articulated distinctness from prior art — and the burden of articulation is the author's
s1d76b2d4d1.zh: 新颖性即相对先前工作阐明出来的独特性 — 阐明的责任在作者

s3deee1dcaa.en: applying a known method to a new domain or setting does not constitute methodological novelty
s3deee1dcaa.zh: 把已知方法应用到新领域或新设定，不构成方法上的新颖性

s781019d504.en: incremental modification or extension of an existing method does not constitute sufficient novelty
s781019d504.zh: 对现有方法的增量式修改或扩展，不构成足够的新颖性

sbb39ec63b8.en: not a definition of novelty at all — the general law that claims must match their validation, imported into novelty denials: the objection is to the support for the novelty claim, not to the novelty itself
sbb39ec63b8.zh: 根本不是新颖性的定义 — 这是主张须与其验证相匹配的一般法则，被引入新颖性否决之中：异议针对的是新颖性主张的支撑，而非新颖性本身

s30f075075f.en: assembling known components is not novel unless the integration itself is
s30f075075f.zh: 拼装已知组件并不新颖，除非整合本身新颖

s7dda0c2d31.en: explicitly indexed to the venue's rank — 'not sufficient for a top-tier conference'
s7dda0c2d31.zh: 明确以会议档次为标尺 — 'not sufficient for a top-tier conference'

sc81b31d431.zh: 难以令人信服的一般性

sf4fd3b39bd.zh: 未分析的成本与性能权衡

sb85ce8ee92.zh: 未经核验的鲁棒性主张

sc747035d1b.zh: 未加论证的超参数选择

s034f99f6ab.en: Whether the method's claims about robustness, applicability, or specific mechanisms hold beyond the tested setting is unverified and questioned by reviewers.
s034f99f6ab.zh: 该方法关于鲁棒性、适用性或特定机制的主张在测试设定之外是否成立，未经核验，受到审稿人质疑。

s8a65acd892.en: The paper does not test performance under conditions such as real-world data, distribution shift, varying scale, or varying density/noise.
s8a65acd892.zh: 论文未在真实数据、分布偏移、不同规模或不同密度/噪声等条件下测试性能。

s7e9be89f1e.en: Experiments rely on a small number of datasets, small-scale data, or data that may not be representative enough to support the paper's conclusions.
s7e9be89f1e.zh: 实验依赖少量数据集、小规模数据，或代表性可能不足以支撑论文结论的数据。

s98d64ed6fa.en: A design or scoping decision (what to embed, which model or input space to select) is left unexplained, unjustified, or ambiguous.
s98d64ed6fa.zh: 某个设计或范围决定（嵌入什么、选择哪个模型或输入空间）未加说明、未加论证或含糊不清。

s417345d2f9.en: Reported results may be artifacts of specific model sizes, class counts, or data contamination rather than a genuine effect.
s417345d2f9.zh: 报告的结果可能是特定模型规模、类别数或数据污染造成的伪效应，而非真实效应。

s9a1e53e6a6.en: The paper omits direct comparison against specific known competing methods or formal diagnostic statistics.
s9a1e53e6a6.zh: 论文遗漏了与特定已知竞争方法的直接比较，或遗漏了正式的诊断统计量。

sf80b52b413.en: Reported improvements over baselines are small, inconsistent across datasets, or not clearly distinguishable.
sf80b52b413.zh: 报告的相对基线的改进幅度小、在数据集间不一致，或难以清楚分辨。

s14d1c6697a.en: The paper lacks analysis isolating or justifying individual components -- training stability, alternative design choices, or the mechanism's theoretical grounding are not examined.
s14d1c6697a.zh: 论文缺少分离或论证各组件的分析：训练稳定性、备选设计选择或该机制的理论根基均未考察。

s91078b54ee.en: A claim about what a model component or representation learns, preserves, or improves is asserted without direct empirical evidence beyond downstream accuracy.
s91078b54ee.zh: 关于某模型组件或表征学到、保留或改进了什么的主张，除下游准确率外没有直接的实证证据。

s1f3c35fac8.en: Whether the method generalizes beyond classification/benchmark tasks, combines with other methods, or remains stable across refinement steps is untested and questioned by reviewers.
s1f3c35fac8.zh: 该方法能否泛化到分类/基准任务之外、能否与其他方法结合、能否在多步细化中保持稳定，均未测试，受到审稿人质疑。

s5795b3fb36.en: Theoretical or heuristic insights are demonstrated only abstractly or in limited domains, without evidence they translate into practical algorithmic improvement.
s5795b3fb36.zh: 理论或启发式的见解只在抽象层面或有限领域得到展示，没有证据表明它们能转化为实际的算法改进。

sa6fb1552db.en: The method underperforms baselines on some tasks or produces results that appear contradictory or confounded by uncontrolled factors like optimizer settings.
sa6fb1552db.zh: 该方法在部分任务上不及基线，或产生看似矛盾、受优化器设置等未控制因素混杂的结果。

s6820e07d1d.en: The proposed technique closely resembles, or could be reconstructed from, existing established methods, leaving its distinct contribution unclear.
s6820e07d1d.zh: 所提技术与既有成熟方法高度相似，或可由其重构而得，其独有贡献因此不明。

s72bbc5ffc8.en: A specific equation, hyperparameter, threshold, or fusion strategy in the method is left unexplained, unjustified, or uncompared against alternatives.
s72bbc5ffc8.zh: 方法中的某个具体公式、超参数、阈值或融合策略未加说明、未加论证，或未与备选方案比较。

s1718dd3dcb.en: Reported improvements may stem from the training setup itself -- limited pretraining data, an unclear per-phase contribution, or a fine-tune-only regime -- rather than the proposed method.
s1718dd3dcb.zh: 报告的改进可能来自训练设置本身（有限的预训练数据、各阶段贡献不明、或仅微调的设定），而非所提方法。

sd0ae538eaf.en: The paper lacks formal proofs, bounds, or theoretical guarantees for the convergence, optimality, or consistency of the proposed method.
sd0ae538eaf.zh: 论文缺少对所提方法收敛性、最优性或一致性的形式化证明、界或理论保证。

s0507cc93e9.en: It is unclear whether the theoretical results or algorithm reliably translate into consistent empirical performance, especially outside idealized or convergent conditions.
s0507cc93e9.zh: 理论结果或算法能否可靠地转化为稳定的实证性能并不清楚，尤其在理想化或收敛条件之外。

se36ce3c84e.en: The mathematical derivation is difficult to follow, omits key assumptions, or contains notational inconsistencies, undefined terms, or technical errors.
se36ce3c84e.zh: 数学推导难以跟随、遗漏关键假设，或含有符号不一致、未定义的项或技术错误。

sd703e308c9.en: A specific theoretical mechanism or design choice, such as why a projection, regularizer, or gradient operation should work, is asserted without formal support.
sd703e308c9.zh: 某个具体的理论机制或设计选择（如某个投影、正则项或梯度操作为何有效）只是断言，缺少形式化支撑。

s9b7f9cc2b8.en: The theoretical construction or result overlaps with, or could be obtained from, existing prior work, and empirical instability such as optimizer divergence undercuts its claimed advantage.
s9b7f9cc2b8.zh: 理论构造或结果与已有工作重叠或可由其推出，而优化器发散等实证上的不稳定又削弱了其声称的优势。

s1e346139bd.en: The rationale behind a specific parameterization, function, or heuristic mechanism is not understood or explained.
s1e346139bd.zh: 某个具体参数化、函数或启发式机制背后的理由未被理解或说明。

s07a951245b.en: Formal statistical rigor, such as significance tests, confidence intervals, variance, or error bars, is absent or inconsistently reported for the results.
s07a951245b.zh: 结果缺少显著性检验、置信区间、方差或误差棒等正式的统计严谨性，或报告不一致。

s7f269e103b.en: The comparison between methods is confounded by assumption violations, mismatched data types or scope, or missing cost metrics like FLOPs and parameter counts.
s7f269e103b.zh: 方法间的比较受到假设违背、数据类型或范围不匹配、或缺少 FLOPs 与参数量等成本指标的混杂。

s1f1e7629f7.en: The experimental evaluation spans too few datasets or baselines, or lacks qualitative/experimental validation altogether.
s1f1e7629f7.zh: 实验评估覆盖的数据集或基线太少，或根本缺少定性/实验验证。

s93b7333fbe.en: A specific reported number, metric computation, or pattern of variation across datasets is presented without adequate explanation.
s93b7333fbe.zh: 某个具体报告数值、指标计算方式或跨数据集的变化模式，未给出充分解释。

s20e9c87ef6.en: Reported gains over baselines are small and may not be statistically meaningful.
s20e9c87ef6.zh: 报告的相对基线的增益很小，可能不具统计意义。

sc957af3016.en: The reviewer remains unconvinced that the reported results establish the claimed correctness, interpretability, or generality.
sc957af3016.zh: 审稿人不相信报告的结果能确立所声称的正确性、可解释性或一般性。

s2c122bbf83.en: No runtime, training/inference time, parameter count, or resource-cost comparison against baselines is provided.
s2c122bbf83.zh: 未提供与基线的运行时间、训练/推理时间、参数量或资源成本比较。

s24d84112cc.en: It is unclear how the method's computational or memory cost scales to larger datasets, sample sizes, or parameter spaces.
s24d84112cc.zh: 该方法的计算或内存成本如何随更大的数据集、样本量或参数空间扩展，并不清楚。

sae7339fb7b.en: The method gains performance by consuming more compute or parameters, and this tradeoff is not analyzed or is inconsistent across settings.
sae7339fb7b.zh: 该方法靠消耗更多计算量或参数换取性能，而这一权衡未作分析，或在不同设定间不一致。

s47c92ce3a5.en: Claims that overhead or resource cost is negligible or minimal are not backed by numerical measurements.
s47c92ce3a5.zh: 开销或资源成本可忽略或极小的主张，没有数值测量支撑。

sad7b40b98d.en: The reviewer directly asked about computational or memory efficiency without the concern being addressed.
sad7b40b98d.zh: 审稿人直接问及计算或内存效率，该关切未得到回应。

scfe4ccb391.en: Figures, captions, or tables contain unclear, inconsistent, duplicated, or mislabeled content that does not match the surrounding text.
scfe4ccb391.zh: 图、图注或表格含有不清晰、不一致、重复或标注错误的内容，与周围正文不符。

sc114ee4278.en: Sections, the abstract, or the paper overall lack clear logical flow and are difficult to follow.
sc114ee4278.zh: 章节、摘要或全文缺少清晰的逻辑脉络，难以跟随。

s247ce4a2c5.en: Symbols, variables, and notation are undefined, inconsistent, or non-standard across the paper.
s247ce4a2c5.zh: 全文的符号、变量与记号未定义、不一致或不规范。

sb749a2b218.en: The paper lacks clear figures or visualizations to illustrate the proposed method.
sb749a2b218.zh: 论文缺少清晰的图或可视化来说明所提方法。

s857a381eb0.en: Qualitative results, presentation styles, or highlighted metrics are shown inconsistently or misleadingly.
s857a381eb0.zh: 定性结果、呈现样式或突出显示的指标呈现不一致或有误导。

s2062ca7412.en: Typos, grammatical errors, missing captions, and formatting inconsistencies appear throughout the text.
s2062ca7412.zh: 全文出现笔误、语法错误、缺失的图注与格式不一致。

s49ada3cdf5.en: The reviewer explicitly reports difficulty understanding central parts, terms, or the paper's differentiation from prior work.
s49ada3cdf5.zh: 审稿人明确表示难以理解核心部分、术语，或论文与先前工作的区别。

s9f9f5f189d.en: Specific recent or state-of-the-art methods, or particular result tables, are absent from the comparison.
s9f9f5f189d.zh: 比较中缺少特定的近期或最先进方法，或缺少特定的结果表。

sbceb8eb6b7.en: The paper lacks comparison against existing or established baseline methods.
sbceb8eb6b7.zh: 论文缺少与现有或成熟基线方法的比较。

s41b0a8ebe8.en: The proposed method performs similarly to, only marginally better than, or inconsistently worse than baselines.
s41b0a8ebe8.zh: 所提方法与基线表现相当、仅略优，或时有不及。

s7d8559cea0.en: The chosen baselines are too simple, naive, or unrepresentative relative to the proposed method.
s7d8559cea0.zh: 相对所提方法，所选基线过于简单、朴素或缺乏代表性。

sd7e2fdc467.en: Experiments and baseline comparisons are confined to small-scale datasets or a limited set of tasks.
sd7e2fdc467.zh: 实验与基线比较局限于小规模数据集或有限的任务集合。

s455bdc6d45.en: No fair comparative experiments against baseline or state-of-the-art methods are provided at all.
s455bdc6d45.zh: 完全没有提供与基线或最先进方法的公平对比实验。

sbb3807ce56.en: The paper lacks ablation studies isolating the contribution of individual components.
sbb3807ce56.zh: 论文缺少分离各组件贡献的消融实验。

sf7029a8cfd.en: Robustness or stability claims are asserted without supporting experiments or justification.
sf7029a8cfd.zh: 鲁棒性或稳定性主张只是断言，没有支持实验或论证。

sb02877c0e8.en: The method introduces numerous hyperparameters that require careful, unguided tuning.
sb02877c0e8.zh: 该方法引入大量超参数，需要细致调参却没有指引。

sf9498be72c.en: No systematic sensitivity or robustness analysis, error bars, or hyperparameter-influence study is provided.
sf9498be72c.zh: 未提供系统的敏感性或鲁棒性分析、误差棒或超参数影响研究。

seb4900cb5e.en: Performance drops significantly or degrades under certain conditions without explanation.
seb4900cb5e.zh: 性能在某些条件下显著下降或退化，未加解释。

s755c1906f1.en: Specific hyperparameter or threshold values and design choices lack justification or motivation.
s755c1906f1.zh: 具体的超参数或阈值取值以及设计选择缺少论证或动机。

s440d962468.en: Robustness experiments are confined to synthetic, small-scale, or single-setting conditions.
s440d962468.zh: 鲁棒性实验局限于合成、小规模或单一设定的条件。

s58b9105dd0.en: The reviewer directly questions how sensitive the method is to hyperparameters, initialization, or sample choice.
s58b9105dd0.zh: 审稿人直接追问该方法对超参数、初始化或样本选择有多敏感。

s6bb1b808bf.en: The paper conflates several problems or leaves the problem setup so general that reviewers cannot see what is actually novel or specific to the claimed setting.
s6bb1b808bf.zh: 论文混淆了多个问题，或把问题设定写得过于宽泛，审稿人看不出哪里真正新颖、哪里专属于所声称的设定。

sa019ee5ac8.en: The paper offers no theoretical account, explainability mechanism, or link between experiments and theory to explain why the proposed approach works.
sa019ee5ac8.zh: 论文没有给出理论解释、可解释性机制，或实验与理论之间的联系，来说明所提方法为何有效。

s9890f9c4e8.en: The work reads as an engineering tweak or natural extension of existing techniques rather than a substantively new contribution, with comparisons or scope framed to flatter it.
s9890f9c4e8.zh: 这项工作读起来像是对现有技术的工程微调或自然延伸，而非实质性的新贡献；比较对象或范围的设定也偏向于抬高它。

s4cee7202e5.en: The paper does not clearly explain why the problem matters, what limits prior approaches, or what real-world applications the method serves.
s4cee7202e5.zh: 论文没有清楚说明这个问题为何重要、先前方法受何限制，或该方法服务于哪些现实应用。

scf812364b9.en: Findings are reported descriptively rather than as tests of a stated hypothesis, and results look unremarkable next to methods that use stronger pretrained priors or more diverse baselines.
scf812364b9.zh: 发现以描述方式报告，而非作为对明述假设的检验；与使用更强预训练先验或更多样基线的方法相比，结果并不突出。

s1a571638aa.en: Theoretical assumptions may not hold in practice, and claims about what drives the observed behavior are not disentangled or validated across a broad enough domain.
s1a571638aa.zh: 理论假设在实践中可能不成立；关于是什么驱动了所观察行为的主张，未加解耦，也未在足够宽的领域内验证。

s410cc195d8.en: Reviewers understand the method mechanically but remain unconvinced of its importance, questioning whether the comparisons or substitutions made are fair or meaningful.
s410cc195d8.zh: 审稿人在机制层面理解了该方法，但不相信它的重要性，质疑所做的比较或替换是否公平、有意义。

s7290e88950.en: Specific relevant papers, baselines, or prior methods that should be cited are absent from the reference list.
s7290e88950.zh: 应当引用的特定相关论文、基线或先前方法未出现在参考文献中。

sfde08849b2.en: The paper mentions related work but never states, item by item, how its approach or contribution differs from it.
sfde08849b2.zh: 论文提到了相关工作，却从未逐项说明自己的方法或贡献与之有何不同。

s4f6c8b6fda.en: Comparisons to prior methods are present but too vague or thin to show whether the proposed method actually improves on them.
s4f6c8b6fda.zh: 与先前方法的比较有，但过于模糊或单薄，看不出所提方法是否真有改进。

s979deb0aa4.en: The paper's conclusions or methods closely echo prior work, reading as an application of an existing approach to a new dataset rather than a new idea.
s979deb0aa4.zh: 论文的结论或方法与先前工作高度相似，读起来像是把现有方法用到了新数据集上，而非新想法。

sd16e3b11e8.en: The related-work coverage is too shallow, incomplete, or scattered through the text instead of consolidated into one coherent section.
sd16e3b11e8.zh: 相关工作的覆盖过浅、不完整，或散落在正文各处，没有汇总成一个连贯的章节。

sfb30bd7626.en: Reference entries or in-text citations contain formatting mistakes, inconsistencies, or errors.
sfb30bd7626.zh: 参考文献条目或文内引用含有格式错误、不一致或差错。

sb461c324db.en: No source code, or an incomplete release lacking a readme, generation scripts, or examples, is provided, leaving implementation details unverifiable.
sb461c324db.zh: 未提供源代码，或发布不完整，缺少 readme、生成脚本或示例，实现细节因此无法核验。

s8737c7b54f.en: Key experimental specifics such as hyperparameters, architecture, training setup, compute cost, and statistical significance needed to reproduce results are not reported.
s8737c7b54f.zh: 复现结果所需的关键实验细节，如超参数、架构、训练设置、计算成本与统计显著性，未予报告。

s383a7f8294.en: How the method applies beyond the tested setting (e.g., non-dense tasks, non-open-source models) is unclear, and some claims aren't fully backed by the reported implementation.
s383a7f8294.zh: 该方法如何应用于测试设定之外（如非密集任务、非开源模型）并不清楚，部分主张也未被所报告的实现完全支撑。

s172bd6010f.en: Experiments validate only a narrow setting or depend on an external model, leaving it unclear whether the reported effect comes from the method itself or from confounding factors.
s172bd6010f.zh: 实验只验证了一个狭窄的设定，或依赖外部模型，使人无法判断所报告的效果来自方法本身还是来自混杂因素。

s3ea4eddb4a.en: The paper omits inference speed, training speed, or other computational-cost figures, along with some architecture and hyperparameter specifics.
s3ea4eddb4a.zh: 论文未给出推理速度、训练速度或其他计算成本数字，也缺少部分架构与超参数细节。

scfd65a47d7.en: Copyright, EULA, or licensing constraints on the released data or dataset overlaps raise doubts about others' ability to access or legally reuse it.
scfd65a47d7.zh: 所发布数据的版权、EULA 或许可限制，或数据集重叠，令人怀疑他人能否获取或合法复用。

sd512b57975.en: Reviewers raise open questions about technical feasibility or detectability and sometimes admit they did not independently verify implementation details, while asking for code or experimental specifics.
sd512b57975.zh: 审稿人对技术可行性或可检测性提出未决问题，有时承认自己未独立核验实现细节，同时索要代码或实验细节。

s43af2ab694.en: “to clarify” — recasting the paper's meaning, not its content
s43af2ab694.zh: “to clarify” — 重述论文的含义，而非其内容

sae63d8f414.en: “we will add…” — the fix deferred to a future version
sae63d8f414.zh: “we will add…” — 修复推到未来的版本

sa533ac9913.en: “we thank the reviewer” — the ritual register
sa533ac9913.zh: “we thank the reviewer” — 礼仪性语体

s13114f464a.en: “in the revised version” — pointing at a change already made
s13114f464a.zh: “in the revised version” — 指向已做出的修改

sc8d2fe8fd3.en: “we have added new experiments/results” — evidence produced, not promised
sc8d2fe8fd3.zh: “we have added new experiments/results” — 证据已交付，而非承诺

s0d33c22a17.en: redeemed only when the paper delivers value beyond stacking existing tools — theoretical or practical, but new
s0d33c22a17.zh: 只有当论文交付了叠加现有工具之外的价值才得救赎 — 理论的或实践的，但须是新的

s19b4a66dc6.en: redeemed only by a genuine new insight the parts did not already contain
s19b4a66dc6.zh: 只有部件本身并不包含的真正新洞见才能救赎

s878764ef45.en: no exception at all — a restatement of the significance bar itself
s878764ef45.zh: 根本不算例外 — 只是重述了重要性门槛本身

s82dae4390e.en: redeemed only by explicit differentiation from the methods being adapted
s82dae4390e.zh: 只有与所改编的方法明确区分才能救赎

s3be7b7f679.en: redeemed only by a fundamentally new mechanism, not a new arrangement
s3be7b7f679.zh: 只有根本上新的机制才能救赎，新的排布不算

s33ba3c71c4.en: redeemed only when the unique contribution can be cleanly isolated from the assembled parts
s33ba3c71c4.zh: 只有当独有贡献能从组装部件中干净地分离出来才得救赎

sdbc2cb2ef4.en: not a combination exception — a separate boundary: reproducing known results is no contribution
sdbc2cb2ef4.zh: 并非组合例外 — 另一条独立的边界：复现已知结果不算贡献

sa5fadfc695.en: redeemed only by methodological innovation beyond engineering-level integration
sa5fadfc695.zh: 只有超出工程层面整合的方法学创新才能救赎

sc9ee4418ad.en: “combines existing techniques” with no part named and no mechanism specified
sc9ee4418ad.zh: “combines existing techniques”，不点名任何部件，也不指明任何机制

s099f94e53b.en: each named part of the method already exists in prior work — the parts are recited
s099f94e53b.zh: 方法中每个被点名的部件都已见于先前工作 — 部件被逐一列举

sf2245576d8.en: the assembly as a whole resembles one specific named prior technique
sf2245576d8.zh: 整个组装体与某一具名的先前技术相似

s340c2ee776.en: the problem is granted as new; the technique applied to it is the offense
s340c2ee776.zh: 承认问题是新的；用在它上面的技术才是罪状

s9b7ec66456.en: known techniques combined without demonstrating any new technical insight
s9b7ec66456.zh: 组合已知技术，却未展示任何新的技术洞见

s515b5e281f.en: What this project is, why the reasoning and not the score, and why ICLR: the question, the pipeline, and the findings digest.
s515b5e281f.zh: 这个项目是什么，为何看推理而非评分，为何选 ICLR：问题、流水线与发现摘要。

scdf9c11234.en: The Atlas About Method Resources API
scdf9c11234.zh: 图谱 关于 方法 资源 API

sd6fffd6b2b.en: theatrum judicii — the theatre of judgment

s9ee5290485.en: rise through the tiersnine tiers, and a colophon
s9ee5290485.zh: 拾级而上九阶，加一则版记

s632e919f7a.en: theatrum — the room this is modelled on
s632e919f7a.zh: theatrum — 本站所仿的那间屋子

s38d30595db.en: An attempted description of peer review, at the resolution of a single thought
s38d30595db.zh: 一次对同行评审的描述尝试，分辨率到单个念头

s086e7c4598.en: The Atlas of Judgment is a metascience instrument: an analysis of every public peer review of ICLR — the International Conference on Learning Representations — asking what the act of reviewing is. To make that analysable, each review is read into atomic units of evaluative logic — and what kinds of unit the record turns out to contain is itself part of the question — then the units are counted, compared, and tested at scale. Not what did reviewers decide, but how did they think.
s086e7c4598.zh: 评判图谱是一件元科学仪器：对 ICLR — 国际学习表征会议 — 全部公开同行评审的分析，追问评审这一行为是什么。为使其可分析，每篇评审被读成评价逻辑的原子单元 — 记录里究竟含有哪些种类的单元，本身也是问题的一部分 — 然后对这些单元做大规模的计数、比较与检验。不问审稿人决定了什么，只问他们如何思考。

s04ca907ac8.en: Peer review decides what counts as knowledge in machine learning. It runs on the unpaid attention of tens of thousands of people, it is argued about constantly, and its interior is studied far less than its verdicts. What is visible from outside is the output — a score, an accept, a reject — the way a verdict is visible while the deliberation behind it is not. This project is an attempt to open the deliberation and describe it.
s04ca907ac8.zh: 同行评审决定机器学习里什么算知识。它靠数万人无偿的注意力运转，争议不断，而其内部远不如其裁决受到研究。从外部可见的只有输出 — 一个分数、一个接收、一个拒稿 — 正如裁决可见，背后的合议却不可见。本项目试图打开这场合议并描述它。

sf6148119e2.en: The result is 1,420,178 atomic units of reviewer reasoning, drawn from nine years of ICLR and analysed across thirty-three plates. It is not an argument about peer review. It is an attempt at a description of it — made in one chosen form, carried all the way through — and it was built so that any part of the description can be taken apart by someone who doubts it.
sf6148119e2.zh: 结果是 1,420,178 条审稿人推理的原子单元，取自九年的 ICLR，在三十三张图版上分析。它不是一篇关于同行评审的论辩。它是一次描述的尝试 — 以一种选定的形式做成，一路贯彻到底 — 而且它的建造方式，让任何怀疑者都能把描述的任何部分拆开来看。

s6da4f284aa.en: Concept diagram: the public record is dissected into four-part units, the units are classified into a 12 by 12 taxonomy, and the taxonomy is counted and drawn into 33 plates.
s6da4f284aa.zh: 概念图：公开记录被解剖为四部分单元，单元被归入 12 乘 12 的分类体系，分类体系再被计数并绘成 33 张图版。

sb6979a5301.en: The whole instrument, at a glance

sa194c1e674.en: Nine years of ICLR, public on OpenReview — every review, rebuttal, and verdict, rejected papers included.
sa194c1e674.zh: 九年 ICLR，公开于 OpenReview — 每篇评审、每篇 rebuttal、每个裁决，包括被拒论文。

s632512912f.en: Each criticism cut into one movement of a reviewer’s mind: inspected · observed · reasoned · judged.
s632512912f.zh: 每条批评切成审稿人心智的一次运动：审视 · 观察 · 推理 · 判断。

s35ea6b1ef7.en: Every unit assigned in a grammar induced from the data: 12 objects of scrutiny × 12 reasoning standards.
s35ea6b1ef7.zh: 每条单元都归入一套从数据归纳得到的语法：12 个审视对象 × 12 个推理标准。

sbc262cf2ee.en: Every figure a count of units — and every number a door, opening back down to a reviewer’s sentence.
sbc262cf2ee.zh: 每张图都是单元的计数 — 每个数字都是一扇门，向下打开，直抵审稿人的一句话。

s365a6993e8.en: The whole project in one strip: the public record, the four-part unit it is dissected into, the 12 × 12 grammar each unit is filed under, and the plates that count them. Read backwards, it is the route of doubt: any number on any plate descends, step by step, to the reviewer sentences beneath it.
s365a6993e8.zh: 整个项目，一条长带：公开记录，它被解剖成的四部分单元，每条单元归档所依的 12 × 12 语法，以及计数它们的图版。倒着读，这是怀疑的路线：任何图版上的任何数字，都能一步步下降到其下的审稿人句子。

sa7fe08c9a9.en: 410,586 units (ICLR 2026, review-level) · 1,009,592 units (2018–2026, forum-level) · 52,460 submissions collected · verified 2026-08-18

s1201aac5bd.en: cur ratio, non numerus — why the reasoning, not the number
s1201aac5bd.zh: cur ratio, non numerus — 为何看推理，而非数字

s6e7e103b0e.en: II · why the reasoning, and not the score
s6e7e103b0e.zh: II · 为何看推理，而非评分

s89735da32e.en: A score is a judgment with the reasons thrown away
s89735da32e.zh: 评分是丢掉了理由的判断

sce39f564c3.en: Two reviewers write 5. One means the idea is not new. The other means the experiments do not support the claim. Averaged into a panel statistic, the difference disappears — and the difference was the whole of what happened. A score is a compression, and what it compresses away is precisely the part that could be argued with, learned from, or improved.
sce39f564c3.zh: 两位审稿人都写下 5。一位的意思是想法不新。另一位的意思是实验不支持主张。平均成评审组统计量后，差异消失了 — 而差异正是所发生的全部。评分是一种压缩，被压掉的恰是可以争辩、可以借鉴、可以改进的那部分。

s7de65b5585.en: The project's research question was fixed early, and verbatim, in its design documents: not whether a paper was accepted, nor whether a review was favorable, but — what do reviewers inspect, and through which criteria, comparisons, assumptions, and inferences does that observation become a judgment?
s7de65b5585.zh: 项目的研究问题早已在设计文档中逐字定下：不问论文是否被接收，也不问评审是否有利，只问 — 审稿人审视什么，那个观察又经由哪些标准、比较、假设与推断成为判断？

s24f6697d56.en: Peer review is a central quality-control mechanism of science, yet the reasoning inside it is rarely studied as an object in its own right. Reviews are usually reduced to scores, sentiment, or accept/reject outcomes. This project treats the reasoning itself as the data.
s24f6697d56.zh: 同行评审是科学的核心质量控制机制，其内部的推理却很少被当作独立对象来研究。评审通常被归约为评分、情感或接收/拒稿结果。本项目把推理本身当作数据。

sc3d76ee9f7.en: That choice sets the shape of everything downstream. Sentiment analysis would have counted how reviewers felt. Outcome modelling would have predicted what became of the paper. Neither says what was being weighed. The atlas is built for a narrower and more stubborn question: which part of a paper was looked at, and which standard was held against it. Asking that at scale meant choosing a grain and a vocabulary before any answer could exist — the four-part unit, the twelve-by-twelve grammar — so every answer the atlas gives is an answer in that chosen vocabulary: one way of carving the reasoning, carried through, not the only way it could have been carved.
sc3d76ee9f7.zh: 这一选择定下了下游一切的形状。情感分析会去数审稿人的感受。结果建模会去预测论文的下场。两者都不说什么在被权衡。图谱为一个更窄、更执拗的问题而建：论文的哪一部分被看了，又被拿哪条标准来衡量。要在大规模上问这个问题，就得在任何答案存在之前先选定粒度与词汇 — 四部分单元、十二乘十二的语法 — 因此图谱给出的每个答案，都是用这套选定词汇给出的答案：一种切分推理的方式，贯彻到底，并非唯一可能的切法。

s5ec0c88de0.en: unum forum — one forum, and only one
s5ec0c88de0.zh: unum forum — 一个会场，仅此一个

sbde210b7a6.en: The venue that publishes the reviews of the papers it rejects
sbde210b7a6.zh: 那个公开其所拒论文评审的会议

sbc7bce2879.en: One property makes ICLR nearly unique among top machine-learning venues: it publishes the reviews of rejected papers. Public review archives usually begin where acceptance ends — and a record without the rejected majority shows judgment only where judgment said yes. ICLR's OpenReview forums carry the full distribution — every submission, every review, every rebuttal, every verdict — for nine consecutive years, 2018 through 2026. That is 52,460 submissions and 792,703 forum messages, all from a single source with a single collection path.
sbc7bce2879.zh: 一项特性让 ICLR 在顶级机器学习会议中近乎独一无二：它公开被拒论文的评审。公开评审档案通常从接收之处才开始 — 而一份缺了被拒多数的记录，只在评判说“是”的地方显示评判。ICLR 的 OpenReview forum 承载完整分布 — 每篇投稿、每篇评审、每篇 rebuttal、每个裁决 — 连续九年，2018 至 2026。即 52,460 篇投稿与 792,703 条 forum 消息，全部来自单一来源、单一采集路径。

s79cfddb60e.en: One ICLR forum's public record: the submission, its official reviews with summary, strengths, weaknesses and questions, the open rebuttal exchange, the meta-review, and a decision fork whose record stays public whether the paper is accepted or rejected.
s79cfddb60e.zh: 一个 ICLR forum 的公开记录：投稿，附 summary、strengths、weaknesses 与 questions 的正式评审，公开的 rebuttal 往来，元评审，以及无论接收还是拒稿记录都保持公开的决定分岔。

s60ae2fb52e.en: One forum, as anyone may read it
s60ae2fb52e.zh: 一个 forum，任何人都可读到的样子

sd347935676.en: the paper itself, public from the day the forum opens — and it stays.
sd347935676.zh: 论文本身，从 forum 开放之日起公开 — 且一直公开。

s8cb4d68929.en: The official reviews ≈ 3.8 per paper
s8cb4d68929.zh: 正式评审 每篇论文 ≈ 3.8 份

se0f469b76a.en: each on one form — summary · strengths · weaknesses · questions — with a rating and a confidence attached: ≈425 words of judgment, signed by a stable pseudonym.
se0f469b76a.zh: 每份都填同一张表 — summary · strengths · weaknesses · questions — 附评分与置信度：≈425 词的评判，署以固定化名。

s66d45eac40.en: the authors answer under every review, and reviewers may return — the whole volley, timestamped, stays in the thread.
s66d45eac40.zh: 作者在每篇评审下作答，审稿人可再回复 — 整轮交锋带着时间戳留在线程里。

sefd01ab03a.en: the area chair reads the panel and writes reasons of their own.
sefd01ab03a.zh: 领域主席读完评审组，写下自己的理由。

s9dbbdc8d42.en: accepted · record stays open rejected · record stays open
s9dbbdc8d42.zh: 接收 · 记录保持公开 拒稿 · 记录保持公开

s2002ddd52c.en: 52,460 submissions · 792,703 public messages · nine years, one source

sd46bbe126e.en: One forum’s record, drawn to its parts. The counts are the corpus’s own: ≈3.8 official reviews per paper and ≈425 words per review are the 2026 means (74,380 reviews over 19,474 papers); 52,460 submissions and 792,703 messages are the nine-year totals. The fork’s two ends are drawn with the same ink on purpose — the record’s completeness does not depend on the verdict, and that is the property this atlas rests on.
sd46bbe126e.zh: 一个 forum 的记录，按部件绘出。数字是语料自己的：每篇论文 ≈3.8 份正式评审、每份评审 ≈425 词，是 2026 年的均值（19,474 篇论文上的 74,380 份评审）；52,460 篇投稿与 792,703 条消息是九年总计。分岔的两端有意用同一种墨绘出 — 记录的完整性不取决于裁决，这正是本图谱所依托的特性。

sbcde24ab6b.en: The choice is a constraint, not an endorsement. ICLR is one venue, in one field, with one culture and a review form that changed four times across the nine years. Everything in the atlas describes ICLR; nothing in it should be read as a fact about peer review in general unless the plate says so, and none of them do.
sbcde24ab6b.zh: 这个选择是一种约束，并非背书。ICLR 是一个会议，在一个领域，有一种文化，评审表在九年间改了四次。图谱中的一切描述的都是 ICLR；除非图版明说，其中没有任何内容应被读成关于同行评审的一般事实，而没有一张图版这样说。

sdfc70954e6.en: unitas judicii — one unit of judgment
sdfc70954e6.zh: unitas judicii — 一个评判单元

s79418e50a6.en: One complete movement of a reviewer's mind
s79418e50a6.zh: 审稿人心智的一次完整运动

sa12664e630.en: The unit of analysis is what this project treats as one complete movement of a reviewer's mind — from a thing inspected, through an observation, through the standard invoked, to a judgment. A real unit from the corpus:
sa12664e630.zh: 分析单元，即本项目视为审稿人心智一次完整运动的东西 — 从被审视之物，经观察，经所援引的标准，到判断。一条来自语料的真实单元：

s83a7c10304.en: The paper's notation system and formatting consistency.
s83a7c10304.zh: 论文的符号系统与格式一致性。

sc870ba45aa.en: The reviewer finds the notation "difficult to follow" due to inconsistencies in subscript/superscript usage.
sc870ba45aa.zh: 审稿人认为符号 "difficult to follow"，原因是上下标用法不一致。

sc60dc23172.en: Clear notation is a prerequisite for verifying correctness; ambiguity here creates a barrier to evaluating technical soundness.
sc60dc23172.zh: 清晰的符号是核验正确性的前提；此处的含混为评估技术可靠性设置了障碍。

sf48faee54d.en: The presentation quality is insufficiently rigorous — a formal weakness that hinders scrutiny.
sf48faee54d.zh: 表述质量不够严谨 — 一处妨碍审视的形式缺陷。

s68d9941303.en: Specimen № 335 of 410,586, from ICLR 2026 submission hPUjTTj64O. The same unit is opened part-by-part on the atlas's own Plate 0.
s68d9941303.zh: 标本 № 335，共 410,586 件，来自 ICLR 2026 投稿 hPUjTTj64O。同一单元在图谱自己的图版 0 上被逐部分打开。

s48c9adc8f8.en: Each unit also carries a verdict polarity (negative / positive / conditional / uncertain / mixed), a suggested fix when the reviewer offered one, line-level citations back to the source review, and a flag recording whether it is grounded in the reviewer's explicit words or inferred by the analysis layer.
s48c9adc8f8.zh: 每条单元还带有判定极性（否定 / 肯定 / 有条件 / 存疑 / 混合），审稿人若给出修复建议则一并记录，指回源评审的行级引用，以及一个标记，记录它是基于审稿人的明确文字还是由分析层推断得出。

s37c840c8d7.en: Everything in the atlas is a count of these. No plate holds anything that is not, at bottom, a pile of units — which is why every figure can be opened until a sentence written by an actual reviewer is showing. A number here is a door, not a conclusion.
s37c840c8d7.zh: 图谱中的一切都是对它们的计数。没有一张图版装着归根到底不是一堆单元的东西 — 所以每张图都能一直打开，直到露出一位真实审稿人写下的句子。这里的数字是一扇门，并非结论。

sa4df8f4c5e.en: manus artificis — the maker's hand, shown
sa4df8f4c5e.zh: manus artificis — 示出匠人之手

s8072c7dc62.en: Three layers, kept separate on purpose

sf585a0c782.en: No one reads 792,703 forum messages. The scale that makes the question answerable is exactly the scale that puts a machine between the reader and the reviewer. The honest way to handle that is not to hide the machine but to name the layers and keep them apart, so that a claim can always be traced to the layer that produced it.
sf585a0c782.zh: 没有人会读完 792,703 条 forum 消息。让问题可回答的规模，恰恰是把一台机器放在读者与审稿人之间的规模。诚实的处理办法是给各层命名并让它们彼此分开，而非隐藏机器，这样任何断言都能追溯到产生它的那一层。

sbb008fb208.en: Layer IHuman reviews — the raw OpenReview record, collected once and kept immutable. No anonymization is applied; the data is already public.
sbb008fb208.zh: 第一层人工评审 — 原始 OpenReview 记录，一次采集，保持不变。未做匿名化；数据本已公开。

s83e29413de.en: Layer IIAnalytic memos — a DeepSeek model reads each review (or forum) and writes a free-text metascientific analysis, under prompts that forbid re-reviewing the paper, require line-ID citations, and deliberately hide outcomes and other reviews at the initial stage.
s83e29413de.zh: 第二层分析备忘 — 一个 DeepSeek 模型读每篇评审（或 forum），写出自由文本的元科学分析；提示词禁止重新评审论文，要求引用行 ID，并在初始阶段有意隐去结果与其他评审。

sae6fd166ed.en: Layer IIIStructured logic units — a Qwen model normalizes each memo into schema-constrained JSON. It never sees the raw review; it is a normalization layer over Layer II, not a second opinion.
sae6fd166ed.zh: 第三层结构化逻辑单元 — 一个 Qwen 模型把每份备忘规范化为模式约束的 JSON。它从不看原始评审；它是第二层之上的规范化层，并非第二意见。

s2b65bb70a7.zh: 两条轨道，一套分类体系

s502fa68327.en: Two independent extraction tracks cover complementary views. The 2026 track works review-by-review at high resolution: 74,380 reviews → 410,586 units. The 2018–2026 track works forum-by-forum across nine years: 50,861 forums → 1,009,592 units, with temporal fields (before/after rebuttal, judgment change) that power the drift and rebuttal analyses.
s502fa68327.zh: 两条独立的抽取轨道覆盖互补的视角。2026 轨道逐篇评审、高分辨率地工作：74,380 份评审 → 410,586 条单元。2018–2026 轨道逐个 forum 横跨九年地工作：50,861 个 forum → 1,009,592 条单元，附时间字段（rebuttal 前/后、判断变化），驱动漂移与 rebuttal 分析。

s51afef4227.en: Both tracks share one taxonomy — 12 objects of scrutiny × 12 reasoning standards — induced from the data itself: a 12,000-unit sample was embedded and clustered with no seeding from prior schemes, the clusters were read and named by hand, and every unit in both tracks was then assigned to its nearest category. Definitions for every term are in the atlas lexicon, and on hover throughout.
s51afef4227.zh: 两条轨道共用一套分类体系 — 12 个审视对象 × 12 个推理标准 — 从数据本身归纳得到：对 12,000 条单元的样本做嵌入与聚类，不以先前方案作种子，聚类经人工阅读并命名，再把两条轨道中的每条单元归入最近的类别。每个术语的定义见图谱词汇表，全站悬停亦可见。

s4536974b97.en: quod non est — what it is not
s4536974b97.zh: quod non est — 它不是什么

s834380a8fc.en: A machine reading of reviews, not a measurement of reviewers
s834380a8fc.zh: 对评审的机器读取，而非对审稿人的测量

sab89cc03c5.en: What this is not: a direct measurement of human reviewers. Every unit is a two-stage machine reading. The support_status flag (explicit vs. inferred) and a per-category reliability grid in the atlas appendix exist so that every claim can be read against the instrument's own error.
sab89cc03c5.zh: 这不是什么：对人类审稿人的直接测量。每条单元都是两阶段的机器读取。support_status 标记（明确 vs. 推断）与图谱附录中的分类别信度网格，正是为了让每条断言都能对照仪器自身的误差来读。

s243a75bb79.en: Read the atlas with five caveats. (1) It measures a machine reading of reviews, not reviewers directly; the reliability grid shows where inference substitutes for quotation. (2) The negative share reflects the memo prompts' bias toward articulating criticism — it is not a sentiment ratio. (3) Coverage is 98.1–98.2% on both tracks; the missing tail (parse failures, provider content-policy refusals) is documented and its topic correlation unverified. (4) Decision-linked plates (the Consequence) are associations: outcomes were never shown to the extraction pipeline, but criticism breadth and paper quality are entangled by design. (5) The four-part unit and the 12 × 12 taxonomy are one induced carving of the text, not the only possible one: their internal reliability is measured, and the categories track ICLR's own sub-scores where they should, but no check can establish them as the right carving — a different scheme would draw a different map of the same reviews.
s243a75bb79.zh: 读这份图谱，带着五条注意。(1) 它度量的是机器对评审的读取，而非审稿人本身；信度网格标出了哪些地方是推断在替代引述。(2) 否定占比反映了分析备忘提示词偏向阐述批评 — 它不是情绪比例。(3) 两条轨道的覆盖率均为 98.1–98.2%；缺失的尾部（解析失败、服务商内容政策拒答）有记录，其与主题的相关性未经核验。(4) 与录用决定相连的图版（后果）是关联：结果从未展示给抽取流水线，但批评广度与论文质量在设计上就纠缠在一起。(5) 四部分单元和 12 × 12 分类体系是对文本的一种归纳得到的切分，并非唯一可能的切分：其内部信度经过测量，各类别在应当对应之处也追随 ICLR 自身的分项评分，但没有任何检验能确立它们是正确的切分 — 换一套方案，会为同一批评审画出另一张地图。

s4ea9421555.en: A caveat kept in an appendix is a caveat that has been hidden. These ride at the same weight as the findings, on the plates themselves as well as here — and the atlas's third appendix is given over entirely to results that failed: patterns that looked real, were tested against a null, and did not survive it.
s4ea9421555.zh: 放进附录的注意事项，等于被藏起来的注意事项。这几条与发现同等分量，印在图版上，也写在这里 — 而图谱的第三个附录全部留给失败的结果：看上去真实、经零假设检验、没能挺过去的模式。

sfa869ac698.en: Three habits make it read faster. Every technical term is defined on hover. Every number opens: click into a figure and it will keep going down until a real reviewer sentence, with a link to the OpenReview thread it came from, is on screen. And every plate has a machine-readable deposition — the same claim in JSON, with its counts, at /api/v1/plates/.
sfa869ac698.zh: 三个习惯能让它读得更快。每个技术术语悬停即有定义。每个数字都能打开：点进一张图，它会一路向下，直到屏幕上出现一句真实的审稿人原句，并附上它所来自的 OpenReview 讨论串链接。每张图版还有一份机读存证 — 同一断言的 JSON 版本，带计数，位于 /api/v1/plates/。

s18d420ee88.en: Some of what the plates hold

scfad9a2e52.en: 71.8%of all units resolve negative — the memo layer articulates the logic of criticism far more often than praise (a property of the instrument as much as of reviewers).
scfad9a2e52.zh: 71.8%的单元判定为否定 — 分析备忘层阐述批评逻辑的频率远高于称许（这既是仪器的属性，也是审稿人的属性）。

s389810814d.en: 138/144the grammar: each object of scrutiny has a canonical standard — novelty is judged by the novelty standard, cost by cost-benefit — and the coupling barely moved in nine years: 138 of 144 cells sit inside the shuffle-null floor.
s389810814d.zh: 138/144语法：每个审视对象都有其对应的标准 — 新颖性以新颖性标准评判，成本以成本收益评判 — 这种耦合九年间几乎没动：144 格中有 138 格落在置换零假设底线之内。

sb4cebc20ed.en: 26→6→13%the script: reviews open conceptually (framing 1.9× base rate) and close with hygiene (reproducibility 1.4×); praise collapses mid-review and returns at the close.
sb4cebc20ed.zh: 26→6→13%脚本：评审以概念开场（问题界定为基准率的 1.9×），以卫生类事项收尾（可复现性 1.4×）；称许在评审中段塌落，到结尾回升。

s630ecc52bf.en: 4.6%the rebuttal: of 130,650 post-response units, only 5.6% weaken or reverse (4.6% weakened, 1.0% reversed); even fresh experiments strengthen the original judgment ~3× more often than they soften it.
s630ecc52bf.zh: 4.6%rebuttal：130,650 条回应后单元中，只有 5.6% 减弱或反转（4.6% 减弱，1.0% 反转）；即便是新补的实验，加强原判断的频率也约为软化它的 3 倍。

s1fa036a0ff.en: −10.6ppthe tribunal: novelty criticism shows the largest acceptance gap (association only, not causation); compute-cost and robustness criticism show none at all.
s1fa036a0ff.zh: −10.6pp评审庭：新颖性批评显示出最大的接收率差距（仅为关联，非因果）；计算成本与鲁棒性批评则完全没有差距。

safd7a4c66a.en: 0.65the legible verdict: counting what was criticised reads a paper’s accept-or-reject at AUC 0.65 (its words 0.74; the panel’s own scores 0.90) — and that legibility has fallen for nine years. (The old “gauntlet” slope — acceptance falling with each added front of criticism — turned out to be expected-by-construction and now hangs in the Null Cabinet.)
safd7a4c66a.zh: 0.65可读的裁决：数一数被批评了什么，就能以 AUC 0.65 读出一篇论文的接收或拒稿（用它的词语是 0.74；评审组自己的评分是 0.90） — 而这种可读性九年来一直在下降。（旧的“夹道”斜率 — 每多一条批评战线接收率就下降 — 结果是构造上的必然，如今挂在零假设陈列柜里。）

s2d6ae8a12d.en: 38.6%dissent: reviewers of the same paper split most on problem framing — whether the question matters — and least on robustness, where evidence speaks.
s2d6ae8a12d.zh: 38.6%分歧：同一篇论文的审稿人在问题界定上分歧最大 — 这个问题是否重要 — 在鲁棒性上分歧最小，那里由证据说话。

sc76a1720e4.en: −13.7ppthe kinder judge: meta-reviewers run 13.7 points less negative and 10.5 points more positive than the panels they summarize.
sc76a1720e4.zh: −13.7pp更宽厚的法官：元评审者比他们所总结的评审组少 13.7 个百分点的否定、多 10.5 个百分点的肯定。

sb9a8a9e726.en: +3.2ppthe drift: 2018→2026, scrutiny moved from theory and clarity toward compute cost, statistical rigor, and reproducibility — from what is this idea toward what does the evidence cost.
sb9a8a9e726.zh: +3.2pp漂移：2018→2026，审视从理论与清晰度移向计算成本、统计严谨性与可复现性 — 从这个想法是什么移向证据要花多少。

sb92e2396ed.en: 7.8→3.1%the watermark: a frozen thirteen-word LLM-vocabulary signature appears in 7.8% of 2024 reviews (the pre-2023 trend expects 1.6%), then fades to 3.1% by 2026 — while co-reviews of the same paper grow 14% more alike under a fixed vocabulary. The fade measures the practice’s visibility, not its prevalence; no single review is accused.
sb92e2396ed.zh: 7.8→3.1%水印：一份冻结的十三词 LLM 词汇指纹出现在 7.8% 的 2024 年评审中（2023 年前的趋势预期为 1.6%），到 2026 年消退至 3.1% — 与此同时，在固定词表下，同一篇论文的同稿评审相似度提高了 14%。消退度量的是这种做法的可见性，而非其流行度；没有任何一条评审被指控。

s8e02f59ee3.en: Every figure above is interactive in the atlas, with counts, definitions, and raw specimen units behind it. None of them is the point of the page you are reading; they are here so that you know what kind of thing is on the other side of the door.
s8e02f59ee3.zh: 上面每张图在图谱里都可交互，背后有计数、定义和原始标本单元。它们都不是你正在读的这一页的重点；放在这里，是让你知道门的另一侧是什么样的东西。

s3bc750c610.en: The companion page, The Atlas Method, records the full pipeline — every script, model, parameter, seed, cost, failure mode, and the exact commands — at the level of detail needed to rerun it, along with an honest account of what cannot be reproduced (LLM sampling nondeterminism, a handful of one-off manual repairs, and upstream drift in OpenReview itself).
s3bc750c610.zh: 配套页面图谱方法记录了完整的流水线 — 每个脚本、模型、参数、随机种子、成本、失败模式和确切命令 — 详细到足以重跑，并如实交代哪些无法复现（LLM 采样的非确定性、少数几处一次性的手工修补，以及 OpenReview 自身的上游漂移）。

s1835e898d7.en: The shape of this page is borrowed from a building. In 1594 the university at Leiden raised a theatrum anatomicum: tiers of standing room in a tight ring, so that one body could be opened in front of witnesses and drawn. Peer review is that room with a paper on the table — a thing examined in public, by people who will say what they saw. This project is the same room turned one quarter further: the instrument pointed back at the hands that hold it.
s1835e898d7.zh: 这一页的形制借自一座建筑。1594 年，莱顿大学建起一座theatrum anatomicum：一圈紧密环绕的站席层层升高，让一具身体得以在见证者面前被打开、被绘下。同行评审就是那间屋子，只是桌上换了一篇论文 — 一件东西在公众面前被检视，检视者会说出自己所见。本项目是同一间屋子再转四分之一圈：仪器掉头指向握着它的手。

s966d200def.en: And the crowd in the tiers you have been reading through is not decoration. Each mark is one unit of reviewer reasoning, roughly one in every hundred the atlas holds, and the colours are their verdicts in the true proportion — overwhelmingly ink, because the corpus is overwhelmingly critical. Section VI explains how much of that is peer review and how much is the instrument.
s966d200def.zh: 你一路读下来的看台上的人群，也不是装饰。每一个标记是一条审稿人推理单元，约占图谱所藏的百分之一，颜色是它们的判定，按真实比例 — 绝大多数是墨色，因为语料绝大多数是批评。第 VI 节解释了其中多少属于同行评审，多少属于仪器。

s605cc69345.en: Why a site, and not a paper
s605cc69345.zh: 为什么是网站，而非论文

s6f0a12e420.en: The form is part of the motive. A paper binds a piece of research to one fixed presentation. Here the record is kept apart from its presentations: the same fifty data files feed the plates a human walks and the API a machine reads — because the readership of a research record is no longer only human. And anyone may draw a third view from the same files; the storeroom and its licence exist for that. The thought owes something to a 2022 note arguing that research data and its display can have different makers.
s6f0a12e420.zh: 形式是动机的一部分。一篇论文把一项研究绑定在一种固定的呈现上。这里的记录与其呈现分开保存：同样的五十个数据文件，既喂给人走过的图版，也喂给机器读取的 API — 因为研究记录的读者已不再只有人。任何人都可以从同一批文件画出第三种视图；库房及其许可证正为此而设。这一想法部分得自一篇 2022 年的短文，它主张研究数据与其展示可以由不同的人制作。

s4d70000cba.en: These pages are set in Cormorant Garamond for the display, Source Serif for the text, and IBM Plex Mono for the instrument labels. The figures are hand-written SVG, drawn stroke by stroke in the browser; the theatre behind the tiers is a single WebGL line engraving. The reviews were read by open-weight language models — analytic memos first, schema-constrained structuring second — and the pages themselves were built in a recorded conversation between the researcher and a language-model assistant, the passage the Method page quotes. Engraved MMXXVI.
s4d70000cba.zh: 这些页面的标题字体为 Cormorant Garamond，正文为 Source Serif，仪器标签为 IBM Plex Mono。图是手写的 SVG，在浏览器中一笔一笔画出；看台后方的剧场是一幅单张 WebGL 线刻。评审由开放权重语言模型读取 — 先出分析备忘，再做模式约束的结构化 — 页面本身则在研究者与语言模型助手的一段有记录的对话中建成，方法页引用的正是这段过程。刻于 MMXXVI。

s3556e847f4.en: This is the room next door to the atlas — the bench where the specimens were prepared, with the jars still labelled. It is in four parts: the build, which is everything needed to make the data again; the instrument tested, which is how well the reading reads and where it cannot be trusted; the record, which is what was actually done, in what order, and on whose prompting; and the bill.

s7322c6a106.en: Language & tooling: Python ≥ 3.12 managed with uv; all commands below are uv run python … from the project root. Tests use unittest (uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests; 69 tests, all synthetic fixtures — they never touch production data).

s6f97e6c923.en: Key dependencies: openreview-py ≥ 2.4.1 (collection), openai ≥ 2.53 (OpenAI-compatible clients for DeepSeek/DashScope), jsonschema, and for the taxonomy stage sentence-transformers, umap-learn, hdbscan.

s31bd327487.en: Credentials (environment variables; never printed or committed): OPENREVIEW_USERNAME/OPENREVIEW_PASSWORD for collection; DEEPSEEK_API_KEY for Layer II; DASHSCOPE_API_KEY for Layer III (in production resolved once per run from 1Password CLI by a supervisor wrapper and exported to the child process).
s31bd327487.zh: 凭据（环境变量；从不打印或提交）：采集用 OPENREVIEW_USERNAME/OPENREVIEW_PASSWORD；第二层用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY；第三层用 DASHSCOPE_API_KEY（生产环境中由监督器封装在每次运行时从 1Password CLI 解析一次，再导出给子进程）。

s1516543370.en: Directory contract: data/raw/ is written once by collection and thereafter opened read-only by everything else (verified by grep over all scripts: only the normalizer references it, with mode=ro). Every analysis run lives in its own directory under data/analysis/iclr/ with a manifest.json, a state.sqlite3 request ledger, and per-request outputs/, provider/, validations/ evidence files.
s1516543370.zh: 目录约定：data/raw/ 由采集一次写入，此后其他一切都以只读方式打开（已用 grep 遍历全部脚本核实：只有规范化器引用它，且带 mode=ro）。每次分析运行都在 data/analysis/iclr/ 下有自己的目录，含 manifest.json、state.sqlite3 请求台账，以及每个请求的 outputs/、provider/、validations/ 证据文件。

scd1206aa96.zh: 采集 — OpenReview → 原始 SQLite

sc4a1f688a8.en: Scope decision: ICLR only, 2018–2026, OpenReview as the single source. ICLR was chosen because it publishes reviews of rejected papers; ICML/NeurIPS expose mostly accepted-paper reviews. 2017 was deliberately excluded (not verifiable as an official OpenReview venue). The year range was fixed at the very start of the project; only extraction methods evolved later.
sc4a1f688a8.zh: 范围决定：仅 ICLR，2018–2026，OpenReview 为唯一来源。选 ICLR 是因为它公开被拒论文的评审；ICML/NeurIPS 暴露的多为已接收论文的评审。2017 被刻意排除（无法核实为 OpenReview 官方会场）。年份范围在项目一开始就固定；之后演变的只有提取方法。

sfd4bd272fd.en: API version handling: runtime detection, not a hardcoded table. venue_config() first queries OpenReview API v2 for the ICLR.cc/{year}/Conference group; if content.submission_id exists it stays on v2, otherwise falls back to v1 ({venue_id}/-/Blind_Submission). Empirically: 2018–2023 resolved to v1, 2024–2026 to v2.
sfd4bd272fd.zh: API 版本处理：运行时检测，不用硬编码表。venue_config() 先向 OpenReview API v2 查询 ICLR.cc/{year}/Conference 组；若存在 content.submission_id 则留在 v2，否则回退到 v1（{venue_id}/-/Blind_Submission）。实测：2018–2023 解析为 v1，2024–2026 为 v2。

s453d250e43.en: Pagination & resilience: cursor pagination (after=<last note id>, sort="id", page size 100) with details="replies" to fetch the reply graph in the same call; up to 7 retries with exponential backoff (1s→30s cap); a RuntimeError guard if a page makes no progress. Resumable via the after_id cursor persisted per year in collection_status; forums upserts on (year, forum_id) so reruns cannot duplicate.
s453d250e43.zh: 分页与韧性：游标分页（after=<last note id>、sort="id"、每页 100），带 details="replies" 在同一次调用中取回回复图；最多 7 次重试，指数退避（1s→30s 上限）；若某页无进展则触发 RuntimeError 守卫。可通过按年持久化在 collection_status 中的 after_id 游标续跑；forums 按 (year, forum_id) upsert，重跑不会重复。

s243acb958a.en: No anonymization: notes are serialized as-is (.to_json()), signatures included. The data is public; no PII masking exists anywhere in the pipeline.
s243acb958a.zh: 不做匿名化：note 按原样序列化（.to_json()），含签名。数据为公开数据；流水线中任何位置都没有 PII 遮蔽。

s51fcf546b4.en: Output: data/raw/iclr/openreview.sqlite3 — forums 52,460 rows (2018:935 · 2019:1,419 · 2020:2,213 · 2021:2,594 · 2022:2,617 · 2023:3,792 · 2024:7,404 · 2025:11,672 · 2026:19,814); collection_status 9 rows, all completed=1 with stored == expected.
s51fcf546b4.zh: 输出：data/raw/iclr/openreview.sqlite3 — forums 52,460 行（2018:935 · 2019:1,419 · 2020:2,213 · 2021:2,594 · 2022:2,617 · 2023:3,792 · 2024:7,404 · 2025:11,672 · 2026:19,814）；collection_status 9 行，全部 completed=1，且 stored == expected。

s994e81b9c5.en: Known limitationCompleteness is self-reported: the expected count comes from page one of the same run that then satisfies it. No post-hoc reconciliation against live OpenReview exists (inventory_iclr.py fetches live counts but writes only to data/inventory/, never cross-checks the raw DB). If OpenReview content changed after collection, the raw snapshot would not notice.
s994e81b9c5.zh: 已知局限完整性为自报：期望计数来自同一次运行的第一页，随后又由该运行自己满足。不存在对照 OpenReview 线上数据的事后对账（inventory_iclr.py 抓取线上计数，但只写入 data/inventory/，从不与原始库交叉核对）。若 OpenReview 内容在采集后发生变化，原始快照不会察觉。

sa38e0b79f6.en: Script: scripts/normalize_iclr.py (334 lines). Deterministic and idempotent — per year it deletes and rebuilds inside one transaction; no wall-clock timestamps or randomness (times come from the raw cdate/mdate).
sa38e0b79f6.zh: 脚本：scripts/normalize_iclr.py（334 行）。确定性且幂等 — 按年在一个事务内删除并重建；没有墙钟时间戳或随机性（时间来自原始的 cdate/mdate）。

s4e180037b9.en: What it adds — provenance only, no interpretation: classify_kind() strips the API-v2 "edit" wrapper then matches an ordered pattern list (official_review → meta_review → desk_rejection → withdrawal → decision → official_comment → public_comment → comment → unknown); classify_role() reads signature strings (/authors, /reviewer_, /area_chair_, /program_chair, public ~ profiles) with kind-based fallback.
s4e180037b9.zh: 它添加了什么 — 仅溯源，不做解读：classify_kind() 剥去 API v2 的 “edit” 包装后，按有序模式列表匹配（official_review → meta_review → desk_rejection → withdrawal → decision → official_comment → public_comment → comment → unknown）；classify_role() 读取签名字符串（/authors、/reviewer_、/area_chair_、/program_chair、公开的 ~ 档案），并以 kind 为后备。

s4b3bad9962.en: Output: data/processed/iclr/analysis.sqlite3 — papers 52,460 · messages 792,703. Kind breakdown: official_comment 507,543 · official_review 199,031 · decision 40,821 · meta_review 30,108 · withdrawal 8,235 · public_comment 5,563 · desk_rejection 980 · comment 422 · unknown 0.
s4b3bad9962.zh: 输出：data/processed/iclr/analysis.sqlite3 — papers 52,460 · messages 792,703。按 kind 细分：official_comment 507,543 · official_review 199,031 · decision 40,821 · meta_review 30,108 · withdrawal 8,235 · public_comment 5,563 · desk_rejection 980 · comment 422 · unknown 0。

s6613ad93ad.en: Engine: scripts/run_deepseek_pilot.py, model deepseek-v4-flash, thinking disabled, temperature=0.4, no seed. A persistent SQLite budget ledger (budget_state, api_call_attempts) with an fcntl lock keeps spend consistent across interruptions; every run declares a cost cap up front.
s6613ad93ad.zh: 引擎：scripts/run_deepseek_pilot.py，模型 deepseek-v4-flash，关闭思考，temperature=0.4，无随机种子。持久化的 SQLite 预算台账（budget_state、api_call_attempts）配 fcntl 锁，使支出在中断之间保持一致；每次运行都预先声明成本上限。

sbc8f261893.en: Prompt contract (canonical text in docs/prompts.md; the rendered prompt of every job is stored verbatim in each DB's jobs table): frame the task as qualitative metascience; never re-review the paper or invent taxonomies; cite evidence by line ID (R-<note_id>:L###); at the initial stage, deliberately hide outcomes and the other reviews.
sbc8f261893.zh: 提示词契约（规范文本见 docs/prompts.md；每个任务渲染后的提示词都原样存于各库的 jobs 表）：把任务定位为定性元科学；绝不重新评审论文，也不发明分类体系；按行 ID 引用证据（R-<note_id>:L###）；在初始阶段刻意隐藏结果与其他评审。

s5c2e87d0e2.en: Leakage control: decisions, scores, and other outcome metadata are never given to any extraction stage; they are joined only at display time, downstream.
s5c2e87d0e2.zh: 泄漏控制：录用决定、评分及其他结果元数据从不提供给任何提取阶段；它们只在下游展示时才被关联。

sdaf169cb87.en: Method choice: a blind same-model judge preferred Layered over Direct 69–31 in the pilot, but Direct was retained for the nine-year track on cost and error-propagation grounds; Layered feeds the high-resolution 2026 track. This trade-off is recorded, not hidden.
sdaf169cb87.zh: 方法选择：试点中，同模型盲评以 69–31 偏好分层法胜过直接法，但九年轨道出于成本与误差传播的考虑保留了直接法；分层法供给高分辨率的 2026 轨道。这一取舍有记录，未隐藏。

s8b8a010a79.en: Model (both tracks): qwen3.7-flash via DashScope's OpenAI-compatible endpoint https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1, realtime API, enable_thinking=false, strict JSON-schema output. No temperature or seed is set — provider defaults apply (a documented reproducibility gap; see §08). Each request reads only the Layer II memo — never the raw review. Manifests pin protocol_sha256 and schema hashes.
s8b8a010a79.zh: 模型（两轨）：qwen3.7-flash，经 DashScope 的 OpenAI 兼容端点 https://dashscope-intl.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1，实时 API，enable_thinking=false，严格的 JSON 模式约束输出。未设置 temperature 或随机种子 — 采用服务商默认值（一处已记录的可复现性缺口；见 §08）。每个请求只读第二层备忘 — 从不读原始评审。清单文件锁定 protocol_sha256 与模式哈希。

s1fea2f0e6d.zh: 轨道 A — 紧凑（ICLR 2026，评审级）

s9c119a065e.en: Schema review-logic-compact-v0.1.json: per review, logic_units[] of {inspected_object, observation, reasoning, judgment, valence, suggested_improvement, evidence_refs, support_status, confidence, missing_links} plus a summary and unresolved tensions. Result: 74,380 / 75,859 complete (98.1%), 1,479 failed, $28.79 against a declared $40 cap. The prompt was frozen at pilot v3 after ~10 gated pilot/control runs (batch-API attempts failed with model_not_found; realtime succeeded).
s9c119a065e.zh: 模式 review-logic-compact-v0.1.json：每篇评审一组 logic_units[]，每条含 {inspected_object, observation, reasoning, judgment, valence, suggested_improvement, evidence_refs, support_status, confidence, missing_links}，外加摘要与未解决的张力。结果：74,380 / 75,859 完成（98.1%），1,479 失败，$28.79，声明上限 $40。提示词经约 10 次门控的试点/对照运行后冻结于试点 v3（批处理 API 尝试以 model_not_found 失败；实时 API 成功）。

s8b3543e56a.zh: 轨道 B — 直接（2018–2026，forum 级）

s86b53a9f25.en: Schema reviewer-logic-direct-v0.1.json: per forum, reviewer_records[] each with logic units carrying temporal_position (initial / post_author_response / meta_assessment / cross_reviewer), update_trigger, and judgment_change (strengthened / weakened / reversed / clarified / not_observed) — the fields behind the rebuttal and drift analyses. Validation is local and strict: JSON-schema plus evidence-reference checking against the memo's line IDs; a response can be HTTP-200 and still be recorded as failed.
s86b53a9f25.zh: 模式 reviewer-logic-direct-v0.1.json：每个 forum 一组 reviewer_records[]，其中每条逻辑单元带 temporal_position（initial / post_author_response / meta_assessment / cross_reviewer）、update_trigger 与 judgment_change（strengthened / weakened / reversed / clarified / not_observed）— rebuttal 与漂移分析背后的字段。校验在本地且严格：JSON 模式校验，加上对照备忘行 ID 的证据引用检查；一个响应可以是 HTTP-200 却仍被记为失败。

s6b1a025091.en: The merge tool verifies the retry's ancestry chain through nested manifests (up to 32 levels), refuses to merge unfinished runs, snapshots the target DB via SQLite's online-backup API before applying (state-pre-retry-merge-<utc>.sqlite3), and never overwrites first-attempt provider evidence. Semantic-validation failures (HTTP-200 rows) are deliberately excluded from API retries — enforced by test.
s6b1a025091.zh: 合并工具通过嵌套清单核验重试的祖先链（最多 32 层），拒绝合并未完成的运行，应用前经 SQLite 在线备份 API 为目标库做快照（state-pre-retry-merge-<utc>.sqlite3），且从不覆盖首次尝试的服务商证据。语义校验失败（HTTP-200 行）被刻意排除在 API 重试之外 — 由测试强制。

sa527a7bcb5.en: The final data layer flattens both tracks into per-unit SQLite tables and assigns every unit to an induced taxonomy. Everything here is local compute — zero API cost — and fully scripted:

sfc8aea3c5c.en: Selection rule: only status='complete' rows of each source run are extracted (outputs also exist for some failed rows; those are excluded).
