s78c6581129.en: Embedding: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5, normalized, batch 256, local. Fields inspected_object and reasoning embedded separately.
s78c6581129.zh: 嵌入：BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5，归一化，批大小 256，本地。字段 inspected_object 与 reasoning 分别嵌入。

s9e5c0c4303.en: Clustering: UMAP (15 components, 30 neighbors, min_dist 0, cosine, random_state 7) → HDBSCAN (min_cluster_size 60, min_samples 10, EOM). Yield: 36 object clusters (37.6% noise) and 17 reasoning clusters (61.5% noise).
s9e5c0c4303.zh: 聚类：UMAP（15 个分量、30 个近邻、min_dist 0、余弦、random_state 7）→ HDBSCAN（min_cluster_size 60、min_samples 10、EOM）。得到：36 个审视对象簇（37.6% 噪声）与 17 个推理簇（61.5% 噪声）。

sfcbbec24a0.en: Human step: cluster exemplars were read and merged by hand into 12 objects × 12 standards, with definitions, recorded in taxonomy-v1.json. Two heterogeneous clusters were excluded from centroid construction. No prior scheme (including the project's own Atlas cards) was used as seed.
sfcbbec24a0.zh: 人工步骤：人工阅读各簇范例并手工合并为 12 审视对象 × 12 推理标准，附定义，记录于 taxonomy-v1.json。两个异质簇被排除在质心构建之外。没有以任何既有方案（包括本项目自己的 Atlas 卡片）作种子。

s9da4c45ffd.en: Assignment: category centroid = normalized mean of member-cluster sample embeddings (the seeded pipeline re-run reproduces cluster membership exactly — verified); every unit gets its nearest centroid by cosine, with the similarity stored as per-unit confidence. High-confidence (≥0.75) share: objects 94.5%, standards 87.9% (2026 track); per-year mean similarity on the direct track is flat at ~0.81, so cross-year comparisons are not a transfer artifact.
s9da4c45ffd.zh: 分派：类别质心 = 成员簇样本嵌入的归一化均值（带种子的流水线重跑可精确复现簇成员 — 已核验）；每条单元按余弦取最近质心，相似度作为该单元的置信度存储。高置信度（≥0.75）占比：审视对象 94.5%，推理标准 87.9%（2026 轨道）；直接轨道上逐年平均相似度平稳在约 0.81，因此跨年比较不是迁移产生的伪影。

sa723702ab4.en: Caveat: the taxonomy was induced on 2026 compact memos and transferred to the direct track; identical centroids, different memo style. The flat similarity profile is the evidence this transfer holds.
sa723702ab4.zh: 注意：分类体系在 2026 紧凑备忘上归纳，再迁移到直接轨道；质心相同，备忘风格不同。平稳的相似度曲线是这一迁移成立的证据。

s1b2c1cd2e4.en: Scheme validity: the four-part unit grain and the 12 × 12 taxonomy are one induced carving of the review text — internally consistent by the checks above, and externally anchored once (the construct-validity grid in §07: the categories dent the venue's own sub-scores where they should) — but no check establishes them as the right carving. A different grain or a different merge would draw a different map; every downstream count is a count within this scheme.
s1b2c1cd2e4.zh: 方案效度：四部分的单元粒度与 12 × 12 分类体系是对评审文本的一种归纳切分 — 按上述检查内部一致，并有一次外部锚定（§07 的构念效度网格：这些类别在应当起作用之处确实撼动了会议自身的分项评分）— 但没有任何检查确立它们是正确的切分。换一种粒度或换一种合并会画出另一张图；下游的每一个计数都是此方案之内的计数。

s5a40fd0d1f.en: Everything above describes how the data was made; this section asks how far the machine reading can be trusted. Two checks, both computed from the shipped unit databases. They are also shown in the atlas, but they belong here: they are statements about the instrument, not findings about reviewers.

s61eebf08f8.en: Support status — where the instrument speaks with its own voice
s61eebf08f8.zh: 支撑状态 — 仪器以自己的声音发言之处

s869bb7762b.en: Every unit carries a support_status field assigned at structuring time: reviewer_explicit (grounded in the reviewer's stated words), memo_inferred (articulated by the DeepSeek memo from context rather than quoted), or mixed. The two tracks differ sharply by construction — the review-level 2026 track runs 19.8% explicit / 77.1% inferred / 3.1% mixed, while the forum-level track runs 57.4% / 40.8% / 1.7% — because the Layered prompts ask the memo to synthesize, and the Direct prompts demand line-ID citations. The share is not uniform across categories or years:
s869bb7762b.zh: 每个单元带有一个在结构化时赋值的 support_status 字段：reviewer_explicit（以审稿人明述的文字为依据）、memo_inferred（由 DeepSeek 分析备忘依上下文阐述而非引用）或 mixed。两条轨道按构造就差异悬殊 — 评审级 2026 轨道为 19.8% 明述 / 77.1% 推断 / 3.1% 混合，forum 级轨道为 57.4% / 40.8% / 1.7% — 因为 Layered 提示词要求备忘做综合，Direct 提示词则要求引用行 ID。这一占比在类别与年份之间并不均匀：

s6109530375.en: Memo-inferred share, object × year — forum-level track (deeper violet = more inferred)
s6109530375.zh: 备忘推断占比，对象 × 年份 — forum 级轨道（紫色越深 = 推断越多）

s23b4cf0539.en: Categories and years where the violet deepens are where downstream figures speak more with the instrument's voice than the reviewer's. Rebuild: uv run python scripts/build_panel_data.py → panel-data.json (key reliability).
s23b4cf0539.zh: 紫色加深的类别与年份，正是下游各图更多以仪器之声而非审稿人之声发言的地方。重建：uv run python scripts/build_panel_data.py → panel-data.json（键 reliability）。

sb97190b6d6.en: Construct validity — do the induced categories track the venue's own decomposition?
sb97190b6d6.zh: 构念效度 — 归纳得到的类别是否跟随会议自身的分解？

s5e2266301e.en: The taxonomy was induced from embeddings, not designed, so it needs an external criterion. ICLR asks reviewers for three sub-scores (soundness · presentation · contribution, 1–4; the fields exist only since 2024). For each object of scrutiny we compare mean sub-scores of reviews that carry at least one negative unit on that object against reviews at the same overall rating without one, weight the per-rating deltas by prevalence (cells with fewer than 30 reviews on either side are dropped), and read whether each criticism dents the sub-score it should. Computed over all 74,380 rated 2026 reviews.
s5e2266301e.zh: 分类体系由嵌入归纳得到，并非设计出来，因此需要一个外部判据。ICLR 要求审稿人给出三项子评分（soundness · presentation · contribution，1–4 分；这些字段自 2024 年起才存在）。对每个审视对象，我们比较在该对象上至少带一个否定单元的评审与同一总评分下不带此类单元的评审的子评分均值，按流行度对各评分档的差值加权（任一侧评审数少于 30 的格子剔除），再看每种批评是否压低了它应当压低的那项子评分。在全部 74,380 篇有评分的 2026 评审上计算。

sc16298d9fc.en: Rating-adjusted Δ sub-score when a negative unit is present (oxblood = drops, verdigris = rises)
sc16298d9fc.zh: 存在否定单元时经评分校正的 Δ 子评分（赭色 = 下降，铜绿色 = 上升）

s528d4531ef.en: The grid largely agrees with the venue's own decomposition — clarity criticism dents presentation specifically (−0.35), novelty dents contribution (−0.12) — with one telling leak: theory criticism dents presentation more than soundness, as if "I could not follow the theory" were filed under presentation. Rebuild: uv run python scripts/build_construct_data.py → construct-data.json.
s528d4531ef.zh: 这张网格与会议自身的分解大体一致 — 清晰度批评专门压低 presentation（−0.35），新颖性压低 contribution（−0.12）— 但有一处耐人寻味的泄漏：理论批评对 presentation 的压低多于 soundness，仿佛 "I could not follow the theory" 被归到了 presentation 之下。重建：uv run python scripts/build_construct_data.py → construct-data.json。

sfec41fc55b.en: The moving ruler — nine years of the rating scale
sfec41fc55b.zh: 移动的标尺 — 评分量表的九年

s43c4cbf217.en: The venue's own instrument did not hold still. Enumerating every rating string in the record (all 199,031 official reviews) gives four distinct scoring forms, and any figure that compares scores across years has to reckon with them:
s43c4cbf217.zh: 会议自身的仪器并未保持静止。枚举记录中的每一条评分字符串（全部 199,031 篇官方评审），得到四种不同的评分形式，任何跨年比较评分的图都必须考虑它们：

s9b91d6c406.en: labeled; 5 = "marginally below the acceptance threshold", 6 = "marginally above"
s9b91d6c406.zh: 带文字标签；5 = "marginally below the acceptance threshold"，6 = "marginally above"

s7b6357a312.en: Reject / Weak Reject / Weak Accept / Accept; the only year with no confidence score (an "experience assessment" instead)
s7b6357a312.zh: Reject / Weak Reject / Weak Accept / Accept；唯一没有置信度评分的年份（代之以 "experience assessment"）

scc2c346cea.en: labeled through 2024 (same threshold anchors at 5/6); bare integers in the 2025 record
scc2c346cea.zh: 到 2024 年为止带文字标签（同样以 5/6 为阈值锚点）；2025 年记录中为裸整数

s298d978a8d.en: bare even integers; no shared threshold anchor with earlier years
s298d978a8d.zh: 裸偶数整数；与早年没有共同的阈值锚点

s23fc756633.en: The elements audit — three blind readers
s23fc756633.zh: 要件审计 — 三位盲读者

s5c6212af19.en: Plate X decomposes "not novel" into elements by clustering (data-driven terrain) and analyst merging (hand-drawn borders). To audit the borders, three independent machine readers (Claude Haiku agents) were each given 60 raw novelty denials and no taxonomy, and asked what each denial actually says. All three independently re-derived the plate's main families — the obvious combination, the insufficient increment, undifferentiated prior art, anticipation, restating the known, mere transfer, the discounted non-method contribution, and the venue-indexed bar — and one reader independently reproduced the decision to keep the imported evidence rule as its own element. Two elements the clustering had folded away surfaced in the audit and are recorded here as finer clauses: the false-priority accusation (the paper claims to be first, and the reviewer says the claim is untrue — an accusation of attribution, not of similarity; ≈3–7% of audited samples, folded inside "restating the known"), and the unlocated contribution (the reviewer cannot find what the paper claims is new; ≈5–10%, all three readers surfaced it). The second is best read the way the imported evidence rule is read: the charge is filed in novelty's docket but the operative law is presentation's — with one substantive twist that keeps it from being a mere clarity issue: reviewers treat novelty that cannot be located as novelty that does not exist, which is to say the venue's operative novelty is a property of the artifact plus its argument, never the artifact alone — consistent with the differentiation rule's burden-of-articulation clause, and with the fact that the dominant remedy for novelty is work of writing. Audit protocol and transcripts ship with the repository.
s5c6212af19.zh: 图版 X 通过聚类（数据驱动的地形）与分析者合并（手绘的边界）把 "不新颖" 分解为要件。为审计这些边界，三个独立的机器读者（Claude Haiku 智能体）各拿到 60 条原始新颖性否决，不给分类体系，被问每条否决究竟说了什么。三者都独立重新推导出该图版的主要族 — 显而易见的组合、增量不足、未加区分的现有技术、已被预见、复述已知、单纯迁移、被打折的非方法贡献、按会议定标的门槛 — 其中一位读者还独立重现了把引入的证据规则保留为独立要件的决定。两个被聚类折叠掉的要件在审计中浮现，在此记录为更细的条款：虚假优先权的指控（论文声称自己是第一个，审稿人说此说不实 — 这是对归属的指控，而非对相似性的指控；≈3–7% 的审计样本，折叠在 "复述已知" 之内），以及找不到的贡献（审稿人找不到论文声称的新东西；≈5–10%，三位读者都发现了它）。第二条最好按引入的证据规则的读法来读：指控归入新颖性的案卷，但生效的法则是表述的 — 只有一处实质性的转折使它不止是清晰度问题：审稿人把找不到的新颖性当作不存在的新颖性，也就是说，会议实际运作的新颖性是产物加其论证的属性，从来不是产物本身的属性 — 这与区分规则的阐明责任条款一致，也与新颖性的主要修复是写作之工这一事实一致。审计协议与记录随仓库发布。

sc4d5d994d1.en: How the atlas handles this: score distributions are always drawn per year on that year's own levels (Figs. 11d, 11e) and the scale changes are named in the captions; the score-spread claim (Fig. 10c) uses entropy normalized to each year's own level count, so a change of form cannot masquerade as a change of behavior; the intraclass correlation (Fig. 10a) is a variance ratio and so survives relabeling, but coarser grids mechanically deflate it — the 2026 point is dashed and flagged for exactly this reason. Raw-point quantities (means, reviewer-pair gaps) are never compared across form boundaries. Sub-scores (soundness · presentation · contribution) exist only from 2024, which is why the construct-validity check above is confined to recent years.
sc4d5d994d1.zh: 图谱如何处理这一点：评分分布始终按年、在该年自身的等级上绘制（图 11d、11e），量表变化在图注中点明；评分离散度的断言（图 10c）使用按各年自身等级数归一化的熵，因此形式的变化无法伪装成行为的变化；组内相关系数（图 10a）是方差比，所以在重新标注后仍然成立，但更粗的网格会机械地压低它 — 2026 年的点画成虚线并加标记，正是出于这个原因。原始分值量（均值、审稿人两两之差）从不跨形式边界比较。子评分（soundness · presentation · contribution）自 2024 年起才存在，这就是上文构念效度校验限于近年的原因。

s60d80ca412.en: LLM sampling: DeepSeek runs at temperature 0.4 without a seed; Qwen sets neither temperature nor seed. Re-running regenerates structurally similar but textually different memos and units. Every seed in the project governs input selection, not model output.
s60d80ca412.zh: LLM 采样：DeepSeek 以温度 0.4 运行，未设随机种子；Qwen 既未设温度也未设随机种子。重新运行会生成结构相似但文本不同的备忘与单元。项目中的每个 seed 都控制输入选择，而非模型输出。

saac0a76495.en: One-off manual repairs: two hardcoded fix scripts (28 episode IDs; 7 chain templates) patched earlier pilot artifacts and would need conscious re-application after any from-scratch rerun.
saac0a76495.zh: 一次性手工修复：两个硬编码的修复脚本（28 个 episode ID；7 个链模板）修补了早期的试点产物，从零重跑后需要有意识地重新施加。

sdb9fe58225.en: Human judgment points: prompt-freeze timing, calibration-config adoption, and stop decisions are documented but not mechanically reproducible.
sdb9fe58225.zh: 人工判断点：提示词冻结的时机、校准配置的采用以及停止决定都有文档记录，但无法机械复现。

s34de549ab0.en: Upstream drift: OpenReview does not expose full edit history; the raw snapshot cannot detect post-collection changes on the platform.
s34de549ab0.zh: 上游漂移：OpenReview 不公开完整的编辑历史；原始快照无法察觉平台上采集之后发生的更改。

se3dc1c0fe4.en: Hash coverage: protocol/schema SHA-256 pinning covers the Qwen-era runs (16 manifests); older pilot artifacts rely on documentary cross-reference only.
se3dc1c0fe4.zh: 哈希覆盖：协议/模式的 SHA-256 固定覆盖 Qwen 时期的运行（16 份清单）；更早的试点产物只能依靠文档互证。

sa2bd5a4ad0.en: what was actually done, in what order, and on whose prompting
sa2bd5a4ad0.zh: 实际做了什么，按什么顺序，受谁的推动

sedcddfd770.en: The actual path — pilots, failures, decisions
sedcddfd770.zh: 实际的路径 — 试点、失败、决定

scf2ec2eb3d.en: The raw, sanitized session history behind this chronicle — every command and decision as it happened, 21,386 events — is published in the project repository (codex-history/), alongside the full pipeline code and these pages. The sections above describe the pipeline as it finally ran. This section records how it actually got there — the small trials, dead ends, and mid-course corrections, in order. Nothing here is retrospective varnish; each item is backed by an artifact directory or manifest still on disk.
scf2ec2eb3d.zh: 这份编年记背后经过脱敏的原始会话历史 — 每条命令与每个决定按发生时的原样，共 21,386 个事件 — 发布于项目仓库（codex-history/），与完整流水线代码和这些页面一起。以上各节描述流水线最终运行的样子。本节记录它实际如何走到那里 — 小规模试验、死路与中途修正，按顺序排列。这里没有事后的粉饰；每一项都有仍在磁盘上的产物目录或清单作支撑。

sea80f113bf.en: Every production stage was piloted first
sea80f113bf.zh: 每个生产阶段都先做了试点

sbc01ebda02.en: Nothing ran at full scale untried. Pilot ledgers (all read-only verifiable): initial_blind 395 pilot jobs ($0.33), trajectory 327 ($0.51), paper_synthesis 100 ($0.52), forum_direct 100 ($0.32), and a dedicated 100-forum method-comparison run ($0.40).
sbc01ebda02.zh: 没有任何东西未经试验就全规模运行。试点账簿（均可只读核验）：initial_blind 395 个试点作业（$0.33），trajectory 327（$0.51），paper_synthesis 100（$0.52），forum_direct 100（$0.32），以及一次专门的 100 个 forum 方法比较运行（$0.40）。

s5cbc279a2c.en: The method fork: Layered (3 DeepSeek calls per review chain) vs Direct (whole forum in one call) were compared head-to-head on 100 forums, judged blind by the same model — Layered won 69–31. Direct was chosen anyway for the nine-year corpus, on cost and because layered errors propagate downstream. The quality trade was accepted knowingly and recorded, not hidden; Layered still powers the high-resolution 2026 track.
s5cbc279a2c.zh: 方法的分岔：Layered（每条评审链 3 次 DeepSeek 调用）与 Direct（整个 forum 一次调用）在 100 个 forum 上正面比较，由同一模型盲评 — Layered 以 69–31 胜出。九年语料仍选了 Direct，出于成本，也因为分层的错误会向下游传播。这一质量上的取舍是明知而接受并记录在案的，没有隐藏；Layered 仍然驱动高分辨率的 2026 轨道。

s24dcf3f54d.zh: episode 弯路（一次有收获的失败）

s4d56918263.en: An intermediate "evaluation episode" schema (v0.1, then a leaner v0.2 Lite/Deep) was designed and validated on curated sets: 1,000 stratified reviews (selection seed 20260816) plus 63 deep extractions — both kept as calibration assets.
s4d56918263.zh: 一个中间的 "evaluation episode" 模式（v0.1，之后是更精简的 v0.2 Lite/Deep）被设计出来，并在精选集上验证：1,000 篇分层抽样的评审（选择用随机种子 20260816）加 63 次深度抽取 — 两者都保留为校准资产。

sf5850e6218.en: Scaling it to all 75,859 reviews failed three ways in sequence: a first full run was rejected for shallow extraction; a v2 was rejected for templated, copy-paste fields; three calibration configs were then run head-to-head (r5-low, r15-medium, r8-medium-v3) and r8-medium-v3 adopted — but the projected wall-clock for the full corpus was roughly a week, and the run was deliberately stopped mid-flight (~9,774 shards planned).
sf5850e6218.zh: 把它扩展到全部 75,859 篇评审时接连以三种方式失败：第一次全量运行因抽取浅薄被否；v2 因字段模板化、复制粘贴被否；随后三个校准配置正面比较（r5-low、r15-medium、r8-medium-v3），采用了 r8-medium-v3 — 但全语料的预计墙钟时间约为一周，运行在中途被有意停止（计划 ~9,774 个分片）。

sf06a018222.en: The agentic Luna engine itself was then retired for this job: it had completed 876 of 75,859 with 186 failures when it was stopped "safely" and the whole extraction was re-designed around a lighter compact schema on Qwen. The 876 Luna outputs were kept as a comparison baseline, not merged.
sf06a018222.zh: 随后智能体式的 Luna 引擎本身也从这项工作中撤下：它在被 "安全地" 停止时已完成 75,859 中的 876 篇，失败 186 次，整个抽取围绕 Qwen 上一个更轻的紧凑模式重新设计。那 876 份 Luna 输出保留为比较基线，未合并。

sb5a82f53ed.en: Batch API first: 0 of 27 pilot requests succeeded (model_not_found on the batch endpoint). Switched to the realtime endpoint: 22/27. Two single-review control runs followed (46/54, then 53/54), a two-reviews-per-request packing was tried and rejected for coverage loss, and a 206-request load test (203 ok) served as the final go/no-go gate before the 75,859-request production run.
sb5a82f53ed.zh: 先试 Batch API：27 个试点请求 0 个成功（批处理端点返回 model_not_found）。改用实时端点：22/27。随后两次单评审对照运行（46/54，然后 53/54），尝试了每请求打包两篇评审并因覆盖率损失而否决，一次 206 个请求的负载测试（203 个成功）作为 75,859 个请求的生产运行之前最后的放行关卡。

sd887d9211a.en: Pilot v1: 0/90 — a dead end. v2 stalled with most requests stuck in prepared. v3 completed exactly one forum. v4 reached 79/90 and froze the method; only then did the 51,813-forum production run launch.
sd887d9211a.zh: 试点 v1：0/90 — 一条死路。v2 停滞，多数请求卡在 prepared。v3 恰好完成了一个 forum。v4 达到 79/90 并冻结了方法；此后 51,813 个 forum 的生产运行才启动。

s26df162efd.en: The first full pass (16k output tokens) left 7,166 truncated responses. A retry round at 24k re-ran 7,270 eligible rows and recovered 6,223. The 959 still failing were retried at 32k, recovering 812 more. 107 rows never parsed at any budget and remain excluded.
s26df162efd.zh: 第一次全量遍历（16k 输出 token）留下 7,166 条截断的响应。一轮 24k 的重试重跑了 7,270 条符合条件的行，找回 6,223 条。仍失败的 959 条以 32k 重试，又找回 812 条。107 行在任何预算下都未能解析，仍被排除。

se7e7ec2da5.en: A separate cluster of 32 rows failed identically at 16k, 24k, and 32k with the provider's content-policy refusal (DataInspectionFailed, HTTP 400) — proof this failure mode has nothing to do with token budgets. They were not retried further; only successes were merged, each merge preceded by an automatic online-backup snapshot of the target database.
se7e7ec2da5.zh: 另有一簇 32 行在 16k、24k 与 32k 下以同样方式失败，返回服务商的内容政策拒答（DataInspectionFailed，HTTP 400）— 证明这种失败模式与 token 预算无关。它们没有再重试；只有成功的结果被合并，每次合并前都对目标数据库自动做一次在线备份快照。

s5d16816b70.en: Semantic-validation failures (813 rows with valid JSON that failed local evidence/schema checks) were deliberately excluded from every retry round — re-billing the API cannot fix a local validation rule; that exclusion is enforced by a unit test.
s5d16816b70.zh: 语义校验失败（813 行 JSON 合法但未通过本地证据/模式检查）被有意排除在每一轮重试之外 — 再向 API 付一次费修不好本地的校验规则；这一排除由单元测试强制执行。

se910b6137b.en: The 32k retry's supervisor shell script crashed after all 959 rows were committed — it used status, a reserved zsh variable, as a local. Renamed to exit_status; zero data impact, but the lesson is written down.
se910b6137b.zh: 32k 重试的监督 shell 脚本在全部 959 行提交之后崩溃 — 它把 zsh 的保留变量 status 用作了局部变量。已改名为 exit_status；对数据零影响，但教训写了下来。

s5dad8f4b4f.en: Two one-off manual repairs patched earlier pilot artifacts (28 malformed episode IDs migrated via a hardcoded table; 7 placeholder chain-templates restored by hand). Both are irreproducible-by-construction and flagged in §08.
s5dad8f4b4f.zh: 两次一次性手工修复修补了早期试点产物（28 个格式错误的 episode ID 通过硬编码表迁移；7 个占位链模板手工恢复）。两者按构造即不可复现，已在 §08 标记。

sa015caaf6e.en: The taxonomy stage had its own iteration: reasoning-side clustering came back with 61.5% noise (vs 37.6% for objects), so the standard taxonomy was accepted as a skeleton induced from the clusterable ~40% — reported as a limitation rather than silently smoothed over.
sa015caaf6e.zh: 分类体系阶段有自己的迭代：推理侧聚类返回 61.5% 的噪声（对象侧为 37.6%），因此标准分类体系被接受为从可聚类的 ~40% 中归纳出的骨架 — 作为局限如实报告，而未悄悄抹平。

s9fbb33d73a.en: The order of the plates is not the order of the work
s9fbb33d73a.zh: 图版的顺序不是工作的顺序

s94b3968278.en: A page like this can read as though every analysis had been foreseen and each plate had waited for the one before it. It did not happen that way, and saying otherwise would be a research practice worth naming: inventing the motivation after seeing the result. So, plainly:
s94b3968278.zh: 这样一页读起来可能像是每项分析都已预见、每张图版都在等前一张。事情并非如此，若声称如此，就是一种值得点名的研究做法：看到结果之后再发明动机。所以，直说：

s989e16e881.en: The sequence is editorial, and it was imposed after the fact. The analyses were built over weeks in the order questions occurred to us; the plates were then grouped into acts and ordered for reading. That arrangement has now been revised three times — from a loose sequence into six acts; split into seven when the act on judgment was carrying two different questions; and regrouped again so that each act opens with the question its plates share (the current form). None of these rearrangements changed any analysis. No plate's position is evidence that it was done for the plate before it.
s989e16e881.zh: 顺序是编辑上的安排，事后才加上。这些分析历经数周，按问题出现在我们脑中的先后建成；之后图版才被归入各幕，并为阅读排序。这一安排至今已修订三次 — 从松散的序列到六幕；当关于评判的那一幕承载着两个不同的问题时拆成七幕；再重新分组，使每一幕以其图版共有的问题开场（即当前形式）。这些重排都没有改变任何分析。没有哪张图版的位置能证明它是为前一张而做的。

scb66d1f7df.en: Some plates began as a stated question, before any number existed. The nine plates added in the seven-act revision — the syntax of reasoning, the early verdict, the combination clause, the unnamed precedent, the law's price, the charge sheet, the moves, the borrowed verdict, the unamended code — were each written down as a question first, and computed afterwards. Two of them came back as nulls and are reported as nulls (the rebuttal moves; the interrogative). One candidate question was dropped before running, as too obviously answerable in advance: whether reviewers had grown a clause about prompt engineering in the LLM years. The timelessness test that occupies that plate replaced it.
scb66d1f7df.zh: 有些图版始于一个明述的问题，在任何数字存在之前。七幕修订中新增的九张图版 — 推理的句法、早判、组合条款、无名判例、法则的代价、控罪单、招式、借来的裁决、未修订的法典 — 每张都先写下问题，之后才计算。其中两张返回零结果，并按零结果报告（rebuttal 招式；疑问式）。一个候选问题在运行之前就被放弃，因为答案事先过于明显：审稿人是否在 LLM 时代长出了一条关于提示工程的条款。占据那张图版的恒常性检验取代了它。

sea46ce2d9f.en: Some plates are frankly exploratory. The script, the ladder and the oracle exist because the data supported the description, not because a hypothesis demanded them. Their ledes say so rather than manufacturing a motive.
sea46ce2d9f.zh: 有些图版坦白说是探索性的。脚本、阶梯与神谕的存在，是因为数据支撑得起这样的描述，而非某个假设要求它们。它们的导语如实说明，没有制造动机。

s1394820cd1.en: One published claim was wrong and was corrected in place. The early-verdict plate first stated that a review's verdict was readable by its sixth unit "against a median review length of eleven units". The median is five, which makes the original claim close to circular. The analysis was re-run restricted to reviews of ten units or more — where the question is real — and the plate now reports that curve, which saturates at eight or nine. The error and the fix are recorded here rather than quietly overwritten.
s1394820cd1.zh: 一条已发表的断言有错，已就地更正。早判图版起初写道，一篇评审的裁决到第六个单元即可读出，"相对于十一个单元的评审长度中位数"。中位数其实是五，这使原断言近乎循环论证。分析限于十个单元及以上的评审重跑 — 在那里问题才是真问题 — 图版现在报告的是那条曲线，它在八或九处饱和。错误与修正记录于此，而非悄悄覆盖。

sf69e2af5a2.en: A second claim was corrected the day it was published. The Watermark’s first posted reading (2026-08-27, morning) presented the rise in co-reviewers’ object-set overlap after 2023 as content-level convergence, noting its turn “lands on the watermark’s arrival year.” A size-matched null run the same day — same forums, same set sizes, contents drawn at random from the year’s mix — absorbed the rise: reviewers simply charge more objects per review in the LLM years (mean set size 3.4 → 3.8), and the excess of choice over size is flat (+0.037–0.054, maximum in 2018). Fig. 29c now draws the null; Fig. 29d reports the two further structural nulls (mix entropy, reasoning-embedding gap) run at the same time. The uncorrected reading survived on the live page for roughly half a day.
sf69e2af5a2.zh: 第二条断言在发布当天即被更正。水印图版首次发布的读数（2026-08-27 上午）把 2023 年后同稿审稿人对象集合重叠度的上升呈现为内容层面的趋同，并指出其转折“正落在水印到来的那一年。”当天运行的一次规模匹配零检验 — 同样的 forum、同样的集合大小、内容从当年的构成中随机抽取 — 吸收了这一上升：审稿人在 LLM 时代每篇评审指控的对象更多（平均集合大小 3.4 → 3.8），而选择超出规模的部分持平（+0.037–0.054，2018 年最高）。图 29c 现已画出该零模型；图 29d 报告同时运行的另外两项结构零检验（构成熵、推理嵌入差距）。未更正的读数在线上页面留存了大约半天。

s626a5ad4eb.en: A third claim fell to the same kind of null, hours later. The corrected plate’s Fig. 29d stated that an individual reviewer’s own attention entropy “rises 0.742 → 0.766: the individual reviewer looks at slightly more, not fewer, kinds of things.” An adversarial audit run the same evening — looking deliberately for siblings of the set-size artifact — found this rise mostly mechanical too: an n-matched null (same reviewers’ unit counts, objects drawn at random from the year’s own mix) rises almost in step, because reviewers file more units per review in the LLM years and the year’s mix itself grew more even. Only +0.008 of the +0.024 rise survives the null, with no trend. Fig. 29d now draws that null and claims only what survives: no narrowing after 2023. The same audit sharpened, rather than weakened, the wording-convergence panel: split by section, the within-paper rise concentrates in the summaries (+20%, still climbing) while the criticism prose rises +6% and stalls after 2025 — both decompositions now on the plate. The affirmative “spreads more” reading survived on the live page for under a day.
s626a5ad4eb.zh: 第三条断言几小时后倒在同类零检验之下。更正后图版的图 29d 曾写道，单个审稿人自身的注意力熵“从 0.742 → 0.766 上升：单个审稿人看的东西种类略多，而不是略少。”当晚运行的一次对抗审计 — 刻意寻找集合大小假象的同类 — 发现这一上升也大多是机械性的：一个 n 匹配的零模型（同一批审稿人的单元数，对象从当年自身构成中随机抽取）几乎同步上升，因为审稿人在 LLM 时代每篇评审提交的单元更多，当年的构成本身也变得更均匀。+0.024 的上升中只有 +0.008 在零检验后留存，且无趋势。图 29d 现已画出该零模型，只断言留存下来的部分：2023 年后没有收窄。同一次审计没有削弱用语趋同面板，反而使它更锐利：按章节拆分，论文内的上升集中在总结部分（+20%，仍在攀升），而批评正文上升 +6% 并在 2025 年后停滞 — 两种分解现都已上图。“分布更广”这一肯定读法在线上页面留存了不到一天。

s5b9e29c179.en: Where a caption gives a reason for an analysis, it is the reason the analysis was run — a question we had — or it is marked as what the result turned out to bear on. Reasons of the second kind are written as consequences ("what this bears on"), never as motives.
s5b9e29c179.zh: 凡图注为某项分析给出理由之处，那要么是该分析被运行的原因 — 我们当时有的一个问题 — 要么被标明为结果最终所关涉之事。第二类理由写成后果（“这关涉什么”），绝不写成动机。

scb7eb1bb49.en: The table below records, for every plate, the question it answers and what we can honestly say about when that question was formed. It exists so that a reader can tell the difference between a question we asked and then answered, and a description we produced and then found interesting. "Not recorded" is a real answer and appears where it appears honestly. Where a record exists, it was recovered from the project's own working history — the full conversation log between the researcher and the assistant, timestamped — not from memory. The log is kept in Japanese; the excerpts quoted below are translated. That log will stay private (decided 2026-08-27): the code-side session history is published in codex-history/, but the conversation log contains material that cannot be responsibly scrubbed at full length, so the dated excerpts quoted in this table are the parts of it that appear. Reconstructing a motive with no record would be exactly the practice this table is meant to prevent.
scb7eb1bb49.zh: 下表为每张图版记录它回答的问题，以及关于该问题何时形成我们能诚实说出的内容。它的存在是为了让读者分清两种东西：我们先提出再回答的问题，和我们先做出、随后觉得有趣的描述。“未记录”是一个真实的答案，出现在它诚实出现的地方。凡有记录之处，记录取自项目自身的工作历史 — 研究者与助手之间带时间戳的完整对话日志 — 而非记忆。该日志以日文保存；下文所引摘录为译文。该日志将保持私密（2026-08-27 决定）：代码侧的会话历史发布于 codex-history/，但对话日志包含无法负责任地全文脱敏的材料，因此本表所引的带日期摘录就是它公开的全部部分。在没有记录的情况下重建动机，正是本表要防止的做法。

s398d84a66e.en: stated first — the question was written down before the numbers existed
s398d84a66e.zh: 先行陈述 — 问题在数字存在之前已写下

sd1b19ca431.en: foundational — built together with the taxonomy itself; no separate hypothesis
sd1b19ca431.zh: 奠基性 — 与分类体系本身一同建立；无单独假设

sbe5552d9cc.en: exploratory — run because the data allowed the description; nothing predicted
sbe5552d9cc.zh: 探索性 — 因数据允许这种描述而运行；无任何预测

sed82245caa.en: part stated — partly specified in advance, partly added afterwards
sed82245caa.zh: 部分陈述 — 部分事先指定，部分事后添加

sea5f96a656.en: not recorded — we do not have a reliable record of what prompted it, and are not going to invent one
sea5f96a656.zh: 未记录 — 我们没有关于其起因的可靠记录，也不打算编造一个

sca2081409a.en: The tally over all 34 ledger rows, before the row-by-row record — a one-glance answer to "how honest is this project about its own process":
sca2081409a.zh: 在逐行记录之前，先给出全部 34 行台账的合计 — 对“这个项目对自身过程有多诚实”的一眼之答：

s0891d6c7cc.en: 17 stated firstquestion on record before the numbers
s0891d6c7cc.zh: 17 先行陈述问题在数字之前已有记录

sbb4c1bc479.en: 4 part statedseed on record, final design not
sbb4c1bc479.zh: 4 部分陈述种子有记录，最终设计无

s0459b1236d.en: 3 foundationalbuilt with the taxonomy itself
s0459b1236d.zh: 3 奠基性与分类体系本身一同建立

s0b479b0128.zh: 1 探索性描述性，无任何预测

s131f3af41e.en: Orientation: one review's anatomy, keyed to the nine acts
s131f3af41e.zh: 导览：一篇评审的解剖，逐一对应九幕

s738e293575.en: Navigation, not analysis; it carries no claim about the corpus. Built to a stated request, at the head of the site's full-screen contents overlay ("The Chart"). The specimen is chosen by a stated rule, not picked by hand: among the 232 sample_reviews, the review with 4–6 units showing the most distinct valences, ties broken by review_id ascending — today that resolves to review 08lMHzVzba (5 units, all five valences, decision Reject). Each unit is drawn as a band split into four strata (inspected object / observation / reasoning / judgment); each stratum's drawn length is the character count of the text actually stored at that layer, scaled to the longest field in the specimen, so the visual dominance of the reasoning stratum is the record's own shape, not a design choice. Leader lines key each of the nine acts to the part of the specimen it examines. The rating scale is drawn empty: this review's unit record carries no rating, so none is marked.
s738e293575.zh: 导航而非分析；它不含关于语料的任何断言。按一项明确的请求建造，置于站点全屏目录浮层（“总图”）的开头。标本按一条明述规则选出，而非手工挑选：在 232 条 sample_reviews 中，取带 4–6 个单元且判定种类最多的那篇评审，并列时按 review_id 升序打破 — 今天解析为评审 08lMHzVzba（5 个单元，五种判定齐全，录用决定 Reject）。每个单元画成一条分为四层的带（审视对象 / 观察 / 推理 / 判断）；每层画出的长度是该层实际存储文本的字符数，按标本中最长的字段缩放，因此推理层在视觉上的主导地位是记录自身的形状，而非设计选择。引线把九幕各自对应到标本中它所检视的部分。评分刻度画为空：这篇评审的单元记录不含评分，故未标出。

s261aa9a2bf.en: Scene-setting; needed before any claim about reviews.
s261aa9a2bf.zh: 铺陈场景；先于任何关于评审的断言。

sa912569202.en: A time-axis view was approved by the researcher from early prototypes (2026-08-18: "the time axis is interesting — let's do it"); the plate's final form evolved afterwards, so the link is a matter of record only in that general sense.

sffcaff4bcd.en: Nine plates were added in the seven-act revision (the Syntax, the Early Verdict, the Combination Clause, the Unnamed Precedent, the Law’s Price, the Charge Sheet, the Moves, the Borrowed Verdict, the Unamended Code), plus the Door, which is navigation and makes no claims. (In the 2026-08-24 restructure the Law's Price merged into the Price plate, the Gauntlet into the Consequence, and the Script into the Itinerary as its prologue; their instruments are unchanged.) One later addition, the Watermark (2026-08-27), closes the list. Their instruments, and where each can mislead:
sffcaff4bcd.zh: 七幕修订新增了九张图版（句法、早判、组合条款、无名判例、法则的代价、控罪单、招式、借来的裁决、未修订的法典），外加门，它只是导航，不作断言。（在 2026-08-24 的重组中，法则的代价并入代价图版，试炼并入后果，脚本并入行程作为其序幕；它们的仪器未变。）后来的一次添加，水印（2026-08-27），收束此列。它们的仪器，以及各自可能误导之处：

sabcdd8e62b.en: The Syntax — form labels come from the Plate III classifier (5-fold CV accuracy 0.685, macro-F1 in the file); transitions are compared against a null that shuffles each review internally, so the reported lifts are within-review order effects only, and they are small — the plate says so rather than dressing them up.
sabcdd8e62b.zh: 句法 — 形式标签来自图版 III 的分类器（5 折交叉验证准确率 0.685，宏 F1 见文件）；转移与一个在每篇评审内部置换的零模型比较，因此报告的提升度只是评审内的顺序效应，而且很小 — 图版直说这一点，不加粉饰。

s98fc90c327.en: The Early Verdict — "readable by unit six" is a statement about a classifier over coarse features (object × valence counts), not about when the reviewer decided; reviewers may draft conclusions first. Target is the 2026 even scale at 6+, 3-fold CV, seed fixed. The 2026-08-21 follow-ups share that target and CV: the raw-text bar is TF-IDF (1–2-grams, min_df 5) over the concatenated review fields; the tally weights are L2-logistic coefficients on whole-review per-topic negative counts (plus total positive and hedged counts) — descriptive coefficients on correlated counts, reported with their fold spread.
s98fc90c327.zh: 早判 — “到第六个单元即可读出”说的是一个基于粗特征（对象 × 判定计数）的分类器，而不是审稿人何时做出决定；审稿人可能先起草结论。目标是 2026 年偶数刻度上 6 分及以上，3 折交叉验证，随机种子固定。2026-08-21 的后续分析共用该目标与交叉验证：原始文本条是拼接评审字段上的 TF-IDF（1–2 元语法，min_df 5）；计数权重是整篇评审逐主题否定计数（加上肯定与有保留计数总量）上的 L2 逻辑回归系数 — 相关计数上的描述性系数，连同其各折离散度一并报告。

sc9b086d5ee.en: The Combination Clause — sub-clusters are k-means (k=8, seed 46) over bge-small embeddings; names were drafted by a machine reader over exemplars and reviewed by the analyst; four near-duplicate referent clusters were merged into one generic charge and the merge is recorded in the builder. Raw clusters ship with the dataset. The referents are clustered on the units' distilled observations, so the headline share (46% name no parts) was audited against source reviews: in a 30-case sample of no-name observations, wherever the source charge sentence could be located its specificity matched the observation's — generic in the reviewer's own words whenever the observation was generic, with one ambiguous exception where a descriptive sentence named parts the charging sentence did not. The audit transcript ships with the repository (notes/combo-audit-30.txt).
sc9b086d5ee.zh: 组合条款 — 子聚类为 bge-small 嵌入上的 k-means（k=8，随机种子 46）；名称由机器读取器基于样例起草、经分析者复核；四个近乎重复的所指聚类被合并为一项笼统指控，合并记录在构建脚本中。原始聚类随数据集发布。所指是在单元的蒸馏观察上聚类的，因此标题份额（46% 未点名任何部件）对照源评审做了审计：在 30 例未点名观察的样本中，凡能定位到源指控句的，其具体程度都与观察一致 — 观察笼统时，审稿人原话同样笼统；仅有一例含糊，其描述句点出了指控句未点出的部件。审计记录随代码库发布（notes/combo-audit-30.txt）。

s2ea8d811e9.en: The Unnamed Precedent — the extractor is a citation regex plus arXiv IDs, with venue acronyms excluded; prose references ("the BERT paper") are missed, so all lit shares are floors — the conclusion (no canon) survives any plausible extractor. The (surname, year) key deliberately over-merges, which only strengthens the null. The measurement was run twice, and both runs are reported (design of the second declared before its results): first on the distilled unit text (5 / 29 / 66; naming 8.4%→3.5% by year; max key 10 forums), then re-measured on the raw review text with the unit serving only to locate the charge — every sentence mentioning novelty ±2 sentences, in the best-token-overlap review of the unit's forum (window found for 79% of units; the window is deliberately generous to naming, since it can absorb a neighbouring criticism's citation). The raw reading gives 12 / 25 / 63, naming 20%→11% by year, max key 21 of 23,251 forums. The naming level is instrument-sensitive (floor 5%, generous window 12%); the two headline facts are not: about two thirds of objections carry no referent under either instrument, the naming rate halves 2018→2026 under both, and no canon appears under either. Builder: build_canon_native.py.
s2ea8d811e9.zh: 无名判例 — 抽取器是一个引用正则加 arXiv ID，排除会议缩写；行文中的提及（"the BERT paper"）会被漏掉，因此所有文献份额都是下限 — 结论（不存在正典）在任何合理的抽取器下都成立。（姓氏，年份）键刻意过度合并，这只会强化零假设。测量跑了两遍，两遍都报告（第二遍的设计在出结果前已声明）：先在蒸馏后的单元文本上（5 / 29 / 66；点名率按年 8.4%→3.5%；最大键 10 个 forum），再在原始评审文本上重测，单元只用于定位指控 — 取该单元所在 forum 中词元重叠最高的那篇评审里每一句提到新颖性的句子 ±2 句（79% 的单元找到了窗口；窗口刻意偏向点名，因为它可能吸入相邻批评的引用）。原始读法给出 12 / 25 / 63，点名率按年 20%→11%，最大键覆盖 23,251 个 forum 中的 21 个。点名水平对仪器敏感（下限 5%，宽松窗口 12%）；两个标题事实则不然：在两种仪器下约三分之二的异议全无所指，点名率在两种仪器下都于 2018→2026 减半，正典在两种仪器下都不出现。构建脚本：build_canon_native.py。

s0bbddc315a.en: The Law’s Price & the Charge Sheet (today Plate XIV · The Price and Plate XIII · The Charge Sheet, after the 2026-08-24 merge) — per-unit law assignments come from the sampled sentence clusters (40k per docket), so absolute co-filing rates are thinned; the plates therefore report only ratios (lift), which the independent-sampling design leaves unbiased to first order, and per-law mean deficits, which sampling thins but does not bias. Deficits are normalized by each year’s rating standard deviation; ratings join reviewer keys to OpenReview signatures by suffix match. The charge sheet’s within-review lifts were additionally tested against a paper-quality confound (build_chargesheet_control.py, declared before results): every displayed pair re-measured across two different reviewers of the same paper. Attractions kept a median ×1.44 across reviewers against ×1.87 within one review (part paper, part reviewer); repulsions showed no cross-reviewer suppression at all (×0.97 against ×0.75 within), placing the one-filing habit with the reviewer, not the paper. Cross-docket pairs cannot share a unit, so multi-law sentences cannot inflate either list.
s0bbddc315a.zh: 法则的代价 & 控罪单（经 2026-08-24 合并后，即今日的图版 XIV · 代价与图版 XIII · 控罪单）— 逐单元的法则归属来自抽样的句子聚类（每份案卷 40k），因此绝对的共同提出率被稀释；两张图版因而只报告比值（提升度）— 独立抽样设计使其在一阶上无偏 — 以及各法则的平均赤字 — 抽样使其变稀，但不引入偏差。赤字按各年评分的标准差归一化；评分通过后缀匹配把审稿人键接到 OpenReview 签名。控罪单的评审内提升度还额外检验了论文质量混杂（build_chargesheet_control.py，在出结果前已声明）：每一对展示的配对都在同一论文的两位不同审稿人之间重测。相吸在跨审稿人时保持中位数 ×1.44，对比评审内的 ×1.87（一部分归于论文，一部分归于审稿人）；相斥则完全没有跨审稿人的抑制（×0.97，对比评审内的 ×0.75），把只提其一的习惯归于审稿人，而非论文。跨案卷配对不可能共享一个单元，因此多法则句子无法抬高任何一份清单。

s3c3610bcf4.en: The Moves — the outcome instrument counts only judgment changes the reviewer recorded in post-response units ("weakened/reversed"); silent score raises are invisible to it. Markers are deterministic regexes, quoted in the builder. The contest’s premium is the association of a chosen move — authors contest when they hold a strong hand. A parallel embedding clustering of the same 722,406 reply sentences (k=12) separated topics more than tactics and found the same null; it ships as moves-raw.
s3c3610bcf4.zh: 招式 — 结果仪器只计入审稿人在回应后单元中记录下的判断变化（"减弱/反转"）；无声的提分对它不可见。标记是确定性的正则，原文引在构建脚本中。争辩的溢价是一个自选招式所带的关联 — 作者手握强牌时才争辩。对同一批 722,406 条回复句子做的并行嵌入聚类（k=12）分开的是话题多于策略，得到同样的零结果；它以 moves-raw 之名发布。

s9e9266670a.en: The Borrowed Verdict — echo tiers are cosine conventions (0.75 / 0.90) over cached reasoning embeddings; moving the thresholds moves the levels, not the comparisons. Nearest-neighbor attribution measures textual proximity, not causal influence — an AC and a reviewer may independently echo the paper. Concentration is computed only on forums with three or more echoed units.
s9e9266670a.zh: 借来的裁决 — 回声层级是缓存推理嵌入上的余弦约定（0.75 / 0.90）；移动阈值改变的是水平，不是比较。最近邻归因度量的是文本接近度，而非因果影响 — AC 与审稿人可能各自独立地呼应了论文。集中度只在有三条或更多回声单元的 forum 上计算。

sa712a78c2b.en: The Unamended Code — the timelessness claim is calibrated by a split-half control (a code fitted on half of 2026, held-out half at 0.152); every year sits within 0.008 of it. Two resolution limits are owned in the caption: sentence embeddings can miss register-preserving semantic shifts, and the transfer clause rides on the code’s one genuinely mixed cluster (majority register transfer; differentiation a defensible second reading), so its 5–7% band is the least certain of the six. The reverse fit (a 2018–19 code applied forward) uses k=6 over only 417 sentences and is reported as weak corroboration, not evidence.
sa712a78c2b.zh: 未修订的法典 — 不随时间改变这一断言用分半对照校准（在 2026 年的一半数据上拟合法典，留出的另一半为 0.152）；每一年都落在其 0.008 之内。图注承认两个分辨率限制：句子嵌入可能漏掉保持语域不变的语义变化；迁移条款依托法典中唯一一个真正混合的聚类（多数为语域迁移；区分是站得住的第二种读法），因此其 5–7% 区间是六个中最不确定的。反向拟合（把 2018–19 的法典向前应用）在仅 417 句上用 k=6，报告为薄弱的佐证，而非证据。

sf56b89d1d3.en: The Watermark (added 2026-08-27, after a literature survey of LLM-in-peer-review work) — corpus-level only, by design: per-review AI detectors are excluded on the record of non-native-speaker false positives (Liang et al., Patterns 2023) and instance-level unreliability (Yu et al., ICLR 2026). The instrument: a thirteen-word marker list frozen verbatim from Liang et al. (ICML 2024) and Kobak et al. (Science Advances 2025) before any counting; each year’s document frequency against its own 2018–2022 linear extrapolation (Kobak’s excess-vocabulary design); 2023 as a built-in placebo year and a frozen ten-word negative-control list run through identical machinery. Free text only — the five review-form eras’ enumerated fields are stripped, and similarity levels are never compared across a form boundary; the headline convergence claim lives inside the constant-form 2024–2026 window under one shared TF–IDF vocabulary. The correlate battery stratifies by length deciles (presence measures are length-sensitive — the control list’s below-trend drift shows the ambient tide), benchmarks the score comparison against the paper’s longest review, and permutes marked labels within papers 200× before reading any quality gradient (conditioning on the comparison group manufactures one from mean reversion alone). Plan, hypotheses and decision rules: notes/llm-era-analysis-plan.md, frozen before computation; addenda after run 1 (fixed vocabulary, length stratification, permutation control, quality strata after Sharma et al. arXiv:2601.20920) are labeled in the plan file. Prior art cited on the plate: Liang et al. 2024; Kobak et al. 2025 and Gray, arXiv:2512.01560 (the excess-vocabulary method’s ancestors — papers at large, not reviews); Latona et al. 2024; Wu et al. arXiv:2604.19578 (nearest neighbour — same venues, aspect-coverage not similarity); Sharma et al. 2026; Kim et al. arXiv:2605.20668 (AI reviewers’ 21%-vs-3% mutual overlap, by expert annotation); Baumann et al. arXiv:2605.03202 (the “hivemind effect”); and arXiv:2607.10511, which reads a 2022–23 shift in ICLR review-text diagnostics — the timing neighbour this plate’s placebo disagrees with by one cycle. A Semantic Scholar + arXiv search on 2026-08-27 found no published within-paper co-review similarity-over-years measurement on real OpenReview data; that is recorded as a search result, not a proof of novelty. Builders: build_llmtrace_data.py (raw text), build_llmtrace_mix.py (addendum E+F: category-mix entropy, size-matched overlap null, reasoning-embedding dispersion — the instruments behind Fig. 29d and the same-day correction of Fig. 29c recorded in § 10).
sf56b89d1d3.zh: 水印（2026-08-27 加入，在对 LLM 参与同行评审的文献做过调研之后）— 设计上仅在语料层面：逐篇评审的 AI 检测器被排除，依据是对非母语作者误报的记录（Liang et al., Patterns 2023）与实例层面的不可靠（Yu et al., ICLR 2026）。仪器：一份十三词标记表，在任何计数之前从 Liang et al.（ICML 2024）与 Kobak et al.（Science Advances 2025）逐字冻结；各年的文档频率对照其自身 2018–2022 的线性外推（Kobak 的超额词汇设计）；2023 作为内置的安慰剂年份，另有一份冻结的十词阴性对照表跑过完全相同的机制。只取自由文本 — 五个评审表时代的枚举字段被剔除，相似度水平从不跨表格边界比较；标题所称的趋同断言只在表格不变的 2024–2026 窗口内、在一套共享的 TF–IDF 词表下成立。相关量组按长度十分位分层（存在性度量对长度敏感 — 对照表低于趋势的漂移显示了背景潮汐），把评分比较以该论文最长的评审为基准，并在读取任何质量梯度之前把标记标签在论文内置换 200×（以比较组为条件，单凭均值回归就能制造出一个梯度）。计划、假设与决策规则：notes/llm-era-analysis-plan.md，计算前冻结；第 1 轮之后的补遗（固定词表、长度分层、置换对照、依 Sharma et al. arXiv:2601.20920 划分的质量层）在计划文件中有标注。图版上引用的先前工作：Liang et al. 2024；Kobak et al. 2025 与 Gray, arXiv:2512.01560（超额词汇方法的先驱 — 面向论文整体，而非评审）；Latona et al. 2024；Wu et al. arXiv:2604.19578（最近邻 — 同一批会议，度量的是方面覆盖而非相似度）；Sharma et al. 2026；Kim et al. arXiv:2605.20668（AI 审稿人 21% 对 3% 的相互重叠，由专家标注）；Baumann et al. arXiv:2605.03202（“蜂群思维效应”）；以及 arXiv:2607.10511，它在 ICLR 评审文本诊断量中读出 2022–23 的转折 — 本图版的安慰剂年份与这位时间上的近邻相差一个周期。2026-08-27 在 Semantic Scholar + arXiv 上的检索未找到任何已发表的、基于真实 OpenReview 数据的论文内同稿评审相似度逐年测量；这只记为一条检索结果，不作为新颖性的证明。构建脚本：build_llmtrace_data.py（原始文本），build_llmtrace_mix.py（补遗 E+F：类别构成熵、规模匹配的重叠零模型、推理嵌入离散度 — 图 29d 背后的仪器，以及 § 10 所记录的对图 29c 的同日更正）。

s0e39cf8836.en: During the plate-by-plate review, several caption claims turned out to live only in a builder’s one-off print output — verifiable at the time, unverifiable once the run scrolled away. The rule adopted: any number in a caption or stat rail must either sit in the shipped JSON or be recomputable by a named script. The following were persisted accordingly:
s0e39cf8836.zh: 逐图版审阅时，发现若干图注断言只存在于构建脚本一次性的打印输出里 — 当时可核验，输出滚走后便无法核验。于是定下规则：图注或统计栏里的任何数字，要么落在发布的 JSON 中，要么可由一个具名脚本重新算出。以下各项据此持久化：

sba05a602d4.en: build_acecho_data.py — now emits gap_by_cutoff: per-valence shares of meta-review units at nearest-neighbor cosine ≥ 0.70 / 0.75 / 0.80, backing the Borrowed Verdict’s claim that criticism is echoed more than praise at every cutoff (+7.0 / +6.6 / +3.3 pp).
sba05a602d4.zh: build_acecho_data.py — 现在输出 gap_by_cutoff：最近邻余弦 ≥ 0.70 / 0.75 / 0.80 时元评审单元按判向的份额，支撑借来的裁决中批评比称许在每个阈值下都被更多回声的断言（+7.0 / +6.6 / +3.3 pp）。

s7df2aeaa50.en: build_score_depth.py — now emits dispersion.accept_unan_div: acceptance for unanimous vs divided panels at exact means 4.0 and 6.0 (the banded version confounds range with mean inside the band and is retained only as the naive contrast). Backs the Measurement’s “the decision is a mean, not a variance” (92.1% vs 91.8% at mean 6.0; 12.1% vs 13.1% at 4.0).
s7df2aeaa50.zh: build_score_depth.py — 现在输出 dispersion.accept_unan_div：均值恰为 4.0 与 6.0 时一致评审组与分歧评审组的接收率（分段版本在段内把极差与均值混在一起，只作为朴素对比保留）。支撑度量中的“录用决定是均值，而非方差”（均值 6.0 时 92.1% 对 91.8%；4.0 时 12.1% 对 13.1%）。

se030a1de5c.en: build_timeless_data.py — now emits dist_se: per-year sentence-bootstrap SEs of the mean distance to the 2026 code (2018: 0.0034 … 2026: 0.0006), so the Unamended Code’s null is stated with its resolution: the early years sit measurably (+2–3 SE) but minutely (+0.006) above calibration; sentences cluster within reviews, so even those SEs are optimistic.
se030a1de5c.zh: build_timeless_data.py — 现在输出 dist_se：到 2026 年法典的平均距离按年做句子自助法得到的 SE（2018：0.0034 … 2026：0.0006），使未修订的法典的零假设连同其分辨率一起陈述：早年可测地（+2–3 SE）却微小地（+0.006）高于校准值；句子在评审内成簇，所以即便这些 SE 也偏乐观。

s27b8675ba1.en: scripts/verify_drift_ci.py (new) — reviewer-clustered bootstrap for the Drift’s four named movers (clarity, theory, compute cost, statistical rigor): all four sit at 8–16× their clustered standard errors (2,721 vs 73,427 reviewer clusters, 1,000 draws).
s27b8675ba1.zh: scripts/verify_drift_ci.py（新增）— 为漂移中点名的四个变动项（清晰度、理论、计算成本、统计严谨性）做按审稿人聚类的自助法：四项都落在其聚类标准误的 8–16× 处（2,721 对 73,427 个审稿人簇，1,000 次抽样）。

s24d367f120.en: scripts/verify_remedy_quartiles.py (new) — recomputes the Elements’ length-quartile robustness check from units.sqlite3: novelty offers a fix for 60–61% of its denials in every quartile of unit length, against 76–94% for the other eleven objects, and novelty units are slightly longer than the pooled rest (221.5 vs 203.0 chars) — terseness ruled out. Supersedes the earlier 63–66%/80–92% figures, which predated a pipeline rebuild.
s24d367f120.zh: scripts/verify_remedy_quartiles.py（新增）— 从 units.sqlite3 重新计算要件的长度四分位鲁棒性检验：在单元长度的每个四分位中，新颖性只为其 60–61% 的否决给出修复，其他十一个对象为 76–94%，且新颖性单元比合并的其余单元略长（221.5 对 203.0 字符）— 排除了简短之说。取代早先的 63–66%/80–92%，那组数字来自流水线重建之前。

s3e0ba105db.en: scripts/build_mirage_data.py (new) — permanent rebuild of the multinomial null that deleted the Kinds plate (2026-08-21), now feeding Appendix III’s centerpiece figure: real reviewer roses vs roses clustered from synthetic profiles drawn i.i.d. from one shared field mix (seed 46, matched unit counts). Reproduces the recorded numbers exactly: k-means explained variance 35.8% real vs 31.0% null; per-standard overdispersion median 1.15, max 1.58.
s3e0ba105db.zh: scripts/build_mirage_data.py（新增）— 把删掉「类型」图版（2026-08-21）的那个多项零模型永久重建，现在为附录 III 的核心图供数：真实审稿人玫瑰图，对比从同一领域构成中 i.i.d. 抽取的合成画像聚类而成的玫瑰图（随机种子 46，单元数匹配）。精确复现记录在案的数字：k-means 解释方差真实 35.8% 对零模型 31.0%；各标准的过度离散中位数 1.15，最大 1.58。

sc2a7d1ff2e.en: build_moves_markers.py — now emits delta_by_quartile_all and n_by_quartile, so the Moves’ effort-stratified premiums disclose the sub-threshold stratum (contest Q1, +1.43pp, drawn faint) instead of silently dropping it.
sc2a7d1ff2e.zh: build_moves_markers.py — 现在输出 delta_by_quartile_all 与 n_by_quartile，使招式中按投入分层的溢价披露低于阈值的那一层（争辩 Q1，+1.43pp，淡色绘出），而非默默丢弃。

s706f1e7bb0.en: build_overrule_data.py — now emits margins: the mercy asymmetry of the 2026 bench recomputed at overrule margins ¼–1 pt (×2.4 / ×2.7 / ×3.9 / ×3.9), backing the Panel’s “survives any margin” claim.
s706f1e7bb0.zh: build_overrule_data.py — 现在输出 margins：2026 年法官席的宽宥不对称在推翻边际 ¼–1 分处重新计算（×2.4 / ×2.7 / ×3.9 / ×3.9），支撑评审组中“在任何边际下都成立”的断言。

s84641bea18.en: Naming provenance for the added plates: the novelty direct-track clause map and the combination sub-cluster names follow the same workflow as the eleven-docket elements — machine-drafted over exemplars, analyst-reviewed (one contested cluster, the transfer/differentiation mixture, is flagged in both the map file and the caption). All raw cluster exports, per-unit assignments, and the builders that made them ship with the repository and the HF dataset.
s84641bea18.zh: 新增图版的命名溯源：新颖性 Direct 轨道的条款图与组合子聚类的名称沿用十一份案卷要件的同一流程 — 机器基于样例起草，分析者复核（一个有争议的聚类，即迁移/区分的混合体，在图文件与图注中都有标注）。所有原始聚类导出、逐单元归属，以及生成它们的构建脚本，都随代码库与 HF 数据集发布。

sd9cc36d238.en: The long rule and the cast shadow — instruments, not plates
sd9cc36d238.zh: 长标尺与投影 — 仪器，而非图版

s1d8d794037.en: Two persistent graphics recur across the atlas and are neither plates nor ledger entries. They are editorial apparatus, and the honest thing is to say so here rather than let a reader mistake them for figures: neither claims anything about the corpus. Each has exactly one real dependency on the data, and it is named below.
s1d8d794037.zh: 有两件常驻图形在图谱各处反复出现，既不是图版，也不是账目条目。它们是编辑装置，诚实的做法是在此说明，而不让读者误以为是图：两者都不对语料做任何断言。每一件对数据只有恰好一处真实依赖，下文点明。

sdf91761583.en: The long rule, a folding rule in the right margin, is built from the document itself: its hinges mark the act boundaries, its segment lengths are proportional to each act's plate count — counted at runtime from the page, not hand-tuned — and its graduations are one per plate, each one clickable. What is engraved along it is a vocabulary of magnifications (SENTENCE · REVIEW · CLAIM · COST · ROOM · COURT · RATING · YEARS · RECORD), one word per act, naming the size of the object that act holds under the lens. That vocabulary is editorial: it is the authors' own description of the book's structure, not a measurement of anything, and it should be read the way a table of contents is read, not the way a plate is read.
sdf91761583.zh: 长标尺是右侧页边的一把折尺，由文档本身构成：它的铰链标出各幕的边界，各段长度与该幕的图版数成比例 — 加载时从页面上数出，非手工调定 — 刻度每图版一格，每格可点击。沿尺刻着一套放大倍率词汇（句子 · 评审 · 断言 · 代价 · 房间 · 法庭 · 评分 · 年份 · 档案），每幕一词，点出该幕置于镜下的对象有多大。这套词汇属于编辑：它是作者对本书结构的自述，不是对任何东西的度量，应当像读目录那样读它，而非像读图版那样。

s3e7bc076ab.en: The cast shadow is a shadow thrown across the page when a heading arrives, inside which real sentences from the corpus develop and fade. It is decorative. The sentences are genuine corpus text — that much is a real data dependency — but nothing is claimed by which ones appear; no frequency, ranking or representativeness should be read into the selection. The whole layer is absent under prefers-reduced-motion and in print, which is itself a statement that it carries no content the page depends on.
s3e7bc076ab.zh: 投影是标题到来时投过页面的一道阴影，其中有语料里的真实句子显现、消隐。它是装饰。这些句子是真实的语料文本 — 这一点是真实的数据依赖 — 但出现哪几句不构成任何断言；不应从选取中读出频率、排名或代表性。整个图层在 prefers-reduced-motion 下和打印时都不存在，这本身就表明它不承载页面所依赖的任何内容。

se5749dfdc0.en: Four bays are the four parts; sixteen drawers are the sixteen sections; each drawer is as deep as its section is long, measured off this page when it loads rather than set by hand, and the card on each front is ruled from that section's own title. Like the atlas's long rule, it is apparatus: it claims nothing about the corpus, and the page reads without it.
se5749dfdc0.zh: 四个格间是四个部分；十六个抽屉是十六节；每个抽屉的深度与其小节的长度相当，在页面加载时从这一页量出，而非手工设定，每个抽屉正面的卡片按该节自己的标题划线。和图谱的长标尺一样，它是装置：不对语料做任何断言，没有它页面照样可读。

sb4e15e9589.en:
Every link to the source code, the underlying data, and the machine-reader API,
  gathered in one place — plus how to cite the atlas and what you may do with what's here.
sb4e15e9589.zh:
通向源代码、底层数据与机读接口的每一个链接，
  汇集于一处 — 还有如何引用本图谱，以及你可以怎样使用这里的东西。

s6bf5965064.en:
Collection, normalization, the DeepSeek/Qwen labeling pipeline, taxonomy induction, and every
  aggregation script behind every plate — the full working repository, including the sanitized agent
  session history the pipeline was built under.
s6bf5965064.zh: 采集、归一化、DeepSeek/Qwen 标注流水线、分类体系归纳，以及每张图版背后的每一个聚合脚本——完整的工作仓库，包括流水线构建时所在的、经脱敏的 agent 会话历史。

s2c3fa7a8f1.en: t46/atlas-of-judgment — scripts, provenance documents, and the source HTML pages themselves.
s2c3fa7a8f1.zh: t46/atlas-of-judgment — 脚本、溯源文档，以及 HTML 页面源文件本身。

sb4d9ee3c59.en: The labeled units, and everything built from them
sb4d9ee3c59.zh: 已标注的单元，以及由它们构建的一切

s167c5c19c5.en: Two layers are published. The primary dataset is the labeled unit tables themselves. The data islands below it are the smaller derived aggregates — one JSON file per statistic the plates chart — published so any number on the site can be recomputed or re-plotted independently.
s167c5c19c5.zh: 发布分两层。主数据集是已标注的单元表本身。其下的数据岛是较小的派生聚合——图版所绘的每项统计量对应一个 JSON 文件——公开发布，使站上任何数字都能独立重算或重绘。

s307a83d4f5.en: 410,586 review-level units (74,380 ICLR 2026 reviews, read at full depth) · 1,009,592 forum-level units (50,861 forums, 2018–2026) · the taxonomy definitions · 600 analyst-labeled rhetoric units. Released CC BY 4.0.
s307a83d4f5.zh: 410,586 个评审级单元（74,380 篇 ICLR 2026 评审，全深度读取）· 1,009,592 个 forum 级单元（50,861 个 forum，2018–2026）· 分类体系定义 · 600 个分析者标注的修辞单元。以 CC BY 4.0 发布。

sd313689289.en: File sizes on the Hub are not mirrored here — check the dataset card on Hugging Face for current per-file sizes.
sd313689289.zh: Hub 上的文件大小不在此处镜像——各文件当前大小请查 Hugging Face 上的数据集卡片。

s1415f5a8db.en: Data islands — the 50 aggregate files behind the plates
s1415f5a8db.zh: 数据岛 — 图版背后的 50 个聚合文件

sec76852a75.en:
Each file is the exact JSON a plate's charts are built from — same data, same source, just
  detached from the page. Sizes and contents below are read directly off the published files.
sec76852a75.zh: 每个文件就是图版图表据以构建的那份 JSON——同样的数据，同样的来源，只是脱离了页面。下方的大小与内容直接读自已发布的文件。

sbe5d9f9bcc.en: The holdings, drawn to scale Every data island as a circle whose area is its exact weight on disk, read live from the table below. Two files — the taxonomy point-cloud and the core taxonomy tables — carry 90% of the atlas’s 5.17 MB; the other 48, together, weigh half a megabyte. The two drawn dashed are collected but not yet rendered on any plate. Each circle links to its file.
sbe5d9f9bcc.zh: 馆藏，按比例绘制 每个数据岛画成一个圆，其面积是它在磁盘上的精确重量，实时读自下表。两个文件——分类体系点云与核心分类体系表——承载了图谱 90% 的体量，图谱共 5.17 MB；其余 48 个合计重 半兆字节。画成虚线的两个已采集，但尚未在任何图版上呈现。每个圆链接到它的文件。

sbf23ec9d73.en: The catalogue · every island by file, size, the plates it feeds, and what it holds
sbf23ec9d73.zh: 目录 · 每个岛按文件、大小、所供给的图版及其内容列出

s12ae1739df.en: How much a meta-review's language echoes each reviewer below it, split by that reviewer's score tier and the panel's verdict.
s12ae1739df.zh: 元评审的措辞对其下每位审稿人的回响程度，按该审稿人的评分层级与评审组的裁决拆分。

sea73c5cd10.en: Research areas clustered into "islands" by dominant object of scrutiny, against a baseline mix.
sea73c5cd10.zh: 研究领域按主导审视对象聚成“岛”，并与基线构成对照。

s72b4cf2c4c.en: The novelty syllogism: ground/warrant/demand clusters with exemplars and the transition matrices behind Fig. 7d.
s72b4cf2c4c.zh: 新颖性三段论：依据/理据/要求各簇及其例句，以及图 7d 背后的转移矩阵。

s9c41b4eb0f.en: Text-similarity measurements of formulaic review language, by object and by rating band.
s9c41b4eb0f.zh: 套语式评审语言的文本相似度测量，按对象与评分段划分。

sa3c3cdbd6b.en: How often an objection names a specific prior work vs. stays vague, by year.
sa3c3cdbd6b.zh: 异议点名具体先前工作与含糊其辞的频率对比，按年份划分。

sfdbae6636b.en: Transition likelihoods between successive units within one review — what follows what.
sfdbae6636b.zh: 一篇评审内相继单元之间的转移概率——什么跟在什么之后。

s6912e7faca.en: The control behind that matrix: the same standard pairs re-measured three ways — inside one unit, across different units of one review, and across two different reviewers of the same paper — which is what separates a real repulsion from a mixture of habits.
s6912e7faca.zh: 那张矩阵背后的对照：同样的标准配对以三种方式重测——在同一单元内、在同一篇评审的不同单元间、在同一篇论文的两位不同审稿人之间——由此把真实的互斥与习惯的混合区分开。

sb38d3e8e84.en: Co-occurrence matrix of which reasoning standards get invoked together in the same review.
sb38d3e8e84.zh: 哪些推理标准在同一篇评审中被一同援引的共现矩阵。

sa9cbf8f7dd.en: The “mere combination” novelty rule, sub-clustered into its exception clauses and referent kinds, with exemplars.
sa9cbf8f7dd.zh: “仅为组合”这条新颖性规则，细分聚类为其例外条款与所指对象类型，附例句。

s43dc53b833.en: How early in a review the eventual verdict becomes predictable from text alone, by review-length decile.
s43dc53b833.zh: 一篇评审进行到多早，仅凭文本就能预测其最终裁决，按评审长度十分位划分。

s0727e29f2c.en: Construct validity: rating-adjusted gaps between the twelve objects and ICLR’s own three sub-scores (Fig. 1c).
s0727e29f2c.zh: 构念效度：十二个对象与 ICLR 自有三项子评分之间经评分校正的差距（图 1c）。

s9b14ffa4c3.en: Counterfactual re-scoring comparison between the 2025 and 2026 cycles.
s9b14ffa4c3.zh: 2025 与 2026 两个周期之间的反事实重评分比较。

s364f724e8c.en: How meta-reviewers revise, forgive, or redeem the panel's judgment below them.
s364f724e8c.zh: 元评审人如何修正、宽宥或挽回其下评审组的判断。

sa6a2f65097.en: Year-over-year score, word-count, and unit-count series feeding the drift analysis.
sa6a2f65097.zh: 供给漂移分析的逐年评分、词数与单元数序列。

s360b3c9202.en: Decision legibility: cross-validated AUCs at reading accept/reject from criticism tallies, text, and scores (Fig. 15b).
s360b3c9202.zh: 录用决定的可读性：从批评计数、文本与评分读出接收/拒稿的交叉验证 AUC（图 15b）。

s78d1ce9d9d.en: Per-forum record of reviewer moves made during panel deliberation.
s78d1ce9d9d.zh: 评审组合议期间审稿人所出招式的逐 forum 记录。

sd01bac5683.en: Nine-year share trends of which objects, standards, and verdict valences reviewers invoke.
sd01bac5683.zh: 审稿人援引的对象、标准与判向的九年份额趋势。

s564b3f63be.en: Whether the words attached to an object actually moved: the span of each object’s yearly vocabulary path against a shuffle noise floor, with the terms that rose early and late.
s564b3f63be.zh: 附着于某个对象的词是否真的动了：每个对象逐年词汇路径的跨度对照置换噪声底线，以及早期与晚期上升的词项。

sc9d7214826.en: Per-object statistics for each of the twelve objects of scrutiny (empirical scope, method design, theory, and so on).
sc9d7214826.zh: 十二个审视对象各自的逐对象统计（实证范围、方法设计、理论等）。

s84742f971e.en: Per-year corpus statistics used as the control baseline for the null-model comparison.
s84742f971e.zh: 用作零模型比较对照基线的逐年语料统计。

scbcda5febf.en: The full point-cloud embedding of sampled units used for the taxonomy map, with region labels. Largest file on the site.
scbcda5febf.zh: 分类体系地图所用抽样单元的完整点云嵌入，带区域标签。站上最大的文件。

s54209d7f48.en: Rate at which objections are phrased as questions vs. assertions, by object.
s54209d7f48.zh: 异议以问句而非断言表述的比率，按对象划分。

sa3a41f71f2.en: The within-review itinerary — which objects get visited, and in what order.
sa3a41f71f2.zh: 评审内的行程——哪些对象被造访，以何种顺序。

s95032b3038.en: Maps reasoning standards to the objects they're applied to and the verdict severity that follows.
s95032b3038.zh: 把推理标准映射到其所施用的对象，以及随之而来的判定严厉度。

s0e0bb0438d.en: The score cost of each criticism type, modeled as a volume-response slope.
s0e0bb0438d.zh: 每类批评的评分代价，建模为数量-响应斜率。

s0467344bc8.en: Whether an objection persists, gets addressed, or drops across the rebuttal cycle, by object.
s0467344bc8.zh: 一条异议在 rebuttal 周期中是延续、被回应还是消失，按对象划分。

s5a64bec282.en: LLM-era traces over 199,031 raw reviews 2018–2026: frozen marker-word excess per year, co-review convergence, and the marked-review profile battery.
s5a64bec282.zh: 199,031 篇原始评审（2018–2026）上的 LLM 时代痕迹：冻结标记词表的逐年超额、同稿评审趋同，以及被标记评审的画像指标组。

sabddd212d5.en: Score-gap ("lottery") analysis of how much reviewer assignment appears to affect outcome.
sabddd212d5.zh: 评分差距（“抽签”）分析：审稿人分派看起来对结果影响多大。

s36c77ada89.en: Era profiles of reviewer behavior: rhetoric-form usage by year and the nine-year vital signs behind Fig. 26c.
s36c77ada89.zh: 审稿人行为的时代画像：修辞形式的逐年使用情况，以及图 26c 背后的九年生命体征。

s415dae5d19.en: Real-vs-synthetic reviewer-profile comparison behind the weak-results ("null cabinet") appendix.
s415dae5d19.zh: 弱结果附录（“零假设陈列柜”）背后的真实与合成审稿人画像比较。

s451e8715b7.en: Classification of rebuttal moves (concede, rebut, clarify, and so on) and the effort behind each.
s451e8715b7.zh: rebuttal 招式的分类（让步、反驳、澄清等）及每种招式背后的投入。

s1d5d1d8747.en: Object–standard coupling in the early era (2018–20) vs the late era (2024–26), with the shuffle-null floor behind Plate II’s 138/144.
s1d5d1d8747.zh: 早期时代（2018–20）与晚期时代（2024–26）的对象–标准耦合，以及图版 II 的 138/144 背后的置换零底线。

scd3622e21b.en: Outcome prediction by research area, against a baseline model.
scd3622e21b.zh: 按研究领域的结果预测，对照基线模型。

sb828cd966e.en: How often a meta-reviewer's final decision overrules the panel's aggregate score.
sb828cd966e.zh: 元评审人的最终决定推翻评审组汇总评分的频率。

sa9395ab194.en: Plates I, XV, XVII, XX, App. II

s0e970fb1c9.en: Cross-cutting panel statistics: rebuttal outcomes, criticism-count "gauntlet," per-standard confidence intervals, meta-reviewer behavior, dissent, and taxonomy reliability.
s0e970fb1c9.zh: 横跨各图版的评审组统计：rebuttal 结局、批评数“夹道”、逐标准置信区间、元评审人行为、异见，以及分类体系信度。

s24c7265465.en: Catalogue of the specific fixes reviewers suggest, grouped by kind.
s24c7265465.zh: 审稿人建议的具体修复目录，按类型分组。

s7861e67f11.en: Stability sweep behind the repair catalogue: the same 80,000 asks re-clustered at k = 11–44; “extend the evidence” leads at every k, family sums move by under 5 points.
s7861e67f11.zh: 修复目录背后的稳定性扫描：同样的 80,000 条要求在 k = 11–44 下重新聚类；“扩展证据”在每个 k 下都领先，各族合计变动不足 5 个百分点。

sffd2d6add1.en: How much a panel's reviewers' repertoire of standards overlaps or clashes, by year.
sffd2d6add1.zh: 评审组各审稿人的标准库有多大重叠或冲突，按年份划分。

s6fad058cf4.en: The induced rhetorical-form taxonomy (600 analyst-labeled units) and its validation.
s6fad058cf4.zh: 归纳得到的修辞形式分类体系（600 个分析者标注的单元）及其验证。

s2c6aaed692.en: Raw review scores matched to review text, by rating.
s2c6aaed692.zh: 与评审文本匹配的原始评审分数，按评分划分。

s32d0622241.en: How much review depth and detail scales with the score given — dispersion and coverage by rating.
s32d0622241.zh: 评审的深度与细节随所给分数变化的程度——按评分的离散度与覆盖度。

scc41b7e4e2.en: How much of the twelve-object space a panel collectively covers vs. leaves unseen.
scc41b7e4e2.zh: 评审组合起来覆盖了十二对象空间的多少，又留下多少未见。

s48c75a3484.en: Daily submission and review-activity time series; not currently rendered on any plate.
s48c75a3484.zh: 每日投稿与评审活动时间序列；目前未在任何图版上呈现。

sc54460b725.en: The structural arc of a review — opening move, positional transitions, and length.
sc54460b725.zh: 一篇评审的结构弧线——开篇、位置间转移与长度。

s6cb1530256.en: The shape of author-reviewer rebuttal threads — whether and how the reviewer returns.
s6cb1530256.zh: 作者与审稿人 rebuttal 讨论串的形状——审稿人是否回来、如何回来。

s1668aeeffb.en: A 2025-vs-2026 comparison series; not currently rendered on any plate.
s1668aeeffb.zh: 2025 与 2026 的对比序列；目前未在任何图版上呈现。

sc15218697d.en: Which reasoning standards read as stable in phrasing across nine years, and which drifted.
sc15218697d.zh: 哪些推理标准在九年间措辞读来稳定，哪些发生了漂移。

se3d7823715.en: Bootstrap confidence intervals on the score effect of each criticism type, by object.
se3d7823715.zh: 每类批评评分效应的 bootstrap 置信区间，按对象划分。

s62b0935289.en: Plates I, II, XII, XXX, App. II

s72a005fbea.en: Core taxonomy definitions, headline KPIs, and sample specimen reviews most plates draw from.
s72a005fbea.zh: 核心分类体系定义、头条指标，以及多数图版取用的标本评审样例。

s613a894277.en: How much post-rebuttal units strengthen, weaken, or reverse the pre-response judgment.
s613a894277.zh: rebuttal 后的单元在多大程度上加强、减弱或反转回应前的判断。

s40bbf31158.zh: 50 个文件 · 合计 5.17 MB · 全为 JSON · 由 /api/v1/data/ 提供

sc22af66b41.en: Catalogue of every API endpoint, plus the plate and data-island lists.
sc22af66b41.zh: 全部 API 端点的目录，以及图版与数据岛清单。

s1bf645f77e.en: Machine-readable schema for the whole API layer.
s1bf645f77e.zh: 整个 API 层的机器可读模式。

s26913c09d1.en: The entry point written for an AI reader — how to use the API, and the one caveat that applies across the whole corpus.
s26913c09d1.zh: 为 AI 读者写的入口——如何使用 API，以及适用于整个语料的那一条注意事项。

s569827a7ef.en: The correction ledger — every published claim later found wrong, with what the check showed and the corrected reading, mirroring method §10.
s569827a7ef.zh: 更正记录——每条事后发现有误的已发布断言，附核查结果与更正后的读法，与方法页 §10 对应。

sc38f7d17bb.en: Human-readable documentation for every endpoint above, in the same visual language as this page's data.
sc38f7d17bb.zh: 上述每个端点的人读文档，与本页数据采用同一套视觉语言。

s75ac1e90d2.en:
Cite the atlas as a whole for general reference. For a specific number, cite the plate and claim
  it came from — that resolves to the exact derivation and recompute script behind it, and stays
  correct even if the caption prose around it is later rewritten.
s75ac1e90d2.zh: 一般性引用请引图谱整体。引用某个具体数字时，请引它所出自的图版与断言——这会解析到其背后的确切推导与重算脚本，即便周围的图注文字日后改写也仍然正确。

s29ca08a6a4.en: Citing the atlas as a whole Takagi, Shiro (UNKTOK). Atlas of Judgment: a metascience instrument reading the reasoning inside ICLR peer review, 2018–2026. 2026. https://atlas-of-judgment.pages.dev
s29ca08a6a4.zh: 引用图谱整体 Takagi, Shiro (UNKTOK). Atlas of Judgment: a metascience instrument reading the reasoning inside ICLR peer review, 2018–2026. 2026. https://atlas-of-judgment.pages.dev

sc96eb8a8e6.en: Citing one claim Cite its plate id and claim id — for example plate-i#1a-negative-share — which resolves via /api/v1/plates/<plate-id>.json to the exact statement, numeric value, source data island, and recompute script behind it.
sc96eb8a8e6.zh: 引用单条断言 引其图版 id 与断言 id——例如 plate-i#1a-negative-share——它经由 /api/v1/plates/<plate-id>.json 解析到其背后的确切陈述、数值、来源数据岛与重算脚本。

s4c2ee1fa42.en: Scoring itself changed instrument four times between 2018 and 2026 — any citation comparing a score (not a unit count or share) across years should carry that caveat. See the moving-ruler note in method.html §07.
s4c2ee1fa42.zh: 评分本身在 2018 到 2026 年间换了四次仪器——任何跨年比较评分（而非单元数或份额）的引用都应附上这条注意事项。见 method.html §07 的移动标尺说明。

s43b67e10d1.en: A correction is part of the instrument, not an embarrassment to it. A claim that a later check overturns is corrected in place on its plate, recorded in method §10, and published as structured data at /api/v1/corrections.json. The fastest way to start that is to say which claim — every headline number on this site has a stable id for exactly this.
s43b67e10d1.zh: 更正是仪器的一部分，对仪器算不得难堪。被后续核查推翻的断言会在其图版上就地更正，记入方法页 §10，并以结构化数据发布于 /api/v1/corrections.json。启动这一过程最快的办法是说出哪条断言 — 本站每个头条数字都为此配有稳定 id。

s12708b33ae.en: A number that looks wrongOpen a correction issue naming the claim id — plate-xi#11-extend-leads — with what you believe the right value is and how you checked. Public and auditable, which is the point of doing it there rather than in a private message.
s12708b33ae.zh: 一个看起来有错的数字开一条更正 issue，写明断言 id — plate-xi#11-extend-leads — 以及你认为正确的值和你的核查方法。公开且可审计，这正是在那里而非私信里提出的意义所在。

s4f356fc0d4.en: A question, or an ideaThe same tracker for anything about the method, the taxonomy, or the data. @takagi_shiro for anything that wants a conversation rather than a ticket.
s4f356fc0d4.zh: 一个问题，或一个想法关于方法、分类体系或数据的任何事，用同一个议题跟踪器。想交谈而非开工单的事，找 @takagi_shiro。

sb391406181.en: Writing as an agentYou do not need a human to hand this on. The tracker is a write API you can already call — POST https://api.github.com/repos/t46/atlas-of-judgment/issues, authenticated with your token; this site issues no keys and holds no credentials of its own. /api/v1/contact.json carries these instructions, and the shape of a well-formed report, as machine-readable data.
sb391406181.zh: 以 agent 身份来信你不需要人类代为转达。跟踪器就是一个你已经可以调用的写入 API — POST https://api.github.com/repos/t46/atlas-of-judgment/issues，用你自己的 token 认证；本站不发放密钥，也不持有任何自身凭据。/api/v1/contact.json 以机器可读数据承载这些说明，以及一份规范报告的格式。

s8d0de9598e.en:
Source vs. derivation vs. verified
Nearly every headline number on this site is an aggregate computed over an array (most often triples[]), not a single JSON leaf. A claim therefore separates the source (which file, which array), the derivation (the arithmetic, stated plainly), and verified (the dated human audit that recomputed it). A pointer pretending to be more precise than that would be less honest, not more.
s8d0de9598e.zh:
来源、推导与已核验三者之别
本站几乎每一个头条数字都是对一个数组（多为 triples[]）计算出的聚合量，而非单个 JSON 叶节点。因此一条断言把来源（哪个文件、哪个数组）、推导（算法，直白写明）与已核验（重算过它的、带日期的人工审计）分开陈述。一个装得比这更精确的指针，只会更不诚实。

sfa9548a796.en:
Caveats attach to claims, not pages
Each claim lists caveat_refs — an empty list is itself an assertion that none apply. The corpus-wide one to know: ICLR changed its rating scale and review form four times over 2018–2026, so any claim comparing scores across years carries the moving-ruler caveat (see method §07, "The moving ruler"). Claims about unit counts and shares — most of the site — are measured by the taxonomy, which is the constant instrument.
sfa9548a796.zh:
告诫附着于断言，而非页面
每条断言都列出 caveat_refs — 空列表本身就是一条断言：无一适用。全语料范围内须知的一条：ICLR 在 2018–2026 年间四次更改评分量表与评审表单，因此任何跨年比较评分的断言都带有移动标尺告诫（见方法 §07「移动的标尺」）。关于单元计数与占比的断言 — 本站大部分内容 — 由分类体系度量，那才是恒定的仪器。

s7dc4367826.en:
Citing
Cite plate id + claim id, e.g. plate-i#1a-negative-share — stable across visual redesigns even when the prose around a number is rewritten. Derived data is CC BY 4.0; the underlying reviews belong to their anonymous authors via OpenReview.
s7dc4367826.zh:
引用方式
请引用图版 id + 断言 id，例如 plate-i#1a-negative-share — 视觉改版后依然稳定，即便数字周围的文字被重写。衍生数据采用 CC BY 4.0 许可；底层评审经由 OpenReview 归其匿名作者所有。
